Aguas Andinas S.A. is a subsidiary of Inversiones Aguas Metropolitanas S.A.

Name: Natura Cosméticos S.A.
Description: Natura Cosméticos S.A. engages in the development manufacture distribution and marketing of cosmetics fragrances and personal hygiene products in Brazil Peru Colombia Chile Argentina Uruguay and Ecuador. It offers its products through retail markets e-commerce business-to-business and franchise channels under the Avon and Natura brands. Natura Cosméticos S.A. was founded in 1969 and is headquartered in São Paulo Brazil.

Name: Cosumar SA
Description: Cosumar SA together with its subsidiaries produces packages and markets sugar products in Morocco. The company offers white sugar refines raw sugar granulated sugar sugar loaf sugar cubes and the ingot as well as molasses pellets and bagasse under the ENMER brand name. The company was founded in 1929 and is headquartered in Casablanca Morocco.

Name: Seera Holding Group
Description: Seera Holding Group together with its subsidiaries provides travel and tourism services in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia the United Kingdom Egypt the United Arab Emirates Spain and Kuwait. The company operates through five segments: Ticketing Tourism Transportation Hospitality and Property Rentals. It offers air ferry and train ticketing services; hotel booking and package holidays services and room rental; transportation Hajj and Umrah education furnished suites and hotels and shipping services; and property rental car rental and other services as well as chartered flights and delivery of shipments and rooms and food and beverages services. The company is also involved in the events management ownership and operation aircraft travel and cargo real estate and sports activities. In addition it provides telecommunications and SMS and/MMS services. Further the company offers information technology support advertising drivers professional fee insurance brokerage triptyque and international driving license services. It markets its products and services under the Discover Saudi Almosafer Mawasim and Lumi brands. The company was formerly known as Al Tayyar Travel Group Holding Company and changed its name to Seera Holding Group in April 2019. Seera Holding Group was founded in 1979 and is headquartered in Riyadh the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

Name: Formula Systems (1985) Ltd.
Description: Formula Systems (1985) Ltd. through its subsidiaries provides proprietary and non-proprietary software solutions Information Technologies (IT) professional services software product marketing and support computer infrastructure and integration solutions and learning and integration. It offers IT software solutions and services and consulting and management services; computer and communication infrastructure solutions; software solutions web world content management database and data warehouse mining application integration database and systems data management and software development tools; and developers and professional training and soft skills and management training services. The company also provides property and casualty insurance platforms such as Sapiens CoreSuite and Sapiens IDITSuite; life pension and annuities platforms including Sapiens Sapiens CoreSuite Sapiens UnderwritingPro Sapiens ApplicationPro Sapiens IllustrationPro and Sapiens ConsolidationMaster; Sapiens Cloud-based DigitalSuite; data and analytics platform; and reinsurance software solutions comprising Sapiens ReinsuranceMaster Sapiens ReinsurancePro and Sapiens Reinsurance GO. In addition it offers Sapiens workers’ compensation solutions; Sapiens medical professional liability solutions; financial and compliance solutions such as Sapiens FinancialPro Sapiens Financial GO Sapiens StatementPro Sapiens CheckPro and Sapiens Reporting Tools; Sapiens Decision an enterprise-scale platform; technology-based solutions; application development and business process integration platforms; vertical software solutions; cloud-based services; strategic consulting and outsourcing services; and professional services as well as sells and markets computers and peripheral equipment and cloud computing solutions. The company was incorporated in 1985 and is headquartered in Or Yehuda Israel.

Name: Isrotel Ltd.
Description: Isrotel Ltd. operates and manages a chain of hotels in Israel. It operates hotels with various facilities comprising rooms and suites lobby dining rooms restaurants conference halls business lounge pubs shops swimming pools health and fitness clubs spas wine bars movie theaters etc. The company also provides various vacation facilities. Isrotel Ltd. was incorporated in 1980 and is based in Tel Aviv Israel.

Name: Auren Energia S.A.
Description: Auren Energia S.A. engages in the investment platform for the management operation acquisition development and construction of energy generation transmission and trading assets in Brazil. The company also operates wind solar and hydropower generation as well as in the sale of energy. The company was formerly known as VTRM Energia Participações S.A. and changed its name to Auren Energia S.A. in March 2022. Auren Energia S.A. is headquartered in São Paulo Brazil.
Industry: Independent Power and Renewable Electricity Producers

Name: Redefine Properties Limited
Description: Redefine Properties Limited is a Real Estate Investment Trust (REIT) with a sectoral and geographically diversified property asset platform valued at R99.4 billion (FY24: R99.6 billion). Redefines portfolio is predominately anchored in South Africa through directly held and managed retail office and industrial properties which is complemented by a strong presence in retail and logistics property assets in Poland. Redefines purpose to create and manage spaces in a way that transforms lives requires more than a business-as-usual approach: it requires an integrated approach to making strategic choices that will sustain value creation for all stakeholders by putting people and purpose at the heart of what we do and focusing on what matters most by executing on our strategic priorities. Redefine is listed on the Johannesburg Stock Exchange (JSE) with a market capitalisation of R31.7 billion (FY24: R33.6 billion). By volume Redefines shares are among the most actively traded in the SA REIT sector making it a highly liquid single-entry point for investors to gain exposure to the South African and Polish real estate markets. Redefines local property asset platform is valued at R65.4 billion (FY24: R64.7 billion). The offshore real estate investments are valued at R34.0 billion (FY24: R34.9 billion) representing 34.2% (FY24: 35.0%) of the group total property asset platform which provides geographic diversification through retail logistics and self-storage property assets in Poland. The marginal decrease in the value of the property asset platform during the period is primarily due to the appreciation of the rand and the disposal of non-core assets offset by the fair value gain of the investment properties of R0.5 billion and the expansion of an additional 10 673m2 of gross lettable area (GLA) at Pan Africa Mall (PAN) for R0.3 billion.

Name: Bicecorp S.A.
Description: Bicecorp S.A. provides various financial products and services in Chile. The company provides personal and business banking services treasury services deposit collections checking accounts credit and debit cards foreign trade activities capital and project financing leasing operation services document discounting mortgage and consumer loans and products and services related to investments and savings. It offers insurance products including private and pension annuities individual insurance group life health and deductions mass insurance and AFP insurance products. In addition the company factoring mortgage mutual funds automotive financing and leasing asset securitization investment banking and real estate asset management services. The company was incorporated in 1978 and is based in Las Condes Chile. Bicecorp S.A. operates as a subsidiary of Servicios Y Consultoria Ltda.

Name: Beyon B.S.C.
Description: Beyon B.S.C. together with its subsidiaries engages in the provision of public telecommunications and associated products and services in the Kingdom of Bahrain Jordan Maldives Sure and internationally. The company offers mobile data communication fixed broadband fixed line and other related services. It also engages in the provision of digital financial security and solution services; selling and buying shares and securities; call center activities; real estate services; renewable energy; investment businesses; trades in computers and peripheral equipment. In addition the company provides webhosting data processing and cloud computing services; IT services; information technology consultancy services; computer and electric devices; and computer infrastructure services. The company was formerly known as Bahrain Telecommunications Company BSC and changed its name to Beyon B.S.C. in September 2024. Beyon B.S.C. was incorporated in 1981 and is headquartered in Manama the Kingdom of Bahrain.

Name: Akdital S.A
Description: Akdital S.A operates hospitals in Morocco. Its portfolio of treatments includes surgery oncology cardiology maternity and radiology as well as multidisciplinary healthcare facilities. It operates private hospitals multidisciplinary and specialized clinics and oncology centers. The company was founded in 2011 and is headquartered in Casablanca Morocco.

Name: Doha Bank Q.P.S.C.
Description: Doha Bank Q.P.S.C. together with its subsidiaries provides various banking products and services to individual and corporate clients in Qatar India and internationally. It operates through two segments: Conventional Banking and Insurance Activities. The Conventional Banking segment offers a range of products and services to business and corporate customers including funded and non-funded credit deposits to corporate customers. It also undertakes funding and centralized risk management activities through borrowings; issues debt securities; uses derivatives for risk management purposes; and invests in liquid assets such as short-term placements and corporate and government debt securities. In addition this segment provides loans including housing and other personal loans; credit and debit cards; current savings and deposit accounts; and other transactions to individuals. The Insurance Activities segment offers contracts of insurance and carries out contracts of insurance. This segment also provides health car travel accident education and medical insurance. It also provides asset and investment management financing wealth planning trade advisory investment brokerage and retirement plans services as well as mobile internet and SMS banking services. Doha Bank Q.P.S.C. was incorporated in 1979 and is headquartered in Doha Qatar.

Name: The Tel-Aviv Stock Exchange Ltd.
Description: The Tel-Aviv Stock Exchange Ltd. operates as a stock exchange in Israel. The company offers markets for the listing and trading of a range of securities and derivative instruments including stocks corporate bonds government bonds treasury bills structured bonds exchange traded funds (ETFs) convertible securities mutual funds commodities options and futures. It also engages in the clearing and settlement of securities; capital and debt raising; and dual listing activities as well as operates trading platform for the buying and selling of a range of securities and other financial instruments. In addition the company provides initial and follow on public offerings data hub conference centers and data store services. Further it offers nominee portfolio and connectivity services; trading arena for technology real estate and other companies; and holds license to distribute and process the data. The Tel-Aviv Stock Exchange Ltd. was founded in 1935 and is based in Tel Aviv-Yafo Israel.

Name: Sendas Distribuidora S.A.
Description: Sendas Distribuidora S.A. engages in the retail and wholesale sale of food products bazaar items and other products in Brazil. The company offers grocery food perishable beverage wrapping and hygiene products; and parking air-conditioned well-lit environments and butcher services. It serves restaurants pizzerias snack bars schools small businesses religious institutions hospitals hotels grocery stores neighborhood supermarkets and individuals. The company sells its products through brick-and-mortar stores as well as telesales. The company was founded in 1974 and is headquartered in Rio De Janeiro Brazil.

Name: Phoenix Group Plc
Description: Phoenix Group Plc together with its subsidiaries provides crypto and cloud mining services in the United Arab Emirates Oman CIS Canada the United States and internationally. The company engages in digital currency and bitcoin mining; cloud hosting; data center hosting; crypto trading; electronic currency design and programming; development operation management maintenance and leasing of data centers; and operation and maintenance of data center equipment. It also provides M2 a digital asset trading platform; cloud services; insurance; internet and multimedia consultancy; and software service solutions. In addition the company trades in computing machines computer and peripheral equipment computer outfits computer systems and software data processing telecommunication equipment and spare parts; leases robots and smart machines; and invests into commercial enterprises related to cloud mining. Further it distributes MicroBT crypto mining equipment digital wallet ledgers and CoolWallets. Phoenix Group Plc was founded in 2017 and is headquartered in Dubai the United Arab Emirates.

Name: Cosan S.A.
Description: Cosan S.A. engages in the fuel distribution business. It operates through Raízen Compass Moove Rumo and Radar segments. The company’s Raízen segment engages in the production commercialization origination and trading of sugar as well as ethanol under the Shell brand; production and commercialization of bioenergy; trading and resale of electricity; and distribution and commercialization of fuels and lubricants. Its Compass segment distributes piped natural gas to industrial residential commercial automotive and cogeneration customers; and develops infrastructure projects in a regasification terminal offshore gas pipeline and thermal generation projects utilizing natural gas as well as the sale of electricity and natural gas. The company’s Moove segment produces and distributes lubricants under the Mobil brand and Comma trademark for industrial commercial and passenger/cargo vehicles. Its Rumo segment provides logistics services for storage and port loading of commodities including grains and sugar; and leases locomotives wagons and other railroad equipment as well as operates containers. The company’s Radar segment manages agricultural property. The company operates in Brazil England France Spain Portugal Argentina Bolivia Uruguay Paraguay the United States Asia and internationally. Cosan S.A. was founded in 1936 and is headquartered in São Paulo Brazil.

Name: Enerya Enerji Anonim Sirketi
Description: Enerya Enerji Anonim Sirketi together with its subsidiaries engages in the wholesale and retail distribution of natural gas in Turkey. The company also offers operational and consultancy services. It serves residential and industrial customers. Enerya Enerji Anonim Sirketi was founded in 2003 and is headquartered in Istanbul Turkey. Enerya Enerji Anonim Sirketi is a subsidiary of Ahlatci Dogal Gaz Dagitim Enerji ve Yatirim A.S.

Name: National Medical Care Company
Description: National Medical Care Company establishes owns equips manages maintains and operates healthcare facilities in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. The company operates Care Medical Rawabi; Care Medical Malaz; Care Company for Pharmaceutical and Medical Distribution; and Braya Al-Taifi Center for Rehabilitation. It also provides home healthcare services. The company was founded in 2003 and is based in Riyadh the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

Name: Central Puerto S.A.
Description: Central Puerto S.A. engages in the electric power generation activities in Argentina. It operates in four segments: Electric Power Generation from Conventional Sources; Electric Power Generation from Renewable Sources; Natural Gas Transport and Distribution; and Forest Activity. The company’s power generation assets include combined cycle gas and steam turbine co-generation hydroelectric wind turbine and solar power plants. It also engages in the natural gas transport and distribution; forestry; and mining businesses. The company was incorporated in 1992 and is based in Buenos Aires Argentina.
Industry: Independent Power and Renewable Electricity Producers

Name: Cyrela Brazil Realty S.A. Empreendimentos e Participações
Description: Cyrela Brazil Realty S.A. Empreendimentos e Participações engages in the development and construction of residential properties in Brazil. The company also provides real estate services such as construction management and technical consultancy services. Cyrela Brazil Realty S.A. Empreendimentos e Participações was founded in 1962 and is headquartered in São Paulo Brazil.

Name: National Industrialization Company
Description: National Industrialization Company operates in the petrochemicals chemicals plastics and metals sectors in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia rest of the Middle East Asia Africa Europe and internationally. The company offers acetic acid butanol liquid fuel butyl acrylate glacial acrylic acid iso-butanol and normal butanol; high- and low-density polyethylene; polyethylene and polypropylene compound; pyrolysis oil; and superabsorbent polymer. It also provides BOPP films car batteries HDPE pipes plastic pallets agrifilm road barrier and water tanks plastic sheets geomembrane liners battery cases and covers plastic paint pails reprocessed resins and lead as well as technical inspection HSE auditing and certification management and technical training calibration food testing and product certification services. In addition the company offers titanium sponge titanium slag and sulphate fines and pig iron. Further it provides application development analytical labs technical support and training and certifications and accreditations services. Additionally the company offers ethylene propylene acrylic acid acrylic sheets industrial membranes industrial dyes and paints and accumulators. Furthermore it operates water desalination and power generation plants; and wholesale of chemical fertilizers and livestock feed for pharmaceutical feed additives as well as involves in recycling of industrial used batteries. The company was founded in 1984 and is headquartered in Riyadh the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

Name: Anadolu Efes Biracilik ve Malt Sanayii Anonim Sirketi
Description: Anadolu Efes Biracilik ve Malt Sanayii Anonim Sirketi together with its subsidiaries engages in the production bottling distribution marketing and sale of beer malt non-carbonated and non-alcoholic beverages in Turkey and internationally. The company operates in two segments Beer and Soft Drinks. It offers carbonated and low alcoholic drinks water fruit juice concentrates purees and fresh fruit sports drinks energy drinks iced teas and coffee. The company also leases intellectual property and related products; and provides a range of sparkling and still beverages under the Coca-Cola Company trademark. Anadolu Efes Biracilik ve Malt Sanayii Anonim Sirketi was incorporated in 1966 and is based in Istanbul Turkey.

Name: CATRION Catering Holding Company
Description: CATRION Catering Holding Company together with its subsidiaries offers catering and other support services to flights operated by Saudi Arabian and other airlines in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. The company operates through two segments: Flight Catering and Integrated Hospitality. It offers in-flight catering services; and manages airport lounges. In addition the company provides catering accommodation management laundry and cleaning services to companies in remote sites; and on-platform and onboard catering services for passengers in rail terminals. Further it offers catering services to private sector firms and government offices as well as hospitals and clinics; commercial laundry services to airlines hotels industrial operations hospitals and other clients; Hajj and Umrah catering services; and security services. Additionally the company provides SkySales an in-flight shopping service. CATRION Catering Holding Company was formerly known as Saudi Airlines Catering Company and changed its name to CATRION Catering Holding Company in October 2023. The company was founded in 1981 and is headquartered in Jeddah the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

Name: Boxer Retail Limited
Description: Boxer Retail Limited operates a chain of supermarkets in South Africa and Eswatini. It offers a range of alcoholic beverages and products including beer malt cider cordials spirits cigarettes tobacco and ice and snacks as well as perishables and fresh foods comprising butchery bakery delicatessen fruit and vegetables health and beauty products and general merchandise. The company was founded in 1977 and is based in Westville South Africa. Boxer Retail Limited operates as a subsidiary of Pick n Pay Retailers Proprietary Limited.

Name: OQ Gas Networks SAOG
Description: OQ Gas Networks SAOG acquires constructs operates maintains repairs and augments gas transportation pipelines and other related activities in Oman. OQ Gas Networks SAOG was incorporated in 2000 and is headquartered in Muscat Oman. OQ Gas Networks SAOG operates as a subsidiary of OQ SAOC.

Name: Aura Investments Ltd.
Description: Aura Investments Ltd. together with its subsidiaries engages in locating initiating planning and construction of residential real estate projects in Israel and internationally. The company develops urban renewal projects as well as entrepreneurial residential projects and housing units. It also renting managing and maintaining real estate properties. The company was incorporated in 1992 and is based in Tel Aviv Israel.

Name: Alupar Investimento S.A.
Description: Alupar Investimento S.A. together with its subsidiaries engages in the transmission generation and commercialization of energy in Brazil Colombia Peru and Chile. It operates through Transmission and Generation segments. The company holds a stake in concessions for 42 electricity transmission systems totaling 9578 km of transmission lines; and operates overhead lines and substations. It is also involved in the generation of renewable energy through hydroelectric plants wind farms and photovoltaic power plants which have an installed capacity of 798.5 MW. The company was incorporated in 2006 and is headquartered in São Paulo Brazil. Alupar Investimento S.A. is a subsidiary of Guarupart Participações Ltda.

Name: Companhia de Eletricidade do Estado da Bahia - COELBA
Description: Companhia de Eletricidade do Estado da Bahia - COELBA engages in the distribution of electricity. The company was founded in 1960 and is headquartered in Salvador Brazil. Companhia de Eletricidade do Estado da Bahia - COELBA is a subsidiary of Iberdrola S.A.

Name: Oman Telecommunications Company SAOG
Description: Oman Telecommunications Company SAOG together with its subsidiaries establishes operates develops and maintains telecommunication services in the Sultanate of Oman and internationally. It offers mobile services including postpaid prepaid data and other services and add-ons; fixed line session initiation protocol trunk fixed-mobile CPN international and conference call services and digital voice services; Internet services such as 5G fiber pro and internet plans for schools and colleges; and business solutions comprising bill analyzers and network performance management portal. The company also provides cloud computing services such as cloud and data center software as a service platform as a service infrastructure as a service managed unified communications and collaborations cyber security and internet of things and artificial intelligence. In addition it provides connectivity solutions such as multi-protocol label switching ethernet national leased line international private leased circuits very small aperture terminal and Inmarsat services. Further the company offers home services value added services permit services and other services. Oman Telecommunications Company SAOG was founded in 1980 and is headquartered in Muscat the Sultanate of Oman.

Name: National Company for Learning and Education
Description: National Company for Learning and Education owns establishes manages and operates kindergarten primary middle and secondary schools in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. The company operates 11 integrated educational complexes using the Saudi national curriculum as well as American international curriculum under the Tarbya Namouthajiya Schools brand. It also invests in sports entertainment and sports clubs for school students. The company was formerly known as Tarniyah Namouthajiyah Schools Company and changed its name to National Company for Learning and Education in 2004. The company was incorporated in 1958 and is headquartered in Riyadh the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

Name: Al Ansari Financial Services PJSC
Description: Al Ansari Financial Services PJSC together with its subsidiaries operates as an integrated financial services company in the United Arab Emirates and internationally. The company offers cross-border payments and payment technology solutions to consumers and businesses in the payments and foreign exchange and remittance markets. It also provides remittance services such as domestic and international money transfer services through money remittance platforms money transfer operator partners and transfer payment networks. The company’s money remittance platforms include Cash Express Global Fund Transfer and Worldwide Cash Express. In addition it provides retail and wholesale foreign currency exchange services including the sale and purchase of foreign currency; bank notes services in various currencies; and TravelCard and FlexiblePay which are reloadable pre-paid cards that can store single or multiple currencies. Further the company offers wage protection system a corporate payroll solution that executes wage payments on behalf of companies; bills payment; and cash management solutions. It serves retail and corporate customers. The company was founded in 1966 and is based in Dubai the United Arab Emirates. Al Ansari Financial Services PJSC is a subsidiary of Al Ansari Holding LLC.

Name: Margün Enerji Üretim Sanayi ve Ticaret A.S.
Description: Margün Enerji Üretim Sanayi ve Ticaret A.S. engages in the establishment and commissioning of solar power plants to generate electricity from renewable energy sources in Turkey and internationally. It also establishes and contracts power generation facilities; and operates a solar power plant with an installed capacity of 118.03 MWp and 61 MWp. The company is also involved in provision of repair and maintenance and software services. The company was incorporated in 2014 and is headquartered in Ankara Turkey. Margün Enerji Üretim Sanayi ve Ticaret Anonim Sirketi is a subsidiary of Esenboga Elektrik Üretim A.S.
Industry: Independent Power and Renewable Electricity Producers

Name: CIBC Caribbean Bank Limited
Description: CIBC Caribbean Bank Limited together with its subsidiaries provides various banking and financial products and services in Barbados and internationally. It operates through Personal and Business Banking Corporate Banking and Wealth Management and Administration segments. The company offers chequing and savings business interest and corporate business accounts; fixed deposits and investment products; personal overdraft facility merchant services and business overdraft services business premium loans and commercial mortgage services; letters of credit; and bonds guarantees and indemnities. It also provides cash management services such as corporate online mastercard prepaid online bill acceptance and e-pay services; and investment banking products and services including financing solutions and trade finance treasury finance and other banking services. In addition the company offers home and auto home construction mortgage indemnity business insurance and credit insurance protection products; loans such as land vehicle personal student and renewable energy; private business and corporate banking services; investment advisory; fiduciary and fund; portfolio management services; credit and debit cards; ATMs; and online banking and mobile application services. The company serves individuals large and mid-size corporate businesses governments financial institutions international trading companies and private wealth vehicles. The company was formerly known as FirstCaribbean International Bank Limited and changed its name to CIBC Caribbean Bank Limited in July 2024. CIBC Caribbean Bank Limited was founded in 1836 and is headquartered in St Michael Barbados. CIBC Caribbean Bank Limited is a subsidiary of CIBC Investments (Cayman) Limited.

Name: Grupo Lamosa S.A.B. de C.V.
Description: Grupo Lamosa S.A.B. de C.V. together with its subsidiaries engages in the design manufacture and distribution of ceramic and porcelain products for floor and wall coverings and adhesive for coatings in North America Central America South America and Europe. The company operates through Coatings and Adhesives and Insulators segments. It offers floors and wall tiles; and adhesives for floors and walls grouting agents jointers stuccos additives waterproofing and specialized materials. The company was founded in 1890 and is based in San Pedro Garza García Mexico.

Name: Savola Group Company
Description: Savola Group Company together with its subsidiaries produces markets and distributes food products. It operates through five segments: Food Processing Retail Food Services Frozen Food and Investments. The company offers sugar pasta spices nuts pulses and other food products as well as sugar spices nuts and pulses. It also engages in the agro cultivation services and maintenance retail trading and distribution trading and distribution of seafood products restaurant renewable energy e-commerce and real estate activities as well as investments in equity-accounted investees and other investments activities. In addition it retails grocery products through a network of hyper markets supermarkets and convenience stores. Savola Group Company was founded in 1978 and is headquartered in Jeddah the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

Name: Geregu Power Plc
Description: Geregu Power Plc engages in the generation and sale of electric power through the National Grid of the Transmission Company of Nigeria to the Nigerian Bulk Electricity Trading. The company was incorporated in 2006 and is headquartered in Lagos Nigeria. Geregu Power Plc is a subsidiary of Amperion Power Distribution Company Limited.

Name: Migros Ticaret A.S.
Description: Migros Ticaret A.S. engages in the retail sale of food and beverages consumer and durables goods in Turkey. It operates stores under the Migros and Macrocenter names. The company also operates Migros Sanal Market a food retail e-commerce website; Tazedirekt.com a food shopping website; Migros Hemen an online grocery application; products under the Anadolu Lezzetleri and Migros Toptan brand name; a network of restaurant under the Migros Yemek name; cosmetics-store format under the Mion name; and a retail media company under the Mimeda name. In addition it offers ready-to-cook products under the Migros Uzman Kasap name; Money Card that provides discounts in money shopping earning money campaigns and transportation; and MoneyPay a mobile application for financial solutions. Further the company EV charging service in the parking lots of select stores; logistics solutions; ready-to-eat meals under the Gurmepack brand; pet products under the Petimo name; and smart financial solutions under the Nakitera brand name. The company was founded in 1954 and is headquartered in Istanbul Turkey.

Name: Gulf Navigation Holding PJSC
Description: Gulf Navigation Holding PJSC together with its subsidiaries operates as a shipping and maritime company in the United Arab Emirates. It operates through Vessel Chartering; and Shipping and Technical Services segments. The company offers sea transport services for oil and petroleum products; and ship charter sea freight and passenger charter and shipping lines shipping sea shipping lines agent clearing and forwarding cargo loading and unloading cargo packaging and sea cargo services. It also provides transportation and storage solutions including offshore logistics services comprising well stimulation platform supply and anchor handling tug supply vessels as well as crew boats; and operates owned and chartered tankers for petrochemicals and freight application. In addition the company offers ship management and maritime services including crew management technical support and consultancy services; and agency services which includes cargo vessel handling coordination and supply services crew boats and ship repair services for terminals and commercial ports. Further it operates a fleet of 22 chemical tankers of 45k tons; and livestock carriers and offshore fleet. It serves oil and gas companies. Gulf Navigation Holding PJSC was founded in 2003 and is headquartered in Dubai the United Arab Emirates.

Name: Burjeel Holdings PLC
Description: Burjeel Holdings PLC together with its subsidiaries owns and operates multi-specialty hospitals and medical centers in the United Arab Emirates the Sultanate of Oman and the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. The company operates in four segments: Hospitals Medical Centre Pharmacies and Others. It offers inpatient day-care and outpatient services to patients to diagnosis the disease as well as medical and surgical treatment services; medical consultation and lab and radiology diagnostic treatment services; and sells pharmaceutical goods cosmetic products and medical equipment. The company provides supply chain valet parking IT services claim submission and procurement services. It operates hospitals under the Burjeel Medeor Hospital LLH Hospital Lifecare Hospitals Tajmeel and Physiotherabia brand names. The company was founded in 2007 and is headquartered in Abu Dhabi the United Arab Emirates. Burjeel Holdings PLC is a subsidiary of Vps Healthcare Holdings Pvt. Ltd.

Name: African Rainbow Minerals Limited
Description: African Rainbow Minerals Limited through its subsidiaries operates as a diversified mining and minerals company in South Africa Malaysia and Switzerland. It explores for platinum group metals nickel coal iron ore copper manganese ore and chrome as well as gold deposits. African Rainbow Minerals Limited was incorporated in 1933 and is based in Sandton South Africa.

Name: Koza Altin Isletmeleri A.S.
Description: Koza Altin Isletmeleri A.S. engages in the operation of mines in Turkey. It owns and operates seven mines in the regions of Ovacık-Bergama-İzmir Çukuralan-İzmir Kaymaz-Eskişehir Mastra-Gümüşhane and Himmetdede-Kayseri. The company was incorporated in 1989 and is headquartered in Ankara Turkey.

Name: Empresa Eléctrica Pehuenche S.A.
Description: Empresa Eléctrica Pehuenche S.A. engages in the generation transmission distribution and supply of electricity in Chile. It owns and operates three hydroelectric power plants consisting of 699 megawatts installed capacity in Pehuenche Curillinque and Loma Alta. The company was founded in 1986 and is based in Santiago Chile. Empresa Eléctrica Pehuenche S.A. operates as a subsidiary of Enel Generación Chile S.A.

Name: One Software Technologies Ltd
Description: One Software Technologies Ltd provides software hardware and integration services. It operates through three segments: Outsourcing of business processes and technological support centers; Infrastructure and computing solutions; and Technological solutions and services management consulting and value-added services. The company offers various solutions such as SAP Oracle Cloud ERP NetSuite Priority and Oneview; development for mega projects customer success management data and analytics with AI digital transformation IoT and smart devices product design and customer success management and mobile and web development; as well as data automation AI and ML DBA services data engineering and data analytics. It also provides Microsoft Dynamics 365 ServiceNow and Salesforce; data infrastructure and network security identity and access management security assurance and CISOaaS; and One Cloud Microsoft Azure and Amazon Web Services. In addition the company offers a range of services including networks personal and business computing data centers and industry specific computing services; offshore and nearshore and on-site; as well as help desk call centers and managed services. Further it serves government education industry and trade technology and hi-tech financial municipal security and retailing sectors. The company was incorporated in 1973 and is based in Petah Tikva Israel.

Name: Isramco Negev 2 Limited Partnership
Description: Isramco Negev 2 Limited Partnership engages in the exploration development and production of oil natural gas and condensate in Israel Jordan and Egypt. The company’s properties include the Tamar and Leviathan reservoirs; and Shimshon and Dalit possession. It serves various customers as well as Israel Electric Company Ltd. The company was incorporated in 1989 and is based in Petah Tikva Israel.

Name: Wafa Assurance SA
Description: Wafa Assurance SA provides insurance products to individuals and companies in Morocco. It offers retirement and education saving plans; auto home health death accident hospital insurance products; and hunting liability and multi-risk pleasure boat insurance. The company also provides Wafa pro insurance; fire risk multi-risk business loss machinery breakdown IT all risks construction site all risks assembly Wafa fleet ship hull and transported goods insurance products. In addition it offers group health insurance. The company was formerly known as Société Nouvelle d’Assurances and changed its name to Wafa Assurance SA in 1989. Wafa Assurance SA was founded in 1972 and is headquartered in Casablanca Morocco. Wafa Assurance SA operates as a subsidiary of OGM Holding.

Name: UFUK Yatirim Yonetim ve Gayrimenkul A.S.
Description: UFUK Yatirim Yonetim ve Gayrimenkul A.S. engages in financial leasing business in Turkey. It leases machinery equipment land and sea transport vehicles and other fixed assets. The company was formerly known as Fon Sinai Yatirimlar A.S. and changed its name to UFUK Yatirim Yonetim ve Gayrimenkul A.S. in May 2016. UFUK Yatirim Yonetim ve Gayrimenkul A.S. was founded in 1995 and is headquartered in Istanbul Turkey. UFUK Yatirim Yonetim ve Gayrimenkul A.S. operates as a subsidiary of Yildiz Holding A.S.

Name: Kuwait Telecommunications Company K.S.C.P.
Description: Kuwait Telecommunications Company K.S.C.P. provides cellular mobile telecommunication and data services primarily in Kuwait. It offers voice data and text services as well as roaming and internet and data communication services; IT systems license installation and its implementation related services; and sells devices. The company also provides solutions under the STC name. The company was incorporated in 2008 and is based in Salmiya Kuwait. Kuwait Telecommunications Company K.S.C.P. operates as a subsidiary of Saudi Telecommunications Company.

Name: Ternium Argentina S.A.
Description: Ternium Argentina S.A. manufactures produces and processes various steel products in Argentina. The company offers hot and cold rolled coils straps and sheets; galvanized prepainted and cincalum coated steel; electrogalvanized plated steel; mechanical and structural use and general-purpose tubes; U and C steel profile; tin products; and steel aggregate blast furnace slag and ferric oxide. It serves the construction automotive white line agroindustry packaging transport and energy industries. The company was formerly known as Siderar S.A.I.C. The company was incorporated in 1962 and is headquartered in Buenos Aires Argentina. Ternium Argentina S.A. operates as a subsidiary of Ternium Internacional España S.L.U.

Name: MTN Uganda Limited
Description: MTN Uganda Limited provides telecommunication and mobile financial services in Uganda. It operates through Consumer Enterprise Business Unit Wholesale and Carrier Services and Mobile Financial Services segments. The company offers a range of products and services including voice data and SMS; digital services including mobile financial services and other digital offerings; and interconnect and roaming services. It also provides internet and connectivity leased lines private APNS SME internet and fixed internet services; fintech services; and bulk SMS and unstructured supplementary services data voice and internet bundles voice over IP solutions and toll-free voice services as well as Webphone a calling and communication application. In addition the company offers cloud services to support on-demand business needs data center internet of things end-to-end solutions API as a service and unified communications and collaboration suites. Further it engages in the sale of mobile devices. MTN Uganda Limited was incorporated in 1998 and is headquartered in Kampala Uganda. MTN Uganda Limited operates as a subsidiary of MTN International (Mauritius) Limited.

Name: Celulosa Argentina S.A.
Description: Celulosa Argentina S.A. operates in the forest industry sector in Argentina Uruguay and internationally. The company offers printing and writing paper tissue paper and packaging paper under the BOREAL BOREALCEL BOOKCEL SPRING CEL PAINTCEL and PAMPA brands. It is also involved in cellulosic Pulp and wood and distribution business. Celulosa Argentina S.A. was founded in 1929 and is based in Buenos Aires Argentina. Celulosa Argentina S.A. operates as a subsidiary of Tapebicua Investment Company S.L.

Name: Promigas S.A. E.S.P.
Description: Promigas S.A. E.S.P. together with its subsidiaries engages in the exploitation exploration purchase storage transportation packaging distribution trade and sale of natural gas electric energy and hydrocarbons and derivatives derived from oil coal and other fuels in Colombia. It operates through Natural Gas Transportation Integrated Solutions for the Industry and Power Generation Distribution of Natural Gas Distribution of Electricity and Non-Bank Financing segments. The company provides natural gas compression and dehydration services; implements energy management systems; develops energy diagnostics; and prepares and implements onsite or distribution of energy generation projects as well as engages in the provision of call center and contact center business process outsourcing professional and technical and personalized attention services for any type of business. It also involved in the investment in construction maintenance and management of ports; loading and unloading storage in ports and other services directly related to the port activities; transportation of fuel gas by the assembly construction operation maintenance and commercial exploitation of systems subsystems and pipelines. In addition the company offers change or replace technology predictive energy maintenance programs and advisory services in energy management; generates transmits and distributes energy; and acquires and sells real estate properties. Further the company sells compressed and liquefied natural gas. Promigas S.A. E.S.P. was incorporated in 1974 and is headquartered in Barranquilla Colombia.

Name: AVI Limited
Description: AVI Limited manufactures processes markets and distributes branded consumer products in the food beverage footwear apparel and cosmetics sectors in South Africa other African countries Europe and internationally. It operates through Entyce Beverages Snackworks I&J Personal Care and Footwear and Apparel segments. The company provides hot beverages such as tea coffee and creamer; sweet and savoury biscuits; baked and fried potato and maize snacks; personal care products including body spray fragrance cosmetics and body lotion products; footwear and apparel; and catches processes markets and distributes seafood. It offers beverages under the Five Roses Freshpak TRINCO Ellis Brown HOUSE OF COFFEES Koffiehuis ciro LAVAZZA and frisco brands; biscuits and snacks under the BAKERS Willards Baker Street and PROVITA brands; frozen food under the I&J brand; and personal care products under the YARDLEY Exclamation and LENTHÉRIC brand names. The company also provides fashion products under the SPITZ KURT GEIGER LACOSTE CARVELA TOSONI GANT and Green Cross GX&Co brands. AVI Limited was incorporated in 1944 and is based in Johannesburg South Africa.

Name: ALEC Holdings PJSC
Description: ALEC Holdings PJSC engineers and constructs building projects airport infrastructure industrial energy and commercial and flagship projects. It offers initial concept and design final completion and handover services; fitout and refurbishment services; mechanical electrical and plumbing engineering (MEP) and electronic low voltage (ELV) systems construction services; and engineering procurement and construction services for data centers. The company also provides data center whitespace and cabling and audio-visual solutions as well as installs safety and security alarm systems and access control and intercom systems. In addition it offers turnkey construction solutions across MEP civil and architectural services specializing in small-scale projects; modular solutions for off-site manufactured housing; and concept commissioning operation and maintenance solutions for solar energy projects. Further the company provides software consultancy services; trades in building and construction materials; sewage homes and water networks connections contracting services; and steel fabrication works as well as rents and leases machine tools engines and turbines cranes and lorries and scaffold and work platforms. Additionally it engages in the provision of carpentry products and crafts needed for construction workers; aluminum installation works; and corrosion and oxidation resistant services fire resistant painting works and metals corrosion removal services as well as machining and forming of metals and glass plates installation works. Further the company manufactures central air conditioning requisites and ventilation equipment; installs and maintains measuring and control systems security equipment and wired and wireless communication systems as well as radio TV station and cinema theatre equipment; and trades in security systems and equipment. The company was founded in 1999 and is headquartered in Dubai United Arab Emirates.

Name: Derayah Financial Company
Description: Derayah Financial Company provides financial and investment services in Saudi Arabia. It operates through Investment properties Investments Asset management and Brokerage segments. The company offers Derayah a digital investment platform; Derayah Global a platform that allows to monitor live prices and create personal watch lists for stocks exchange traded funds derivatives commodities and options; Derayah Smart a digital platform that provides a range of investment strategies for investor’s financial background and future objectives; Mutual Funds Supermarket which allows clients to invest in a range of investment funds; and real estate and capital market investment discretionary portfolio management margin trading and investment advisory solutions. The company was founded in 2009 and is based in Riyadh the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

Name: Partner Communications Company Ltd.
Description: Partner Communications Company Ltd. provides various communication services in Israel. It operates through Stationary and Cellular segments. The company offers mobile cellular fixed-line and international telephony; internet and TV services; transmission; data communications; and PRI as well as Partner TV and optic fiber infrastructure. It also provides cellular communication services including text messages internet browsing and data transfer; value-added services such as device repair; multimedia messages voicemail cyber protection cloud backup pantones and MyGuard antivirus. In addition the company offers email accounts routers anti-virus and website filtering; network and data infrastructure services information security integration solutions dedicated services business information storage services and data center and cloud services; and broadcasting services. Further the company provides broadband fiber optic infrastructure; and sells electronic equipment and terminal equipment; and sells a wide range of mobile phones accessories and other electronic equipment such as tablets laptops gaming consoles speakers headphones and smartwatches through a variety of sales channels including physical stores and the website. Additionally it operates service and sales centers in Israel. Partner Communications Company Ltd. was incorporated in 1997 and is headquartered in Rosh Ha'ayin Israel.

Name: Leejam Sports Company
Description: Leejam Sports Company operates sports and fitness centers in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia and the United Arab Emirates. The company was incorporated in 2008 and is headquartered in Riyadh the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

Name: Alef Education Holding plc
Description: Alef Education Holding plc together with its subsidiary provides AI-powered learning solutions in the United Arab Emirates Indonesia the United States and the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. It operates through Education Solution and Support and Services segments. The company engages in the research development and consultancy in the field of technology education; institute training and development of teachers; educational facilities management; training on the development of personal competencies; educational consultancy; administrative support training services; computer systems and software designing; and information technology consultancy as well as provision of IT infrastructure set up and maintenance support and services. Its products include Alef Platform personalized learning environment designed to meet the unique needs of each student; Alef Pathways that provides personalized learning experiences for Mathematics Science Arabic and English subjects; Arabits a comprehensive and engaging curriculum designed to help students learn the Arabic language; Abjadiyat a digital solution that delivers Arabic lessons for early childhood education for K-4 learners; and artificial intelligence solutions. The company was founded in 2016 and is headquartered in Abu Dhabi the United Arab Emirates. Alef Education Holding plc operates as a subsidiary of Tech Nova Investment - Sole Proprietorship LLC.

Name: Fibra Mty S.A.P.I. de C.V.
Description: Fibra Mty is a Mexican real estate investment trust (“FIBRA”) that initiated operations on December 11th 2014 identified by the number F/2157 (“Trust 2157”) and also as “Fibra Mty” or “FMTY”. Fibra Mty’s strategy is based mainly on the acquisition administration development and operation of corporate properties in Mexico. Fibra Mty is a FIBRA qualified as a transparent entity under Mexican Income Tax laws; therefore all revenues derived from Fibra Mty’s operation are attributable to the holders of its CBFIs given that Trust 2157 is not subject to Income Tax in Mexico. In order to maintain FIBRA status articles 187 and 188 of Mexican Income Tax Law establish that FIBRAs sus as Trust 2157 must distribute annually at least 95% of their net income to holders of CBFIs and invest at least 70% of their assets in real estate rental properties among other requirements. Fibra Mty is internally managed by Administrador Fibra Mty S.C. making Fibra Mty the first investment vehicle of its kind within the FIBRAS sector in Mexico supported by an innovative corporate governance structure aligned with investor interests generating economies of scale and taking advantage of the opportunities offered by real estate market.

Name: Grupo Profuturo S.A.B. de C.V.
Description: Grupo Profuturo S.A.B. de C.V. engages in managing loans pension and retirement fund business in Mexico. The company was founded in 1996 and is based in Mexico City Mexico.

Name: Arriyadh Development Co.
Description: Arriyadh Development Co. engages in the purchase and sale of lands and real estate in Saudi Arabia. It operates through Commercial Centers Public Benefit Lands and Contributions and Common Assets and Liabilities segments. It is involved in off-plan sales activities; management and leasing of owned or leased out residential and non-residential properties; and real estate development of residential and commercial buildings as well as wholesale and retail sale of new and used private cars including ambulances minibuses and four-wheel drive vehicles. Arriyadh Development Co. was founded in 1993 and is headquartered in Riyadh Saudi Arabia.

Name: Minera Valparaiso S.A.
Description: Minera Valparaiso S.A. an investment company engages in the generation and sale of electric power. It is also involved in the development of forestry; and management of the real estate properties. The company was formerly known as Sociedad Fábrica de Cemento El Melón S.A. and changed its name to Minera Valparaíso S.A. in 1969. Minera Valparaiso S.A. was incorporated in 1906 and is based in Santiago de Chile Chile.
Industry: Independent Power and Renewable Electricity Producers

Name: Banco do Nordeste do Brasil S.A.
Description: Banco do Nordeste do Brasil S.A. operates as a regional development bank in Latin America. It operates through Own Portfolio and FNE segments. The company offers savings accounts cash and term deposits and custody of securities; specialized credit; credit for infrastructure and urban and rural microfinance; and collection services and credit cards. It is also involved in involved in structuring and distribution of bonds and local short and long-term securities such as debentures notes promissory notes real estate receivables certificates investment funds; third-party asset management consisting of the management of investment funds; exchange operations; portfolio management and credit analysis; and electronic transfers. It serves corporate large medium small and micro-enterprises; agribusinesses rural producers and family farming; urban and rural microfinance sectors; representative entities; individuals; and direct and indirect public administration institutions. The company operates through physical service points including agencies and microcredit units. Banco do Nordeste do Brasil S.A. was founded in 1952 and is headquartered in Fortaleza Brazil.

Name: Dubai Taxi Company P.J.S.C.
Description: Dubai Taxi Company P.J.S.C. a taxi company provides passenger transportation services for individuals and businesses in the United Arab Emirates. It operates through Regular Taxis Limousine Service and Bus Transport Service segments. The company offers taxi VIP limousine commercial and school bus and last mile delivery bike services; passenger transport by vehicles via e-services; and families and ladies taxi services. It also provides DTC My Driver service that allows trained and competent drivers to interested parties for a limited period agreed upon between the two parties. In addition the company offers hourly limousine rental services; and operates DTC application. Dubai Taxi Company P.J.S.C. was incorporated in 1994 and is based in Dubai the United Arab Emirates.

Name: M. Dias Branco S.A. Indústria e Comércio de Alimentos
Description: M. Dias Branco S.A. Indústria e Comércio de Alimentos manufactures distributes and sells food products in Brazil. Its principal product categories are cookies and crackers pasta wheat flour and bran and margarine and vegetable shortening; cakes cake mixes snacks and nuts toasts peanut butter seasonings chocolates granola and grains breads and wraps sugar and sweeteners. The company offers its products under the Adria Aldente Basilar Bonsabor Estrela Fortaleza Finna Fit Food Frontera Isabela Jasmine Pelágio Pilar Piraquê Predilleto Richester Salsito Smart Taste&Co Treloso Vitarella Zabet and Las Acacias brands. The company also offers refined oils and wheat milling services. It also exports its products. The company was founded in 1936 and is headquartered in Eusébio Brazil.

Name: Cury Construtora e Incorporadora S.A.
Description: Cury Construtora e Incorporadora S.A. operates in real estate businesses in Brazil. The company sells real estate units; and offers real estate agent and brokers and credit analysis services. It also provides construction management real estate administration and electrical and hydraulic installation services. The company was founded in 1963 and is headquartered in São Paulo Brazil.

Name: The Housing Bank for Trade and Finance
Description: The Housing Bank for Trade and Finance provides various banking and financial products and services. The company offers savings POS current salaries basic bank time deposit current and other accounts; housing auto small business and personal loans; credit and debit cards and virtual prepaid cards as well as Iskan coin and gain products; money transfer online payments and bank drafts; safety deposit boxes; platform for spot trading in precious metals as well as spot and forward trading in foreign currencies; and e-services. It also provides direct facilities including overdraft discounted bills and contractors financing as well as real estate investment long-term syndicated and revolving loans; loans in foreign currency; indirect trade facility comprising inward and outward letters of credit bills of collection and letters of guarantee; mobile and online electronic services; and industrial start-ups business productive business vehicle and tourism loans. In addition the company offers brokerage services for trading in regional and international equity/debt capital markets; asset management services; investment services such as custody and issuance and investment trusteeships; financial advisory services including equity financing business valuation feasibility studies general financial advisory merger and acquisition and restructuring; treasury sales; and money market services. The Housing Bank for Trade and Finance was incorporated in 1973 and is based in Amman Jordan.

Name: Alrov Properties and Lodgings Ltd.
Description: Alrov Properties and Lodgings Ltd. a real estate company develops invests in and operates real estate projects in Israel the United Kingdom France Switzerland and the Netherlands. The company’s project comprises investment properties and residential projects as well as develops owns and operates 5-star luxury hotels. Alrov Properties and Lodgings Ltd. was founded in 1978 and is based in Tel Aviv-Yafo Israel.

Name: TotalEnergies Marketing Maroc S.A.
Description: TotalEnergies Marketing Maroc S.A. operates petroleum products service stations in Morocco. The company operates maintains and renovates service stations. It also engages in the manufacture of lubricants bitumens additives fuels and specialty fluids; and distribution lubricants oil and cleaning products as well as engine oil. In addition the company provides logistics services. It serves the service station network industrial customers lubricants aviation gas logistics and renewable energies markets. The company was formerly known as Total Maroc S.A. The company was incorporated in 1927 and is headquartered in Casablanca Morocco. TotalEnergies Marketing Maroc S.A. operates a subsidiary of TOTAL Outre-Mer S.A.

Name: Colombia Telecomunicaciones S. A. E.S.P. BIC
Description: Colombia Telecomunicaciones S. A. E.S.P. BIC together with its subsidiary provides telecommunication services in Colombia Europe and Latin America. The company offers mobile telephony and connectivity; broadband services; and fiber optics services to the home pay television fixed telephony and a range of digital solutions for small medium and large companies and corporations. It also provides fixed and mobile connectivity services as well as a range of digital services for individuals and companies. The company was incorporated in 2003 and is based in Bogotá Colombia. Colombia Telecomunicaciones S. A. E.S.P. BIC operates as a subsidiary of Telefónica Hispanoamérica S.L.

Name: Telecom Egypt Company
Description: Telecom Egypt Company together with its subsidiaries provides public communications and related products and services in Egypt. The company operates through Communications Marine Cables and Infrastructure Services; Internet Services; Outsourcing Services; and Other Activities segments. It offers mobile balance fixed voice fixed broadband international and roaming entertainment services mobile number portability and other services for individuals; and devices such as routers fixed landline phones USB modems 4G routers mobile phones and accessories. The company also provides mobile services; data and connectivity; voice services; hosting and data center; managed ICT services; and wholesale businesses. In addition it owns operates maintains and develops voice video and written data transmission telecommunication networks and infrastructure; offers voice video and data transmission telecommunication services to subscribers as well as value-added services content services marketing electronic signature and online money transfer; managing leasing selling purchasing possessing renting and dealing on any property and rights or benefit in any property including movable and immovable property; operates communication systems such as submarine cables satellites and circuits; and purchases sells and distributes fixed line sets computers and its peripherals and spare parts. The company was formerly known as Arab Republic of Egypt National Telecommunications Organization and changed its name to Telecom Egypt Company in March 1998. Telecom Egypt Company was founded in 1854 and is headquartered in Giza Egypt.

Name: Torunlar Gayrimenkul Yatirim Ortakligi A.S.
Description: Torunlar Real Estate Investment Partnership Joint Stock Company (“Torunlar GY O” or the “Company”). The Company was established in 1996 in Istanbul Türkiye under the title of Toray Construction Industry and Trade Inc. The Company was registered as Torunlar Real Estate Investment Partnership Inc. on January 21 2008 with the amendment to the articles of association in the Trade Registry Gazette published on January 25 2008. The Company is registered with the Capital Markets Board (“CMB”) and its shares have been traded on Borsa Istanbul since October 21 2010. The Company operates in Türkiye. As of March 31 2025 the Company had 56 employees (December 31 2024: 54) and its ultimate parent company is the Torun Family. The company is registered in the Istanbul Trade Registry Chamber in Türkiye and its headquarters is located at the following address: Rüzgarlıbahçe Mahallesi Özalp Çıkmazı No: 4 Beykoz 34805 Istanbul/Türkiye. The main activity of the Company is to engage in the purposes and subjects written in the CMB regulations regarding real estate investment partnerships such as investing in real estate real estate-based capital market instruments real estate projects and capital market instruments.

Name: Abdullah Al-Othaim Markets Company
Description: Abdullah Al-Othaim Markets Company together with its subsidiaries engages in the wholesale and retail trade of food supplies and other products in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia and Arab Republic of Egypt. It operates through Retail and Wholesale Real Estate and Leasing and Others segments. The company wholesales and retails food fish meat agricultural products livestock and household items; and involved in establishing managing operating and maintaining supermarkets commercial complexes and bakeries offering cooked and uncooked catering services as well as manages training and educational centers. It also acquires lands to construct buildings for lease or sale. In addition the company imports and exports fruits vegetables fish dairy products olive ghee halawa pasta and soft drinks; ready-made and sport clothes jewelry sewing tools bags leather products decorations dropped ceilings and vehicles spare parts. Further the company sells rents and exploits real estate proerties and lands; and sports and entertainment centers as well as offers computer services and maintenance of training and entertaining centers. Additionally it establishes agriculture projects; manages bakeries and cafes; and undertakes general contracting services. Furthermore the company involved in the construction maintenance demolition and restoration and electrical and electronic works as well as cultivates vegetables and fodder; and operates commercial complexes. It also offers poultry breeding as well as labor import and export and marketing services. Abdullah Al-Othaim Markets Company was founded in 1956 and is headquartered in Riyadh the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

Name: Celsia Colombia S.A. E.S.P.
Description: Celsia Colombia S.A. E.S.P. engages in the generation transmission distribution marketing and commercialization of electricity in Colombia Panama Costa Rica and Honduras. The company operates hydroelectric thermal solar and wind power plants. It also offers internet charging stations and sewage and sanitation management services. Celsia Colombia S.A. E.S.P. was formerly known as Empresa de Energia del Pacifico S.A. E.S.P and changed its name to Celsia Colombia S.A. E.S.P. Celsia Colombia S.A. E.S.P. was incorporated in 1994 and is based in Cali Colombia.

Name: United Electronics Company
Description: United Electronics Company engages in the wholesale and retail trade of electric appliances electronic gadgets computers and their spare parts and accessories furniture and office equipment and tools in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia and internationally. It operates in two segments Sales and Services and Consumer Finance. The company provides e-commerce installation and repair services for electronic products computers smartphones and accessories as well as extended warranties gift cards and installment sales; and maintenance and repair third-party marketing and consumer financing services. It also offers mobiles and tables TV and entertainment products air conditioners washing machines refrigerators dishwashers bult-in home appliances cookers dryers freezers coolers vacuums coffee makers heaters personal care and cooking products air fryers irons kitchen machines water dispensers and desalination air purifiers air care appliances kitchen utensils gaming products pet supplies home improvement products toys smart home and gadgets and sunglasses. The company was founded in 2002 and is based in Al Khobar the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

Name: The Foschini Group Limited
Description: The Foschini Group Limited together with its subsidiaries operates retail stores in South Africa and internationally. The company operates through TFG Africa TFG London and TFG Australia segments. It provides clothing jewellery cellphones accessories cosmetics sporting apparel and homeware and furniture. The company offers its products under the Home American Swiss Homelivingspace Archive BeautyBox Bash The Bed Store Connor Coricraft Dial-a-Bed Exact Fabiani The FIX Foschini Galaxy & Co. Granny Goose G-Star RAW Hi JD Hobbs Jet Jet Home Johnny Bigg Markham Phase Eight White Stuff Relay Jeans RFO Rockwear Sneaker Factory Sportscene Inside Story Sterns Tarocash Totalsports Volpes Whistles and YD brand names. It serves its products online. The company was formerly known as Foschini Limited and changed its name to The Foschini Group Limited in September 2010. The Foschini Group Limited was founded in 1924 and is headquartered in Cape Town South Africa.

Name: Hilan Ltd.
Description: Hilan Ltd. a software as a service (SaaS) provider develops solutions for management of enterprise human capital in Israel. It provides solutions for payroll HR time and attendance pension analytics professional service bureau services and BPO; products and services for enterprise resource planning (ERP) business systems; and managing the employee lifecycle from recruitment to retirement. The company also offers information technology (IT) infrastructure security software product marketing and data management; and IT solutions including big data data storage backup and virtualization cloud SaaS data and cyber security. In addition it provides operation and management of outsourcing; solutions in the fields of development projects testing services automation and training; and solutions for managing financial assets. It serves customers in the industry high-tech finance academic communication health care municipal transportation retail government education social care association and hotel sectors. The company was incorporated in 1992 and is based in Tel Aviv Israel.

Name: PSG Financial Services Limited
Description: PSG Financial Services Limited together with its subsidiaries provides various financial services and products in South Africa and Namibia. It operates through three segments: PSG Wealth PSG Asset Management and PSG Insure. The PSG Wealth segment offers portfolio management stockbroking local and offshore investments estate planning financial planning local and offshore fiduciary multi-managed solutions and retirement products to individuals families and businesses. The PSG Asset Management segment provides various investment products including local and international unit trust funds. The PSG Insure segment offers personal short-term insurance products including home car and household insurance; and commercial insurance products such as business and agri-insurance. The company was formerly known as PSG Konsult Limited and changed its name to PSG Financial Services Limited in August 2023. PSG Financial Services Limited was incorporated in 1993 and is headquartered in Bellville South Africa.

Name: Qatar Insurance Company Q.S.P.C.
Description: Qatar Insurance Company Q.S.P.C. together with its subsidiaries engages in the insurance reinsurance real estate asset management and information technology businesses. It operates in six segments: Marine & Aviation Insurance Property & Casualty Insurance Health & Life Insurance Real Estate Advisory and Investments. It offers personal insurance products including car motorcycle travel home boat and life and medical; and business insurance products such as property and commercial marine and aviation energy and motor fleet. The company is involved in real estate activities; issuance of tier 2 notes; and provision of IT and related advisory and investment management services. It operates Qatar the United Arab Emirates the Sultanate of Oman Kuwait the United Kingdom Switzerland Bermuda Singapore Cayman Islands Gibraltar Jersey and Malta. The company was incorporated in 1964 and is headquartered in Doha Qatar.

Name: Zenith Bank Plc
Description: Zenith Bank Plc provides banking and other financial services to corporate and individual customers in Nigeria rest of Africa and internationally. The company accepts current savings salary domiciliary and children’s accounts; fixed and call deposits certificate of deposits and short-term investment funds; sole proprietorship and partnership accounts and trust funds; clubs societies and associations accounts; and limited liability company non-governmental organization embassies and high commission and church accounts. It also offers term loans and leasing services; overdrafts receivable/invoice discounting and LPO finance services; import and export finance facilities; MSME and scheme loans; education loans; and bonds and guarantees. In addition the company provides personal funds management and investment advisory home remittance and trust formation; import letters of credit import bills for collection non-valid for forex/advance payment export transactions invisible remittance and e-services; and collection payment and reporting solutions. Further it offers electronic banking services; virtual credit debit prepaid multi-purpose branded and loyalty and corporate cards; internet banking; and general and life insurance products and services. Additionally the company operates branches; cash centers; ATM terminals; and POS terminals. The company was formerly known as Zenith International Bank Limited and changed its name to Zenith Bank Plc in May 2004. Zenith Bank Plc was incorporated in 1990 and is based in Lagos Nigeria.

Name: Emlak Konut Gayrimenkul Yatirim Ortakligi A.S.
Description: In 1953 an understanding that would pioneer a country's urbanization efforts and raise people's quality of life came to life. The successful journey of Emlak Konut a long-established brand in the construction sector began. Establishing environmentally friendly modern cities that would add comfort to human life was determined as the corporate vision. With this basic purpose Emlak Konut became the architect of many innovative applications in its sector. Emlak Konut carried out projects that set an example and left a mark in the planned urbanization of our country. It built the most innovative cities of its time large enough to give its name to the district it was located in. This stable growth brought with it a serious turning point and in 2002 Emlak Konut became a real estate investment partnership. This transformation was actually the harbinger of giant projects groundbreaking initiatives and becoming a bigger company. With becoming a Real Estate Investment Partnership" Emlak Konut was behind projects that resonated around the world in the field of design included environmentally friendly technologies and added value to the city. Since 2003 it has tendered a total of 388 projects of various sizes and as a result of the completion of these projects it will have ensured the construction of 251000 independent units. Emlak Konut went public twice with a breakthrough that would crown its rapid growth and carry its goals to broader horizons. The first offering in 2010 became one of the 5 largest public offerings in the history of the Republic. The secondary offering in 2013 was the largest public offering in the real estate sector in Europe in the last 5 years. Growing with the public offerings Emlak Konut has further consolidated its place among the strongest companies in Turkey with its paid-in capital of 3.8 billion liras and total assets of 205 billion liras as of the end of 2024."

Name: FIBRA Terrafina
Description: Terrafina (BMV: TERRA13) is a Mexican real estate investment trust formed primarily to acquire develop lease and manage industrial real estate properties in Mexico. Terrafina’s portfolio consists of attractive strategically located warehouses and other light manufacturing properties throughout the Central Bajío and Northern regions of Mexico. It is internally managed by highly qualified industry specialists and externally advised by PGIM Real Estate. Terrafina owns 292 real estate properties including 288 developed industrial facilities with a collective GLA of approximately 42.2 million square feet and four land reserve parcels designed to preserve the organic growth capability of the portfolio. Terrafina’s objective is to provide attractive risk-adjusted returns for the holders of its certificates through stable distributions and capital appreciations. Terrafina aims to achieve this objective through a successful performance of its industrial real estate and complementary properties strategic acquisitions access to a high level of institutional support and an effective management and corporate governance structure. As of August 3 2024 FIBRA Terrafina operates as a subsidiary of FIBRA Prologis.

Name: Misr Fertilizer Production Company
Description: Misr Fertilizer Production Company engages in the production and sale of fertilizers ammonia and nitrogen in Egypt. It offers ammonia and urea; and ammonia water urea water industrial urea and scrape urea. The company also exports its products to Europe Latin America Asia Africa and North America. Misr Fertilizer Production Company was incorporated in 1998 and is based in Cairo Egypt.

Name: Al Masane Al Kobra Mining Company
Description: Al Masane Al Kobra Mining Company engages in the production of non-ferrous metal ores and precious metals in Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. It primarily explores for gold silver copper zinc aluminum lead manganese and platinum deposits. The company holds interests in the Al Masane Copper Zinc Mine project located in Najran Saudi Arabia; the Guyan Gold Mine project located in Najran Saudi Arabia; and the Moyeath Orebody project located in Najran Saudi Arabia. It engages in the wholesaling precious metals and gemstones. The company was incorporated in 2007 and is headquartered in Najran Saudi Arabia.

Name: Bet Shemesh Engines Holdings (1997) Ltd
Description: Bet Shemesh Engines Holdings (1997) Ltd engages in the production of jet engine parts in Israel. The company operates in two segments Engines and Spare Parts Manufacturing. It offers jet engine complex parts such as compressor and turbine disks and blisks frames cases air seals spacers turbine nozzles and turbine blades; sheet metals and combustion chambers; and augmentor seals flaps and flame holders. The company also provides torque frame disc gear rotating seal bearing housing case ring rotor flange hub impeller and stub shaft produced by closed-die forgings and rolled seamless rings; and air foils and structural parts for the engines. In addition it offers repair overhaul and engineering services to complete engines as well as to modules and engine components and accessories; and field services comprising troubleshooting and HSI on-wing for aircraft and helicopters. Further the company designs gas turbine engines modules and parts; and development customization and manufacture of a range of gas turbine engines. Bet Shemesh Engines Holdings (1997) Ltd was incorporated in 1997 and is based in Beit Shemesh Israel.

Name: Douja Promotion Groupe Addoha S.A.
Description: Douja Promotion Groupe Addoha S.A. operates in the real estate sector in Morocco. The company offers various real estate properties including land plots projects to commercial and residential. Douja Promotion Groupe Addoha S.A. was founded in 1988 and is headquartered in Casablanca Morocco.

Name: Transcorp Power Plc
Description: Transcorp Power Plc engages in the generation and sale of electric power in Nigeria and internationally. It operates a gas-fired open cycle thermal power plant with an installed capacity of 972 MW. The company was formerly known as Transcorp Power Limited and changed its name to Transcorp Power Plc in January 2024. The company was incorporated in 2012 and is based in Lagos Nigeria. Transcorp Power Plc is a subsidiary of Transnational Corporation of Nigeria Plc.

Name: Grupo Bolívar S.A.
Description: Grupo Bolívar S.A. invests in administers and manages a portfolio of investments. It invests in shares corporate quotas and interest on national or foreign companies; equity or investment securities bonds issued by public or private entities and other securities with credit content or tradable shares in the market; bonds and other debentures; and trademarks and other forms of industrial properties. The company was founded in 1939 and is based in Bogotá Colombia.

Name: Arabian Drilling Company
Description: Arabian Drilling Company operates as an onshore and offshore gas and oil rig drilling company in Saudi Arabia.
