It provides adhesives grout mortar for flooring and tiles; thermal and industrial cement-based and mortar-based products; powdered stucco and putty; cement products; and special coatings sealers and additives for cement mixtures. In addition the company offers decorative paints primers sealers coatings metal paints wood and other paints and electrostatic powder paints and complementary products. Further it provides plumbing piping systems and related accessories for hot and cold water in residential public industrial and other buildings. The company serves its products to contractors trading houses building material yards and other parties including institutional public and private industries. The company was incorporated in 2013 and is headquartered in Airport City Israel.

Name: Azzas 2154 S.A.
Description: Azzas 2154 S.A. engages in the development and marketing of women's men's and children's footwear handbags accessories and clothing in Brazil and internationally. It offers its products through franchise stores company-operated store and web commerce channel under the Arezzo Schutz Anacapri Alexandre Birman Alme Vans Reserva Reserva Mini Reserva INK Reserva Go Oficina Reserva Brizza Troc Baw Carol Bassi ZZMALL Reversa Simples Reserva Paris Texas Vicenza Animale Farm Farm Global Fabula Foxton Cris Barros Off Premium Maria Filo NV Hering and Dzarm brands. The company was formerly known as Arezzo Indústria e Comércio S.A. and changed its name to Azzas 2154 S.A. in July 2024. Azzas 2154 S.A. was founded in 1972 and is headquartered in Belo Horizonte Brazil.

Name: Motus Holdings Limited
Description: Motus Holdings Limited provides automotive mobility solutions in South Africa the United Kingdom Australia and internationally. The company operates through five segments: Import and Distribution; Retail and Rental; Mobility Solutions; Aftermarket Parts; and Head Office and Eliminations. It imports and distributes passenger and light commercial vehicles and parts to serve a network of dealerships vehicle rental companies fleets and government institutions; retails new and pre-owned passenger and commercial vehicles; sells parts and accessories; provides servicing and maintenance of vehicles; and provides treasury management fleet management telemetry and business process outsourcing services. The company also distributes wholesales and retails parts and accessories for out-of-warranty vehicles; and develops manages administers distributes vehicle related financial products and services. Motus Holdings Limited was founded in 1948 and is based in Bedfordview South Africa.

Name: Emaar Misr for Development Company (S.A.E.)
Description: Emaar Misr for Development Company (S.A.E.) engages in real estate and project development and investment business in Egypt. The company involved in the planning and construction of urban districts and provision of utilities and services. Emaar Misr for Development Company (S.A.E.) was founded in 1997 and is based in Giza Egypt. Emaar Misr for Development Company (S.A.E.) is a subsidiary of Emaar Properties PJSC.

Name: NCBA Group PLC
Description: NCBA Group PLC together with its subsidiaries provides retail corporate and digital banking brokerage bancassurance and investment banking services in Kenya Tanzania Uganda Rwanda Cote d’Ivoire and Ghana. The company operates through Corporate and Institutional Banking Retail Banking Treasury Dealing Digital Bank and Investment Banking segments. It offers saving and current accounts; home plot personal car vehicle and equipment construction and term loans; overdrafts; insurance premium financing leasing and wealth management services; advisory services on corporate finance capital raising and project finance; and finance advisory services that include due diligence reviews business restructuring mergers and acquisitions spin-offs and business valuations and working capital reviews for optimization. The company also provides foreign currency services; property health money employee and liability insurance products; asset finance; and securities brokerage services. It operates through a network of multiple branches ATMs and cash deposit machines. The company was formerly known as Commercial Bank of Africa Limited and changed its name to NCBA Group PLC in September 2019. NCBA Group PLC is headquartered in Nairobi Kenya.

Name: Humansoft Holding Company K.S.C.P.
Description: Humansoft Holding Company K.S.C.P. together with its subsidiaries establishes and operates universities and colleges in Kuwait and internationally. It operates through Higher Education and Others segments. The company offers computer programming; advertisement publication and distribution; and technology e-commerce and media services. It also provides diploma degrees in business administration information technology and engineering; content-based programs; learning solutions comprising IT business desktop and language e-learning content; professional certifications and learning management systems; and consultancy services for the implementation hosting and administration of e-learning solutions. In addition the company offers technical application and business skill courses; cyclical pedagogical syllabus learning system; career development and job placements; and management and training services to schools. Further it operates foster fledgling educational institutions. Humansoft Holding Company K.S.C.P. was founded in 1994 and is based in Kuwait City Kuwait.

Name: Ajman Bank PJSC
Description: Ajman Bank PJSC provides various banking products and services for individuals businesses and government institutions in the United Arab Emirates. The company undertakes banking financing and investing activities through various Islamic financing and investment products such as Murabaha Ijarah Mudaraba Musharaka Wakala and Sukuk. It operates through Consumer Banking Corporate Banking and Treasury segments. The company offers current savings 2 in 1 young deposit and payroll accounts; property personal and auto finance as well as house mortgages; credit and debit cards; syndication and underwriting; business banking services; and internet telephone mobile and SMS banking services; ATM/CCDM; and digital wallet and e-statement services as well as life and general takaful products. Further it offers Islamic investment fund; project finance; IPO and share finance; mutual funds and private equity; secured and Islamic; corporate and commercial banking including long term working capital letter of guarantee term finance real estate finance and trade finance services; letters of credit; and wealth management and export/import finance services. Additionally the company is involved in the activities of dealing room related money market and foreign exchange transactions with other banks and financial institutions; and leasing of commercial and residential properties. Ajman Bank PJSC was founded in 2007 and is headquartered in Ajman the United Arab Emirates.

Name: National Corporation for Tourism and Hotels
Description: National Corporation for Tourism and Hotels invests in owns and manages hotels and leisure complexes in the United Arab Emirates. It operates through Hotels Retail Services Catering Services and Holding segments. The company provides rooms and food and beverages services; catering services; develops and manages hotels; asset management and owner representation services; and logistics services. It also manages investments. National Corporation for Tourism and Hotels was incorporated in 1996 and is based in Abu Dhabi the United Arab Emirates.

Name: Arab Banking Corporation (B.S.C.)
Description: Arab Banking Corporation (B.S.C.) provides wholesale banking services worldwide. It operates through MENA Subsidiaries International Wholesale Banking Group Treasury ABC Brasil and Other segments. The company provides consumer banking products such as term deposits current savings and call accounts; personal home and car loans; and credit and visa electron cards. It also offers transaction banking solution for trade and supply chain management and cash management; financing products and advisory services; structured financing solutions for real estate asset acquisition such as commercial investment and residential development; Shari’a compliant banking solutions; capital market products and services; financial markets and treasury products; and digital corporate onboarding services. In addition the company offers ila Bank a digital and mobile-only banking space. Arab Banking Corporation (B.S.C.) was incorporated in 1980 and is based in Manama the Kingdom of Bahrain.

Name: Aramex PJSC
Description: Aramex PJSC together with its subsidiaries invests in freight express logistics and supply chain management businesses in the United Arab Emirates the Middle East North Africa Turkey East and South Africa Europe North America North and South Asia and Oceania. It operates through four segments: Courier Freight Forwarding Logistics and Other Operations. The Courier segment is involved in the delivery of small packages to retail and wholesale customers express delivery of small parcels pick up and deliver shipments and related royalty and franchise levies. The Freight Forwarding segment engages in the forwarding of loose and consolidated freight through air land and ocean transport; and warehousing customer clearance and break-bulk activities. The Logistics segment offers warehousing and related management distribution supply chain management inventory management and other value-added services. The Other Operations segment provides visa services and publication and distribution services. Aramex PJSC was founded in 1982 and is headquartered in Dubai the United Arab Emirates. As of July 22 2025 Aramex PJSC operates as a subsidiary of Abu Dhabi Ports Company PJSC.

Name: ALPEK S.A.B. de C.V.
Description: Alpek S.A.B. de C.V. together with its subsidiaries operates as a petrochemical company in Mexico the United States Argentina Brazil Chile Canada the United Kingdom Oman and Saudi Arabia. It operates in two segments Polyester and Plastic and Chemicals. The company offers purified terephthalic acid (PTA) an organic compound that is raw material for PET; polyethylene terephthalate (PET) a plastic resin that creates products for their lightness hygiene and resistance along with their recyclability; recycled PET for new bottles and containers strapping and packing supplies and fibers for clothing and carpet; and and polyester fibers which are mainly used for food and beverage packaging textile and industrial filament markets. It also manufactures polypropylene and expandable styrene as well as fertilizers and other chemicals for consumer goods automotive construction agriculture pharmaceutical and other markets. In addition the company offers DPET Sheet a PET sheet for food packaging applications including bakery produce pre-packaged food yoghurt egg trays. and other consumer products. The company was founded in 1975 and is based in San Pedro Garza García Mexico. ALPEK S.A.B. de C.V. is a subsidiary of Controladora Alpek S. A. B. de C. V.

Name: Nearshoring Experts & Technology S.C.
Description: Nearshoring Experts & Technology S.C. is headquartered in Mexico.

Name: Pluz Energía Perú S.A.A.
Description: Pluz Energía Perú S.A.A. distributes electricity in Peru. The company holds a concession area of approximately 1602 square kilometers and provides energy to approximately 1600000 customers. It is also involved in the network movement works; sale of power blocks; and pole rental activities. The company was formerly known as Enel Distribución Perú S.A.A. and changed its name to Pluz Energía Perú S.A.A. in August 2024. The company was incorporated in 1994 and is based in Lima Peru. Pluz Energía Perú S.A.A. operates as a subsidiary of North Lima Power Grid Holding S.A.C.

Name: United Arab Bank P.J.S.C.
Description: United Arab Bank P.J.S.C. together with its subsidiary provides commercial banking products and services for institutional and corporate customers in the United Arab Emirates. It operates through two segments Wholesale Banking and Retail Banking. The company offers current and savings accounts; fixed flexi fixed escalator and call deposits; personal home auto and term loans; overdrafts; and credit and debit cards. It also provides trade and supply chain finance solutions including letters of credit inward and outward bill collection trust receipts invoice and PDC discounting and guarantees as well as trade finance advisory/supply chain finance specialist services; working capital solutions; and receivable contractors construction and capex and heavy equipment financing solutions. In addition the company offers account collections and payroll services; and treasury services such as foreign exchange investment interest rate risk and money market products as well as Islamic banking services. Further it provides digital banking services that include online mobile SMS and phone banking services as well as ATM and e-statement services. The company operates through a network of branches and ATMs. United Arab Bank P.J.S.C. was incorporated in 1975 and is based in Sharjah the United Arab Emirates.

Name: Ahli Bank SAOG
Description: Ahli Bank SAOG provides commercial banking services in the Sultanate of Oman. It operates through two segments Retail Banking; and Wholesale Banking Treasury and Investments. The company offers deposits and unrestricted investment accounts; consumer loans including home personal and auto loans; debit and credit cards; overdrafts Islamic financing and fund transfer facilities; and bancassurance products such as motor personal accident travel home and individual term insurance as well as group credit life coverage. It also provides current accounts term deposits loans and advances etc.; treasury trade finance and other investment services; and investment banking services comprising corporate finance advisory asset management and brokerage services. In addition the company offers internet mobile and SMS banking; ATM and CDM services; payment gateway and POS terminal services; and service centers and kiosk services. It serves the institutional corporate small and medium enterprise and retail sectors. Ahli Bank SAOG was incorporated in 1997 and is based in Muscat the Sultanate of Oman.

Name: Boubyan Petrochemical Company K.S.C.P.
Description: Boubyan Petrochemical Company K.S.C.P. manufactures and sells petrochemical products in Kuwait other MENA countries Asia South America and North America and internationally. The company operates through three segments: Energy Manufacturing and Petrochemical Sector; Education and Services; and Others. It is involved in manufacture and trades of packaging materials and plastic pipes; manufactures steel abrasive materials; produces chlorine salt and other petrochemical products; provision of educational and medical services; and undertakes industrial investments as well as investing directly and through portfolios into various sectors. The company also engages in incubators communications and technology business; general trading activities; provision of transportation services; blending of chemical products; and manufacture of chlor alkali products. The company was incorporated in 1995 and is headquartered in Kuwait City Kuwait.

Name: Al-Babtain Power and Telecommunications Company
Description: Al-Babtain Power and Telecommunications Company together with its subsidiaries produces lighting poles power transmission towers accessories and communication towers in the United Arab Emirates Saudi Arabia and Egyptian Arabic Republic. The company operates through Towers and Metal Structures Sector; Poles and Lighting; Design Supply and Installation Sector; and Solar Energy Sector segments. The Towers and Metal Structures Sector segment produces power transmission towers galvanized communication towers and tests and galvanized steel structures. The Poles and Lighting Sector segment engages in the production and galvanization of electricity and lighting poles masts and accessories; and production of street lighting lanterns for playgrounds and gardens as well as electricity distribution panels. The Design Supply and Installation Sector segment supplies installs and maintains communication systems. The Solar Energy Sector segment is involved in the production of mobile metal components for solar photovoltaic energy tracking systems. In addition it designs and produces poles masts and lanterns for lighting and squares; manufactures markets and sells decorative poles and LED lighting; and installs operates and maintains programs for wired and wireless communication systems computer devices and networks as well as mechanical and electrical equipment for factories. The company also installs maintains and repairs wind energy networks and generates electric energy; offers electrical and mechanical works; and engages in designing supplying installing and maintaining communication systems as well as provides oil and gas field services including contracting. Al-Babtain Power and Telecommunications Company was founded in 1955 and is headquartered in Riyadh Saudi Arabia.

Name: Bolsa Mexicana de Valores S.A.B. de C.V.
Description: Bolsa Mexicana de Valores S.A.B. de C.V. operates as a stock exchange derivatives exchange and systems administrator to facilitate securities transactions. The company is involved in the operation of cash listed derivatives and OTC markets for multiple asset classes including equities fixed income and exchange traded funds as well as custody clearing and settlement facilities and data products. It also operates the Mexican Stock Exchange which facilitates relationships and transactions between the supply and demand of securities; provision of information on the securities listed as well as financial brokerage services depository services price reporting and stock market education; establishing necessary measures to ensure stock market operations comply with applicable provisions; development of Mexican securities market. The company was founded in 1894 and is based in Mexico City Mexico.

Name: Amram Avraham Construction Company Ltd
Description: Amram Avraham Construction Company Ltd operated private construction projects in Israel. The company operates in The Entrepreneurial Real Estate in Israel and The Responsive Real Estate Sector in Israel segments. The Entrepreneurial Real Estate in Israel segment includes land identification improvement processes and initiation construction and sale of real projects in the real estate sector. The Responsive Real Estate Sector segment in Israel includes locating initiating establishing renting and managing real estate for investment industrial warehousing logistics Industry storage logistics trade offices or hotels. The company was incorporated in 2002 and is based in Hadera Israel.

Name: Fawry for Banking Technology and Electronic Payments S.A.E.
Description: Fawry for Banking Technology and Electronic Payments S.A.E. provides electronic -payments and digital finance solutions in Egypt. The company offers digital and bill payment investment and cash deposit and withdrawal services. It also offers rewards and loyalty programs; commerce enablement services such as online checkout point of sale and payment link services; e-ordering marketplace; payment and collection pay-out and ticketing services; micro finance and insurance brokerage services; and operates TicketsMall and Super app. In addition the company provides HR solutions; and payout portal payroll card employee insurance acceptance cash management cash-in and cash-out cash collection and remittance services; and acts as a banking agent that offers various banking and financial services. Further it offers business loans and daily interest accounts; digital platforms; consumer finance services; fast moving consumer goods (FMCG) platform solutions for consumer goods companies and merchants; and commercial technology solutions. Additionally the company provides systems and communication equipment management and maintenance and computer network services; advanced solutions and strategic software services that supports digital transformation in business organization; and operates free zone. It serves individuals enterprises small and medium size enterprises (SMEs) and financial institutions. Fawry for Banking Technology and Electronic Payments S.A.E. was incorporated in 2008 and is based in Giza Egypt.

Name: Orascom Construction PLC
Description: Orascom Construction PLC together with its subsidiaries operates as an engineering and construction contractor for infrastructure complex industrial and high-end commercial projects in the United States the Middle East Africa and Central Asia. The company constructs water transportation monorail and metro highways and roads and power infrastructure; data center fertilizer cement and petrochemicals projects; and commercial healthcare museum student housing and senior living new cities and buildings. It also offers steel structures steel collector elements plate works pressure vessels boilers heat recovery steam generators heat exchangers piping tanks and packaged skids; aluminum doors windows stick curtain walls unitized curtain walls skylights handrails standing seam roofs and laminated stone products as well as various architectural metal works; pre-cast and pre-stressed concrete pipes; and decorative paints and industrial coatings. In addition the company provides waterproofing lining and geomembranes thermal insulation concrete repair injection and fire proofing and joints sealants; cleaning security and repair services for commercial buildings; and hard services including engineering fit-outs civil and architectural repair and maintenance services; and soft services such as housekeeping janitorial services and deep cleaning services with specialties in façade cleaning landscaping pest control waste management and recycling. Further it manages industrial zones. Orascom Construction PLC was founded in 1950 and is headquartered in Dubai the United Arab Emirates.

Name: Villar International Ltd.
Description: Villar International Ltd. together with its subsidiaries engages in acquisition development and construction of real estate properties in Israel and internationally. The company finds and purchases land for industrial buildings and safe housings; leases offices; and provides archival services. It also initiates and builds residential construction projects; and office buildings shopping centers and logistic centers. In addition the company provides archive storage and logistics services for storing various types of media including papers magnetic media and X-rays. Further it offers engineering solutions and services; rental of construction and safety equipment; and initiates constructs acquires maintains and upkeeps of photovoltaic power generation systems. Villar International Ltd. was incorporated in 1975 and is based in Caesarea Israel.

Name: United Gulf Holding Company B.S.C.
Description: United Gulf Holding Company B.S.C. together with its subsidiaries provides asset management and investment banking and commercial banking products and services in Bahrain the Middle East North Africa Europe the Americas and internationally. It undertakes asset portfolio management corporate finance advisory investments in quoted and private equity/funds real estate capital markets international banking and treasury activities. The company also offers loans and other credit facilities; and accepts deposit and current accounts from corporate and institutional customers. In addition it offers property rental services. The company was incorporated in 2017 and is based in Manama Bahrain. United Gulf Holding Company B.S.C. operates as a subsidiary of Kuwait Projects Company Holding K.S.C.P.

Name: NICO Holdings plc
Description: NICO Holdings plc together with its subsidiaries engages in general insurance life assurance pension administration banking corporate finance advisory asset management and information technology (IT) businesses in in Malawi Zambia Uganda and Mozambique. It operates through Life Insurance and Pension Business General Insurance Business Banking Business Asset Management and Information Technology segments. It provides general insurance products such as motor vehicle building road construction liability engineering professional indemnity marine hull cargo fire loss of profits agriculture burglary house-owners householders and personal accident products. The company also offers individual life insurance products including endowment assurance with profits cash generator endowment assurance with profits savings protection policy with profits child saver lien endowment assurance with profits and unit linked endowment with profits; and group business insurance products comprising deposit administration managed funds group life assurance group mortgage group credit and group funeral policies and annuities. In addition it provides deposit products credit facilities visa credit debit card services trade finance services foreign exchange products women business programs and other value-added services; pension solutions; and investment management services to institutional individual investors. Further the company offers corporate and project finance advisory services; IT services including IT managed services IT infrastructure services IT projects management and software solutions; property advisory management development and retail services; and hospitality services. NICO Holdings plc was founded in 1971 and is based in Blantyre Malawi.

Name: Scotia Group Jamaica Limited
Description: Scotia Group Jamaica Limited together with its subsidiaries provides financial products and services in Jamaica. It operates through Retail Banking Corporate and Commercial Banking Treasury Investment Management Services Insurance Services and Others segments. The Retail Banking segment offers personal banking services personal deposit accounts credit and debit cards consumer loans and mortgages. The Corporate and Commercial Banking segment provides non-personal direct debit facilities current accounts deposits overdrafts loans and other credit facilities. The Treasury segment is involved in the foreign currency trading activities. The Investment Management Services segment offers investments unit trusts and pension and other fund management services; brokerage and advisory services; and trust account administration services. The Insurance Services segment is involved in the provision of life and medical insurance products individual pension administration and annuities services as well as acts as a general insurance agency. It also offers investment banking services; and mortgage financing services. The company was founded in 1889 and is headquartered in Kingston Jamaica. Scotia Group Jamaica Limited operates as a subsidiary of Scotiabank Caribbean Holdings Ltd.

Name: Empresas AquaChile S.A.
Description: Empresas AquaChile S.A. a food company produces processes distributes and markets salmon products in Chile and internationally. It offers Atlantic and Coho salmon products. The company operates under the Aqua and Verlasso brands. It also sells its products through retail stores. The company was incorporated in 1979 and is based in Puerto Montt Chile. Empresas AquaChile S.A. is a subsidiary of AGROSUPER S.A.

Name: ESG Emirates Stallions Group PJSC
Description: ESG Emirates Stallions Group PJSC together with its subsidiaries engages in the investment construction and real estate sectors in the Middle East Africa Asia Europe and the Americas. The company offers manpower and accommodation solutions a diversified portfolio to encompass workers and staff accommodation services; real estate development and services which includes feasibility design project management construction and operational management; retail interior decoration and manufacturing provides comprehensive solutions ensuring quality craftsmanship and creative design. It also provides outsourcing services in various fields such as restaurants real estate resorts and labor accommodation; and commercial brokerage services. In addition the company offers loose furniture wooden doors kitchen cabinets wardrobes wall paneling and wooden decorative items outdoor joinery and woodworks. The company was incorporated in 2008 and is based in Abu Dhabi the United Arab Emirates. ESG Emirates Stallions Group PJSC is a subsidiary of International Holding Company PJSC.

Name: First National Bank of Botswana Limited
Description: First National Bank of Botswana Limited provides various banking and related products and services to individuals businesses corporates and private clients in Botswana. The company operates through four segments: FNB Retail FNB Commercial RMB Corporate and Treasury. It offers cheque transactional savings student youth corporate transact and business accounts; call accounts notice and fixed deposits treasury bills and bonds products; overdrafts; personal tertiary graduate home and business loans as well as vehicle and asset commercial property purchase order and corporate finance services; first funding employee loan schemes; and credit and debit cards. The company also provides foreign exchange solutions; Islamic finance and financial planning services; forex and trade services such as payment and import and export solutions; and accounting and custody services. In addition it offers agricultural solutions farming enterprise finance services business investment solutions and farm risk insurance finance services; and payment funding and cash management services to the public sector. Further the company provides corporate and investment banking services; private banking services comprising wealth and advisory and structured lending services; funeral debt protection car building and travel insurance services as well as business insurance services including fire business interruption electronic equipment business all risks glass goods in transit money theft public liability workers compensation and vehicle; and online and cellphone banking services. Additionally it offers InContact Pro an electronic platform for managing the money in business accounts. The company was founded in 1991 and is headquartered in Gaborone Botswana. First National Bank of Botswana Limited operates as a subsidiary of First National Bank Holdings (Botswana) Limited.

Name: Nestlé Nigeria Plc
Description: Nestlé Nigeria Plc manufactures markets and distributes food products in Nigeria. It operates in two segments Food and Beverages. The company offers food products under the Maggi Cerelac SMA Nan Lactogen Golden Morn brands; beverage drinks under the Milo Milo energy cube Nescafe Milo ready-to-drink and Nestlé Pure Life brands; and snacking products. It also provides purified water. In addition the company offers its products under the Ideal Nido Carnation Gloria and Nestlé Professional brand names. It also exports its products. The company was founded in 1961 and is headquartered in Lagos Nigeria. Nestlé Nigeria Plc is a subsidiary of Société des Produits Nestlé S.A.

Name: Banque Attijari de Tunisie Société anonyme
Description: Banque Attijari de Tunisie Société anonyme provides various banking products and services to individuals professionals and companies in Tunisia. The company offers accounts; savings and investment; bank cards; cash management; real estate consumer education vehicle and personal credit products and solutions; project finance; structured finance; remote banking; insurance; finance and capital market services; asset management; stock market intermediation; venture capital consulting insurance leasing services; treasury bills and bonds; certificate of deposits; term accounts; cash vouchers services. It also provides online and international banking services as well as protection capitalization and tax optimization solutions. The company was founded in 1964 and is headquartered in Tunis Tunisia. Banque Attijari de Tunisie Société anonyme operates as a subsidiary of Andalucarthage Holding.

Name: Dogan Sirketler Grubu Holding A.S.
Description: Dogan Sirketler Grubu Holding A.S. together with its subsidiaries engages in the electricity generation industry and trade automotive trade and marketing finance and investment internet and entertainment and real estate investment businesses in Turkey. It generates electricity from hydroelectric solar and wind power plants; sells food and cosmetic products; sells vehicles and distributes automotives; rents real estate properties; and sells books and magazines. The company is also involved in foreign trade husbandry and production; TV radio and magazine publishing; trading; mining and export; and music and entertainment activities. In addition it offers technology and informatics automotive electronics telecommunications automotive infotainment systems investment banking factoring administrative consultancy investment insurance health planning advertisement real estate management and Internet services. Dogan Sirketler Grubu Holding A.S. was incorporated in 1980 and is based in Istanbul Turkey.

Name: Netcare Limited
Description: Netcare Limited an investment holding company operates private hospitals in South Africa. It operates through Hospital and Emergency Services and Primary Care segments. The Hospital and Emergency Services segment engages in the hospital and pharmacy operations. Its operations covers its private acute hospital network and day clinics; and non-acute services including emergency medical services private mental health clinics operation diagnostics support services and cancer care services as well as sells healthcare products and vouchers. The Primary Care segment offers healthcare services and employee health and wellness services as well as administrative services to medical and dental practices. It also engages in the financing property owing and pharmaceutical services. It operates through a network of acute hospitals beds day clinics netcare 911 sites cancer care centres haematology centres renal dialysis facilities dialysis stations point of care devices mental health hospitals primary health care facilities and occupational health service contracts as well as insurance products and prepaid procedures and healthcare vouchers. Netcare Limited was incorporated in 1996 and is headquartered in Sandton South Africa.

Name: Massy Holdings Ltd.
Description: Massy Holdings Ltd. together with its subsidiaries engages in trading service industries and finance business in Trinidad and Tobago the Barbados and Eastern Caribbean region Guyana Jamaica Colombia and the United States. The company operates through four segments: Integrated Retail Gas Products Motors and Machines and Financial Services. It is involved in the retail and wholesale distribution of pharmaceuticals foods and general merchandise; sale of liquified petroleum gases and industrial gases including nitrogen oxygen and carbon dioxide; and provision of maintenance services and the execution of construction projects for oil gas and mining clients. The company sells new and used vehicles spare parts industrial equipment and lubricants; and engages in short- and long-term vehicle and equipment rental business. In addition the company engages short- and long-term vehicle and equipment rental business; provision of remittances services; accepts deposits for fixed terms; and grants installment credit secured by assets. The company was formerly known as Neal & Massy Holdings Limited and changed its name to Massy Holdings Ltd. in July 2014. The company was incorporated in 1923 and is based in Port of Spain Trinidad & Tobago.

Name: Aygaz A.S.
Description: Aygaz A.S. purchases liquid petroleum gas (LPG) to retailers for distribution to customers in Turkey. It operates through three segments: LPG and Gas Cargo Transportation and Distribution and Petroleum Products and Electricity. The company manufactures LPG cylinders and tanks regulators and other supplementary materials; and retails and wholesales fuel and lubricants through its autogas stations. It also engages in the purchase and sale of natural gas; arrangement for modulation and storing of natural gas; and building of necessary facilities. In addition the company purchases builds rents and operates vessels that transports crude oil petroleum products liquid petroleum gas natural gas and solid liquid and liquefied products. Aygaz A.S. was incorporated in 1961 and is headquartered in Sisli Turkey.

Name: Çimsa Çimento Sanayi ve Ticaret A.S.
Description: Çimsa Çimento Sanayi ve Ticaret A.S. engages in the production and sale of cement and building materials primarily in Turkey. It offers white gray and aluminate cement products; and ready mix concrete as well as refactory construction chemical aggregate and iron and steel products. The company was incorporated in 1972 and is headquartered in Istanbul Turkey. Çimsa Çimento Sanayi ve Ticaret A.S. operates as a subsidiary of Haci Ömer Sabanci Holding A.S.

Name: Ray Sigorta Anonim Sirketi
Description: Ray Sigorta Anonim Sirketi engages in the non-life insurance business in Turkey. The company offers accident illness - health land vehicles aircraft watercraft transportation fire natural disasters general damages credit financial losses and legal protection insurance services; home insurance policies; and general liability insurance solutions. It sells its products through agencies agency branches brokers broker branches banks and leasing companies. The company was incorporated in 1958 and is headquartered in Istanbul Turkey. Ray Sigorta Anonim Sirketi operates as a subsidiary of ATBIH GmbH.

Name: Electra Real Estate Ltd.
Description: Electra Real Estate Ltd. together with its subsidiaries engages in the establishment operation and management of private equity funds for the investment in income-yielding commercial properties in Israel and the United States. The company owns and operates multifamily communities comprised of approximately 35000 units in Georgia Florida North Carolina South Carolina Tennessee and Texas. It also acquires develops and repositions newly built single-family rental housings and boutique urban hotel assets. In addition the company provides short-term capital services including bridge loans mezzanine loans preferred equity investment and participating preferred equity investment to middle-market real estate firms; and advisory services for real estate transactions and operations comprising acquisitions underwriting structuring closing and property management. Further the company involved in repositioning repurposing and revitalizing real estate assets. Electra Real Estate Ltd. was incorporated in 1972 and is based in Tel Aviv-Yafo Israel. Electra Real Estate Ltd. is a subsidiary of Elco Ltd.

Name: Poulina Group Holding S.A.
Description: Poulina Group Holding S.A. together with its subsidiaries operates in real estate wood and household appliances building materials poultry mass consumption goods steel work packaging and trade services in China and internationally. The company engages in the real estate activities; and construction of buildings. It also manufactures and distributes household appliances including refrigerators stoves and washing machines; industrial equipment such as freezers mini bars and refrigerators under the Mont Blanc brand; and office furniture goods. In addition the company develops and markets ice creams yogurts desserts dairy products pastries juices and chips under the SELJA and OLA brands; table margarine professional margarine and vegetable fats and oils; and Halwa Chamia. Further it engages in the provision of packaging printing cardboard and paper processing and plastic film services; food packaging and cardboard boxes cells polystyrene and stretched films; and corrugated and solid boards flexible packaging products and egg cells. Additionally the company is also involved in the manufacture of metal equipment and steel processing activities; and international trade representation import packaging and information and communication technologies businesses. It also engages in the manufacture and distribution of ceramic tiles for wall and flooring and porcelain tiles; production and distribution of animal feed; and distribution of eggs and chicken and turkey meat. The company was founded in 1967 and is based in Ben Arous Tunisia. Poulina Group Holding S.A. operates as a subsidiary of Founders Capital Partners.

Name: EcoRodovias Infraestrutura e Logística S.A.
Description: EcoRodovias Infraestrutura e Logística S.A. operates as an infrastructure company that operates highway concessions in Brazil. It operates Ecopátio Logística Cubatão an intermodal logistics platform which is the regulating site for trucks at the Port of Santos. The company is also involved in the port operations and handling and storage of import and export cargo at the Port of Santos. The company was founded in 1997 and is based in São Paulo Brazil. EcoRodovias Infraestrutura e Logística S.A. operates as a subsidiary of IGLI S.p.A.

Name: Union Coop
Description: Union Coop establishes and manages hypermarkets and consumer cooperatives in the United Arab Emirates. It operates in three segments: Retail E-Commerce and Real Estate. The company operates online shopping platforms for its business; and leases shops in its various branches and malls. It owns and operates Al Warqa City Mall Etihad Mall Al Barsha Mall Al Barsha South Mall Nad Al Hamar Center Al Nahda Motor City and Silicon Oasis; and a chain of stores under the Coop brand name. Union Coop was incorporated in 1982 and is headquartered in Dubai the United Arab Emirates.

Name: SONASID S.A.
Description: SONASID S.A. produces and sells round bars concrete and wire rods for the construction and industrial applications in Morocco and internationally. It also offers billet and fiber and drawn wire products. The company was founded in 1974 and is headquartered in Casablanca Morocco. SONASID S.A. is a subsidiary of Nouvelles Siderugies Industries.

Description: Fibra Nova is headquartered in Mexico.

Description: e-finance for Digital and Financial Investments S.A.E. provides digital payment solutions in Egypt. The company develops and operates financial networks; offers a suite of digital products to governments businesses and consumers; and provides technological infrastructure security for the support of e-payment systems. Name: Anadolu Hayat Emeklilik Anonim Sirketi
Description: Anadolu Hayat Emeklilik Anonim Sirketi provides private pension and insurance products in Turkey in Turkey. The company offers private pension products including individual non-sponsored group employer-sponsored and income drawdown plans; auto-enrolment plans; and life insurance products such as savings and endowment annuities and term life. Name: Life Healthcare Group Holdings Limited
Description: Life Healthcare Group Holdings Limited an investment holding company operates as a private healthcare company in Southern Africa the United Kingdom Europe the United States and internationally. The company operates acute hospitals. It also offers mental health acute rehabilitation renal dialysis oncology and imaging services. In addition the company provides long-term services for patients requiring frail care chronic mental healthcare and substance abuse support; wellness programs and occupational and primary healthcare to corporate and institutional clients; and contracted on-site occupational primary and emergency healthcare services to large private and public employees. Further the company develops and commercializes molecular imaging agents for use in positron emission computerized tomography diagnostics. The company was formerly known as Afrox Healthcare Limited and changed its name to Life Healthcare Group Holdings Limited in January 2005. Life Healthcare Group Holdings Limited was founded in 1983 and is headquartered in Johannesburg South Africa.

Name: Société Ivoirienne de Banque S.A.
Description: Société Ivoirienne de Banque S.A. provides various banking products and services to individuals professionals and businesses in Ivory Coast. It offers deposit current and savings accounts; cards; bancassurance products; financing solutions; cash management and money transfer services; documentary credit documentary collection stand-by letter of credit transfer and repatriation services; and ATM SMS internet and mobile banking services. The company was founded in 1962 and is headquartered in Abidjan Ivory Coast. Société Ivoirienne de Banque S.A. operates as a subsidiary of Attijari West Africa.

Name: Sitios Latinoamérica S.A.B. de C.V.
Description: Sitios Latinoamérica S.A.B. de C.V. through its subsidiaries provides wireless telecommunications infrastructure services and solutions in Argentina Brazil Chile Colombia Costa Rica Dominican Republic Ecuador El Salvador Guatemala Honduras Nicaragua Panama Paraguay Peru Puerto Rico and Uruguay. The company constructs installs maintains operates and commercializes towers support structures physical spaces and other non-electronic elements of passive infrastructure; provides related services to the telecommunication sector; and leases tower spaces. It serves radio communications service providers primarily concessionaires of public wireless telecommunications networks. Sitios Latinoamérica S.A.B. de C.V. was incorporated in 2022 and is headquartered in Mexico City Mexico.

Name: Banco Guayaquil S.A.
Description: Banco Guayaquil S.A. provides various banking products and services in Ecuador. The company offers current saving and business checking accounts. It also offers finance products such as microcredit home loan education loan working capital factoring agricultural credit and other financing products as well as fixed asset and immediate credit services. In addition the company provides credit cards; foreign trade products and services; and virtual banking and online services and consultations. Further it offers buying and selling currencies insurance services remittances visa application and payment related services as well as microfinance services. Banco Guayaquil S.A. was founded in 1923 and is based in Guayaquil Ecuador. Banco Guayaquil S.A. operates as a subsidiary of Corporacion Multibg S.A.

Name: Dan Hotels Ltd
Description: Dan Hotels Ltd owns and operates a chain of hotels in Israel. The company operates business and VIP lounges Ben Gurion Airport. It also owns and manages commercial and apartments at ‘King David Towers’ in Tel Aviv as well as owns a third of the Panorama Mall commercial center in Haifa. In addition the company operates schools hotel service and culinary arts; and provides catering services. Dan Hotels Ltd was founded in 1947 and is based in Tel Aviv Israel. The company operates as a subsidiary of Federmann Enterprises Ltd.

Name: Petkim Petrokimya Holding Anonim Sirketi
Description: Petkim Petrokimya Holding Anonim Sirketi operates as a petrochemical company in Turkey. It operates through Petrochemical and Port segments. The company offers thermoplastics such as low density polyethylene high density polyethylene polypropylene masterbatches and polyvinyl chloride; fiber raw materials including acrylonitrile mono-ethylene glycol and pure terephthalic acid; aromatics such as benzene paraxylene orthoxylene and toluene; olefins comprising polymer and chemical purity propylene and ethylene; isopropyl alcohol 2ethyl hexanol and styrene monomer; and other products such as crude butadiene raw C4 C5 mixture aromatic oil pyrolysis gasoline diethylene glycol sodium hydroxide phthalic anhydride cutter stock glycol mixture and atactic polypropylene. The company was founded in 1965 and is based in Istanbul Türkiye. Petkim Petrokimya Holding A.S. is a subsidiary of Socar Turkey Petrokimya AS.

Name: Presco Plc
Description: Presco Plc engages in the oil palm plantations development palm oil milling palm kernel processing and vegetable oil refining businesses in Nigeria and Ghana. The company is involved in the extraction refining and fractioning of crude palm oil into finished products. It also provides special palm oil; refined bleached and deodorized palm oil; palm olein; palm stearin; palm fatty acid distillate; fresh fruit bunches; crude palm oil; and crude and refined palm kernel oil as well as palm kernel cakes. The company was formerly known as Presco Industries Limited. Presco Plc was incorporated in 1991 and is headquartered in Benin City Nigeria. Presco Plc is a subsidiary of NV Siat SA.

Name: Jazeera Airways K.S.C.P.
Description: Jazeera Airways K.S.C.P. engages in providing air transportation and commercial passenger services in Kuwait Middle East Central South Asia and Europe. It operates through Passenger Airline Service and Terminal Operations segments. The company operates a fleet of Airbus A320 and A320neo aircraft. It also owns and operates a terminal at Kuwait International Airport. In addition the company provides park and fly remote check-in services; and air cargo services including express courier unaccompanied bags human remains dangerous goods and general and perishable cargo services. It offers its services through its website and mobile app. The company was incorporated in 2004 and is based in Kuwait City Kuwait.

Name: Reysas Gayrimenkul Yatirim Ortakligi A.S.
Description: Reysas Gayrimenkul Yatirim Ortakligi A.S. is a privately owned real estate investment trust.  It invests in the real estate markets of Turkey. The firm invests in the warehousing market. Reysas Gayrimenkul Yatirim Ortakligi A.S. is based in Istanbul Turkey.

Name: Sagicor Group Jamaica Limited
Description: Sagicor Group Jamaica Limited together with its subsidiaries provides various financial services in Jamaica the Cayman Islands Costa Rica Barbados and Panama. The company operates through Long Term Insurance Short Term Insurance Commercial Banking Investment Banking and Other segments. The Long Term Insurance segment provides annuities traditional life and universal life products. The Short Term Insurance segment offers group life group health and property and casualty offerings services. The Commercial Banking segment provides banking retail mortgages small business banking treasury management and corporate banking services. The Investment Banking segment offers wealth management products and services to retail and institutional clients including unit trusts mutual funds brokerage asset management and corporate trust. The Other segment provides property management captives management real estate investment remittance and cambio services. The company offers retirement products general insurance pension administration group insurance administration microfinance real estate development real estate sales and rental pension fund management insurance brokerage and investment services. It provides its services under Sagicor brand name. Sagicor Group Jamaica Limited was founded in 1840 and is based in Kingston Jamaica.

Name: AtlantaSanad Société Anonyme
Description: AtlantaSanad Société Anonyme provides various insurance products for individuals professionals and corporates primarily in Morocco. AtlantaSanad Société Anonyme operates as a subsidiary of Groupe Holmarcom.

Name: Y.D. More Investments Ltd
Description: Y.D. More Investments Ltd is a privately owned Investment Manager. The firm engages in capital market activities in Israel. The company operates through Investment Portfolios Pension Funds and Management of Provident Funds segments. It is involved in managing mutual funds securities portfolios for clients investment funds providing trading services in foreign securities and financial assets brokerage activity. The firm was incorporated in 2006 and is headquartered in Ramat Gan Israel.

Name: United Real Estate Company K.S.C.P.
Description: United Real Estate Company K.S.C.P. together with its subsidiaries engages in real estate operation and development in Kuwait Egypt Lebanon the United Arab Emirates Syria Oman Bahrain Jordan Europe and the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. It operates through Rental Operations Hospitality Operations Real Estate Development and Property Trading and Contracting and Services segments. Its property portfolio includes hotels clubs motels entertainment houses rest places gardens parks exhibitions restaurants cafes residential compounds touristic and health spas entertainment and sports facilities and stores. In addition it offers agriculture general trading touristic development contracting beauty and medical care services; facilities management services such as maintenance cleaning and security services; real estate advisory services; and maintenance works of buildings and real estate properties such as civil mechanical and electrical works elevators and air conditioning works and other related maintenance works. Description: Ampa Ltd. through its subsidiaries develops and manages residential and commercial properties. Name: Miahona Company Limited

Name: Inversiones Aguas Metropolitanas S.A.
Description: Inversiones Aguas Metropolitanas S.A. through its subsidiaries engages in the sanitation business in Chile. It operates through Water and Non-Water segments. The Non-Water segment is involved in environmental analysis; treatment of liquid industrial waste; integral engineering services; and the sale of sanitary services energy projects and biogas. Inversiones Aguas Metropolitanas S.A. operates as a subsidiary of Suez Inversiones Aguas del Gran Santiago Limitada.

Name: Mineros S.A.
Description: Mineros S.A. engages in the exploration development and production of gold in Central and South America. It explores for gold and silver deposits. It also engages in the hydroelectric power generation activities. The company was formerly known as Mineros de Antioquia S.A. and changed its name to Mineros S.A. in May 2004. Name: Banvida S.A.
Description: Banvida S.A. provides financial services in Chile. The company provides financial services such as life and general insurance mortgage and consumer loans and investment services. The company was founded in 1998 and is based in Santiago Chile. Banvida S.A. is a subsidiary of Inversiones Teval S.A.

Name: Hidrovias do Brasil S.A.
Description: Hidrovias do Brasil S.A. together with its subsidiaries an integrated logistics solutions company in Brazil and internationally. Name: Orizon Valorização de Resíduos S.A.
Description: Orizon Valorização de Resíduos S.A. operates as a waste recovery process company. The company was founded in 1857 and is based in Bogotá Colombia. Banco Bilbao Vizcaya Argentaria Colombia S.A. operates as a subsidiary of Banco Bilbao Vizcaya Argentaria S.A.

Name: Etihad Atheeb Telecommunication Company
Description: Etihad Atheeb Telecommunication Company provides telecommunication products and services for individuals and businesses in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia and internationally. It operates through the Data Services; Voice; Systems Analysis Application Design and Development Services; and E-Commerce segments. The company offers broadband satellite services; automated vehicle location services; fintech solutions; military software; geographic information systems applications and services; telecommunications and information networks management and monitoring services; digital certification services; telecom facility rental services; Internet of Things (IoT) services using license-exempt frequencies; virtual voice services; Internet exchange services; and virtual IoT network operator services. Description: Datatec Limited together with its subsidiaries provides information and communication technology (ICT) solutions and services worldwide. The company distributes cyber security network infrastructure unified collaboration products data centre solutions and channel services; and offers financing/leasing solutions for ICT customers as well as digital service. Description: Saudi Pharmaceutical Industries and Medical Appliances Corporation develops manufactures and markets of medicinal and pharmaceutical products in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia the Middles East Egypt and Morocco. Name: CAP S.A.
Description: CAP S.A. engages in iron ore mining steel production steel processing and infrastructure businesses in Chile and internationally. The company explores evaluates and develops mineral ores; and produces iron ore and pellets in the Pacific coast. Description: Illovo Sugar (Malawi) plc engages in the manufacture and sale of sugar from sugar cane in Malawi. The company produces raw brown and refined sugars as well as molasses. It operates through two segments Retail Banking and Wholesale Banking. The company offers savings current salary children youth goldfish and fixed/call deposit accounts; forex products; payment solutions; fund transfer services; overdrafts; loans for micro small and medium enterprises; personal/consumer mobile home business mortgage and construction loans; term loans supply chain and distribution financing import duty finance working capital loans and asset finance services; mortgages; trade finance services; and insurance premium financing and mortgage finance solutions. It also provides investment services; bancassurance consultancy and capacity building stock brokerage and leasing services; debit credit business and prepaid cards; wealth fund and investment management solutions; insurance solutions custody and investor and treasury bond and bill services; share registry safe keeping and corporate trustee services; and fixed income and money market products. The company was founded in 1968 and is headquartered in Nairobi Kenya. The Co-operative Bank of Kenya Limited operates as a subsidiary of Co-opholdings Co-operative Society Limited.

Name: Ülker Bisküvi Sanayi A.S.
Description: Ülker Bisküvi Sanayi A.S. together with its subsidiaries manufactures markets and sells biscuits chocolates chocolate coated biscuits wafers and cakes in Turkey and internationally. The company also offers spread chocolate crackers Bebe biscuits light snacks gum gift chocolates and candies kid’s snacks and food supplements. It is also involved in trading investment and consultancy services. The company was founded in 1944 and is headquartered in Istanbul Turkey. Ülker Bisküvi Sanayi A.S operates as a subsidiary of Yildiz Holding A.S.

Name: Emirates Driving Company P.J.S.C.
Description: Emirates Driving Company P.J.S.C. together with its subsidiaries manages and develops motor vehicles driving training in the United Arab Emirates. It manages investment properties; and provides delivery services. The company also engages in the passenger transport by luxury motor vehicles; and invests in commercial industrial and agricultural enterprises management. In addition it offers pre-license and post-license services. The company was incorporated in 2000 and is headquartered in Abu Dhabi the United Arab Emirates.

Name: Zambia Sugar Plc
Description: Zambia Sugar Plc engages in growing of sugar cane in Zambia the Democratic Republic of Congo Kenya and South Africa. It operates through Cane Growing and Sugar Production segments. The company offers household brown refined white dark brown icing and castor sugars; treacle maple and golden syrup; and molasses. It sells its products under the Whitespoon brand. The company exports its products. Zambia Sugar Plc was founded in 1964 and is headquartered in Mazabuka Zambia. Zambia Sugar Plc operates as a subsidiary of Illovo Sugar Limited.

Name: Carozzi S.A.
Description: Carozzi S.A. produces and markets food products in Chile. It manufactures cookies chocolates candies cereal bars ice cream cereals oatmeal liquid and powdered beverages compotes pasta rice olive oil flours premixes desserts tomato sauce and paste jams coffee fruit and vegetable pulps preserves biscuits and panettone and snacks as well pet food products. The company markets its products under the Bresler Costa CACHORROS GATITOS ViVo and Ambrosoli brand names. It sells its products to supermarket chains; distributors; warehouses and small stores; and food service sector such as hotels restaurants and casinos. It exports its products in Peru Argentina and the United States. Carozzi S.A. was founded in 1898 and is based in San Bernardo Chile.

Name: Dogus Otomotiv Servis ve Ticaret A.S.
Description: Dogus Otomotiv Servis ve Ticaret A.S. together with its subsidiaries engages in automotive and real estate businesses in Turkey. It operates through automotive and real estate segments. The automotive segments engages in the importing marketing and selling vehicles spare parts and marine engines of Volkswagen Group brands VW Audi Seat Cupra Porsche Bentley Lamborghini Meiller Scania Wielton semi-trailers and Thermoking vehicle cooling systems; purchasing and selling used vehicles through dealers under the DOD brand; sales and service of Novamarine brand boats and speedboats as well as after-sales services and spare parts field; and sales and service operations of Aerofoil brand e-foil products and Mate brand electric-assisted bicycles. The real estate segment operates a portfolio consisting of real estate-based assets and rights. It also offers installation and operation of charging units charging stations and charging network; and create and manage a portfolio of real estate and real estate-based capital market instruments. The company was founded in 1994 and is headquartered in Istanbul Turkey. Dogus Otomotiv Servis ve Ticaret A.S. operates as a subsidiary of Doğuş Holding A.Ş.

Name: SMU S.A.
Description: SMU S.A. operates as a food retailer in Chile and Peru. The company operates through Supermarket and Financial Services segments. It provides groceries fruits and vegetables and non-food and other products; and e-grocery solutions. The company also issues credit cards that grants credit to Unimarc supermarkets customers. It operates supermarkets under the Unimarc Mayorista 10 Super 10 Alvi Mayorsa and Maxi Ahorro brands. SMU S.A. was founded in 2007 and is headquartered in Santiago Chile.

Name: Malam - Team Ltd
Description: Malam - Team Ltd provides information technology services in Israel. It offers IT and communication infrastructure; software products; enterprise systems; cyber security; systems integration and development; digital DATA and AI; managed services; software development and outsourcing services; cloud solutions; payroll attendance and HR; and pension and provident fund services. Malam - Team Ltd was incorporated in 1972 and is headquartered in Petah Tikva Israel.

Name: Southern Province Cement Company
Description: Southern Province Cement Company engages in the manufacture production and sale of cement clinker and its derivatives and accessories in Saudi Arabia. It sells clinker. The company was founded in 1978 and is headquartered in Abha Saudi Arabia.

Name: Ferreycorp S.A.A.
Description: Ferreycorp S.A.A. together with its subsidiaries engages in the distribution of machinery engines equipment spare parts lubricants and other goods in Peru and Central and South America. The company is also involved in the purchase and sale of machinery automotive chemical equipment and agricultural equipment as well as related spare parts; and provision of maintenance and repair storage and workshop services; bulking agency; and equipment rental businesses as well as the delivery of related services. It engages in the marketing of technology-related software and equipment as well as operates as a representative and distributor of tires lubricants and safety equipment. The company was formerly known as Ferreyros S.A.A. and changed its name to Ferreycorp S.A.A. in March 2012. The company was incorporated in 1922 and is headquartered in Lima Peru.

Name: Kvutzat Acro Ltd
Description: Kvutzat Acro Ltd engages in the construction business in Israel. The company’s project portfolio includes residences offices and commercial buildings as well as hotels. It undertakes urban renewal projects. The company was incorporated in 1994 and is based in Herzliya Israel.

Name: Israel Shipyards Industries Ltd
Description: Israel Shipyards Industries Ltd designs constructs markets and sells military and civilian vessels in Israel and internationally. It operates general cargo port that provides loading discharging sorting storage and transportation services; performs metal works; and imports produces markets and sells cement and construction products as well as offers vessel building and repair services. The company is involved in the management and operation of a fleet of cargo ships comprising seven general cargo ships and ships for transporting cement; and provision of logistics and support services for the offshore gas and petrol drilling operations. Israel Shipyards Industries Ltd was founded in 1959 and is based in Haifa Israel.

Name: C&A Modas S.A.
Description: C&A Modas S.A. operates as a fashion retailer for women men and children in Brazil and internationally. It offers blouses pants dresses skirts coats beachwear underwear t-shirts shirts Bermuda jackets and coats bodies sets and shorts; beauty products including perfumes makeup skincare body and bath and accessories; and footwear such as boots shoes and moccasins flats sandals and tennis footwear. The company sells its products through stores as well as online. The company was founded in 1841 and is headquartered in Barueri Brazil.

Name: Rimon Consulting & Management Services Ltd.
Description: Rimon Consulting & Management Services Ltd. provides end-to-end solutions for small to large scale projects for the public and private sectors in Israel. It delivers infrastructure projects such as water and natural gas networks water reservoirs pumping stations water wells complex marine works construction waste recycling and other civil infrastructure works. The company is also involved in the provision of water and environmental solutions and services including wastewater effluent treatment and reuse for agriculture and drinking water; transmission and supply of water for agricultural industrial and municipal uses; water desalination and treatment systems; brine treatment and reuse; and water wells rehabilitation. In addition it develops designs build finances and operates cogeneration facilities solar PV energy storage and biogas facilities; owns natural gas distribution licenses; and provides smart grid management services (microgrid) electricity supply electricity infrastructure and meters systems for the industrial factories hospitals and other public entities. Further the company provides construction D and B EPC and EPCF services as well as acts as financing arranger through export credit transactions. Rimon Consulting & Management Services Ltd. was incorporated in 1997 and is based in Caesarea Israel.

Name: Egyptian Iron and Steel Company
Description: Egyptian Iron and Steel Company produces and sells iron and steel products in Egypt. The company offers products including hot rolled equal angles duct beams round bars square strips and baklava; smooth and serrated rebar wicker rods flanges beams cold rolled strips and rolls slabs and square; iron limestone and barite ore abrasive blast furnaces and cast iron molds; oxygen argon and nitrogen; metal structural work; and manufacture spare parts. The company is based in Cairo Egypt. Egyptian Iron and Steel Company is a subsidiary of Metallurgical Industries Co.

Name: Palestine Telecommunications Company P.L.C
Description: Palestine Telecommunications Company P.L.C. provides manages and sells telecommunication services in the Palestinian territories. It operates through Telecommunication Digital Services and Information Technology and Investing segments. The company provides wireline and wireless communication as well as leased lines internet and ADSL services; and operates telephone and cellular networks. It is also involved in investment activities. Palestine Telecommunications Company P.L.C. was incorporated in 1995 and is headquartered in Nablus Palestinian Authority.

Name: Ripley Corp S.A.
Description: Ripley Corp S.A. engages in the retail sale of apparel accessories and home products through department stores and e-commerce in Chile and Peru. The company product categories include beauty products techno products shoes and slippers accessories and complements automotive and decor products sport and adventure products bedroom and electro products hardware and pet products toy and children products health and wellness products men’s fashion women’s fashion children’s fashion furniture and other products as well as automotive spare parts. It is also involved in banking business through the management of Ripley Bank that primarily focuses on the consumer sector; and the real estate business including the ownership of shopping malls. The company was founded in 1956 and is based in Santiago Chile.

Name: Al Majed for Oud Company
Description: Al Majed for Oud Company engages in the wholesale and retail trade of perfumes in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia and the Gulf countries. The company offers oud musk incense saffron oriental and western perfumes as well as cosmetics bags glasses antiques gifts and decorative flowers. It is also involved in the manufacture of room and air fresheners men’s and women’s perfumes oud oil and agarwood and incense products as well as mixing and packaging of perfumes oils and plants. Al Majed for Oud Company was founded in 1956 and is headquartered in Riyadh the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

Name: United Development Company Q.P.S.C.
Description: United Development Company Q.P.S.C. together with its subsidiaries contributes and invests in infrastructure and utilities in the State of Qatar. The company operates through four segments: Urban Development Hospitality and Leisure Infrastructure and Utilities and Other Operations. It engages in the real estate development and construction activities. The company is also involved in the investment and development of hotel and leisure facilities; selling of luxurious items; construction and management of district cooling systems and marina activities; provision of information technology solution and other services; environment related businesses; and business management activities. United Development Company Q.P.S.C. was incorporated in 1999 and is based in Doha Qatar.

Name: Stanbic Uganda Holdings Limited
Description: Stanbic Uganda Holdings Limited provides various banking products and services in Uganda. It operates through Personal and Private Banking Business and Commercial Banking Corporate and Investment Banking and Treasury and Capital Management segments. The company also holds and manages the real estate portfolio; offers other services such as facilities management site acquisition property consultancy and execution of real estate projects; and engages in stock brokerage and asset management services. In addition it provides software development and financial technology solutions; wealth and investment solutions to private and personal banking markets; advisory networking and sustainability support to small- and medium-sized businesses and large commercial enterprises; advisory transactional trading and funding support to large companies governments parastatals and institutional clients; and insurance products and services. The company was formerly known as Stanbic Bank Holdings Limited and changed its name to Stanbic Uganda Holdings Limited. The company was founded in 1906 and is based in Kampala Uganda. Stanbic Uganda Holdings Limited is a subsidiary of Stanbic Africa Holdings Limited.

Name: Mibanco Banco de la Microempresa S.A.
Description: Mibanco Banco de la Microempresa S.A. provides various banking products and services in Peru. The company offers business savings current accounts; business loans such as working capital machines and equipment commercial premises warehouse debt purchase cash credit line agricultural markets and shopping arcades campaigns and financing for SOAT; and business protection and multi-risk insurance products. It also provides fixed term deposits CTS easy savings flexible full savings online term deposit savings for a dream and woman savings; personal loans including personal and housing loans women and business vehicle credit and cash dependent; and personal insurance such as life financial protection individual accident family protected family plan flex home insurance microinsurance tax free return and tax relief return. The company was incorporated in 1998 and is based in Surquillo Peru. Mibanco Banco de la Microempresa S.A. operates as a subsidiary of Banco de Crédito del Perú S.A.

Name: Leche Gloria S.A.
Description: Leche Gloria S.A. produces and sells milk and other dairy products in Peru Bolivia Ecuador. The company offers milk to dilute UHT milk powdered milk UHT and powdered milk mix as well as dairy mixes and drinks to dilute; dairy products comprising yogurt butter cheese condensed milk milk cream manjarblanco and ice cream base; drinks including daily drinks water fruit drinks soft drinks homemade drinks tea and vegetable drinks; and food products such as jams panettone canned fish and margarine. It sells its products under the Gloria Bonlé Pura Vida leche Griego Batti PRO Yofresh Bella Holandesa Chicolac Yomost Multilac Aruba and La Mesa brand names. The company was incorporated in 1941 and is based in Lima Peru. Leche Gloria S.A. is a subsidiary of Gloria Group.

Name: Union Properties Public Joint Stock Company
Description: Union Properties Public Joint Stock Company invests in and develops properties. The company operates through four segments: Real Estate Property Management Contracting Activities Investing Activities and Sales of Goods and Services. Its project portfolio includes master communities residential commercial hospitality and industrial projects. The company is involved in central air-conditioning requisites manufacturing and fire fighting equipment assembling; cold storage and warehousing; facilities management security mechanical electrical and plumbing works and energy management services; building management and consultancy for motor racing tracks; manufacturing and interior decoration; and owners association management. It is also engaged in real estate development; investment in equities; facilities management services; trading activities; investment and management of companies; lifeguard services; and facilities management security mechanical electrical and plumbing works and energy management services. The company was founded in 1987 and is headquartered in Dubai the United Arab Emirates.

Name: Equatorial Maranhão Distribuidora de Energia S.A.
Description: Equatorial Maranhão Distribuidora de Energia S.A. provides electricity distribution services in the state of Maranhão Brazil. It serves residential industrial commercial rural public power street lighting and public service customers. The company was formerly known as Companhia Energética do Maranhão – CEMAR and changed it to Equatorial Maranhão Distribuidora de Energia S.A. in September 2019. The company was founded in 1958 and is headquartered in São Luís Brazil. Equatorial Maranhão Distribuidora de Energia S.A. is a subsidiary of Equatorial Energia Distribuição S.A.

Name: Sociedad Punta del Cobre S.A.
Description: Sociedad Punta del Cobre S.A. engages in the development and exploitation of mineral resources primarily in the Atacama Region. The company primarily explores for copper gold and silver concentrates. It holds interest in the Punta del Cobre mine the Manto de Cobre mine and the Granate mine San Jose and Biocobre mines located in the Atacama Region. The company also holds a 100% interest in the El Espino project located in Coquimbo region; and the Tovaku mining project located in Antofagasta region. Sociedad Punta del Cobre S.A. was incorporated in 1989 and is headquartered in Copiapó Chile.

Name: First HoldCo Plc
Description: First HoldCo Plc together with its subsidiaries provides commercial banking investment banking corporate banking and other financial services in Nigeria and internationally. The company operates through Commercial Banking Business Group; Investment Banking and Asset Management Business Group (IBAM); and Others segments. The Commercial Banking Business Group segment offers financial intermediation services to individual and corporate clients/customers. The IBAM segment provides advisory asset management markets and private equity services to corporations and governments; and merchant banking services. The Others segment offers insurance brokerage services. The company also provides funds management investment and general trading trusteeship real estate investment financial/ investment advisory and portfolio management services. In addition it is involved in the venture capital and private equity business. Further the company offers retail portfolio such as credit cards mortgages term loans and overdrafts facilities. The company was formerly known as FBN Holdings Plc and changed its name to First HoldCo Plc in February 2025. First HoldCo Plc was founded in 1894 and is based in Lagos Nigeria.

Name: Almunajem Foods Company
Description: Almunajem Foods Company together with its subsidiary engages in the wholesale and retail trade of fruits vegetables cold and frozen poultry and meat bottled and food stuff in Saudi Arabia. The company offers poultry and meat; cheese butter cream and evaporated milk; potato okra green beans frozen peas molokheya spinach mixed vegetables corn broccoli and canned vegetables; green black greek and kalamata olives as well as oil; avocado acai mango pomegranate guava strawberry berries cherries and cocktails; rice cooking oil thyme ketchup mayonnaise hot sauce tomato paste broad beans and tahina; seafood shrimp and fish FPP; chicken meat vegetarian and pizza ready meals; and puff pastry paratha samosa spring roll kunafa and baklava products. It also provides logistical services including storage and transportation services. The company sells its products under the Dari DOUX COOPOLIVA LambWeston President Asmak Montana Marietta Fletcher Silver Fern Farms Valbreso Moralejo Selección and Villa Germania brands through direct-to-retail distribution food services wholesale and online sales platforms. The company was founded in 1950 and is headquartered in Riyadh Saudi Arabia. Almunajem Foods Company operates as a subsidiary of Abdullah Ali Almunajem Sons Company.

Name: Dar Al Majed Real Estate Company
Description: Dar Al Majed Real Estate Company a real estate development company develops residential villas and commercial buildings in Saudi Arabia. The company was formerly known as Nasser and Abdulsalam Abdulrahman AlMajed Real Estate Company and changed its name to Dar Al Majed Real Estate Company in 2020. Dar Al Majed Real Estate Company was founded in 1969 and is based in Riyadh Saudi Arabia.

Name: Sanlam Maroc
Description: Sanlam Maroc provides insurance services Morocco. It offers various life and non-life insurances. The company was formerly known as SAHAM Assurance S.A. and changed its name to Sanlam Maroc in June 2022. The company was founded in 1949 and is headquartered in Casablanca Morocco. Sanlam Maroc is a subsidiary of Sanlam Pan Africa.

Name: Guararapes Confecções S.A.
Description: Guararapes Confecções S.A. together with its subsidiaries engages in the manufacture distribution and sale of clothes items for personal use and other related items in Brazil. It also offers financial services including interest-bearing products digital account cards loans insurance and assistance; and financial products.
