It also provides small and medium enterprises solutions including cash management integrated financial and treasury services; business banking solutions comprising account payment services and cash management trade business card foreign currency internet banking and call center services; business finance services such as small business and doctors’ finance; and investment purchasing and financing of corporate restructuring and financial instruments. In addition the company offers corporate and trade finance and account and liquidity management services; factoring; and foreign exchange money market hedging and risk management and market analysis solutions. Further it provides financial leasing services and sale and lease back services that include funding of various assets such as buildings machinery and equipment passenger and commercial vehicles and others; and mergers and acquisitions and debt and equity capital market services. The company was formerly known as National Bank for Development (S.A.E) and changed its name to Abu Dhabi Islamic Bank - Egypt S.A.E in April 2012. Abu Dhabi Islamic Bank - Egypt S.A.E was founded in 1974 and is based in Cairo Egypt. Abu Dhabi Islamic Bank - Egypt - S.A.E is a subsidiary of Abu Dhabi Islamic Bank PJSC.

Name: Societe Ivoirienne Des Tabacs S A
Description: Societe Ivoirienne Des Tabacs S A operates as a subsidiary of Imperial Tobacco Group plc.

Name: Duniec Bros. Ltd
Description: Duniec Bros. Ltd operates as a public construction company primarily in Israel. The company engages in the planning developing construction marketing and selling of residential construction projects. Duniec Bros. Ltd was formerly known as Doniec Bros Company Ltd. and changed its name to Duniec Bros. Ltd in November 1992. The company was founded in 1963 and is based in Rishon LeZion Israel.

Name: Aradei Capital S.A.
Description: Aradei Capital S.A. together with its subsidiaries operates as a commercial real estate company in Morocco. The company engages in the possession acquisition development and rental of commercial real estate assets. It also provides property management and facility management services such as rental management property and mall management commercialization marketing and communication rental and real estate laws technical management design development management and preliminary studies for the supervision of the implementation until opening. The company was formerly known as Vecteur LV and changed its name to Aradei Capital S.A. in 2018. Aradei Capital S.A. was found 2013 and is headquartered in Casablanca Morocco.

Name: Al-Saif Stores for Development & Investment Company
Description: Al-Saif Stores for Development & Investment Company engages in the wholesale and retail sale of household utensils electrical appliances and cleaning supplies in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. It also engages in the general contracting; construction repair restoration and demolition of buildings; public construction of road works water and sewage works dams drilling wells; maintenance and operation of electrical mechanical and electronic installation; landscaping and blacksmithing carpentry aluminum decoration gypsum maintenance and cleaning works; management and operation of cities utilities buildings and public and private facilities; and buying and owning real estate and lands to construct buildings. It also sells its products online. The company was founded in 1993 in and is headquartered in Riyadh the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

Name: Log-In Logística Intermodal S.A.
Description: Log-in Logística Intermodal S.A. engages in the provision of integrated logistics solutions for moving and transporting door-to-door containers and cargo in Brazil Austria and internationally. It operates through Integrated Logistics Solutions Port Terminal and Road Cargo Transport segments. The company offers cabotage services; coastal shipping and maritime services; warehousing separation and cross-dock services; and storage services for containers and general cargo as well as manages and operates container port terminals. It also provides road freight transport of cargo and parcels; administration transportation consultancy storage and customs clearance services; and river navigation agency and arm vessels cargo import and export and multimodal transport services. In addition the company is involved in the purchase sale rental administration construction and operation of real estate; distribution of material and equipment by air land sea or river; investment activities in securities; maritime trade; and deposit loading and unloading of goods. The company was incorporated in 1973 and is headquartered in Rio De Janeiro Brazil. Log-In Logística Intermodal S.A. is a subsidiary of SAS Shipping Agencies Services SÀRL.

Name: NCB Financial Group Limited
Description: NCB Financial Group Limited provides various banking products and services in Jamaica Trinidad and Tobago Dutch Antilles Bermuda and internationally. It operates through Consumer & SME Banking; Payment Services; Corporate & Commercial Banking; Treasury & Corresponding Banking; Wealth Asset Management & Investment Banking; Life and Health Insurance & Pension Fund Management; and General Insurance segments. The Consumer & SME Banking segment provides banking services to individual and small and medium business clients. Its Payment Services segment offers card related services and digital/electronic payment services. The Corporate & Commercial Banking segment provides banking services to large corporate clients. Its Treasury & Correspondent Banking segment engages in the liquidity and investment management function management of correspondent bank relationships and relationship with other financial institutions as well as foreign currency dealing activities. The Wealth Asset Management & Investment Banking segment offers stock brokerage securities trading investment management and other financial services. Its Life and Health Insurance & Pension Fund Management segment provides life and health insurance investment management and pension fund management services. The General Insurance segment offers property and casualty insurance services. NCB Financial Group Limited was founded in 1837 and is headquartered in Kingston Jamaica.

Name: Hosken Consolidated Investments Limited
Description: Hosken Consolidated Investments Limited an investment holding company operates media and broadcasting gaming transport properties coal mining and branded products and manufacturing businesses in South Africa Other African countries the Middle East Europe and the United Kingdom. The company owns and operates hotel and leisure such as casinos hotels galaxy bingo sites gaming machines and vslots. It also involved in the operation of conference and exhibition industrial inner-city housing mixed-use precincts office student accommodation and retail properties. In addition the company engages in textile and non-woven textile manufacturing toy distribution and property investment activities. Further the company involved in the coal mining; and exploration and development of palladium. Hosken Consolidated Investments Limited was incorporated in 1973 and is based in Cape Town South Africa.

Name: Scope Metals Group Ltd.
Description: Scope Metals Group Ltd. stores processes and delivers metal and plastic worldwide. The company supplies aluminum stainless steel steel plastic materials copper bronze brass titanium zinc lead tungsten magnesium and other raw materials. Its products include actuators control and shut-off valves gate and globe valves pressure reducing valves positioners control instrumentation check valves and strainers measuring instruments steam traps and humidifiers expansion joints and vessels expansion joints sphere connectors plastic valves; fire sprinkler and protection systems firefighting monitors cabinets pumps nozzles suppression foam fire apparatus equipment pipework and fittings hydrants industrial firefighting systems and other accessories. In addition the company offers clean water vacuum industrial sanitary diaphragm and submersible pumps boosters mixers silukit macerator and mixing equipment; anchors screws nuts washers rings threaded rods pins rivets hose clamps and self-clinching fasteners. Further it provides welding electrodes and wires; submerged arc welding welding helmets and metal surface treatments; industrial flooring systems floor plates expanded meshes perforated sheets modular railings chains cables tensioners decorative aluminum sheets plastic sheets corrugated panels decorative stainless sheets and tiles; handles and hinges. The company was founded in 1968 and is based in Bnei Ayish Israel.

Name: Kocaer Celik Sanayi ve Ticaret Anonim Sirketi
Description: Kocaer Celik Sanayi ve Ticaret Anonim Sirketi together with its subsidiaries engages in the production and sale of iron and steel products in Turkey and internationally. It offers merchant bars such as equal angle round square T serrated flat and flat bars; UB and UC universal beams W beam IPE beams HEA/HEB beams and IPN profiles; PFC C UPN UAC CH and UPE channels; and mining and tunneling steel profiles. The company also provides rasp bars steel profiles for solar mounting and tracking systems and underground fortification systems; and window sections. In addition it is also involved in domestic and international logistics activities. The company serves the structural steel transportation machinery manufacturing agriculture shipbuilding and defense industries. Kocaer Celik Sanayi ve Ticaret Anonim Sirketi was incorporated in 1984 and is based in Istanbul Turkey.

Name: Alexander Forbes Group Holdings Limited
Description: Alexander Forbes Group Holdings Limited a financial services company provides employee benefits retirement and healthcare consulting investment and wealth management solutions to corporate clients and individuals. It offers solutions for individuals including preservation funds unit trusts tax-free saving accounts actuarial consulting wills and estates planning retirement navigators and living and retirement annuities as well as healthcare broking and management solutions. The company also provides solutions for businesses such as retirement consulting services; platform investment consulting and multi-management services; healthcare consulting group risk and administration services; umbrella and beneficiary funds; and employee benefit systems. In addition it offers financial advisory and broking services. Alexander Forbes Group Holdings Limited operates in South Africa Namibia Botswana Jersey the Channel Islands and Nigeria. The company was formerly known as Alexander Forbes Equity Holdings Proprietary Limited and changed its name to Alexander Forbes Group Holdings Limited in June 2014. Alexander Forbes Group Holdings Limited was founded in 1935 and is headquartered in Sandton South Africa.

Name: Al Rajhi REIT Fund
Description: The Al Rajhi REIT is a Sharia compliant fund listed on Tadawul with the objective of generating periodic income through investing in income-generating real estate assets in Saudi Arabia. The fund is closed ended and invests in diverse property types.

Name: Middle East Company for Manufacturing and Producing Paper
Description: Middle East Company for Manufacturing and Producing Paper together with its subsidiaries engages in the production and sale of container boards and industrial papers in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia the Middle East Africa Asia and Europe. The company operates through two segments: Manufacturing and Trading. The Manufacturing segment provides containerboards comprising high performance fluting test liner dual use kraft liner board and white top test liner products under MEPFLUTE MEPLINER MEPDUAL MEPKRAFT and MEPWHITE brand names for use in beverages consumer durables detergents industrial goods and processed food industries; and semi-chemical fluting products under the MEPCHEM brand name for frozen and fresh food applications. The segment also offers paperboards including core boards under the MEPCORE brand name for film tape and label textiles and paper applications; plasterboard liners under the MEPGYPSUM brand name for interior wall lining systems; and absorbent kraft products under the MEPLAMINATE brand name for laminated furniture and shelves and counters and floors as well as industrial and tissue papers. In addition it is involved in the wholesale and retail sale of paper carton and plastic waste products; production and sale of tissue paper rolls; wholesale of wastes scrap and other products; provision of waste management and treatment services; recycling and collection of carton waste; and manufacture import and export of cartons. The company was incorporated in 2000 and is headquartered in Jeddah Saudi Arabia.

Name: Rio Paranapanema Energia S.A.
Description: Rio Paranapanema Energia S.A. generates and sells electricity in Brazil. It operates eight hydroelectric power plants; and two small hydroelectric plants that have an installed capacity of 2265.3 megawatts. The company was formerly known as Duke Energy International Geração Paranapanema S.A. and changed its name in January 2017. The company was founded in 1999 and is based in Sao Paulo Brazil. Rio Paranapanema Energia S.A. is a subsidiary of Rio Paranapanema Participações S.A.

Name: Barita Investments Limited
Description: Barita Investments Limited together with its subsidiary Barita Unit Trusts Management Company Limited engages in the securities brokerage money market cambio operation investment banking and funds management activities in Jamaica. The company operates through Fixed Income Funds Management and Other Operations segments. It offers managed funds including capital growth fund money market fund FX growth and bond portfolio income portfolio real estate portfolio individual retirement scheme and pension fund management as well as FX income calculator; fixed income products; advisory equity and debt raising and mergers and acquisitions services; and loans. The company was incorporated in 1977 and is based in Kingston Jamaica. Barita Investments Limited is a subsidiary of Cornerstone Financial Holdings Limited.

Name: Ege Endüstri ve Ticaret A.S.
Description: Ege Endüstri ve Ticaret A.S. develops manufactures and sells axle and suspension system components for commercial vehicles and special vehicle applications in Turkey and internationally. It offers fabricated axle housings tag axles air bellow beams trailer axles pusher axles and cast axles machining. The company was founded in 1964 and is based in Izmir Turkey. Ege Endüstri ve Ticaret A.S. is a subsidiary of Bayraktar Holding A.S.

Name: Cementos Pacasmayo S.A.A.
Description: Cementos Pacasmayo S.A.A. produces distributes and sells cement and cement-related materials in Peru. It operates in three segments: Cement Concrete Mortar and Precast; Quicklime; and Sales of Construction Supplies. The company offers cement and concrete products for use in residential and commercial construction and civil engineering; ready-mix concrete for use in construction sites; concrete precast such as paving units or paver stones for pedestrian walkways as well as other bricks for partition walls and concrete precast for structural and non-structural uses; and cement-based products. It also produces and distributes quicklime for use in steel food fishing and chemical industries. In addition the company sells and distributes other construction materials manufactured by third parties such as steel rebar wires nails corrugated iron electric conductors and plastic tubes and accessories. It offers its products directly to other retailers private construction companies and through a network of independent retailers and hardware stores. The company was incorporated in 1949 and is headquartered in Lima Peru. Cementos Pacasmayo S.A.A. is a subsidiary of Inversiones ASPI S.A.

Name: Al-Ahleia Insurance Company S.A.K.P.
Description: Al-Ahleia Insurance Company S.A.K.P. together with its subsidiaries engages in insurance and reinsurance operations in Kuwait. It operates in four segments: Non-life insurance Life insurance Reinsurance and Investments. The company offers motor insurance such as third party liability comprehensive vehicle personal accident public liability car total loss driver license and unified orange card insurance policies; life and medical insurance including travel individual life group life and medical insurance policies; and marine insurance such as marine hull and marine cargo insurance. It also offers property insurance including fire and household protection policies; engineering insurance policies such as contractors all risk erection all risk contractors plant and machinery machinery breakdown loss of profit due to machinery breakdown electronic equipment and deterioration of stock in cold stores insurance policies; liability insurance including general public liability professional indemnity and product liability insurance; and general accidents insurance such as money fidelity guarantee glass plate burglary personal accident workmen's compensation employer's liability bankers blanket directors and officers liability and decennial liability insurance products. In addition the company engages in investment activities. Al-Ahleia Insurance Company S.A.K.P. was incorporated in 1962 and is based in Kuwait City Kuwait.

Name: Value Grupo Financiero S.A.B. de C.V.
Description: Value Grupo Financiero S.A.B. de C.V. provides various financial services. It provides brokerage credit operational and financial leasing factoring stock market intermediary and other services. The company was formerly known as Grupo Financiero Fina Value SA de CV and changed its name to Value Grupo Financiero S.A.B. de C.V. in May 2000. Value Grupo Financiero S.A.B. de C.V. was incorporated in 1992 and is based in San Pedro Garza García Mexico.

Name: Press Corporation PLC
Description: Press Corporation PLC together with its subsidiaries operates in the financial services telecommunications energy retail and real estate sectors in Malawi and Tanzania. It operates through four segments: Financial Services Telecommunication Energy and All Other. The Financial Services segment offers retail and corporate and investment banking as well as stockbroking insurance and pension administration services. The Telecommunication segment provides information and communications technology-based product and services. The Energy segment manufactures ethanol. The All Other segment engages in the property investment and development; and manufacture and distribution of fish products. Press Corporation PLC was founded in 1961 and is based in Blantyre Malawi.

Name: Stanbic Holdings Plc
Description: Stanbic Holdings Plc engages in the banking insurance agency asset management and stock broking businesses in Kenya and South Sudan. It offers savings and current transactional investment fixed and call deposits; business overdraft and revolving credit; business term commercial property SME bizna SME trader loans as well as vehicle and asset finance; equity release construction and vacant land financing home loan KMRC affordable housing and cash advance; and corporate and business insurance. The company also provides bill avalisation documentary collections invoice discounting and LPO/ contract financing; agribusiness solutions; credit and debit cards; home travel motor and flexi protect insurance products; and corporate and business corporate and business liabilities and liabilities employee benefits and SME business insurance products. In addition it offers asset management services. The company was formerly known as CfC Stanbic Holdings Limited and changed its name to Stanbic Holdings Plc in October 2016. The company is headquartered in Nairobi Kenya. Stanbic Holdings Plc is a subsidiary of Stanbic Africa Holdings Limited.

Name: Palram Industries (1990) Ltd
Description: Palram Industries (1990) Ltd manufactures and sells thermoplastic sheets and panel systems and finished products in Israel and internationally. The company offers PVC polycarbonate and acrylic sheets and panel systems. Its products are used in DIY construction architectural project advertising agriculture safety and security and fabrication markets. The company was founded in 1963 and is based in Zevulun Israel. Palram Industries (1990) Ltd is a subsidiary of Ramat Yohanan Industries & Agriculture Development-Agricultural Coperative Society.

Name: Compañía General de Electricidad S.A.
Description: Compañía General de Electricidad S.A. through its subsidiary engages in the distribution and transmission of electricity business in Chile. It sells the 11058 GWh capacity of power. The company was founded in 1905 and is based in Santiago Chile. Compañía General de Electricidad S.A. is a subsidiary of State Grid Chile Electricity Spa.

Name: Konya Çimento Sanayii Anonim Sirketi
Description: Konya Çimento Sanayii Anonim Sirketi manufactures and sells cement Portland cement clinker and ready mixed concrete in Central Anatolia and the Mediterranean Region. It also offers testing and analysis services. The company was founded in 1954 and is based in Konya Turkey. Konya Çimento Sanayii Anonim Sirketi is a subsidiary of Parficim S.A.

Name: Enel Distribucion Chile S.A.
Description: Enel Distribucion Chile S.A. distributes electricity in Chile. It distributes electricity across 33 communes with concession area covering 2105 square kilometers in the Metropolitan region. The company was formerly known as Chilectra S.A. and changed its name to Enel Distribucion Chile S.A. in October 2016. Enel Distribucion Chile S.A. was founded in 1996 and is based in Santiago Chile. Enel Distribucion Chile S.A. operates as a subsidiary of Enel Chile S.A.

Name: Bank Nizwa SAOG
Description: Bank Nizwa SAOG provides commercial banking products and services to individuals small and medium size enterprises corporations and government institutions. It operates through three segments: Retail Banking Corporate Banking and Treasury and Investment Banking. The company offers personal banking products and services including current savings Mudaraba investment youth minors ladies banking and recurring deposit accounts; personal auto home and commercial finance for individuals as well as sustainable finance buyout and Iskan programmes; debit and credit cards; and wealth management services as well as long term financing letters of credit and foreign exchange services. It also provides project finance and syndication SME and commercial banking corporate call account and internet banking and trade finance; and government investment and international banking products and services. In addition the company offers current checking call and term investment accounts. It serves customers through various channels including Branches & ATMs digital and online banking. The company was incorporated in 2012 and is based in Muscat the Sultanate of Oman.

Name: Akçansa Çimento Sanayi ve Ticaret Anonim Sirketi
Description: Akçansa Çimento Sanayi ve Ticaret Anonim Sirketi together with its subsidiaries manufactures and sells cement clinker ready-mix concrete and aggregates in Turkey and internationally. The company operates through Cement and Ready-Mix Concrete segments. It offers products under the Akçansa Agregasa and Betonsa brand names. The company provides port services. The company was founded in 1967 and is headquartered in Istanbul Turkey.

Name: MEEZA QSTP LLC (Public)
Description: MEEZA QSTP LLC (Public) provides managed information technology (IT) services and solutions in Qatar the Middle East and North Africa. The company offers data center cloud managed security solution and workplace services as well as master system integrator services. It also provides software designing and programming; trades in computer network equipment and device; information technology consulting; stores data and documents; and designs electronic sites. MEEZA QSTP LLC (Public) was founded in 2008 and is based in Doha Qatar.

Name: Eastern Province Cement Company
Description: Eastern Province Cement Company produces and sells clinker and cement in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia and internationally. The company operates in two segments Cement and Precast. The Cement segment engages in the manufacture and wholesale of ordinary salt-resistant and clinker cement. The Precast segment provides partitions frames and prefabricated buildings from prefabricated concrete. It is also involved in the operation of quarries mining of gypsum and anhydrite and wholesale of cement and gypsum. Eastern Province Cement Company was founded in 1982 and is headquartered in Dammam the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

Name: Alujain Corporation
Description: Alujain Corporation together with its subsidiaries produces and sells propylene and polypropylene products in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia and internationally. It also engages in the manufacture distribution and sale of geo-synthetic products; and wholesale of chemicals basic plastic rubber and synthetic fiber homecare products insecticides and agricultural insecticides as well as manufactures organic chemicals including styrene. In addition the company operates and invests in petrochemical and chemical industries as well as in basic and transformational plastic renewable energy and other industries. The company was formerly known as Alujain Holding Corporation and changed its name to Alujain Corporation in May 2022. Alujain Corporation was incorporated in 1991 and is headquartered in Riyadh the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

Name: SalfaCorp S.A.
Description: SalfaCorp S.A. engages in engineering construction and real estate businesses in Chile and internationally. The company offers construction and industrial assembly civil works construction industrial maintenance mining development marine works earthmoving and drilling and blasting services as well as undertakes engineering procurement and construction projects. It is also involved in real estate commercial and infrastructure activities; and development and rental of commercial and industrial projects. The company was founded in 1929 and is based in Santiago Chile.

Name: Forus S.A.
Description: Forus S.A. designs develops markets and distributes footwear apparel accessories and beauty/ personal care products in Chile Peru Colombia and Uruguay. The company offers its products under the CAT RKF Columbia Under Armour Merrell BSoul VANS Hush Puppies Azaleia Norseg and as of this year Crocs and L’OCCITANE en Provence brand names. It serves its customers through sales channels which include physical stores e-commerce websites and wholesale and third-party marketplaces. The company was formerly known as Comercial Hush Puppies Chile Limitada and changed its name to Forus S.A. in December 1991. Forus S.A. was founded in 1980 and is headquartered in Santiago Chile. Forus S.A. is a subsidiary of Inversiones Costanera Limitada.

Name: Batisöke Söke Çimento Sanayii T.A.S.
Description: Batisöke Söke Çimento Sanayii T.A.S. manufactures and sells cement and clinker products in Turkey and internationally. The company offers portland cement clinkers and potassium silicate cement; portland cement sulphate resistant portland cement portland compound cement and pozzolanic cement; and aggregates and cement bypass dust. It also exports its products. The company was incorporated in 1955 and is headquartered in Izmir Turkey. Batisöke Söke Çimento Sanayii T.A.S. is a subsidiary of Batiçim Bati Anadolu Çimento Sanayii Anonim Sirketi.

Name: Banco Internacional
Description: Banco Internacional provides various banking products and services in Chile. The company operates through Commercial Banking Personal Banking and Treasury and Investments segments. It offers current accounts; leasing factoring and structured financing services; revolving credit facilities; term deposits and mutual funds; collection and cash management services; and working capital foreign trade treasury and other products. It also provides consumer loans credit cards mortgage loans and other products; and investments. The company was formerly known as Banco Israelita de Chile and changed its name to Banco Internacional in July 1981. Banco Internacional was founded in 1944 and is based in Las Condes Chile. Banco Internacional operates as a subsidiary of ILC Holdco Spa.

Name: Administradora de Fondos de Pensiones y Cesantías Protección S.A.
Description: Administradora de Fondos de Pensiones y Cesantías Protección S.A. is a publicly owned investment manager. The firm manages pension funds for its clients. It invests in equity markets. Administradora de Fondos de Pensiones y Cesantías Protección based in Medellin Colombia.

Name: Arabian Mills for Food Products Company
Description: Arabian Mills for Food Products Company produces and sells wheat and feed products in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. It also offers livestock and poultry feed; and bran. The company was formerly known as Second Milling Company and changed its name to Arabian Mills for Food Products Company in November 2023. Arabian Mills for Food Products Company was founded in 1977 and is based in Riyadh Saudi Arabia. The company operates as a subsidiary of Abdulaziz Alajlan & Sons Company for Commercial and Real Estate Investment SA.

Name: Zamil Industrial Investment Company
Description: Zamil Industrial Investment Company engages in the design and engineering manufacturing and fabrication of construction materials pre-engineering steel buildings steel structures air conditions and climate control systems. It operates through four segments: Air Conditioners Industry Steel Industry Insulation Industry and Corporate and Others. The Air Conditioners Industry segment produces window split and central air conditioners; electrical and gas ovens; automatic dryers; microwave ovens; air conditioning ducts/channels; household refrigerators; and automatic washing machines as well as engages in the installation maintenance operation and leasing of air conditioning and refrigeration systems. The Steel Industry segment engages in constructing managing and operating industrial projects airports and warehouses; constructing and providing fire protection services for building and structures; building repairing and maintaining the communication towers. This segment is involved in the business of steel sheets works heavy equipment and spare parts and storage tanks; installation of containers and pumps; and implementation of electric works. The Insulation Industry segment engages in the production of insulation products including fiberglass for thermal insulation of central air conditioners pre-insulated pipes glass wool rock wool and engineering plastic foam insulations. The Corporate and Others segment is involved in training and investment activities. It caters commercial industrial and residential applications as well as telecom and broadcasting towers process equipment fiberglass rockwool and engineering plastic foam insulation and solar power projects in Saudi Arabia other Asian countries and Africa. The company was founded in 1974 and is headquartered in Dammam Saudi Arabia.

Name: Orascom Development Egypt S.A.E.
Description: Orascom Development Egypt S.A.E. engages in developing buildings and integrated communities in Egypt. The company operates through Hotels Real Estate Land Sales Town Management and Other Activities segments. It develops residences hotels and commercial and leisure amenities such as golf courses sports facilities retail and restaurants and marinas; provides hospitality services; sells land and land rights; and offers facilities and infrastructure services at resorts and towns. The company also offers real estate rental mortgages sports hospital services educational services marina rentals limousine rentals and other services. The company was founded in 1995 and is headquartered in Giza Egypt. Orascom Development Egypt S.A.E. is a subsidiary of Orascom Development Holding AG.

Name: Shamal Az-Zour Al-Oula Power and Water Company KSC (Public)
Description: Shamal Az-Zour Al-Oula Power and Water Company KSC (Public) develops constructs owns and operates power and water plants in Kuwait. It produces and supplies water and power to the national power and water grid. The company was incorporated in 2013 and is headquartered in Kuwait City Kuwait.
Industry: Independent Power and Renewable Electricity Producers

Name: Vicenne S.A
Description: Vicenne S.A distributes technology-intensive equipment solutions and services to healthcare professionals. It provides medical equipment laboratory equipment and implantable devices. The company engages in the distribution of radiotherapy equipment such as accelerators; medical imaging including MRI scanners and catheterization rooms; implantable medical devices including heart valves and cochlear implants; and in vitro diagnostics which include equipment and reagents for laboratories. It is also involved in the collection management and treatment of medical and pharmaceutical waste; and provision of support and advisory services. The company was formerly known as Best Health S.A. and changed its name to Vicenne S.A in 2025. Vicenne S.A was incorporated in 2004 and is headquartered in Rabat Morocco.

Name: E7 Group PJSC
Description: E7 Group PJSC engages in commercial printing packaging and distribution business in the United Arab Emirates. It operates in two segments Printing and Distribution. The Printing segment is involved in the printing publishing packaging and distribution of newspapers magazines books outdoor printing collaterals and educational publishing solutions; and provision of banking cards telecom cards national ID cards and passports as well as foldable boxes disposable food packaging frozen food packaging and paper cups. The Distribution segment provides services including fulfilment distributions logistics mailing room and customer services. It serves its products to banking government telecom hospitality financial institutions education healthcare food and beverage transportation pharmaceuticals media and retailer sectors. The company was formerly known as United Printing & Publishing Sole Proprietorship LLC and changed its name to E7 Group PJSC in November 2023. The company is based in Abu Dhabi the United Arab Emirates.

Name: Coris Bank International SA
Description: Coris Bank International SA provides banking products and services to individual business and NGO/association customers in Burkina Faso. It offers checking savings term deposit money and business accounts; guarantees; bank cards; SMS banking services; tax deposits; cash real estate operating and investment credits; cardless money services; and foreign exchange transactions transfers and e-statement services as well as operates E-CORIS services. The company was founded in 2008 and is headquartered in Ouagadougou Burkina Faso. Coris Bank International SA operates as a subsidiary of Coris Holding SA.

Name: Kalyon Günes Teknolojileri Üretim A.S.
Description: Kalyon Günes Teknolojileri Üretim A.S. manufactures and sells solar panels to solar power plants in Turkey and internationally. The company was founded in 2020 and is based in Ankara Turkey. Kalyon Günes Teknolojileri Üretim A.S. operates as a subsidiary of Kalyon Teknoloji Yatirimlari Sanayi ve Ticaret A.S.

Name: Al-Maidan Clinic for Oral Health Services Company K.S.C.P.
Description: Al-Maidan Clinic for Oral Health Services Company K.S.C.P. provides oral health care services in Kuwait. It operates in two segments Clinics and Hospital. The Clinics segment operates clinics that offer services relating to oral health care diagnosis consultations and treatment to outpatients with a specialty in dental treatment. The Hospital segment operates hospitals which provide services related to medical diagnosis health care consultations surgical and treatment to outpatients and inpatients with various specialties. The company offers dental services including prosthodontics and cosmetic dental implants and periodontics orthodontics pedodontics endodontic restorative services conservative services dental hygiene and sterilization services. It also engages in shares and real estate trading activities; building and management of specialized medical centers; and contracting with doctors nurses and technicians. In addition it provides medical services; maintenance services for medical devices and equipment; conducts studies and researches related to the field of dentistry and contracting; establishes and manages specialized laboratories; dentistry and medical house services; purchases medical devices and equipment; owns properties; and undertakes transportation activities. The company was founded in 1987 and is headquartered in Kuwait City Kuwait. Al-Maidan Clinic for Oral Health Services Company K.S.C.P. operates as a subsidiary of United Medical Services Company K.S.C.

Name: Arabian Cement Company
Description: Arabian Cement Company engages in the production trading and selling of cement in Saudi Arabia and Jordan. The company trades construction materials clinker derivatives and other related materials. It also produces concrete products. Arabian Cement Company was incorporated in 1955 and is headquartered in Jeddah Saudi Arabia.

Name: CW Enerji Mühendislik Ticaret ve Sanayi Anonim Sirketi
Description: CW Enerji Mühendislik Ticaret ve Sanayi Anonim Sirketi operates in the photovoltaic power generation sector in Turkey. The company offers inverters comprising of hybrid irrigation communication and monitoring solar irrigation off and on grid inventors; MPPT and PWM charge controllers; solar equipment energy storage heating solar panels and cooling related equipment. It also provides solar packs such as vineyard house/caravan packages boat/yacht packages micro inverter kits carport packages and agricultural irrigation packages. In addition the company offers solar-power irrigation systems off-grid and on-grid solutions solar power camera systems and signages and Led lighting system services. Further it provides technical and maintenance services. CW Enerji Mühendislik Ticaret ve Sanayi Anonim Sirketi was incorporated in 2010 and is headquartered in Antalya Turkey.

Name: SHL Finance Company
Description: SHL Finance Company operates as a real estate finance company in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. It engages in financing the purchasing of houses residential lands and apartments; financing of real estate properties; and financing the establishment of commercial and industrial projects. The company was formerly known as Saudi Home Loans Company and changed its name to SHL Finance Company in February 2023. SHL Finance Company was founded in 2007 and is based in Riyadh the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

Name: Banque Internationale pour le Commerce et l'Industrie de la Côte d'Ivoire S.A.
Description: Banque Internationale pour le Commerce et l'Industrie de la Côte d'Ivoire S.A. provides various banking and financial services to professionals individuals and corporate clients in Ivory Coast. It offers various accounts credits payments money transfers savings and investments cash management solutions and insurance services. The company was founded in 1962 and is headquartered in Abidjan Ivory Coast. Banque Internationale pour le Commerce et l'Industrie de la Côte d'Ivoire S.A. operates as a subsidiary of BNP Paribas SA.

Name: Banco Bolivariano C.A.
Description: Banco Bolivariano C.A. provides banking products and services in Ecuador. It offers saving and current accounts; payroll collection money transfer and foreign trade services; mortgage and vehicle loan products as well as short- and medium-term loans; and internet banking services. The company was founded in 1978 and is based in Guayaquil Ecuador.

Name: Batiçim Bati Anadolu Çimento Sanayii Anonim Sirketi
Description: Batiçim Bati Anadolu Çimento Sanayii Anonim Sirketi operates in the cement industry in Turkey and internationally. The company offers Portland cement clinkers and potassium silicate cements; Portland sulphate resistant Portland Portland compound and pozzolanic cements; and aggregate and cement bypass dust products. Batiçim Bati Anadolu Çimento Sanayii Anonim Sirketi was founded in 1966 and is headquartered in Izmir Turkey.

Name: Consultatio S.A.
Description: Consultatio S.A. engages in the real estate development and investment business in Argentina and internationally. It is involved in the development of urbanizations; residential buildings for sale; and corporate towers. The company was incorporated in 1981 and is headquartered in Buenos Aires Argentina.

Name: Nemak S. A. B. de C. V.
Description: Nemak S. A. B. de C. V. together with its subsidiaries develops manufactures and sells aluminum components for e-mobility structure and chassis and ICE powertrain applications to the automotive industry in North America Europe and internationally. The company offers ICE powertrain components such as cylinder heads engine blocks oil pans and transmission cases; and vehicle structures and chassis products including lift gates longitudinal members support brackets A-pillars cradles e-brackets shock towers and subframes. It also provides e-mobility components comprising e-motor and battery housings for hybrid and electric vehicles. The company was formerly known as Tenedora Nemak S. A. de C. V. and changed its name to Nemak S. A. B. de C. V. in June 2015. Nemak S. A. B. de C. V. was incorporated in 1979 and is headquartered in García Mexico.

Name: Menivim - The New Reit Ltd
Description: Menivim - The New Reit Ltd was founded in 2015 and is headquartered in Caesarea Israel.

Name: Phoenix Power Company SAOG
Description: Phoenix Power Company SAOG owns designs develops constructs operates maintains finances and insures power generating station and associated gas interconnection facilities and other related infrastructure in the Sultanate of Oman. The company owns and operates the Sur independent power plant a gas-fired combined cycle power facility with an installed capacity of 2000 megawatts located in the Sur Industrial area Muscat. Phoenix Power Company was incorporated in 2011 and is headquartered in Muscat the Sultanate of Oman.
Industry: Independent Power and Renewable Electricity Producers

Name: Safwa Islamic Bank
Description: Safwa Islamic Bank together with its subsidiaries provides various banking products and services in Jordan. The company operates through three segments: Retail Accounts Corporate Accounts and Treasury. It offers current and savings accounts and investment deposits and certificates; deposit boxes; car real estate Musawamah travel education and treatment financing as well as goods land motorcycle stocks and solar systems and heaters financing; prepaid credit and ATM cards; and online and mobile banking and SMS services. The company is also involved in the provision of corporate banking and cash management services; cash deposit machines; financing services for small enterprises; capital market services; and buying and sale of securities as well as products and services related to Sukuk. In addition it offers brokerage and treasury and fund management; and refinancing services; and point-of-sale (pos) devices. The company was formerly known as Jordan Dubai Islamic Bank and changed its name to Safwa Islamic Bank in May 2017. Safwa Islamic Bank was incorporated in 1963 and is headquartered in Amman the Hashemite Kingdom of Jordan. Safwa Islamic Bank is a subsidiary of Etihad Islamic Investment Company.

Name: Ayalon Insurance Company Ltd
Description: Ayalon Insurance Company Ltd through its subsidiaries provides various insurance products in Israel. The company offers life insurance and long-term savings plans such as pension savings insurance funds and savings policies; and general insurance cover products including property liability marine and third party liability insurance as well as compulsory motor motor property and business property insurance. It also provides health insurance products including nursing care surgeries and transplants medical expenses outpatient coverage dental personal accident and medical insurance for foreign workers; and employers' third-party professional directors and officers and product liability insurance. In addition it offers fire engineering and works insurance; contractors insurance; comprehensive insurance for businesses and offices; mechanical engineering equipment insurance; mechanical breakdown electronic equipment and agricultural insurance; comprehensive insurance for apartments; cargo insurance in transportation and cyber damage insurance. Ayalon Insurance Company Ltd was formerly known as Ayalon Holdings Ltd and changed its name to Ayalon Insurance Company Ltd in July 2022. The company was founded in 1976 and is based in Ramat Gan Israel.

Name: Fourth Milling Company
Description: Fourth Milling Company engages in the production packaging and sale of flour and its byproducts animal feed and bran products the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. The company also engages in wheat maize and barley packing and milling; rice packing milling and bleaching; production of flour from rice; manufacture of flour and dough for bakeries; and manufacture of concentrated animal fodder and cattle fodder. It is also involved in operating animal food and feed stores; storage in warehouses of grain silos flour and agricultural products; wholesale of bakery products; and trading of special and healthy food; and storage in ports customs or free zones. The company was founded in 1972 and is based in Dammam the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. Gulf Flour Milling Industrial Company operates as a subsidiary of Gulf Flour Milling Industrial Company.

Name: Invictus Investment Company PLC
Description: Invictus Investment Company PLC together with its subsidiaries engages in trading of agricultural commodities and food products in Africa the Middle East Europe the Americas and Asia. It operates in two segments International Trading Business and Agri Commodities Wholesale Trading & Local Distribution. It trades in oilseeds sugar and sweeteners grains and cereals animal feed vegetable oils cotton and textiles ingredients and meat. The company is also involved in trading of non-manufactured precious metals and other general commodities. In addition it provides sea cargo and shipping lines agents services. The company was founded in 2014 and is headquartered in Dubai the United Arab Emirates. Invictus Investment Company PLC is a subsidiary of Invictus Holding Limited.

Name: Sun International Limited
Description: Sun International Limited owns and operates casino hotel and resort properties in South Africa. The company offers management services for businesses in the hotel resort casino and gambling industry. It is also involved in the gaming route operation and related activities; online sports betting and gaming business; and letting of retail facilities as well as operation and letting of entertainment facilities. Sun International Limited was founded in 1966 and is headquartered in Sandton South Africa.

Name: More Provident Funds Ltd
Description: More Provident Funds Ltd. manages provident and pension funds in Israel. The company offers provident funds for rewards and compensations savings education training and investments as well as for saving plans for a child; and general and comprehensive pension funds. More Provident Funds Ltd. was incorporated in 2013 and is based in Ramat Gan Israel.

Name: Avrupakent Gayrimenkul Yatirim Ortakligi Anonim Sirketi
Description: Avrupakent Gayrimenkul Yatirim Ortakligi Anonim Sirketi engages in the real estate development leasing and business administration activities in Turkey. It operates residential shopping malls and other real estate properties. The company was founded in 1977 and is based in Istanbul Turkey.

Name: City Cement Company
Description: City Cement Company together with its subsidiaries manufactures and sells cement in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. The company provides ordinary portland cement for construction and plastering works concrete pipe and block and tile industry; and concrete structure works. It also offers sulphate resistant cement for wastewater treatment plants coastal ports and platforms and dams and land infrastructure; and green finishing cement. In addition the company engages in the import and operation of radioactive devices of its plants processing waste industrial agricultural and municipal waste as well as produces alternative fuels. The company was founded in 2005 and is headquartered in Riyadh the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

Name: RCL Foods Limited
Description: RCL Foods Limited operates as a food manufacturer in South Africa. The company operates through the Groceries Baking and Sugar segments. It is involved in culinary products including mayonnaise peanut butter and rusks; milling specialty and bakery products; breads buns rolls and pies; as well as pet food products and beverages and sugar and molasses-based feed operations. The company sells its products primarily under the Ouma Nola Yum Yum Nutso Bobtail Catmor Dogmor Ultra Dog Canine Cuisine Optimizer Feline Cuisine Mageu Number 1 Monati Mnandi Supreme Tafelberg Safari A1 5 Star Sunbake Piemans Sunshine and Selati brands. In addition it engages in treasury international investments farming marketing and food innovation and research activities. The company was formerly known as Rainbow Chicken Limited and changed its name to RCL Foods Limited in August 2013. RCL Foods Limited was founded in 1960 and is based in Durban South Africa.

Name: Carreras Limited
Description: Carreras Limited markets and distributes cigarettes primarily in Jamaica. The company offers its products under the Craven A Matterhorn Dunhill Rothmans Pall Mall and Vuse brand names. Carreras Limited was incorporated in 1962 and is based in Kingston Jamaica. Carreras Limited is a subsidiary of Rothmans Holdings (CARICOM) Limited.

Name: Lesha Bank LLC
Description: Lesha Bank LLC an Islamic bank together with its subsidiaries provides financial products and solutions to Qatar and internationally. The company operates through Alternative Investments Private Bank and Other segments. It provides private wealth management; fixed income money market; investment banking advisory including mergers and acquisitions debt advisory/debt capital markets equity capital markets and restructuring advisory; and real estate investments services. The company is also involved in direct investment in the venture capital business direct private equity; provision of private banking including advisory deposit accounts brokerage funds and investments treasury forex products plain vanilla and financing and elite services to high net worth clients; and short term liquid investment and FX products to banking clients. In addition it engages in arranging deals in investment and credit facilities; provision and arranging of custody services; manages and advising on investments; and operates a collective investment fund. Further the company is involved in money market fund; financing construction; and owning and leasing real estate properties. The company was formerly known as Qatar First Bank L.L.C (Public) and changed its name to Lesha Bank LLC in October 2022. Lesha Bank LLC was founded in 2008 and is based in Doha Qatar.

Name: Thungela Resources Limited
Description: Thungela Resources Limited engages in the mining and production of thermal coal in South Africa and Australia. It owns interests in and produces its thermal coal from mining operations consisting of underground and open cast mines in the Mpumalanga province of South Africa including Goedehoop colliery Greenside colliery Isibonelo colliery Khwezela colliery Zibulo colliery and Mafube colliery. It also holds 85% of the Ensham Mine located in Queensland Australia. The company also exports its products to Indian Asian Southeast Asian the Middle East and North African markets. Thungela Resources Limited was founded in 1945 and is based in Johannesburg South Africa.

Name: GB Corp
Description: GB Corp engages in the assembly manufacture sale distribution financing and after-sales service of automotive products in the Middle East and Egypt. It operates through Passenger Car Buses and Trucks 2 & 3 Wheels Financial Non-Banking Services and Other Operations segments. The company offers new and used heavy trucks semi-trucks passenger cars buses mini and micro buses agriculture tractors cranes and mechanical tools equipment for soil movement and motors with various structures. It also provides trailers superstructures and construction and farming equipment; motorcycles; and three-wheelers. In addition the company is involved in trading spare parts and accessories and tires for vehicles and equipment as well as light trucks; undertakes import and export activities; provision of microfinancing nano-financing SME lending factoring mortgage finance leasing venture capital securitization consumer lending and insurance services. It sells its products under the Hyundai Mazda Chery Changan Haval Karry Bajaj Marcopolo Volvo Truck and Volvo Bus Volvo Construction Equipment Mitsubishi Fuso SDLG Higer Shacman Lassa Yokohama DoubleCoin Goodyear Thunderer MRF Sunfull and MG as well as Westlake Verde and Techking brands. The company was formerly known as GB Auto (S.A.E.) and changed its name to GB Corp in May 2023. The company was founded in 1940 and is headquartered in Giza Egypt.

Name: Combined Group Contracting Company - K.S.C. (Public)
Description: Combined Group Contracting Company - K.S.C. (Public) together with its subsidiaries operates as a contracting company in State of Kuwait and other Gulf countries. The company offers construction general contracting and renovations of residential and non-residential buildings nonindustrial railway facilities and airports; and hospitals free zones or markets cooling warehouses buildings precast houses roads pavements bridges tunnels and infrastructure works. It is also involved in laying of communication and power lines oil liquefied petroleum gas steam fire irrigation and electrical and telecommunications wiring and networks; construction and maintenance of main lines and water distribution stations irrigation and sewer systems water wells drilling sewage disposal plants pumping stations and power plants parking lots outdoor swimming pools refineries petrochemical plants port docks marine structures tourist marinas and dams; and demolition removal site preparation pouring foundations dewatering and rocks and rocky ground blasting services. In addition the company builds finishing; installs lighting systems fire alarms and other electrical installation solar energy collectors emergency and exit lighting cooling systems sanitary wares and mechanical installations; ceramic terrazzo marble cut stone granite marble carpets and linoleum floor coverings and rubber or plastic and parquet and decorations; and exterior glass of towers interiors of shops mobile homes boats furniture and exterior cladding. Further it is involved in plastering or stucco and painting works; maintaining of oil pipes; building completion and preparation work bricklaying and stone setting works and scaffolding erecting; contracting for insulating materials and protection materials; and import of aggregate. The company was incorporated in 1965 and is based in Kuwait City Kuwait. The company is a subsidiary of Insha'a Holding Company.

Name: Balsu Gida Sanayi ve Ticaret Anonim Sirketi
Description: Balsu Gida Sanayi Ve Ticaret Anonim Sirketi engages in production processing and logistics facilities in Turkey and internationally. The company supplies natural roasted blanched and diced hazelnuts as well as hazelnut pastes and meals. It exports its products to approximately 110 countries. The company was founded in 1978 and is headquartered in Istanbul Turkey.

Name: I&M Group PLC
Description: I&M Group PLC together with its subsidiaries provides various banking products and services in Kenya Tanzania Rwanda Uganda and Mauritius. The company offers personal transaction and savings accounts; business and special accounts as well as fixed deposits; loans including car/vehicle home/mortgage asset finance and personal and business; and credit debit and prepaid cards. It also provides wealth management custodial trade finance services; insurance products; local and international transfers and government payments; investment products; and business solutions such as business connect cash management direct debit scheme payment solution water services and remote cheque scanning solutions. In addition it is involved in provision of financial advisory services; and real estate investments. The company was formerly known as I&M Holdings Plc and changed its name to I&M Group PLC in June 2022. I&M Group PLC was incorporated in 1950 and is based in Nairobi Kenya.

Name: Corporación Actinver S. A. B. de C. V.
Description: Corporación Actinver S. A. B. de C. V. through its subsidiaries provides financial and investment banking services for individuals and businesses in Mexico and internationally. The company operates through Private Banking and Wealth Management Global Markets Asset Management Corporate and Investment Banking and Actinver Patrimonial and Digital Channels segments. It offers investment management advice; capital desks money exchanges and derivatives; consulting services in the field of insurance fiduciary social security debit cards checkbooks credit and leasing; transactional services to individuals from private banking wealth management and corporate banking as well as institutional clients; investment solutions through investment funds ETFs and management of mandates; advisory services to legal entities such as credit leasing and insurance as well as asset management global markets and investment banking products and services; and digital tools services. The company also provides personal basic payroll MX and digital accounts; social welfare services; personal retirement and pension plans; saving funds and issuer trusts; investment products including investment funds capital market money market exchange market and derivatives market; credit services such as pledge auto and revolving credit; and insurance products including life auto health home and business insurance as well as educational savings plans. In addition it operates Bursanet an online trading platform; and offers credit and leasing fiduciary and asset protection and social security services. The company was formerly known as Grupo Actinver S.A. de C.V and changed its name to Corporación Actinver S. A. B. de C. V. The company was founded in 1994 and is based in Mexico City Mexico.

Name: Stadio Holdings Limited
Description: Stadio Holdings Limited through its subsidiaries provides higher education programs in South Africa and Namibia. The company offers undergraduate programs including higher certificates diplomas and degrees; and post-graduate programs such as honors and master’s degrees and doctorates through contact and distance learning modules. It also provides programs across its schools of accounting business and commerce; administration and management; education; film; architecture and spatial design; media and design; fashion; information technology; law; policing and law enforcement; arts and humanities; and live performance and creative writing. In addition the company operates the STADIO Higher Education Milpark Education and AFDA higher education institutions. Stadio Holdings Limited was incorporated in 2016 and is based in Cape Town South Africa.

Name: Résidences Dar Saada S.A
Description: Résidences Dar Saada S.A engages in the real estate development business in the Kingdom of Morocco. Its projects include apartments villas land shops and duplexes. Résidences Dar Saada S.A was founded in 2001 and is based in Casablanca the Kingdom of Morocco.

Name: Esval S.A.
Description: Esval S.A. produces and distributes drinking water in Chile. It also engages in the collection decontamination and disposal of wastewater and sewage. The company provides services in the municipalities of Valparaiso except Panquehue Olmué Juan Fernandez Santo Domingo and Easter Island. It also offers potable water services in Algarrobo. Esval S.A. was founded in 1989 and is based in Valparaíso Chile.

Name: Issta Ltd
Description: Issta Ltd provides travel and tourism services to private and business customers groups and organizations in Israel and internationally. It offers outbound and domestic tourism services including scheduled flights charter flights vacation packages organized trips ski vacations sports music and cruises as well as complementary services such as hotels car rentals visas and student cards. The company offers its products through its branches in Israel as well as through call centers and online travel services. The company was formerly known as Issta Lines Ltd. Issta Ltd was founded in 1956 and is based in Tel Aviv-Yafo Israel.

Name: Abraj Energy Services SAOG
Description: Abraj Energy Services SAOG an integrated energy company provides oilfield and well services in Oman and Kuwait. It operates in two segments Drilling and Work Over; and Well Services and Others. The company provides onshore drilling workover flowback well testing and intervention cementing fracturing coil tubing integrated project management drilling fluid and training services. The company was incorporated in 2006 and is based in Muscat Oman. Abraj Energy Services SAOG is a subsidiary of OQ SAOC.

Name: Capex S.A.
Description: Capex S.A. an integrated energy company engages in the exploration and exploitation of hydrocarbons in Argentina. The company is involved in the exploration and exploitation of oil and gas; construction and development of a combined-cycle thermal power plant with an installed capacity of 672 MW and an LPG plant; production of hydrogen and oxygen; and production and sale of propane butane and gasoline as well as generation of energy from wind farms and hydrogen/oxygen. It also processes and separates liquid gases derived from gas. The company was incorporated in 1988 and is based in Vicente López Argentina. Capex S.A. is a subsidiary of Companias Asociadas Petroleras S.A.

Name: QUA Granite Hayal Yapi ve Ürünleri Sanayi Ticaret A.S.
Description: QUA Granite Hayal Yapi ve Ürünleri Sanayi Ticaret A.S. manufactures exports and sells ceramics floor tiles tile materials and granite in Turkey Europe the United States and internationally. The company also offers bathroom kitchen outdoor and wall tiles; and toilets luminaires sinks reservoirs and shower systems. It sells its products through dealers distributors and DIY market chains. QUA Granite Hayal Yapi ve Ürünleri Sanayi Ticaret A.S. was incorporated in 2015 and is based in Aydin Turkey.

Name: AECI Ltd
Description: AECI Ltd together with its subsidiaries provides products and services for mining water treatment plant and animal health food and beverage manufacturing and general industrial sectors. The company operates through four segments: AECI Mining AECI Chemicals AECI Managed Businesses and AECI Property Services and Corporate. The AECI Mining segment provides mine-to-mineral solutions for the mining sector which includes commercial explosives initiating systems and blasting services as well as surfactants for explosives manufacture. The AECI Chemicals segment supplies industrial and speciality chemical products; water treatment chemicals; and technology equipment and plant and crop protection products as well as plant nutrients. The AECI Managed Businesses segment supplies products and services to customers in agriculture industrial manufacturing road infrastructure food and beverage public water and animal feed and products as well as the textile sector. The AECI Property Services and Corporate segment offers property leasing and management services in the office industrial and retail sectors. It operates in South Africa rest of the African continent Europe Asia North America South America and Australia. AECI Ltd was founded in 1894 and is based in Sandton South Africa.

Name: Farmacias Benavides S.A.B. de C.V.
Description: Farmacias Benavides S.A.B. de C.V. engages in the retail of health and wellness products. The company also provides medicamentos non-perishable food and hygiene and beauty products as well as photography. The company was founded in 1917 and is based in Monterrey Mexico. Farmacias Benavides S.A.B. de C.V. operates as a subsidiary of Walgreens Boots Alliance Inc.

Name: Jadwa Investment - Jadwa Reit Saudi Fund
National Real Estate Company - K.P.S.C.
Description: National Real Estate Company - K.P.S.C. together with its subsidiaries provides real estate investment and development services in the Middle East and North Africa. The company involved in the ownership development trading leasing and management of real estate properties and other activities. It also sells and purchases land and real estate properties; manages third-party properties and public facilities; constructs residential buildings; real estate consulting; repair and maintains air conditioning refrigeration and air purification equipment; and trade fairs organization and management. In addition the company engages in the design construction operation maintenance and transfer of projects; auctions; operates and manages hotel and restaurant; and investing activities. National Real Estate Company - K.P.S.C. was incorporated in 1973 and is based in Kuwait City Kuwait.

Name: Castleview Property Fund Limited
Description: Castleview Property Fund Limited is a property holding and investment company based in Cape Town South Africa that was listed as a REIT on the AltX of the JSE on 20 December 2017 with assets as at March 2024 of c. R22 billion. Run by a small focused executive team Castleview’s investment mandate is to deliver healthy total returns to its shareholders via a diversified property portfolio by investing in South African and selected international real estate focused firstly on net asset value growth and secondly on the maintenance of a sustainable cash flow yield.

Name: Amen Bank Société anonyme
Description: Amen Bank Société anonyme provides banking products and services to individuals and businesses in Tunisia. It offers savings and term deposits; and investment products. The company was formerly known as Crédit Foncier et Commercial de Tunisie. Amen Bank Société anonyme was incorporated in 1967 and is headquartered in Tunis Tunisia.

Name: Plano & Plano Desenvolvimento Imobiliário S.A.
Description: Plano & Plano Desenvolvimento Imobiliário S.A. through its subsidiaries develops constructs and sells real estate projects in the São Paulo Metropolitan Region. The company was founded in 1997 and is based in São Paulo Brazil.

Name: Heavy Engineering Industries and Shipbuilding Company K.S.C.P.
Description: Heavy Engineering Industries and Shipbuilding Company K.S.C.P. together with its subsidiaries operates as an engineering procurement and construction contracting company in Kuwait. It operates in three segments: Industrial Oil & Gas; Shipyard; and Offshore. The company is involved in the construction and repair of ships; marine industrial installation and maintenance works related to ships waterways and ports; trading in equipment spare parts and industrial consumables; acting as an agent for trading agencies; industrial inspection works and radiation services; and maintenance repair and public services for transport lines oil and gas tankers refineries factories and annexes as well as projects and stations of electrical power generation and distribution water sources and water and electricity establishments safety. It also supplies installs and maintains safety equipment and security systems; provides installs and maintains establishments equipment machinery and devices as well as supplies specialized technical manpower for works related to the electricity water oil and environment sectors; undertakes contract works for laying and installation of pipes and fine cutting works through using plasma and water etc.; engages in sandblasting paint and fixed mobile scaffolds and welding; provides galvanization works; acquires movables and real estate; and owns intellectual property rights comprising patents trademarks and franchise rights. In addition the company engages in dredging marine and civil construction activities; shipyard oil and gas construction industrial maintenance fabrication service and onshore and offshore operations; electrical and mechanical works; diving and afloat/port repairs; and testing and calibration services. Heavy Engineering Industries and Shipbuilding Company K.S.C.P. was incorporated in 1974 and is headquartered in Kuwait City Kuwait.

Name: Faisal Islamic Bank of Egypt
Description: Faisal Islamic Bank of Egypt provides retail and corporate banking and investment services in Egypt and internationally. The company operates through Large Medium and Small Enterprises; Investment; Individuals; and Other Activities segments. It offers current and debit current accounts; deposits; financial derivatives; saving pools; and personal and real estate Murabaha. The company also engages in mergers purchase of investments; restructuring of financing companies and instruments; and finance and investment transactions as well as other banking activities such as fund management. In addition it provides mutual funds and saving certificates; Faisal investment Bab Rizk joint and investment accounts for minors; bank cards; e-wallet; and digital and online banking services as well as letters of credit and guarantee. Further the company offers promotion and marketing real-estate marketing specialized exhibitions appraisal and other services such as payment of periodical commitments and regular dues and concluding sale and rent contracts and real-estate mortgage agreements. Faisal Islamic Bank of Egypt was founded in 1977 and is headquartered in Cairo Egypt.

Name: Societe de Limonaderies et de Boissons Rafraichissantes d'Afrique
Description: Societe de Limonaderies et de Boissons Rafraichissantes d'Afrique engages in the manufacture and sale of beer soft drinks mineral water alcomixes and energy drink products. It operates malt houses breweries and lemonades; and manufactures preforms. The company was formerly known as Societe de Limonaderies et Brasseries d'Afrique SA and changed its name to Societe de Limonaderies et de Boissons Rafraichissantes d'Afrique in May 2023. The company was founded in 1955 and is based in Abidjan Ivory Coast.

Name: Keystone Infra Ltd
Description: Keystone REIT Ltd. operates in the asset management and custody banks industry. The company was incorporated in 2022 and is based in Israel.

Name: Mogan Enerji Yatirim Holding Anonim Sirketi
Description: Mogan Enerji Yatirim Holding Anonim Sirketi engages in the renewable energy business in Turkey. It generates energy through geothermal hydroelectric and wind power plants. The company was founded in 1980 and is based in Ankara Turkey.
Industry: Independent Power and Renewable Electricity Producers

Name: Dangote Sugar Refinery Plc
Description: Dangote Sugar Refinery Plc produces and sells refined sugar to consumers and industrial markets in Nigeria. The company offers vitamin A fortified sugar for direct consumption baked foods sweetening of cereals and beverages applications; and non-fortified industrial sugar used by pharmaceuticals food and beverage other manufacturing companies. It sells its products under the Dangote Sugar brands. The company also exports its products. The company was founded in 1999 and is headquartered in Lagos Nigeria. Dangote Sugar Refinery Plc is a subsidiary of Dangote Industries Limited.

Name: Qatar National Cement Company (Q.P.S.C.)
Description: Qatar National Cement Company (Q.P.S.C.) manufactures and sells cement lime washed sand and other related products in Qatar. The company offers ordinary Portland cement sulphate resistant cement hydrated and calcined lime white cement calcium carbonate and calcium carbonate fines and ground granulated blast furnace slag. Qatar National Cement Company (Q.P.S.C.) was incorporated in 1965 and is headquartered in Doha Qatar.

Name: Auto Hall S.A.
Description: Auto Hall S.A. engages in the marketing and distribution of rolling stocks in Morocco and Japan. The company offers SUVs compact utility and city cars. It also provides funding long-term rental and after-sales services. It markets and distributes various branded products such as Ford Nissan Chery Mitsubishi DFSK Fuso Foton GAZ Opel Ford Trucks New Holland MASERATI Jeep Alfa Romeo FIAT FIAT Professional Case Belaz AutoCaz LEADER and VALVOLINE brands. Auto Hall S.A. was founded in 1907 and is headquartered in Casablanca Morocco. Auto Hall S.A. is a subsidiary of Societe Amana.

Name: IZDEMIR Enerji Elektrik Uretim A.S.
Description: IZDEMIR Enerji Elektrik Uretim A.S. produces and sells electricity through coal. It is also involved in the iron-steel and port businesses. The company was incorporated in 2007 and is headquartered in Izmir Turkey. IZDEMIR Enerji Elektrik Uretim A.S. operates as a subsidiary of Izmir Demir Çelik Sanayi Anonim Sirketi.

Name: Banco Nacional de Crédito C.A. Banco Universal
Description: Banco Nacional de Crédito C.A. Banco Universal provides various banking products and services in Venezuela. It offers checking and savings accounts term deposit certificates and demand deposit accounts in foreign currency. The company also provides commercial credits auto financing invoice discounting and factoring discount financing alternatives and microcredits; bail bonds domestic letters of credit and letters of credit in foreign currency; and financing for agri-food manufacturing tourism health and mortgage sectors as well as for entrepreneurs. In addition it offers escrow services; cards; commerce/person collection services; ATMs; services for foreign and national currency; and points of sale and mobile and online banking services. The company was formerly known as Banco Tequendama C.A. and changed its name to Banco Nacional de Crédito C.A. Banco Universal in December 2004. Banco Nacional de Crédito C.A. Banco Universal was founded in 2003 and is headquartered in Caracas Venezuela.

Name: Credit Agricole - Egypt Bank (S.A.E.)
Description: Credit Agricole - Egypt Bank (S.A.E.) provides corporate retail and investment banking services in the Arab Republic of Egypt and internationally. It operates through Large Medium and Small Enterprises; Investment; Retail; and Asset and Liability Management segments. The company offers current and savings accounts; financial inclusion EGP payroll and USD and foreign accounts; deposits overdraft account credit facilities and financial derivative services; money management services; credit debit and prepaid cards; personal mortgage new and used car and education loans; green finance and housing finance; insurance products; and mutual funds. It also provides banking operations such as asset and liability management services. In addition the company offers special overdraft products short-term loans medium-term financing solutions and trade and contract financing; various guarantees such as bid bond advance payment and performance guarantees as well as standby letters of credit; import and export business; payroll services; business e-solutions; e-commerce services; and online mobile and phone banking services as well as e-statement SMS alerts online bill payments ATM services and digital services. The company was founded in 2006 and is headquartered in New Cairo Egypt. Credit Agricole - Egypt Bank (S.A.E.) operates as a subsidiary of Crédit Agricole S.A.

Name: Mills Locação Serviços e Logística S.A.
Description: Mills Locação Serviços e Logística S.A. operates as a machinery and equipment rental company in Brazil. It rents sells imports and exports steel and aluminum tubular structures shoring and access equipment for civil construction works and reusable concrete forms. The company also develops related engineering projects and provides supervisory and optional assembly services. Additionally it sells rents and distributes aerial work platforms manipulator handlers parts and components and offers technical assistance and maintenance services. It also offers tractors excavators wheel loaders motor graders forklifts and pallet trucks. The company was formerly known as Mills Estruturas e Serviços de Engenharia S.A. and changed its name to Mills Locação Serviços e Logística S.A. in July 2022. Mills Locação Serviços e Logística S.A. was founded in 1952 and is based in Rio de Janeiro Brazil.

Name: RCN Televisión S.A.
Description: RCN Televisión S.A. operates a private television channel in Colombia and internationally. It also provides telecommunication and online streaming services; and produces and broadcasts film audiovisual and commercial content including soap operas series news TV shows reality shows sports contests and events and commercials. The company was incorporated in 1997 and is headquartered in Bogota Colombia.

Name: Vodacom Tanzania Public Limited Company
Description: Vodacom Tanzania Public Limited Company offers telecommunication services to consumers and enterprises in Tanzania. The company offers mobile; mobile internet and fixed data; SMS and social media applications; value-added services including media and entertainment education and advertisement and health services; and customer care comprising call centre Vodacom shops service desks supplementary service data and customer alerts as well as customer support through social media and live chat on website and WhatsApp. It also provides deposits and withdrawals; person-to-person transfers; M-Pesa super-app; electronic payment solutions including virtual M-Pesa Visa card merchants consumer to business business to consumer and business to business; and financial services such as M-Pesa overdraft savings and loans group savings agent term loans insurance services and wealth management solutions. In addition the company offers mobility solutions such as voice small medium enterprises packages data internet of things reverse charge bulk messaging SIM manager and value-added services; fixed and wholesale solutions including internet inter-branch capacity hosting/co-location cloud session initiation protocol services digital solutions and M-Pesa for business solutions. It serves customers through various sales and distribution channels including wholesale distributors retailers franchise stores direct sales partners street vendors and informal resellers; and direct sales forces independent dealers and agents street vendors and informal resellers. The company was founded in 1999 and is headquartered in Dar es Salaam Tanzania.

Name: Net Holding A.S.
Description: Net Holding A.S. engages in the tourism publication and holding and other activities in Turkey Croatia Bulgaria Montenegro and the Turkish Republic of Northern Cyprus. It is involved in the hotel and accommodation casino and lottery management touristic shopping and car rental; real estate development; and book and newspaper publishing businesses as well as operates bookstore and stationery. The company was founded in 1974 and is based in Istanbul Turkey.

Name: Banco de Venezuela S.A. Banco Universal
Description: Banco de Venezuela S.A. Banco Universal provides personal business and private banking products and services in Venezuela.
