It offers currency digital key global and paid global accounts; financing services; credit and debit cards; payment and collection services; foreign exchange services; and mobile banking services. The company was incorporated in 1890 and is based in Caracas Venezuela. Banco de Venezuela S.A. Banco Universal operates as a subsidiary of Banco de Desarrollo Económico y Social de Venezuela.

Name: Saudi Paper Manufacturing Company
Description: Saudi Paper Manufacturing Company engages in the manufacture and sale of tissue papers in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia Gulf Cooperation Council countries and internationally. The company operates through Manufacturing and Trading and Others segments. It offers facial tissues napkins toilet paper pocket tissues kitchen towels industrial tissues and maxi rolls; and table napkins under pad and interfold towels under the Mouchoir Excellence City SPC Pro and Jumbo Roll brands. The company also buys manufactures and distributes pulps and papers; and collects sorts transports and presses waste papers. Saudi Paper Manufacturing Company was founded in 1989 and is based in Dammam the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

Name: Almendral S.A.
Description: Almendral S.A. through its subsidiaries provides telecommunication services in Chile and Peru. The company provides mobile telecommunications services including voice added value data broadband mobile internet and fixed network services as well as call center services for the corporate market. It also offers data services; local telephony; Internet access; long-distance public telephony; information technology services including data center business process outsourcing and operational continuity; digital and cybersecurity services; network leasing; and wholesale traffic businesses. The company was formerly known as Chilquinta S.A. and changed its name to Almendral S.A. in 2001. Almendral S.A. was founded in 1921 and is based in Vitacura Chile.

Name: Plasson Industries Ltd
Description: Plasson Industries Ltd develops manufactures and markets technical products in Israel Europe Brazil Oceania the United States Asia Africa and rest of the Americas. It offers various solutions for connecting PE pipes for use in municipal water distribution systems gas conveyance systems industrial fluids transfer wastewater systems communication mines and agriculture. The company also provides a range of bathroom and kitchen products such as faucets drainage lines bathroom sinks concealed cisterns monoblocks and accessories for bathrooms. In addition it offers various systems for the controlled supply of potable water automatic feeding and climate control for poultry and livestock including broilers turkeys breeders layers and swine as well as professional solutions. Plasson Industries Ltd was founded in 1963 and is headquartered in Menashe Israel.

Name: Banque de Tunisie Société anonyme
Description: Banque de Tunisie Société anonyme provides various banking products and services to individuals professionals and businesses in Tunisia. It offers current and savings accounts. The company also provides various funding solutions for consumption credit home improvement vehicle computer property and education; operating cycle funding including advance payment mobilization of administrative claims overdraft facility seasonal credit stock financing commercial discount advance on merchandise and market pre-financing; and international trade funding comprising down streaming currency export pre-financing documentary credit mobilization of foreign claims transfer abroad documentary remittance and business travel allowance as well as investment financing and bank guarantees. In addition it offers investment products and services consisting of investment packages savings deposit accounts commercial papers cash vouchers and certificate of deposits; savings plus life travel assistance fire leasing and other insurance products; cards; and treasury bills cheques and transfer services as well as mobile online and SMS banking services. The company was founded in 1884 and is headquartered in Tunis Tunisia.

Name: Sixth of October for Development and Investment Company "SODIC" (S.A.E.)
Description: Sixth of October for Development and Investment Company SODIC" (S.A.E.) operates as a real estate development company in Egypt. It develops invests constructs sells and leases residential and commercial properties clubs and villas offices medical complex and retail spaces. The company is also involved in the development construction operation and management of cities hotels educational buildings restaurants and golf courses.
