Name: Astral Foods Limited
Description: Astral Foods Limited operates as an integrated poultry producer in South Africa and internationally. The company operates through Poultry and Feed segments. It also engages in the marketing sale and distribution of fresh and frozen poultry products; and breeding and sale of day-old chicks and hatching eggs. The company also produces and sells feed products for farmed animal species; provides laboratory analytical services to the animal feed industry; and a range of value-added products comprising frozen reformed crumbed and ready-to-eat poultry products. It offers its products under the Goldi County Fair Festive Meadow Feeds National Chicks Ross CAL Tiger Chicks Tiger Animal Feeds Mountain Valley Earlybird and SupaStar brands. The company was founded in 2001 and is based in Gauteng South Africa.

Name: Pan Jamaica Group Limited
Description: Pan Jamaica Group Limited together with its subsidiaries manufactures and sells food and drink products in Jamaica. It operates through Property and Infrastructure; Financial Services; Global Services; and Specialty Foods segments. The company engages in the processing distribution and retail of food and drink; agricultural services; property investment development rental and management; hotel operations and management; and capital infrastructure development. It also provides financial management; logistics transportation and port operations; business processing outsourcing and tourist attractions; captive insurance; cold storage; contract labour; and security services. Pan Jamaica Group Limited was founded in 1929 and is headquartered in Kingston Jamaica.

Name: Dubai Refreshment (P.J.S.C.)
Description: Dubai Refreshment (P.J.S.C.) engages in bottling and selling Pepsi Cola International products in the United Arab Emirates and internationally. The company offers carbonated drinks under the Pepsi Mountain Dew Mirinda 7UP Sting ROCKSTAR Evervess Britvic and Shani brands; non-carbonated drinks under the Lipton Aquafina Mathieu Teisseire Ceres Robinsons London Essence and Gatorade brand names; and water under the Aquafina brand name as well as confectionary products under the Edita and Snack Time brands. It also exports its products. Dubai Refreshment (P.J.S.C.) was incorporated in 1959 and is headquartered in Dubai the United Arab Emirates.

Name: Rotshtein Realestate Ltd
Description: Rotshtein Realestate Ltd develops and constructs residential projects in Israel. The company engages in developing and executing large-scale residential projects and complex engineering jobs. The company was formerly known as D. Rothstein Company and changed its name to Rotshtein Realestate Ltd in February 2013. Rotshtein Realestate Ltd was incorporated in 1961 and is based in Petah Tikva Israel. Rotshtein Realestate Ltd is a subsidiary of Avnei Shoham Development Ltd.

Name: Al Khaleej Training and Education Company
Description: Al Khaleej Training and Education Company together with its subsidiaries operates schools for primary and secondary education with an international curriculum in Kingdom of Saudi Arabia Other Gulf Cooperation Council countries and internationally. It operates through Training Universities Management Projects and Others Call Centre and Schools segments. The Training segment provides training programs related to language and computers to individuals and corporate customers. The Universities segment offers academic staff for the orientation years according to the basis and standards set by the universities and managing human resources for the universities. The Management Projects and Others segment offers qualified skilled personnel as well as support services to corporate customers such as security maintenance and operational systems management. The Call Centre segment manages and operates customer service centres via telephone and the digital technologies for government and private companies. The Schools segment operates private educational schools for kinder garden to grade 12. It also operates IT and computer training and teaching languages and communication skills institutes; and provides management consulting services and integrated office administrative services. In addition the company engages in information communications administrative activities and support services; computer systems consultancies; training in human resource behavior; and professional online career network for job seekers and employers to connect. Further it offers training courses for English and IT as well as self-study and classroom-based language courses. Al Khaleej Training and Education Company was incorporated in 1992 and is headquartered in Riyadh the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

Name: Botswana Insurance Holdings Limited
Description: Botswana Insurance Holdings Limited together with its subsidiaries provides financial solutions in Botswana. It operates through two segments Life Business and Asset Management. The company underwrites various classes of long-term insurances; administers deposit administration schemes and life and pension funds; and manages investments. It also provides life and short-term insurance; and microlending services. In addition the company is involved in the unit trust corporate social responsibility hospitality industry and corporate finance businesses. The company was founded in 1975 and is based in Gaborone Botswana. Botswana Insurance Holdings Limited is a subsidiary of Sanlam Allianz Africa (Pty) Ltd.

Name: Bin Ulasim ve Akilli Sehir Teknolojileri A.S.
Description: Bin Ulasim ve Akilli Sehir Teknolojileri A.S. provides software solutions for micro-mobility transportation field in Turkey. It also designs and manufactures IoT device for vehicles; and purchases sells rents and operates electric non-electric bicycle motorcycle scooter etc. The company was founded in 2016 and is based in Ümraniye Turkey. Bin Ulasim ve Akilli Sehir Teknolojileri A.S. operates as a subsidiary of 1000 Yatirimlar Holding Anonim Sirketi.

Name: Alandalus Property Company
Description: Alandalus Property Company a real estate company engages in investment development and operation of commercial real estate properties in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. It constructs owns and manages centers commercial and residential complexes. The company also involved in the general contracting services for residential and commercial buildings educational recreational health institutions roads dams water and sewage projects electrical and mechanical works as well as provides maintenance and operation of real estate properties buildings and commercial facilities. The company was incorporated in 2006 and is headquartered in Riyadh Saudi Arabia.

Name: Wisynco Group Limited
Description: Wisynco Group Limited engages in the bottling and distribution of water and beverages in Jamaica and internationally. The company offers bottled drinking water under the WATA brand; cranberry juice under the CranWATA brand; soft drinks under the BIGGA brand; and energy drinks under the BOOM brand. It also distributes and retails food products; and provides insurance services. In addition it imports grocery products under the General Mills Nestle and Kellogg’s brands; and distributes beverages juices and soft drinks under the Coca-Cola Tru-Juice Freshhh Juice Drinks Squeezz Drinks Wakefield Juices Calico Jack Rum Punch Fanta Sprite Schweppes Minute Maid and AdeS brands. Further it distributes green tea under the Ayataka brand; coffee and tea under the Costa Georgia Gold Peak and Honest Tea brands; water under the Dasani and smartwater brands; juices and nectars under the Del Valle and Simply brands; sports drinks under the Powerade brand; smoothies and juices; vitaminwater; and coconut water under the ZICO brand. Wisynco Group Limited was incorporated in 1999 and is headquartered in Spanish Town Jamaica. The company operates as a subsidiary of Wisynco Group (Caribbean) Limited.

Name: Camuzzi Gas Pampeana S.A.
Description: Camuzzi Gas Pampeana S.A. distributes natural gas in Argentina. It serves families businesses and industries through approximately 56000 kilometers of gas transport pipelines and distribution network systems in the provinces of Buenos Aires La Pampa Neuquén Chubut Río Negro Santa Cruz and Tierra del Fuego. The company is based in Buenos Aires Argentina. Camuzzi Gas Pampeana S.A. operates as a subsidiary of Sodigas Pampeana S.A.

Name: Stor-Age Property REIT Limited
Description: Stor-Age is the largest self storage property fund and most recognisable brand in SA. The portfolio consists of 108 properties across SA (63) and the UK (45) as at June 2025 providing storage to more than 55 000 customers. The combined value of the portfolio including properties managed in our JV partnerships was R18.5 billion (SA – R6.6 billion; UK – £500 million) at 31 March 2025. The maximum lettable area including the development pipeline and ongoing projects exceeds 700 000m². The group employs more than 500 staff across SA and the UK. Stor-Age has been listed on the Johannesburg Stock Exchange since November 2015.

Name: Caribbean Cement Company Limited
Description: Caribbean Cement Company Limited together with its subsidiaries manufactures and sells cement and clinker in Jamaica Caribbean countries and North America. The company is also involved in mining and sale of gypsum shale and pozzolan. It operates a spa facility. The company was incorporated in 1947 and is based in Kingston Jamaica. Caribbean Cement Company Limited is a subsidiary of Trinidad Cement Limited.

Name: Bank of Jerusalem Ltd.
Description: Bank of Jerusalem Ltd. provides commercial banking services in Israel. The company offers deposit products such as saving and checking accounts; structured deposit products; personal loans such as new and used car loans and loans secured by deposits; mortgage loans; and foreign currency loans. It also provides independent trading services on the capital markets and investment advisory services as well as interactive brokerage services; housing credit and other retail credit and finance for housing construction; manages current accounts; and private banking services to non-residents. The company was formerly known as Bank of Jerusalem for Development and Mortgages Ltd. and changed its name to Bank of Jerusalem Ltd. in 1996. Bank of Jerusalem Ltd. was incorporated in 1963 and is headquartered in Airport City Israel. Bank of Jerusalem Ltd. is a subsidiary of Export Investment Co. Ltd.

Name: National Petroleum Services Company K.S.C.P.
Description: National Petroleum Services Company K.S.C.P. engages in the provision of various upstream oilfield services in Kuwait and internationally. It operates through Oil field and Non-oil field services segments. The company offers upstream oil services that include cementing down hole tool completion directional drilling well logging services hydraulic fracturing coiled tubing and well stimulation services; environmental and sustainability services such as environmental and safety services; quality health safety and environmental services. It also provides drilling and maintenance of oil wells and chemical waste management; petrochemical activities; and support activities for petroleum & natural gas mining incidental to onshore and offshore oil & gas extraction. In addition the company offers support services for well drilling repairing and preparation for production well maintenance-related services; importing and owning machines tools and materials; owning lands and real estate necessary for establishing facilities and equipment; and importing and exporting chemicals. National Petroleum Services Company K.S.C.P. was incorporated in 1993 and is based in Al Ahmadi Kuwait. National Petroleum Services Company K.S.C.P. operates as a subsidiary of Kuwait Projects Company Holding K.S.C.P.

Name: Oba Makarnacilik Sanayi ve Ticaret A.S.
Description: Oba Makarnacilik Sanayi ve Ticaret A.S. produces and sells pasta in Turkey and internationally. It also offers children pasta mac and cheese flour noodles and semolina products under the OBA Makarna OBA Mie Pasta Savana Omelia Vera Obalino Eva Rosa Linda OBA Gold Pasta Layla Nido Intervallo and Champion brand names. Oba Makarnacilik Sanayi ve Ticaret A.S. was incorporated in 1966 and is based in Gaziantep Turkey. Oba Makarnacilik Sanayi ve Ticaret A.S. operates as a subsidiary of Alpinvest Yatÿrÿm Gÿda Sanayi ve Ticaret Anonim Şirketi.

Name: Akfen Yenilenebilir Enerji
Description: Akfen Yenilenebilir Enerji engages in the production of renewable energy in Turkey. It operates 12 hydroelectric power plant facilities with a total installed power of 228.7 megawatts; 27 unlicensed solar power plants with a capacity of 25.95 megawatts and 8 licensed solar power plants with a power of 95.45 megawatts; and wind power plants with an installed capacity of 348.9 megawatts. The company was founded in 2009 and is based in Ankara Turkey. Akfen Yenilenebilir Enerji operates as a subsidiary of Akfen Holding Anonim Sirketi.
Industry: Independent Power and Renewable Electricity Producers

Name: Absa Bank Botswana Limited
Description: Absa Bank Botswana Limited provides various financial services in Botswana. It operates through three segments Corporate and Investment Banking; Retail Business Banking and Other; and Islamic Banking. The company offers current savings and call accounts; and term fixed interest and non-interest bearing and cheque account deposits. It also provides personal home life term foreign currency scheme and business loans; vehicle mortgage and production loans; commercial asset finance and overdraft services; trade finance products including letters of credit document collections performance bonds and bank guarantees and bills of exchange; and credit cards. In addition the company offers personal insurance products such as home owners household contents funeral motor and retrenchment insurance products; business insurance products covering buildings contents stock in trade motor vehicles electronic equipment workers compensation and other insurance products; treasury services comprising foreign exchange currency repo risk management and investment services; investment banking financing risk management and advisory solutions; customer loyalty programs and services; and cash management and merchant services. Further it provides Internet and ATM banking mobile app and e-statement services. The company offers its services to corporates financial institutions and government clients; and medium small businesses and retail customers. It operates through multiple branches ATMs and point-of-sale devices. The company was formerly known as Barclays Bank of Botswana Limited and changed its name to Absa Bank Botswana Limited in February 2020. The company was founded in 1950 and is headquartered in Gaborone Botswana. Absa Bank Botswana Limited is a subsidiary of Absa Group Limited.

Name: PPC Ltd
Description: PPC Ltd together with its subsidiaries engages in the production and sale of cement aggregates ready mix concrete and fly ash in South Africa Botswana and Zimbabwe. It also provides premixes stone sand road layer materials and special aggregate-related products. The company was formerly known as Pretoria Portland Cement Company Limited and changed its name to PPC Ltd in October 2012. PPC Ltd was incorporated in 1892 and is based in Johannesburg South Africa.

Name: Palm Hills Developments S.A.E.
Description: Palm Hills Developments S.A.E. develops integrated residential and commercial real estate and resort projects primarily in Egypt. It constructs and operates villas apartments chalets beach houses cabins tessera town and twin houses and office malls. The company leases constructs and operates hotels motels resorts and residential compounds; generates electricity; desalinates water; provides sports field services; and operates and manages sport games. Further the company establishes private clubs academies health clubs and fitness centres; establishes manages and operates schools; operates five-star hotel; manages and operates centers for the preparation training and development of human resources; engages in the construction and building works and finishing works; offers decorations and general supplies; provides engineering consultancy services; engages in the construction and building activities related to residential commercial and hotel projects beach resorts recreational areas and projects; undertakes infrastructure works and facilities for projects; and offers tourism management and marketing services. Palm Hills Developments S.A.E. was founded in 1997 and is headquartered in Cairo Egypt.

Name: Cydsa S.A.B. de C.V.
Description: Cydsa S.A.B. de C.V. together its subsidiaries produces and markets salt chlorine caustic soda and refrigerant gases electricity and steam cogeneration and underground storage of hydrocarbons in Mexico the United States Canada Central and South America Asia and Europe. It operates through Salt Chlorine and Caustic Soda Refrigerant Gases Energy Processing and Logistics and Cydsa and Other segments. The company offers light salt salt substitute Kosher and halal grade salt salt with chile and lime and coarse sea salt for use in household and commercial human consumption food industry and industrial processes as well as salt pellets for swimming pools and water softening. It also provides liquid and gas chlorine solid caustic soda membrane grade and rayon grade liquid caustic soda chlorine in cylinders sodium hypochlorite caustic potash synthetic hydrochloric acid and muriatic acid for use in chemical petrochemical water treatment oil pulp paper pesticides bleach soaps detergents bottling mining-metallurgy plastics pigments and paints industries and others. In addition the company offers refrigerant propellant and blowing gases as well as gases for fluoropolymers and anesthetic-medical products for use in industrial commercial and domestic refrigeration medical automotive and domestic appliance industries. Further it involved in the electricity and steam cogeneration business; and hydrocarbons processing and underground storage business as well as provides liquid petroleum gas processing and storage services. The company offers its products under the La Fina Cisne Marfil Gallo Palomitos Bakara Elefante Klara Carmen Brisa de Occidente Fine Genetron Aquion and Eco Flush trademarks. Cydsa S.A.B. de C.V. was founded in 1945 and is headquartered in San Pedro Garza García Mexico.

Name: Alpha Data PJSC
Description: Alpha Data PJSC offers system integration services. The company provides IT infrastructure solutions including servers storage network infrastructure audio-visual infrastructure physical security infrastructure and backup and disaster recovery infrastructure. It offers tailored solutions by integrating advanced technologies such as cybersecurity cloud mobility AI big data digital transformation and software automation technology. In addition the company provides AWS services Microsoft solutions artificial intelligence mobility big data IoT cloud infrastructure end user software and ELV services. The company was founded in 1981 and is headquartered in Abu Dhabi United Arab Emirates.

Name: Guardian Holdings Limited
Description: Guardian Holdings Limited together with its subsidiaries underwrites insurance products in Trinidad and Tobago Jamaica Barbados Dutch Caribbean Martinique Grenada curacao the Netherlands Aruba Cayman Islands Bermuda Bahamas and internationally. The company operates through four segments: Life health and pension; Property and casualty; Insurance brokerage; and Asset management. It offers short-term and long-term life and health insurance for both individuals and groups. In addition it provides critical illness property motor employers’ liability public marine accident engineering bonding fire commercial and crime insurance as well as short-term and long-term reinsurances. Further it offers traditional life and interest-sensitive without guarantee annuities-based and unit-linked life and interest-sensitive with guarantees insurance products. The company was incorporated in 1982 and is headquartered in St Georges Grenada. Guardian Holdings Limited is a subsidiary of NCB Global Holdings Limited.

Name: IBL Ltd
Description: IBL Ltd through its subsidiaries engages in the agro and energy building and engineering commercial and distribution financial hospitality life and technologies logistics seafood and property businesses. The company retails and supplies consumer healthcare and industrial products; produces sugar cane; generates electricity from thermal and photovoltaic sources; and distributes and retails healthcare and wellbeing solutions. It also offers financial services including banking asset and wealth management insurance stockbroking and private equity services; building engineering and contracting solutions; logistics shipping and aviation solutions; hospitality and tourism services; and fishmeal and fish oils from by-products as well as engages in the fish storage activities. In addition the company develops invests and manages real estate properties including retail office industrial and hospitality properties. It operates in Mauritius Europe the United States Madagascar Comoros Seychelles & Reunion Dubai Africa Australia the Maldives and internationally. IBL Ltd was incorporated in 1970 and is based in Port Louis Mauritius.

Name: Egyptian Chemical Industries
Description: Egyptian Chemical Industries produces and sells nitrogenous fertilizers and chemical materials in Egypt. Its products include high density ammonium nitrate urea fertilizers liquid ammonia pporous prilled ammonium nitrate ferro silicon ammonium nitrate novo kima fort and liquid ammonium nitrate fertilizers. The company also provides nitrogen gas liquid and aqua ammonia nitric acid and hydrochloric acid for industrial purposes as well as oxygen gas for medical and industrial purposes; and silica fume that is used in concrete. The company was founded in 1956 and is based in Aswan Egypt. Egyptian Chemical Industries is a subsidiary of Chemical Industries Holding Company S.A.E.

Name: Analyst I.M.S. Investment Management Services Ltd
Description: Analyst I.M.S. Investment Management Services Ltd is a publicly owned investment manager. The firm provided its services to private clients private and public corporations and institutional clients. Through its subsidiaries the firm provides portfolio management financial services consulting trust funds with different specializations fund management underwriting services and management and consulting services for its clients. Analyst I.M.S. Investment Management Services Ltd was founded in 1985 and is based in Tel Aviv Israel.

Name: Bosch Fren Sistemleri Sanayi ve Ticaret A.S.
Description: Bosch Fren Sistemleri Sanayi ve Ticaret A.S. engages in the production and sale of hydraulic brake systems for automotive and light commercial vehicles in Turkey and internationally. It offers servo brakes and brake master cylinders and support systems. The company was incorporated in 1975 and is headquartered in Bursa Turkey. Bosch Fren Sistemleri Sanayi ve Ticaret A.S. is a subsidiary of Robert Bosch GmbH.

Name: Albaraka Türk Katilim Bankasi A.S.
Description: Albaraka Türk Katilim Bankasi A.S. provides various banking products and services in Turkey. The company provides participation current trend and gold accounts. It also offers personal housing real estate vehicle consumer dealer and jet financing services; cards including debit trend credit and digital debit cards; insurance and pensions such as private pensions vehicle housing health life and personal accident; investment comprising capital market and treasury products; payments and other banking services. In addition the company provides SME commercial and corporate cash and non-cash leasing credit guarantee fund and dealer financing; foreign trade payments financings treasury products electronic transfer notice form other transactions; cash management such as collections and payments e-services and accounting; merchant member and POS including merchant member services applications products and solutions; investment which includes capital market products treasury products and electronic product certificate; insurance and pension for employees liabilities assets and farmers; and SME and chargeback cards. Further it offers digital banking mobile banking; open banking; and internet branch services as well as provides ATM banking and services. Albaraka Türk Katilim Bankasi A.S. was incorporated in 1984 and is headquartered in Ümraniye Turkey.

Name: Luzon Ronson N.V.
Description: Luzon Ronson N.V. engages in the real estate development and construction business in Israel and internationally. The company is based in Ra'anana Israel. Luzon Ronson N.V. is a subsidiary of Amos Luzon Development and Energy Group Ltd.

Name: Adese Gayrimenkul Yatirim A.S.
Description: Adese Gayrimenkul Yatirim A.S. operates in the real estate investment sector. The company engages in the operation and management of shopping malls residential and entertainment centers. Adese Gayrimenkul Yatirim A.S. was founded in 1991 and is based in Selçuklu Turkey.

Name: Wilson Bayly Holmes-Ovcon Limited
Description: Wilson Bayly Holmes-Ovcon Limited operates as a construction company in South Africa rest of Africa and the United Kingdom. It undertakes construction of buildings including retail commercial offices residential healthcare hotels and entertainment warehousing and industrial and data centres; civil engineering and infrastructure for mining industrial and water and energy infrastructure; and roads and earthworks such as road and bridges bulk earthworks dams oil and gas and rail and pipeline infrastructure projects. The company also undertakes construction of airports toll roads renewable energy and serviced accommodation; and manufactures supplies and installs long-steel products. Wilson Bayly Holmes-Ovcon Limited was founded in 1970 and is headquartered in Johannesburg South Africa.

Name: Commercial Bank International P.S.C.
Description: Commercial Bank International P.S.C. together with its subsidiaries provides banking products and services to individuals and businesses in the United Arab Emirates and internationally. It operates through Wholesale Banking Retail Banking Treasury Real Estate and Other segments. The company offers eSaver Mabrook and CBI saver saving accounts; fixed deposits; current and call deposit accounts; CBI ready money and secured overdraft; and remittances. It provides personal home and auto loans; insurance products; debit and credit cards; and mobile online and telephone banking. In addition the company offers cash management financing solutions treasury services Al Islami solutions corporate finance trade and working capital and deposits. The company was incorporated in 1991 and is headquartered in Ras Al-Khaimah the United Arab Emirates.

Name: Generation Capital Ltd
Description: Generation Capital Ltd is an infrastructure investment firm specializing in infrastructure and energy sector. The firm was founded in 2018 and is headquartered in Herzliya Israel.

Name: Tanzania Cigarette Public Limited Company
Description: Tanzania Cigarette Public Limited Company manufactures distributes markets and sells cigarettes in the United Republic of Tanzania. The company offers its products under Embassy Crescent & Star Portsman Sweet Menthol Safari Club Camel and Winston Aspen Monte Carlo and LD brand names. It also exports its products to the Democratic Republic of Congo Southern Africa and Namibia and internationally. The company was incorporated in 1961 and is based in Dar es Salaam the United Republic of Tanzania. Tanzania Cigarette Public Limited Company operates as a subsidiary of JT International Holding B.V.

Name: Ozak Gayrimenkul Yatirim Ortakligi A.S.
Description: Ozak Gayrimenkul Yatirim Ortakligi A.S. is a real estate investment trust. It invests in the real estate markets of Turkey.  Ozak Gayrimenkul Yatirim Ortakligi A.S. was founded in 2008 and is based in Istanbul Turkey.

Name: Land Development of Nimrodi Group Ltd.
Description: Land Development of Nimrodi Group Ltd. together with its subsidiaries primarily engages in the real estate business in Israel Poland and internationally. It operates through four segments: Rental of Properties in Israel; Rental of Properties Abroad; Development of Residential Construction in Israel; and Development of Residential Construction Abroad. The company develops and constructs commercial office and residential projects; and develops leases and operates logistic centers light industries and logistics parks in Poland Germany Romania and Austria. It also engages in the development construction and sale of urban renewal projects; and operation of various outdoor advertising platforms including billboards walls bridges urban advertising facilities bus shelters and others. Land Development of Nimrodi Group Ltd. was founded in 1909 and is based in Bnei Brak Israel.

Name: A'ayan Leasing and Investment Company K.S.C.P.
Description: A'ayan Leasing and Investment Company K.S.C.P. engages in financial investments trading and investing in properties and leasing activities primarily in the State of Kuwait. It operates through four segments: Islamic Financing Leasing Sector Real Estate and Proprietary Investment and Assets Management. The company offers lease financing services; acts as financial intermediary and broker; grants credit facilities to consumers; and participates in the establishment of companies and deals in the shares of the companies on its behalf and on behalf of third parties. It also involved in the marketing of products and services; portfolio management on behalf of the customers; investment in real estate properties in industrial agricultural and other sectors; and development and rental of residential land and commercial properties. In addition the company conducts research and studies and related activities on behalf of customers; and establishes investment funds and manages funds. Further the company engages in the leasing and investment securities related activities as well as leases vehicle and equipment and provides logistic services. A'ayan Leasing and Investment Company K.S.C.P. was incorporated in 1999 and is headquartered in Kuwait City Kuwait.

Name: Sun Tekstil Sanayi ve Ticaret A.S.
Description: Sun Tekstil Sanayi ve Ticaret A.S. designs produces and sells knit fabrics and ready-made womenswear garments in Turkey and internationally. It also exports its products. The company was founded in 1987 and is based in Izmir Turkey.

Name: Empreendimentos Pague Menos S.A.
Description: Empreendimentos Pague Menos S.A. engages in the retail sale of medicines perfumes personal hygiene and beauty products in Brazil. The company offers medicines and health care products in the areas of pediatrics oncology psychiatry urology orthopedics dermatology contraception pediatric endocrinology assisted reproduction geriatric gastrointestinal and hepatic pain fever and inflammation diabetes and endocrinology. It also provides personal care and beauty products including deodorant intimate care and oral hygiene as well as foot hair face and hand care products; dermo-cosmetics; and repellent diaper cloth and food products as well as other accessories for moms and babies. In addition the company offers clothing and accessories supplements first aid food and drink utilities and others; and cereals fibers vitamins and minerals first aid and herbal medicines and natural products. It sells its products through retail stores and online. Empreendimentos Pague Menos S.A. was incorporated in 1981 and is headquartered in Fortaleza Brazil.

Name: Brait PLC
Description: Brait PLC an investment holding company invests in privately owned business. Its primary investment portfolio includes Virgin Active Premier and New Look brands. The company invest in health clubs under Virgin Active brand in South Africa the United Kingdom Italy Australia Namibia Botswana Thailand and Singapore; Premier which manufactures baking and milling sugar confectionary and home and personal care products as well as wheat flour maize meal pasta biscuits animal feed and rice products in South Africa Eswatini Mozambique and Lesotho; and New Look an online fashion retailer that offers clothing and footwear in the United Kingdom and the Republic of Ireland. Brait PLC was founded in 2011 and is based in Moka Mauritius.

Name: Galatasaray Sportif Sinai ve Ticari Yatirimlar A.S.
Description: Galatasaray Sportif Sinai ve Ticari Yatirimlar A.S. engages in the commercial industrial and investment activities for various sports. The company also invests in and develops real estate properties. In addition it engages in the sale and merchandising of products with the GS logo; and communication activities. The company was incorporated in 1997 and is headquartered in Istanbul Turkey. Galatasaray Sportif Sinai ve Ticari Yatirimlar A.S. is a subsidiary of Galatasaray Spor Kulubu Derbegi.

Name: Vinte Viviendas Integrales S.A.B. de C.V.
Description: Vinte Viviendas Integrales S.A.B. de C.V. engages in the land acquisition design promotion construction urbanization and commercialization of housing projects for families in Mexico. Vinte Viviendas Integrales S.A.B. de C.V. was incorporated in 2001 and is headquartered in Mexico City Mexico.

Name: Sekerbank T.A.S.
Description: Sekerbank T.A.S. together with its subsidiaries provides agricultural business SME corporate and retail banking services in Turkey and internationally. It operates through Corporate/Commercial SME Retail Treasury/Investment and Other segments. The company accepts time demand savings commercial and other deposits as well as foreign currency deposits. It also offers small and medium enterprises loans; consumer loans comprising mortgage vehicle general purpose and other loans; corporate and commercial loans specialized loans; export and import loans; business loans; corporate and commercial loans; loans given to financial sector; retail loans; and individual and commercial credit cards. In addition the company provides transaction brokerage portfolio brokerage private portfolio management investment consulting and brokerage and underwriting of public offerings as well as general custody services; domestic and foreign factoring services; and financial leasing services. Further it operates a portfolio consisting of real estates real estate projects rights based on real estate capital market instruments and other assets and rights. The company was formerly known as Pancar Kooperatifleri Bankasi A.S. and changed its name to Sekerbank T.A.S. in 1956. Sekerbank T.A.S. was incorporated in 1953 and is headquartered in Istanbul Turkey.

Name: Inverfal Perú S.A.A.
Description: Inverfal Perú S.A.A. engages in investing in fixed or variable income securities. The company operates through Retail Financial and Real Estate and Other Services segments. It is involved in the marketing of hardware construction home and interior decoration accessories as well as engaged in hypermarket and supermarket activities; and real estate activities. In addition the company acts as an insurance broker; and provision of computer; and call attention services. Inverfal Perú S.A.A. was incorporated in 2019 and is based in San Isidro Peru. The company operates as a subsidiary of Falabella S.A.

Name: Sinpas Gayrimenkul Yatirim Ortakligi A.S.
Description: Sinpas Insaat Anonim Sirketi (Sinpas Insaat) which was established on 22 December 2006 with the aim of transforming into a Real Estate Investment Partnership (REIT) applied to the Capital Markets Board (CMB) with the request to transform into a REIT and following the approval of the relevant request it was transformed into a REIT by being registered in the trade registry on 3 May 2007 and its title was changed to Sinpas Gayrimenkul Yatirim Ortakligi A.S. (Sinpas GYO). The main operation of the Group is to develop residential and sales real estate projects. The Group is under the roof of Sinpas Group Companies one of the leading real estate investment and development groups in the sector. The Group was established in Turkiye and operates in Turkiye. The main shareholder of the Group is Avni Celik. Considering the advantages and synergy that the merger of Sinpas GYO and Sinpas Yapi which operate in the same sector will create in terms of economic operational and competitive power and the benefits that the opportunities and possibilities that will arise from the company size after the merger will provide to all Capital Market stakeholders it was decided to merge Sinpas GYO and Sinpas Yapi based on the balance sheets of 30.06.2017 within the framework of the relevant legislation with the decision of the Board of Directors taken on 21.11.2017 by the Board of Directors of Sinpas GYO. At the Extraordinary General Assembly meeting held on 29.12.2017 it was decided by majority vote that Sinpas Yapi would be taken over by Sinpas GYO and merged within Sinpas GYO. The Extraordinary General Assembly meeting was registered on 28.02.2018. Due to the merger transaction the issued capital of Sinpas GYO was increased by 600000000 TL to 873193432 TL. The merger was realized within the Group and the merger transaction was evaluated within the framework of the provisions of TFRS standards and a combined group balance sheet was created as required by the standard. Sinpas Yapi's net assets underlying the merger were determined by valuing investment properties and stocks at fair value. As of 31 March 2025 the Group has 188 employees. (31 December 2024: 205 employees.) The Group's registered address is Sinpas Plaza Dikilitas Mahallesi Yenidogan Sokak. No:36 34349 Besiktas Istanbul.

Name: Sembcorp Salalah Power & Water Company SAOG
Description: Sembcorp Salalah Power & Water Company SAOG develops owns and operates an electricity generation and seawater desalination plant in the Salalah region. The company operates Salalah independent water and power plant that comprises 5 gas turbines and 2 steam turbines with a contracted power capacity of 445 megawatts as well as contracted water production capacity of 15 million imperial gallons per day. It also supplies power and water to the Oman Power and Water Procurement Company. Sembcorp Salalah Power & Water Company SAOG was incorporated in 2009 and is based in Salalah Oman.
Industry: Independent Power and Renewable Electricity Producers

Name: IC Enterra Yenilenebilir Enerji A.S.
Description: IC Enterra Yenilenebilir Enerji A.S. engages in the renewable energy production activities in Turkey. It operates hydroelectric and solar power plants. The company was founded in 1998 and is based in Ankara Turkey.
Industry: Independent Power and Renewable Electricity Producers

Name: Amos Luzon Development and Energy Group Ltd
Description: Amos Luzon Development and Energy Group Ltd together with its subsidiaries engages in the real estate development and construction business in Israel and internationally. It also involved in the energy infrastructure business. The company was formerly known as U. Dori Group Ltd and changed its name to Amos Luzon Development and Energy Group Ltd in May 2016. Amos Luzon Development and Energy Group Ltd was founded in 1961 and is based in Petah Tikva Israel.

Name: Curro Holdings Limited
Description: Curro Holdings Limited together with its subsidiaries acquires develops and manages independent schools primarily in South Africa Namibia and Botswana. The company operates in Curro and Meridian segments. It offers independent education and ancillary services including Select schools Curro Academy Schools Curro Preschools Curro Assisted Learning Curro DigiEd Curro Private College and Curro Online for learners from the age of three months to Grade 12. The company was incorporated in 1998 and is based in Bellville South Africa.

Name: Ashot Ashkelon Industries Ltd.
Description: Ashot Ashkelon Industries Ltd. manufactures and sells systems and components for aerospace and defense in Israel and internationally. The company offers aerospace products such as engine shafts and rotating parts; high lift system components including universal joints transmissions and gearboxes lever bearing arms and long and short shafts for rotary actuation; landing gears components for turbo prop and business jet aircraft; electro and mechanical assemblies for aerospace applications; gearboxes transmissions and gear-based products; and tungsten products which are installed in various aircrafts to balance weights in the wing fuselage vertical and horizontal stabilizers helicopter rotors propellers and aerospace instruments. It also provides land products comprising automated transmission products used in heavy-duty vehicles; final drive products; suspension systems which include rotary and linear shock absorbers road arms suspension springs and arms tension mechanism and road wheels tracks; and upgrade packages. It serves defense aerospace agriculture mining marine oil and gas printing construction industrial and commercial markets. Ashot Ashkelon Industries Ltd. was incorporated in 1970 and is based in Ashkelon Israel. Ashot Ashkelon Industries Ltd. was a former subsidiary of Lahav Haherev Ltd.

Name: Marshall Boya Ve Vernik Sanayii A.S.
Description: Marshall Boya Ve Vernik Sanayii A.S. manufactures and sells paint coating and varnish products in Turkey. It offers interior wall and exterior paint. The company was founded in 1954 and is headquartered in Dilovasi Turkey.

Name: Délice Holding SA
Description: Délice Holding SA engages in the dairy products business in Tunisia. The company produces and sells carbonated drinks and juice beverages; dairy products such as milk flavored milk milkshake fermented milk fresh cream butter and yoghurt; and melted triangle squared grated and fresh cheese as well as packaged drinking water. It offers its products under the DELICE DANONE and SAVENCIA brands. Délice Holding SA was founded in 1978 and is headquartered in Tunis Tunisia.

Name: Kuyas Yatirim A.S.
Description: Kuyas Yatirim A.S. operates as a real estate development company in Turkey. It constructs projects such as hotels additional workshop units exhibition and conference areas gold exchange building parking area and training area. The company was incorporated in 2005 and is headquartered in Istanbul Turkey.

Name: Seprod Limited
Description: Seprod Limited together with its subsidiaries manufactures and distributes food products in Jamaica. The company offers sports drinks condensed milk sardines tuna salmon and other seafood carbonated soft drink biscuits and snacks spreads carbonated beverage for kids real fruit flavour drinks pure juice with no additives or added sugar flour sauces jams seasoning oil various beans cheese mayonnaise creamer and dressings. It also offers canned foods milk punches nuts breakfast cereals cornmeal instant porridge mix crackers nutritional supplements liquid meal supplement powdered beverages energy drinks. The company offers its products under Altitude Betty Brunswick Busta Butterkist Chiffon Chubby Cool Fruit Delite Eve Gold Seal Goya Kraft Miracle Planters Post Pronto Ritz Serge Seven Seas Supligen Supligen Max Swizzzle Tang Turbo and Uncle Sam's brand names. In addition it engages in agriculture; manufacture and sale of oils and fats consumer pharmaceutical biscuit milk products juices corn and wheat; investments; investments in real estate; property development; dairy farming; and logistics activities. Further it exports its products to various countries. Seprod Limited was founded in 1930 and is headquartered in Kingston Jamaica.

Name: Borlease Otomotiv A.S.
Description: Borlease Otomotiv A.S. offers car rental services in Turkey. It provides fleet leasing and management services mobility services and vehicle and driver support services. The company was incorporated in 2013 and is headquartered in Istanbul Turkey.

Name: Integrated Holding Company K.S.C.P.
Description: Integrated Holding Company K.S.C.P. operates a logistics company in Kuwait and internationally. The company offers equipment leasing and hiring services; heavy lifting services including specialized lifting and engineering and rigging services; heavy transport haulage services such as various trucks trailers and equipment; and alternative lift services comprising gantry system and jacking and skidding services. It also provides earth moving services including demolition and construction activities; industrial equipment services comprising air compressors welding machines tower lights man lifts and tele handlers; and rig move services such as drilling rig and super rig move work over casing and heavy haulage. In addition the company offers energy services for temporary project location including generators transformers fuel tanks load banks synchronizers and totals panels; shutdown management services; and tower cranes for residential and commercial civil construction high-rise building infrastructure bridges and flyovers and other construction projects. Further it provides port operations services such as handling of aggregates pet coke clinker gypsum rocks coal steel scrap direct reduced iron hot briquetted iron general cargo and jumbo bags; other services that include hopper system weigh bridge operation and port information management services; and general trading and contracting services. The company was incorporated in 2005 and is headquartered in Kuwait City Kuwait.

Name: Telefónica Chile S.A.
Description: Telefónica Chile S.A. together with its subsidiaries operates as a telecommunication company in Chile. The company operates through Fixed Telephony Communications and Company Data Television Services and Others segments. It offers basic telephone services line connections and installations services dedicated lines international long-distance services marketing terminal equipment rental of circuit media of terminal equipment rental of means of circuits and others. The company also engages in the provision of business communication services; data transmission services; the sale and rental of communication equipment; telecommunications; and the sale and lease of networks. In addition it provides multimedia services such as the development installation maintenance marketing and operation of satellite television services; broadband; channel paid services; video on demand; and interactive or multimedia television services. Further the company offers logistics personnel and administration services. Additionally it provides broadcast live and play services as well as other related services in the fields of connectivity cloud security big data IoT and digital workplace. The company was formerly known as Compañía de Telecomunicaciones de Chile S.A. and changed its name to Telefónica Chile S.A. in April 2009. Telefónica Chile S.A. was founded in 1880 and is based in Santiago de Chile Chile. Telefónica Chile S.A. operates as a subsidiary of Telefonica Moviles Chile S.A.

Name: GraceKennedy Limited
Description: GraceKennedy Limited together with its subsidiaries engages in food trading and financial services businesses in Jamaica the United Kingdom the United States Canada rest of Caribbean countries other European countries Africa and internationally. It operates through four segments: Food Banking and Investments Insurance and Money Services. The Food segment engages in the merchandising of general goods and food products; processing and distribution of food products; and operation of a chain of supermarkets. The Banking and Investments segment provides commercial banking stock brokerage corporate finance advisory and lease financing services. The Insurance segment offers general health group and creditors life insurance products as well as insurance brokerage services. The Money Services segment provides money transfer and bill payment services as well as is involved in the cambio operations. The company engages in the data analytics media rights holding property rental and investment management activities. GraceKennedy Limited was founded in 1922 and is headquartered in Kingston Jamaica.

Name: Hagag Group Real Estate Entrepreneurship Ltd
Description: Hagag Group Real Estate Entrepreneurship Ltd engages in the development management and marketing of real estate projects in Israel. It develops residential towers luxurious office towers and buildings private houses and apartments and commercial buildings as well as undertakes urban renewal projects. The company was incorporated in 1950 and is based in Tel Aviv Israel.

Name: Kizilbük Gayrimenkul Yatirim Ortakligi A.S.
Description: Kizilbük Gayrimenkul Yatirim Ortakligi A.S. operates as real estate investment trust in Turkey. The company is based in Istanbul Turkey.

Name: Societe Metallurgique d'Imiter société anonyme
Description: Societe Metallurgique d'Imiter société anonyme engages in the mining of silver deposits in Morocco. It holds interest in the Imiter mine covering an area of 375 ha located to the east of Ouarzazate in Morocco. The company was incorporated in 1960 and is headquartered in Casablanca Morocco. Societe Metallurgique d'Imiter société anonyme operates as a subsidiary of Managem S.A.

Name: Castro Model Ltd.
Description: Castro Model Ltd. engages in the retail sale of fashion products home fashion fashion accessories and cosmetics and care products in Israel. The company’s products portfolio includes knits and putters jeans jackets and coats shirts shoes dresses skirts swimwear accessories and bags underwear and socks cases and garden suits sunglasses and vision uniforms pants and tights and bodysuits. It provides storage and organization reusable picnic utensils textile serving/ hosting and holiday table products as well as cups plates and baking molds; pillows blankets and bedding sets; carpets and rugs fragrance and decoration products; bath rugs towels and bath accessories; and gift boxes. The company provides its products for women men boys girls and babies. Castro Model Ltd. was incorporated in 1973 and is based in Bat Yam Israel.

Name: Is Gayrimenkul Yatirim Ortakligi A.S.
Description: İş Gayrimenkul Yatırım Ortaklığı A.Ş. (İş REIC) was founded through the takeover of Merkez Gayrimenkul Yatırım ve Proje Değerlendirme A.Ş. by İş Gayrimenkul Yatırım ve Proje Değerlendirme A.Ş. on 6 August 1999 which was then transformed into a real estate investment trust. Blending its market prestige backed by the deep-rooted corporate principles and financial strength of its parent İşbank Group with its sectoral experience and vision İş REIC develops distinguished projects and maintains a healthy growth process since the day it was founded. One of the sector’s prominent companies with its diversified and well-balanced portfolio and robust financial structure İş REIC focuses on providing its investors with an optimal possible risk-return trade-off. Using its solid shareholders’ equity funding facilities and sustainable sources generated on regular rental income derived on its high quality portfolio to finance its new investments İş REIC takes sure-footed steps based on its determination to strengthen its position in the sector. İş REIC which invests in real estate properties and real estate projects carry out its activities in compliance with the requirements of the Capital Markets Board of Türkiye (CMB) laws and regulations.

Name: Akis Gayrimenkul Yatirim Ortakligi A.S.
Description: Akis Gayrimenkul Yatirim A.S is based in Turkey.

Name: Grupo Casas Bahia S.A.
Description: Grupo Casas Bahia S.A. together with its subsidiaries retails electronics home appliances and furniture in Brazil. It also offers financial services and solutions such as buy now pay later and credit card services; and logistics solutions and services comprising fulfillment and full commerce services as well as manufactures and sells wooden furniture. The company provides extended warranty and equipment installation services. In addition it serves consumers through brick and-mortar stores and e-commerce platforms under the Casas Bahia Pontofrio Extra.com Bartira banQi Rede Celer ASAPLog and CNT brands; and distribution centers. The company was formerly known as Via S.A. and changed its name to Grupo Casas Bahia S.A. in September 2023. Grupo Casas Bahia S.A. was founded in 1946 and is headquartered in São Paulo Brazil.

Name: Compagnie Minière de Touissit S.A.
Description: Compagnie Minière de Touissit S.A. engages in the exploration extraction and processing of base metals precious metals and industrial minerals in Morocco. The company produces silver-bearing lead and zinc concentrates as well as silver. It also manages a portfolio of 34 mining permits in Morocco. Compagnie Minière de Touissit S.A. was incorporated in 1974 and is based in Casablanca Morocco.

Name: Oula Fuel Marketing Company - KSCP
Description: Oula Fuel Marketing Company - KSCP together with its subsidiaries engages in the acquisition establishment leasing operating and maintenance of petrol stations in Kuwait. It operates through two segments Fuel Marketing and Other Related Services; and Investments. The company also offers automobile services including oil change car wash maintenance workshop services and technical check-ups; prepaid fuel cards and related electronic services; various account cards for individual and corporate customers; and oulaE Tag a smart system for fuel payment and other services in the oula station. In addition it provides logistics marketing and consultancy services. Further the company is involved in the purchase renting owning and selling of lease lands and real estate; trade in petroleum products in bulk or retail; operation of central markets; and investment in financial and real estate portfolios. Oula Fuel Marketing Company - KSCP was incorporated in 2004 and is headquartered in Kuwait City Kuwait.

Name: Nitratos de Chile S.A.
Description: Nitratos de Chile S.A. through its subsidiary Potasios de Chile S.A. invests in shares of Sociedad Química y Minera de Chile S.A. The company was founded in 2011 and is based in Santiago Chile. Nitratos de Chile S.A. is a subsidiary of Norte Grande S.A.

Name: Raubex Group Limited
Description: Raubex Group Limited engages in the infrastructure development and construction materials business in South Africa Australia rest of Africa and internationally. The company operates through four segments: Materials Handling and Mining Construction Materials Roads and Earthworks and Infrastructure. The Materials Handling and Mining segment is involved in the contract mining; contract crushing; materials handling and processing services for the mining industry; and resource ownership activities. The Construction Materials segment produces and supplies materials to the construction market such as aggregates from commercial quarries asphalt and value-added bituminous products. The Roads and Earthworks segment is involved in the road construction and earthworks and road surfacing and rehabilitation activities including laying of asphalt chip and spray surface dressing enrichments and slurry seals. The Infrastructure segment undertakes infrastructure projects which includes renewable energy telecommunications facilities management housing infrastructure and commercial building refurbishment and construction projects. Raubex Group Limited was founded in 1974 and is headquartered in Bloemfontein South Africa.

Name: Tegma Gestão Logística S.A.
Description: Tegma Gestão Logística S.A. provides logistics management transportation and storage services in Brazil. The company operates in two divisions Automotive Logistics and Integrated Logistics. The Automotive Logistics division engages in the transfer and distribution of new and used vehicles port transfers inventory and yard management vehicle assembly and vehicle preparation services. The Integrated Logistics division provides road transport general and bonded storage logistics management returnable packaging management inventory management operations parts and components management stock management vehicle preparation services tropicalization accessorization and reverse logistics. It serves chemicals home appliances consumer goods automotive and petrochemicals sectors. Tegma Gestão Logística S.A. was founded in 1969 and is headquartered in São Bernardo do Campo Brazil.

Name: Holding Bursátil Regional S.A.
Description: Holding Bursátil Regional S.A. a holding company operates capital markets infrastructures in Chile Colombia and Peru. The company offers clearing and settlement services for stock market transactions registration transfer administration and custody of securities; information services related to market information databases licensing and reports; negotiation products and services; services for issuers listed on the stock exchange; value-added services comprising office technological solutions; and other products such as fines office rental training and advertising area and website. Holding Bursátil Regional S.A. was formerly known as Holding Bursatil Chilena S.A. The company was incorporated in 2022 and is based in Santiago Chile.

Name: Kontrolmatik Teknoloji Enerji Ve Muhendislik Anonim Sirketi
Description: Kontrolmatik Teknoloji Enerji Ve Muhendislik Anonim Sirketi provides consulting feasibility studies project management engineering design construction management and procurement services in Turkey and internationally. The company also provides advanced process control computerized plant information systems software projects and support plant start-up and commissioning IoT and data analytics products and services. It serves oil and gas power generation power distribution and transmission process industry transportation mining agriculture and food and beverage sectors. The company was incorporated in 2008 and is based in Istanbul Turkey.

Name: RAGHSA Sociedad Anonima
Description: RAGHSA Sociedad Anonima engages in the real estate development business. It is involved in the construction leasing and sale of properties for offices and/or homes; and financing of properties. The company was incorporated in 1969 and is based in Buenos Aires Argentina.

Name: Export Development Bank of Egypt (S.A.E.)
Description: Export Development Bank of Egypt (S.A.E.) provides various banking products and services in Egypt. The company offers current savings export and time deposit accounts as well as certificates of deposit. It also provides loans for auto used car petroleum sector pharmacists university professors and scientific research centers doctors bankers loan-to-card buy out and financial institution employees; corporate and syndicated loans; and mortgage finance trade finance and export promotion services as well as financing for small and medium enterprises. In addition the company offers treasury services such as foreign exchange daily market report and money market services; and funded and unfunded risk participation bilateral loans and funding arrangements payments facilitation tailored/structured solutions and other products. Further it provides payroll financial inclusion transaction banking bancassurance online banking e-wallet and ATM services as well as debit prepaid and credit cards. The company was founded in 1983 and is headquartered in New Cairo Egypt.

Name: Banvit Bandirma Vitaminli Yem Sanayii Anonim Sirketi
Description: Banvit Bandirma Vitaminli Yem Sanayii Anonim Sirketi operates as a food company in Turkey. The company engages in the slaughtering production marketing and sales of breeding eggs daily broilers live chickens and chicken meat. It also offers energy production services. The company also exports its products. It distributes its products through the branches and dealers. The company was incorporated in 1968 and is headquartered in Balikesir Turkey. Banvit Bandirma Vitaminli Yem Sanayii Anonim Sirketi is a subsidiary of TBQ Foods GmbH.

Name: Tamkeen Human Resources Company
Description: Tamkeen Human Resources Company offers labor recruitment and manpower services in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. It provides manpower services for public and private sectors and local contracting. The company also offers labor services for domestic workers; and public and private sector workers as well as provides services related to sponsorship transfer. Tamkeen Human Resources Company was incorporated in 2018 and is headquartered in Riyadh Saudi Arabia.

Name: Ipek Dogal Enerji Kaynaklari Arastirma ve Üretim A.S.
Description: Ipek Dogal Enerji Kaynaklari Arastirma ve Üretim A.S. together with its subsidiaries engages in the research development and production of oil natural gas and energy and energy resources in Turkey. It is involved in the construction; air transportation; tourism and hotel management; and food and livestock businesses. The company was incorporated in 1968 and is based in Ankara Turkey. Ipek Dogal Enerji Kaynaklari Arastirma ve Üretim A.S. is a subsidiary of Koza İpek Holding A.Ş.

Name: Baladi Ltd
Description: Baladi Ltd. engages in the production processing and packaging of various food products. It offers beef lamb poultry and fish to food chains independent retailers hotels hospitals nursing homes defense ministry catering services restaurants and other manufacturing enterprises. It also distributes fresh and frozen meats fresh and frozen seafood frozen fruits and vegetables pastries and other products. In addition it offers cold storage surface services. The company was founded in 1916 and is based in Kiryat Malakhi Israel.

Name: Saudi Public Transport Company
Description: Saudi Public Transport Company together with its subsidiaries engages in the provision of transportation services in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia and internationally. It operates through Passenger Transport; Specialized Services; Concession Arrangements for the King Abdul-Aziz Project for Public Transport in Riyadh; Digital Mobility Solutions; and Technical Shared Services segments. The company offers public transportation services which connects cities within the kingdom; electronic services in public transportation such as mobile application and ticket vending machine self-service; national intercity transportation service linking cities and villages in the kingdom; international transportation services for passengers from cities in the kingdom to the neighboring Gulf and Arab countries including United Arab Emirates Bahrain and Egypt; specialized transportation services; and maintenance repair and logistics services. It is also involved in the transfer of non-postal parcels and cargo; school transport and teachers transport services; car rental and private transport services; and import of spare parts and chemical detergents for vehicles. In addition the company operates and maintains trains metros and motor vehicles and trucks; organizes tours; and transports pilgrims and visitors inside and outside of the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. Further it provides digital mobility solutions which include passenger solutions eJourney platform FinUP MerAPP and Fastmile services. Additionally the company offers driver training services and systems analysis and self-mobility technologies. Saudi Public Transport Company was incorporated in 1979 and is headquartered in Riyadh the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

Name: Europen Endustri Insaat Sanayi ve Ticaret A.S.
Description: Europen Endustri Insaat Sanayi ve Ticaret A.S. engages in the manufacturing and wholesale of PVC window and door profiles in Turkey. It also offers PVC sheets and panels; and refrigerator oven and furniture glasses. The company was founded in 1965 and is headquartered in Eskisehir Turkey.

Name: Diplomat Holdings Ltd
Description: Diplomat Holdings Ltd. operates as a sales and distribution company in the fast-moving consumer goods sector. It offers logistics services including storage packaging and transportation; and third part logistics services. The company also provides detergents knives shaving diapers cleaning personal grooming hygiene and health personal care laundry general house cleaning paper sweet food food and other food products as well as sweets and snacks canned food products and coffee; and electricity and batteries. It serves food retail chains pharmacy chains minimarkets containers wholesalers restaurants catering customers etc. The company operates in Israel South Africa Georgia New Zealand and Cyprus. Diplomat Holdings Ltd. was incorporated in 1963 and is headquartered in Airport City Israel.

Name: Al Taiseer Group TALCO Industrial Company
Description: Al Taiseer Group TALCO Industrial Company engages in the designing manufacturing and marketing a range of aluminum products in Oman Kuwait Bahrain Egypt Iraq the United Arab Emirates Lebanon and internationally. It operates through Aluminum Forming and Selling Sector; Metal Coating Powder Sector; and Other segments. The company offers aluminum extrusion decorative surface finishes and thermal break products. It also provides anodized powder-coated PVDF coatings; wood-finished aluminum such as real wood effecta film sublimation; thermoset powder coatings including polyester epoxy super durable and metallic powders; and weatherstrips polypropylene yarn rubber gaskets plastic components bags sheets and wrapping films. Its products are used in architectural products aluminum profiles building facades towers doors windows and curtain walls of buildings kitchens truck bodies scaffolding metal formwork formwork sun insulators electrical cable carriers stairs and air conditioning networks. Al Taiseer Group TALCO Industrial Company was incorporated in 1976 and is based in Riyadh Saudi Arabia.

Name: MIA Teknoloji Anonim Sirketi
Description: MIA Teknoloji Anonim Sirketi provides software development services to public and private organizations in Turkey. The company offers Pizzy an integrated facility management software; BIO-ID a biometric data management software; MIA-SOFT a multimodal biometric authentication and identification software; MBIS a multi biometric identification system; Surveillance an environmental surveillance and face recognition system; MIA-MED a hospital information management system software; traffic monitoring software; and ID-100B a multi biometric identification unit. It also provides identification and authentication environmental surveillance intelligent traffic inspection shared mobility renewable energy information technologies facility security and management city security health informatics technologies e-vehicle charging network cyber security critical facility security and management defense and immersive technologies sustainable and zero carbon and sustainable agriculture and food safety solutions. The company was incorporated in 2006 and is headquartered in Ankara Turkey.

Name: Commercial Facilities Company S.A.K.P.
Description: Commercial Facilities Company S.A.K.P. together with its subsidiaries provides installment credit facilities to finance consumer products in Kuwait. The company offers cash auto housing educational marine furniture electrical commercial education and personal loans; guarantees; and short- medium- and long-term loans for the purchase of equipment home appliances land and properties. It also invests in real estate industrial agricultural and other economic sectors; and manages loans syndicated loans and investment portfolios. In addition the company is involved in the purchase and sale of financial securities such as shares and bonds; real estate activities; provision of collection services; and buying and selling of cars. Commercial Facilities Company S.A.K.P. was incorporated in 1977 and is headquartered in Kuwait City Kuwait.

Name: Europower Enerji ve Otomasyon Teknolojileri Sanayi Ticaret Anonim Sirketi
Description: Europower Enerji Ve Otomasyon Teknolojileri Sanayi Ticaret Anonim Sirketi develops manufactures and sells products for low medium and high voltage electrical systems. The company offers medium and low voltage products Compact substations PFC systems railway products and silicone insulators as well as oil type distribution medium power and special type transformers. It also undertakes electrical and electromechanical EPC projects in Turkey and internationally. The company is based in Ankara Turkey.

Name: Afcon Holdings Ltd
Description: Afcon Holdings Ltd develops and executes construction projects in Israel and internationally. It provides electric charging solutions; generates electricity from wind energies; delivers hybrid systems and technological solutions for dealing with water and wastewater; and markets sells installs and maintains green technologies. The company conducts projects in the field of end-to-end communication solutions and security systems as well as in energy storage and renewable energies; multimedia and low-voltage installation; and develops and delivers communication services infrastructure and telecom solutions. In addition it plans and installs fire detection and extinguishing systems; provides technological solutions and products for very low voltage control and automation; conducts integrative security-related projects; technology-enhanced projects for electromechanical systems; and develops produces and installs peripheral electronic security and protection systems using advanced technologies. Further the company set up and maintain parking system projects; develops solutions in monitoring and control systems; radars for securing open-space facilities; deals with construction and civil engineering and electro-mechanical systems; provides electricity air conditioning plumbing cooling and low voltage electricity services; and manufactures electric boards for high voltage gas-insulated switchgears (GIS) and air-insulated switchgears (AIS) and for low voltage. Additionally it markets and distributes switching control communications and electrical installation as well as communication products; provides consultancy services and technical solutions; air conditioning and ventilation systems services; and develops and executes concession projects. The company was formerly known as Afcon Industries Group. The company was founded in 1945 and is based in Petah Tikva Israel. Afcon Holdings Ltd is a subsidiary of Shlomo Group.

Name: Verusa Holding A.S.
Description: Verusa Holding A.S. is a private equity and venture capital firm specializing in recapitalizations growth capital restructuring growth equity growth stage and Pre-Initial Public Offering companies. The firm invests in middle market; later stage; mature; turnaround; emerging growth; seed/startup; and early mid and late venture companies. It typically invests in communication services information technology innovation software renewable energy chemistry steel construction information technology venture capital food health food health sector hospitals chemicals metals and mining (Bauxite Gold Steel). The firm primarily invests in emerging market companies with focus on Turkey. It invests between ₺5 million ($0.62 million) and ₺100 million ($12.55 million) in preferred equity and in companies having turnover between ₺5 million ($0.62 million) and ₺400 million ($50.23 million). The firm supports it’s investee companies to grow internally and through add-on acquisitions. The firm prefers to seek strong minority positions with substantial shareholder rights or majority investments. It prefers to exit it's investments from 3 to 7 years. It prefers to invest througgrowthh balance sheet investments. Verusa Holding A.S. was founded in 2006 and is based in Istanbul Turkey.

Name: Jordan Electric Power Company
Description: Jordan Electric Power Company generates transmits and distributes of electric power in Jordan. The company was incorporated in 1938 and is based in Amman Jordan.

Name: Isiklar Enerji ve Yapi Holding A.S.
Description: Isiklar Enerji ve Yapi Holding A.S. together with its subsidiaries operates in the paper sack casting energy construction and contracting textile and building materials fields in Turkey and internationally. The company operates three river type hydroelectric power plants. It also manufactures and sells paper sacks; and provides alloyed grinding products to cement and mining companies. In addition the company manufactures pressed coating and floor bricks; cotto clinker pang hand and facade systems; and flex joint sealants and adhesives ceramics adhesives and joint sealants liquid silicones and brick surface cleaners. Further it manufactures sells and exports polyester yarns; and constructs water structures bridges tunnels roads factories treatment plants infra-structure facilities pipelines houses and commercial buildings. The company also exports its products. The company was incorporated in 1982 and is headquartered in Istanbul Turkey.

Name: Kuwait Investment Company K.S.C.P.
Description: Kuwait Investment Company K.S.C.P. together with its subsidiaries provides various investment and financial products and services in Kuwait Other GCC countries Other Middle East and North Africa Europe the United States and Asia. It operates through four segments: Asset Management Direct Investments and Corporate Finance Treasury and Other Operations. The company offers portfolio management services which include customized portfolio management; access to IPOs; and local regional and international fund management services. It also provides local/regional asset management services for asset classes including equity and fixed income institutions and individuals; fund management services that comprise a range of investment products for individuals and corporations; direct investment services that manage and monitor a diversified portfolio of mid to long-term direct investments; and online trading services through its platform KIC Trade. In addition the company offers treasury services that consist of foreign exchange trading and money market activities as well as manages strategic investments lending real estate and rental activities. Further the company engages in maritime medical and brokerage activities. Kuwait Investment Company K.S.C.P. was incorporated in 1961 and is headquartered in Kuwait City Kuwait. Kuwait Investment Company K.S.C.P. is a subsidiary of Kuwait Investment Authority.

Name: Hightech Payment Systems S.A.
Description: Hightech Payment Systems S.A. offers electronic payments and solutions in Morocco Europe the United States Africa Asia and the Middle East. It is involved in the field of electronic banking software publishing consulting training auditing and electronic payment processing for third parties. The company offers PowerCARD platform that covers the payment value chain and offers a range of solutions such as card issuing credit management merchant acquiring fraud monitoring e/m commerce payment analytics mobile payment ATM and POS management and retail payment applications. It also provides processing services for payment and switching activities; and testing services. The company was founded in 1995 and is based in Casablanca Morocco.

Name: Grupo Traxión S.A.B. de C.V.
Description: Grupo Traxión S.A.B. de C.V. provides logistics and mobility solutions in Mexico and Latin America. The company operates through three segments: Mobility of Cargo Logistics and Technology and Mobility of Personnel. It offers logistics solutions including 4PL logistics services 3PL warehouse management distribution last-mile brokerage and forwarding parcel and courier services technology applications rail logistics coordination services as well as logistics solutions for pharmaceuticals and medical supplies. Cargo solutions comprise regular and refrigerated truckload intermodal and cross-border cargo less-than-truckload and moving and relocation services as well as specialized transportation for food-grade products petrochemicals and hazardous materials. Additionally it provides personnel school and tourism transportation services. The company is also involved in general merchandise packaging tracto maintenance cash transfers and general refrigerated and/or specialized cargo transportation for cross-border and customs procedures. It offers storage services and intermediation services through technological platforms as well as storage import export labeling assembly and distribution services for all kinds of goods such as medical items. In addition it establishes organizes and manages a private transport club; manages and operates online pharmacies; supplies treatments for chronic conditions; sells distributes and delivers medicines and medical equipment; provides logistics coordination and transportation services personnel advertising and financial services; leases buses; and operates a non-profit association. The company was formerly known as Fondo de Transporte México S.A.P.I. de C.V. and changed its name to Grupo Traxión S.A.B. de C.V. in September 2017. Grupo Traxión S.A.B. de C.V. was incorporated in 2011 and is headquartered in Mexico City Mexico.

Name: Blau Farmacêutica S.A.
Description: Blau Farmacêutica S.A. a pharmaceutical company provides drug products in Brazil Argentina Chile Colombia Uruguay Ecuador Peru and the United States. Its products cover various areas such as immunology hematology oncology nephrology infectology and anesthesiology.
