Blau Farmacêutica S.A. was incorporated in 1987 and is headquartered in Cotia Brazil.

Name: Sociedad Anónima Importadora y Exportadora de la Patagonia
Description: Sociedad Anónima Importadora y Exportadora de la Patagonia operates a chain of supermarket in Argentina. Its supermarkets offer food personal care and children other products. The company was founded in 1908 and is based in Buenos Aires Argentina.

Name: Oando PLC
Description: Oando PLC through its subsidiaries provides integrated energy solutions in Nigeria and internationally. The company operates through Exploration and Production and Supply and Trading segments. It explores and produces oil and gas; and trades in crude refined and unrefined petroleum products. Oando PLC was formerly known as Unipetrol Nigeria Plc and changed its name to Oando PLC in December 2003. The company was founded in 1956 and is headquartered in Lagos Nigeria. Oando PLC is a subsidiary of Ocean and Oil Development Partners Limited.

Name: Ecogas Inversiones S.A.
Description: Ecogas Inversiones S.A. through its subsidiaries engages in the distribution of natural gas to residential and commercial customers in Argentina. It serves 1399777 customers through an infrastructure of 35842 km of networks and gas pipelines. The company was formerly known as Inversora de Gas del Centro S.A. Ecogas Inversiones S.A. was incorporated in 1992 and is based in Buenos Aires Argentina.

Name: Fuzul Gayrimenkul Yatirim Ortakligi Anonim Sirketi
Description: Fuzul Gayrimenkul Yatirim Ortakligi Anonim Sirketi develops residential and commercial properties. The company was incorporated in 1992 and is based in Istanbul Turkey

Name: Suez Canal Bank (S.A.E)
Description: Suez Canal Bank (S.A.E) provides retail corporate and investment banking services in the Arab Republic of Egypt. The company provides personal banking products and services including savings and current accounts; time deposits and certificates of deposit; payroll services; debit credit Meeza and prepaid cards; personal cash-secured bankers pensions semi-covered doctors auto property ownership club membership and education loans as well as loan against payroll full salary/installment transfer self-employed and professionals and non- salary transfer; loans to army and police officers pensioners and credit card; mortgage finance; and mutual funds. It also offers banking products financial and non-financial services and specialized programs to small and medium enterprises; cash management services; bookkeeping services; trade finance services; and money exchange transfer and brokerage services. In addition the company provides corporate banking products and services including account opening subscription in mutual funds short-term funding letters of credit letters of guarantees discounting of bills and term loans; institutional banking services; and treasury services such as spot and forward foreign exchange foreign exchange swaps selling and buying various foreign currencies against the Egyptian pound time deposits in domestic and foreign currencies Eurobonds and treasury bills and bonds. Further it offers Islamic banking services; online and mobile banking and e-wallet services. The company was founded in 1978 and is headquartered in Cairo Egypt.

Name: The Mediterranean and Gulf Cooperative Insurance and Reinsurance Company
Description: The Mediterranean and Gulf Cooperative Insurance and Reinsurance Company provides medical motor and other general insurance in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. The company offers third party and comprehensive motor medical malpractice and domestic worker contract insurance; roadside assistant; and visit visa extension services. It also provides health insurance; property all risks sabotage and terrorism fire and allied perils and political violence insurance; aviation hull and liability unmanaged aerial systems airport operations / contractors liability insurance; and marine cargo insurance one single shipment marine cargo open cover marine hull land transit insurance one shipment and land transit open cover. In addition the company offers insurance for boiler and pressure; erection all risk insurance; plant and equipment insurance; contractors all risk insurance; electronic equipment insurance; inherent structural defects insurance; deterioration of stock following machinery breakdown insurance; and machinery breakdown insurance products. The company was founded in 2006 and is headquartered in Riyadh the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

Name: Axtel S.A.B. de C.V.
Description: Axtel S.A.B. de C.V. an information and communications technology (ICT) company provides ICT solutions to companies corporations financial institutions and government entities in Mexico. It offers local and international long-distance calls to landlines and mobile phones; international traffics; voice over IP services; private lines accesses and dedicated internet; VPN and ethernet services; system integration and managed services; and digital transformation services including cloud cybersecurity managed application and collaboration services. The company also provides connectivity services such as last mile access long distance transport IP transit fiber spectrum and colocation services to fixed and mobile data center and tower operators. The company was incorporated in 1994 and is headquartered in San Nicolás de los Garza Mexico. Axtel S.A.B. de C.V. is a subsidiary of Controladora Axtel S.A.B. de C.V.

Name: TotalEnergies Marketing Ghana PLC
Description: TotalEnergies Marketing Ghana PLC engages in the marketing and sale of petroleum and allied products in Ghana. The company offers lubricants; fuels such as gasoil petrol and illuminating kerosene; and jet fuels and aviation gasolines. It provides solar solutions comprising solar powered service stations and phone charging solar kiosks; liquified petroleum gas and TotalEnergies Card solutions. It serves the aviation bitumen and mining industries. The company was formerly known as Total Petroleum Ghana Plc and changed its name to TotalEnergies Marketing Ghana PLC in May 2022. The company was incorporated in 1951 and is based in Accra Ghana.

Name: Ecobank Ghana PLC
Description: Ecobank Ghana PLC provides retail banking corporate and investment banking and other financial services in Ghana and internationally. The company operates through Consumer Banking Commercial Banking Corporate Banking and Treasury segments. It offers current savings and electronic accounts; personal auto and asset acquisition mortgage travel and cash backed loans as well as salary advance facility; microfinance products and services; term deposits; investor and securities services; and investment banking services. The company also provides funding for small and medium sized businesses and MidCaps; trade hub services; trade services and finance solutions; supply chain transaction banking cash and liquid management client channel access and integration rapid collect Omni Plus and asset and wealth management services; transfer and payment services; bancassurance products; fixed income currencies and commodities; business overdraft and revolving credit plan debtor finance distributor finance scheme and vehicle and asset finance services; e-commerce solutions; debit credit prepaid VISA Mastercard and PAC cards; and cashless payment ATM and internet and mobile banking services. It serves individuals small and medium-sized enterprises medium local corporates non-government public sector public sector multinational institutions financial institutions and international organizations. The company was incorporated in 1989 and is headquartered in Accra Ghana. Ecobank Ghana PLC is a subsidiary of Ecobank Transnational Incorporated.

Name: Bank of Palestine Plc
Description: Bank of Palestine Plc provides banking and financial services in the Palestinian Authority. It operates through three segments: Retails; Corporate Institutions and Public Sector; and Treasury segments. The company offers current primary and saving account such as Baraem savings account; Labors program services; loan products including commercial mortgage loan programs personal personal housing student fishermen green and mortgage loans; overdrafts and microenterprise financing as well as loans for financing people with disabilities. It also provides card products and online banking services. In addition the company offers current accounts for corporate institutional customers and public sector; and trading and treasury services managing bank’s funds and investments. Bank of Palestine Plc was founded in 1960 and is based in Ramallah the Palestinian Authority.

Name: Gulf Warehousing Company Q.P.S.C.
Description: Gulf Warehousing Company Q.P.S.C. provides logistics and freight forwarding services in Qatar the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia and internationally. The company operates through four segments: Logistics Operations Freight Forwarding Investment Properties and Others. It offers storage handling packaging and transportation; freight services through land air and sea; warehousing management; inventory management; retail distribution; promotional packing labelling and tagging; consulting projects event forwarding fine art relocations and equestrian solutions; and records management services including digitization of documents time-bound document retrieval document classification indexing and cataloguing comprehensive fixed asset tagging and inventorying electronic document management system implementation and storage management and secured destruction of physical records. The company also provides HAZMAT and pharmaceutical logistics solutions; and shipping agency services including yard operations liner representation port agency services cruise ship hosting and husbandry service. In addition it is involved in the trading of food chemicals plastic pipes and its accessories; container transportation; maintenance and repair services; rental income investment properties business; investment in shares bonds and funds; information technology services; record management and IT freight services; and preparation development and management of warehouses as well as courier services. It serves oil and gas government logistics retail FMGC healthcare shipping banking NGO sports and event management fine art aviation and small and medium enterprises. The company was incorporated in 2004 and is headquartered in Doha Qatar.

Name: Nayifat Finance Company
Description: Nayifat Finance Company provides personal financing solutions in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. The company operates through Personal Financing SME Financing and Islamic Credit Cards segments. It offers lease finance consumer finance small and medium enterprise finance debt crowdfunding and credit cards finance products. The company serves retail customers small and medium enterprises and high net-worth individuals. The company was founded in 2002 and is based in Riyadh the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

Name: Esenboga Elektrik Üretim A.S.
Description: Esenboga Elektrik Üretim A.S. engages in the establishment commissioning production and sale of electricity in Turkey. The company owns solar power plants as well as involved in solar power plant contracting business. Esenboga Elektrik Üretim A.S. was founded in 2009 and is headquartered in Ankara Turkey. Esenboga Elektrik Üretim A.S. is a subsidiary of Naturel Yenilenebilir Enerji Ticaret A.Ş.

Description: Oman Cement Company SAOG manufactures and sells cement and related products in the Sultanate of Oman and other GCC countries. The company was incorporated in 1978 and is based in Ruwi the Sultanate of Oman. Oman Cement Company SAOG operates as a subsidiary of Abra Holdings Limited.

Name: Tanzania Portland Cement Public Limited Company
Description: Tanzania Portland Cement Public Limited Company manufactures and sells cement in Tanzania and internationally. The company offers cement products under the Twiga Ordinary Twiga Plus Twiga Extra Twiga Jenga Twiga Super and Twiga Mega names. It serves constructions and government infrastructure projects; producers of ready-mixed concrete; and the general public through distributorship network. The company exports its products to various countries in the Central and East African Sub-Region. The company was founded in 1959 and is based in Dar es Salaam Tanzania. Tanzania Portland Cement Public Limited Company operates as a subsidiary of Scancem International DA.

Name: Tsogo Sun Limited
Description: Tsogo Sun Limited together with its subsidiaries engages in the gaming entertainment and hospitality business in South Africa. The company operates through Casinos Limited Payout Machines (LPMs) and Other Gaming and Betting segments. It offers casinos and gaming comprising VSlots division with limited payout machines and the Galaxy Bingo division with electronic bingo terminals. The company’s gaming and entertainment options include movies bird gardens theme parks restaurants bars shows and events and others. It also operates hotels; and online betting division through playTSOGO and bet.co.za. The company was formerly known as Tsogo Sun Gaming Limited and changed its name to Tsogo Sun Limited in June 2023. Tsogo Sun Limited is headquartered in Four Ways South Africa. Tsogo Sun Limited is a subsidiary of Hosken Consolidated Investments Limited.

Name: Moura Dubeux Engenharia S.A.
Description: Moura Dubeux Engenharia S.A. provides real estate development services in Brazil. The company develops flats hotels resorts and residential buildings as well as offers technical construction management and advisory services to the condominiums. It also engages in the purchase and sale of properties; rental and split of land allotment; real estate construction of properties; and management and administration of own- or third-party real properties as well as offers engineering services. The company was founded in 1983 and is based in Recife Brazil.

Name: Burstone Group Limited
Description: Burstone Group Limited is a South African Real Estate Investment Trust (REIT) which listed on the JSE in the Real Estate Holdings and Development Sector on 14 April 2011. At 31 March 2025 the Group comprised a portfolio of 58 properties in South Africa with a total GLA of 845 345 m2 valued at R13.3 billion. Name: Al Kout Industrial Projects Company K.S.C.P.
Description: Al Kout Industrial Projects Company K.S.C.P. together with its subsidiaries engages in the production and sale of chlor alkali products in Kuwait other in the Middle East and North Africa Asia South America North America and internationally. It operates through Chlor Alkali Petrochemical Products Trading Logistics and Transport Industrial Projects and Investments segments. The company offers caustic soda chlorine ferric chloride sodium hypochlorite purified food grade salt hydrochloric acid and hydrogen. It also provides logistic and transportation services; construction of chlorine dioxide plant for groundwater reservoirs; distribution of industrial materials; production and sale of petrochemical products; and investment activities. In addition the company is involved in the import storage and distribution of cement and other bulk materials; establishing operating and managing storage silos; and production of steel drums and other petrochemical products. It serves potable and waste water treatment plant power plant oil refinery petrochemical oil drilling industrial food and pharmaceutical industries. The company was incorporated in 1993 and is headquartered in Kuwait City Kuwait. Al Kout Industrial Projects Company K.S.C.P. is a subsidiary of Boubyan Petrochemical Company K.S.C.P.

Description: Discount Investment Corporation Ltd. a holding company invests in companies in various sectors in Israel and internationally. In addition it engages in the identifying transformative technologies nurturing gifted entrepreneurs and building companies into technology leaders; and managing investment portfolios mutual funds and investment banking. The company was incorporated in 1961 and is based in Tel Aviv Israel.

Name: Beyout Holding Company (K.P.S.C)
Description: Beyout Holding Company (K.P.S.C) through its subsidiaries provides human resources and project lifecycle support services. It operates through Real Estate and Services segments. The company offers human capital and life support services such as HR and life support solutions; facilities management; engineering services; and KRH Academy a platform for training and professional growth. It also provides real estate services comprising real estate consulting property management solutions and development and project execution services as well as conducts feasibility studies and market research and analysis. In addition the company provides property leasing general trading housing entertainment human resources management logistic and support travel and tourism and contracting services. Beyout Holding Company (K.P.S.C) was incorporated in 2006 and is headquartered in Kuwait City Kuwait.

Name: Molinos Rio de la Plata S.A.
Description: Molinos Rio de la Plata S.A. engages in the industrialization and commercialization of food and alcoholic beverages in Argentina and internationally. It operates through Foods and Wineries segments. The company offers edible oils pasta dried frozen fractionated flour grass rice wines and sparkling wines. Molinos Rio de la Plata S.A. was incorporated in 1931 and is based in Buenos Aires Argentina.

Name: Egyptian Financial and Industrial SAE
Description: Egyptian Financial and Industrial SAE engages in the manufacture and trading of chemical materials fertilizers and various agricultural fertilizers in Egypt. It operates through Acids Fertilizers Ammonium Sulfate and DCP segments. The company offers granulated single superphosphate and powder single superphosphate fertilizers; and concentrated and diluted sulfuric acid. It also manufactures and distributes acids ammonium sulfate and DCP products. The company also exports its products. Egyptian Financial and Industrial SAE was founded in 1929 and is based in Cairo Egypt.

Name: Compañía Electro Metalúrgica S.A.

Description: Cem Zeytin Anonim Sirketi produces and sells olives in Turkey. It offers green and black olives. The company was founded in 1930 and is based in Balikesir Turkey.

Description: Ollamani S.A.B engages in professional sports services games and raffles publishing and magazine distribution and other businesses in Mexico. The company is headquartered in Mexico City Mexico.

Name: Tanmiah Food Company
Description: Tanmiah Food Company together with its subsidiaries engages in food and agriculture business in Saudi Arabia and internationally. The company offers fresh and frozen poultry; ready-to-cook; added value products; and deli meat products. It is also involved in the manufacturing wholesale and retail trading in foodstuff; preparation of animal and poultry feeds for commercial; construction of poultry farms; retail and wholesale trading in poultry equipment; and operation of restaurant outlets with related services. In addition the company engages in wholesale trading of poultry products and agricultural produce; retail and wholesale trading in machines and equipment in the field of animal care animal shelter animal feed chicks and hatching eggs veterinary lab equipment and medicines as well as marketing and import and export of related products; general trading activities; and cafeterias and fast-food activities. It also offers its products online. The company was formerly known as Tanmiah Foods Trading Company and changed its name to Tanmiah Food Company in May 2019. The Company was founded in 1962 and is headquartered in Riyadh Saudi Arabia. Tanmiah Food Company is a subsidiary of Al Dabbagh Group Holding Company Limited.

Name: Lila Kagit Sanayi Ve Ticaret A.S.
Description: Lila Kagit Sanayi Ve Ticaret A.S. produces and sells roll papers primarily in Turkey. It offers hygienic cleaning paper products such as toilet paper paper towels tissue paper handkerchiefs and napkins. The company is also involved in the textile sector with an integrated cotton yarn and dyeing operations. It offers its products under the Sofia Maylo Ultra Berrak Nua and Nua Professional brand names. Lila Kagit Sanayi Ve Ticaret A.S. also exports its semi-finished and finished products to approximately 80 countries on 5 continents. The company was founded in 1930 and is headquartered in Istanbul Turkey.

Name: Naturgy BAN S.A.
Description: Naturgy BAN S.A. engages in natural gas distribution business. The company was formerly known as Gas Natural Ban S.A. and changed its name to Naturgy BAN S.A. in January 2019. The company was incorporated in 1992 and is based in Buenos Aires Argentina. Naturgy BAN S.A. is a subsidiary of Invergas S.A.

Name: Cairo Amman Bank
Description: Cairo Amman Bank provides various banking and financial services for corporate and institutional customers in Jordan and internationally. The company offers current deposit savings and notice accounts; and debit credit and prepaid cards. It also provides a range of loan products including retail corporate and renewable energy loans as well as venture and micro and small and medium enterprise financing. In addition the company offers investments services such as foreign exchange derivatives hedging and custody; money transfer safety deposit box mobile ATM online bill payment interest rates and commissions and fees services; brokerage and investment management finance leasing and Islamic banking services; and SMS mobile and online banking services. It operates through a network of multiple branches in Jordan Palestine and Bahrain. Cairo Amman Bank was incorporated in 1960 and is headquartered in Amman Jordan.

Name: Abu Dhabi Ship Building PJSC
Description: Abu Dhabi Ship Building PJSC together with its subsidiaries engages in the construction maintenance repair and overhaul of commercial and military ships and vessels in the United Arab Emirates. The company operates through New Build and Engineering Small Boats Military Repairs and Maintenance Commercial Repairs and Maintenance and Mission Systems segments. It offers design engineering research and development construction commissioning test and trails ILS upgrade conversions and consulting services for military commercial and leisure vessels. The company also engages in the in-house design development research and development construction of moulds prototypes and boats for military commercial and luxury boats as well as commissioning servicing and repairing of composite and special material boats. Name: First Avenue Real Estate Development Company
Description: First Avenue Real Estate Development Company invests in and develops of real estate properties for private sector in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. It operates through Real Estate Sales and Contracting segments. The company constructs residential and non-residential buildings including schools hospitals hotels etc.; and restores of residential and non-residential buildings. It is also involved in the demolition and removal of buildings etc.; and management and rental of owned or rented residential and non-residential real estate properties. First Avenue Real Estate Development Company was incorporated in 2017 and is headquartered in Riyadh the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

Name: National Cement Company (Public Shareholding Co.)
Description: National Cement Company (Public Shareholding Co.) engages in the manufacture and sale of cement and related products in the United Arab Emirates and internationally. The company provides ordinary Portland high and moderate sulphate resisting Portland Portland blast furnace and high slag Portland blast cement products as well as white aggregates. It also invests in securities and properties. National Cement Company (Public Shareholding Co.) was incorporated in 1968 and is based in Dubai the United Arab Emirates.

Locaweb Serviços de Internet S.A. was founded in 1998 and is headquartered in São Paulo Brazil.

Name: Instituto de Diagnóstico S.A.
Description: Instituto de Diagnóstico S.A. provides health services in Chile. It offers patient information and indication exams and online services; specialties services; and outpatient services including urgency laboratory imaging vaccination blood bank outpatient procedures and reproductive medicine unit. The company also provides hospitalization services such as maternity adult and pediatric hospitalization adult critical patient unit pavilion and surgical procedures neonatology and robotic surgery; and telemedicine services comprising online consultation and rehabilitation. Further the company offers research and training services as well as newborn school and accident agreements. Instituto de Diagnóstico S.A. was founded in 1961 and is headquartered in Providencia Chile.

Description: Altron Limited together with its subsidiaries engages in information communication and technology business in South Africa rest of Africa Europe and internationally. The company offers motor marine cargo fire engineering general accident and fleet insurance; and property insurance including property all risks fire and allied perils fire and lightning burglary business interruption sabotage and terrorism and hotels package insurance services. Name: Holcim (Argentina) S.A.
Description: Holcim (Argentina) S.A. operates in the construction material industry in Argentina. It engages in the production of cement concrete stone aggregates liquid paints and membranes. The Retail Banking segment offers private banking services deposit and investment savings products safe custody debit cards consumer loans and mortgages.
