Description: Cohen Development Gas & Oil Ltd. engages in the exploration for development production and marketing of natural gas condensate and oil in Israel Cyprus and Morocco. The company was incorporated in 1958 and is based in Bnei Brak Israel.

Name: Omani Qatari Telecommunications Company SAOG
Description: Omani Qatari Telecommunications Company SAOG develops operates and maintains mobile and fixed telecommunications services in the Sultanate of Oman. The company operates global system for mobile communication for prepaid and post-paid services; and sells telecommunication equipment and other associated services. It also provides international and national fixed line voice and data services from fixed line. In addition it offers data collection services; wired telecommunications services; and manages and operates data preparation of other agencies as well as maintains networks and rents communication equipment. The company was incorporated in 2004 and is based in Muscat the Sultanate of Oman. Omani Qatari Telecommunications Company SAOG operates as a subsidiary of Seyoula International Investment W.L.L.

Name: Kardan Real Estate Enterprise and Development Ltd
Description: Kardan Real Estate Enterprise and Development Ltd plans constructs develops builds and manages residential building and income-producing properties in Israel. It develops projects in the field of residential office hotel commercial etc.; and rents office buildings commercial areas and a parking lot as well as undertakes urban renewal projects. The company was incorporated in 1988 and is based in Tel Aviv Israel. Kardan Real Estate Enterprise and Development Ltd is a subsidiary of Cardan Israel Ltd.

Name: ANSA Merchant Bank Limited
Description: ANSA Merchant Bank Limited together with its subsidiaries provides a range of banking and financial services in Trinidad and Tobago and Barbados. The company operates into four segments: Banking Services Mutual Funds Life Insurance Operations and General Insurance Operations. The Banking Services segment is involved in asset financing commercial banking merchant banking investment services securities trading and foreign exchange trading activities. The Mutual Funds segment operates as the sponsor investment manager administrator and distributor of open-ended mutual funds registered in Trinidad & Tobago. The Life Insurance Operations segment underwrites longer-term insurance including individual participating and non-participating life insurance group life insurance individual insurance and group annuity and pension. The General Insurance Operations segment underwrites short-term insurance comprising commercial and residential fire general accident marine motor workmen compensation and group and individual health and rental of property. It also provides green lease project fleet financing; corporate line of credit; and debt refinancing debt consolidation and restructure debt. The company was incorporated in 1977 and is headquartered in Port of Spain Trinidad and Tobago. ANSA Merchant Bank Limited operates as a subsidiary of ANSA McAL Limited.

Name: Megureit Israel Ltd
Description: Megureit Israel Ltd operates in the real estate sector. It invests majorly in residential apartments for rent offices and commercial centers. Megureit Israel Ltd was formerly known as Index Residential Real Estate in Israel Ltd. and changed its name to Megureit Israel Ltd in August 2016. The company was incorporated in 2016 and is based in Ramat Gan Israel.

Name: Saudi Azm for Communication and Information Technology Company
Description: Saudi Azm for Communication and Information Technology Company together with its subsidiaries provides business and digital technology solutions in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. The company provides institutional services including operational support for large government and private institutions system integration services procurement and human resources; and management consulting services comprising strategic and operating model consulting services. It also offers development and products innovation solutions and platforms for financial technology and other sectors; and platform development services such as design building development and operation of platforms that include public partnership projects. In addition the company engages in the designing and programming of software; application development; designing of user experience and customer journey and repair and maintenance of personal and portable computers. Further it provides management and control services of communication sale of wire and wireless equipment and devices; senior management consulting services; and information networks and research and development on technology services. Saudi Azm for Communication and Information Technology Company was incorporated in 2017 and is based in Riyadh the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

Name: Pasifik Teknoloji A.S.
Description: Pasifik Teknoloji A.S. provides computer hardware electronic products and software products to corporate companies in Turkey. The company offers cybersecurity and technological infrastructure services. The company was formerly known as Pasifik Donanim ve Yazilim Bilgi Teknolojileri A.S. and changed its name to Pasifik Teknoloji A.S. in August 2024. Pasifik Teknoloji A.S. was incopotaed in 2015 and is based in Sariyer Turkey.

Name: Multiexport Foods S.A.
Description: Multiexport Foods S.A. provides seafood products in Chile and internationally. It offers Atlantic salmons coho salmon and trout as well as fresh frozen and smoked products. The company was formerly known as Aquafarms SA and changed its name to Multiexport Foods S.A. in May 2007. Multiexport Foods S.A. was founded in 1983 and is based in Puerto Montt Chile. Multiexport Foods S.A. is a subsidiary of Multiexport Dos S.A.

Name: Gulf Medical Projects Company (PJSC)
Description: Gulf Medical Projects Company (PJSC) manages hospitals in the United Arab Emirates. It operates in two segments Health Services and Others and Investments. The company provides telehealth services; and health medical care and other related services as well as operates home healthcare and first aid training centers. It also establishes and constructs medicine manufacturing factories as well as invests in properties and securities. The company was incorporated in 1979 and is headquartered in Sharjah the United Arab Emirates.

Name: Zephyrus Wing Energies Ltd
Description: Zephyrus Wing Energies Ltd. engages in renewable energy business in Poland. It generates electricity from wind and photovoltaic farms. It also engages in the development and construction of wind and photovoltaic farms as well as engineering procurement construction and technical and commercial management services. The company was incorporated in 2022 and is based in Tel Aviv Israel.
Industry: Independent Power and Renewable Electricity Producers

Name: Emira Property Fund Limited
Description: Emira Property Fund Limited (the “Company”) is a Real Estate Investment Trust (“REIT”) domiciled in South Africa and together with all its subsidiaries (the “Group” or the “Fund” or “Emira”) owns a portfolio of property investments which are sectorally and geographically diversified. Emira continues to deliver returns throughout the cycles by way of this risk-mitigating diversification strategy. The Fund has direct property holdings as well as indirect property investments through equity investments in property owning companies with specialist third-party co-investors. In South Africa the Fund owns a direct portfolio of properties diversified across the retail industrial office and residential sectors which it segregates between the Commercial Portfolio (the retail industrial and office properties) and the Residential Portfolio (the residential properties) respectively. The Residential Portfolio includes the properties of Transcend Residential Property Fund (Pty) Ltd (“Transcend”) a specialist residential property company wholly owned by Emira which is focused on value-oriented good-quality suburban units. Emira has international exposure through its indirect property investments in the United States of America (the “USA” or “US”) and Poland. In the USA Emira has equity interests in 11 grocery-anchored dominant value-oriented power centres held together with its US-based partner The Rainier Companies. In Poland Emira has a 45% equity interest in DL Invest Group S.A. (“DL Invest”) a Luxembourg-headquartered property company which develops and holds industrial and logistics centres mixed use/office centres and retail parks across Poland.

Name: Afrimat Limited
Description: Afrimat Limited operates as a mining and materials company primarily in the southern African region. The company operates through five segments: Construction Materials Industrial Minerals Bulk Commodities Future Materials and Metals and Services. The Construction Materials segment provides aggregates products including sand gravel and crushed stone; and concrete-based products comprising concrete made from rock sand water and readymix cement. The Industrial Minerals segment offers limestone dolomite and industrial sand. The Bulk Commodities segment provides iron ore and anthracite. The Future Materials and Metals segment produces phosphate an organic fertilizer; and vermiculite rare earths and green construction materials. The Services segment offers IT consulting and external logistical and mining services as well as mobile crushing screening drilling and blasting loading and hauling services. The company was founded in 1963 and is based in Bellville South Africa.

Name: Enel Generacion Piura S.A.
Description: Enel Generacion Piura S.A. an energy company engages in the production and sale of electricity in Peru. The company generates electricity from hydro solar and thermal resources. It is also involved in the natural gas business. The company was formerly known as Empresa Electrica de Piura S.A. and changed its name to Enel Generacion Piura S.A. in October 2016. The company was incorporated in 1995 and is based in Lima Peru. Enel Generacion Piura S.A. is a subsidiary of Enel Perú S.A.C.

Name: Tadiran Group Ltd
Description: Tadiran Group Ltd engages in the development manufacturing marketing import distribution and sale of air conditioners and air treatment systems Israel Europe and internationally. The company operates through Consumer Goods sector and Energy Sector segments. It offers cooling units switchboards air handling units blowers heat pumps mini overhead ducted and multi-split air conditioner products as well as inverters. The company also provides refrigerators washing machines tumble dryers freezers ovens dishwasher stove vapor absorbers microwave devices and other products. In addition it imports distributes and trades products in the field of photovoltaic energy uninterruptible power systems energy storage systems and charging electric vehicles as well as involves in providing warranty and maintenance services; and real estate leasing aluminum cladding curtain walls and other products. The company offers its products under the Tadiran Amkor Spectra and Crystal brand names. The company was formerly known as Tadiran Holdings Ltd and changed its name to Tadiran Group Ltd in May 2021. Tadiran Group Ltd was incorporated in 1962 and is headquartered in Petah Tikva Israel.

Name: Altinay Savunma Teknolojileri Anonim Sirketi
Description: Altinay Savunma Teknolojileri Anonim Sirketi provides products and solutions in the fields of motion control unmanned stealth weapon ammunition destruction and production systems. The company offers actuator telescopic mast pedestal electro-optical monitoring test weapon unmanned maritime servo drive and robot systems. It serves government and private sectors in Turkey and internationally. The company was founded in 2014 and is based in Istanbul Turkey.

Name: Diagnósticos da América S.A.
Description: Diagnósticos da América S.A. together with its subsidiaries provides diagnostic and hospital services in Brazil and Argentina. It operates through Hospitals and Oncology; Diagnostics and Care Coordination; and Diagnostics – International Operations segments. The company offers outpatient doctors; medical and outpatient services; diagnostic support assistants for private patients or partner companies; care coordination remote monitoring population health management home medical and paramedical services; and medical consultations. It is also involved in the development and licensing of computer programs and predictive models using information technology and data science; and brokerage activities. In addition the company provides oncology hematology and infusion centers. The company was formerly known as Laboratório Clínico Delboni Auriemo S.A. and changed its name to Diagnósticos da América S.A. in August 2000. Diagnósticos da América S.A. was founded in 1961 and is headquartered in Barueri Brazil.

Name: Zorlu Enerji Elektrik Üretim A.S.
Description: Zorlu Enerji Elektrik Üretim A.S. together with its subsidiaries engages in the production generation transmission distribution and trading of electricity and natural gas in Turkey and internationally. It sells and installs solar panels; rents electric vehicles; and sells installs and operates power stations as well as engages in electric vehicle charging activities. The company also engages in geothermal wind and hydroelectric power plants electricity generation. In addition it carries out engineering procurement and construction work with turnkey projects. Zorlu Enerji Elektrik Üretim A.S. was founded in 1993 and is based in Istanbul Turkey.
Industry: Independent Power and Renewable Electricity Producers

Name: Walaa Cooperative Insurance Company
Description: Walaa Cooperative Insurance Company provides cooperative insurance and reinsurance products and services in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. The company offers motor insurance products which include commercial and private motor comprehensive and third party liability policies; travel; medical marketplace; home; shop; SME medical; worker health; and saving and protection insurance products. It also provides property all risk fire and specified perils property damage home and loss of profit/business interruption insurance; engineering insurance products such as erection and construction all-risk contractor’s plant and machinery/equipment insurance machinery breakdown insurance (MBD) loss of profit following MBD and deterioration of stock following MBD; marine insurance products including marine cargo and hull insurance policies; medical insurance; and accident and liability insurance as well as security and private protection energy downstream plastic card fidelity guarantee and trade credit insurance. The company was formerly known as Saudi United Cooperative Insurance Company and changed its name to Walaa Cooperative Insurance Company in May 2017. The company was incorporated in 2007 and is headquartered in Al Khobar the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

Name: Smart Günes Enerjisi Teknolojileri Arastirma ve Gelistirme Üretim Sanayi ve Ticaret A.S.
Description: Smart Günes Enerjisi Teknolojileri Arastirma ve Gelistirme Üretim Sanayi ve Ticaret A.S. an integrated solar technology company produces solar photovoltaic modules in Turkey. The company also installs renewable energy power plants; and provides engineering and labor services. In addition it engages in selling and marketing various solar power plant system equipment. Further the company is involved in the research and development activities for the electrical energy sector including electricity networks and generation facilities; provides maintenance and operation services of technical infrastructure and systems; manage s turnkey projects for the electrical energy sector; offers project installation and maintenance repairs of low voltage lines and facilities electricity networks transformers electricity distribution panels and tables control systems and meters. Additionally it offers contracting works; provides tools and software for measuring protection automation remote monitoring and communication in high medium and low voltage networks; buys sells imports and exports ready-made panels; offers project contracting settlement and engineering services; develops software programs; prepares studies research and reports; and offers official-private national and international consultancy services. The company was incorporated in 2014 and is headquartered in Istanbul Turkey. Smart Günes Enerjisi Teknolojileri Arastirma ve Gelistirme Üretim Sanayi ve Ticaret A.S. is a subsidiary of Smart Holding A.S.

Name: RP Optical Lab Ltd
Description: RP Optical Lab Ltd. engages in the development production and marketing of optical and electro-optical products in Israel. The company offers short mid and long waved infrared lenses special lenses video engine for cooled thermal imaging systems thermal imaging cameras multi-sensor systems. It serves to defense homeland security medical and commercial markets. The company was incorporated in 2010 and is based in Petah Tikva Israel.

Name: Menif - Financial Services Ltd
Description: Menif - Financial Services Ltd provides mezzanine financing for equity to promoters and contractors in the construction sector in Israel and internationally. The company was incorporated in 1999 and is based in Ramat Gan Israel.

Name: Gulf Pharmaceutical Industries P.S.C.
Description: Gulf Pharmaceutical Industries P.S.C. together with its subsidiaries manufactures and sells medicines drugs and various other types of pharmaceutical cosmetic and medical compounds in United Arab Emirates other GCC countries and internationally. It operates through Manufacturing Planet Investments and Others segment. The company offers generic medicines for pain and inflammation antiviral respiratory anti-infectives immunosuppressants and selective immunosuppressants cardio care CNS and psychiatry vitamins and supplements wound care management dermatology endocrine gynecology and women care anemia antibiotics decongestants and other nasal preparations hyperkalemia and hyperphosphatemia urinary antispasmodics erectile dysfunction benign prostatic hyperplasia and gastrointestinal tract. It also provides solutions for type 1 type 2 and gestational diabetes such as insulin formulations of recombinant human insulin and continuous glucose monitoring systems. In addition the company is involved in the transportation activities; general trading; distribution wholesale and retail trading of medicines and cosmetic products; facilities management services health treatment undertaking services and hospitals management; investment in commercial industrial and healthcare enterprises; and trading in medical equipment. Gulf Pharmaceutical Industries P.S.C. was incorporated in 1980 and is headquartered in Ras al-Khaimah the United Arab Emirates.

Name: Al Hassan Ghazi Ibrahim Shaker Company
Description: Al Hassan Ghazi Ibrahim Shaker Company together with its subsidiaries engages in the trading wholesale and maintenance of spare parts electronic equipment household equipment and air-conditioners in Saudi Arabia and Jordan. It operates through three segments: Heating Ventilation and Air-Conditioning (HVAC) Solutions; Home Appliances; and All Other. The HVAC Solutions segment offers residential and commercial air conditioners including chillers and related services. The Home Appliances segment provides televisions washing machines dryers refrigerators irons gas cookers and floor care. The All Other segment offers consultancy services for energy solutions; and sells mobile phones.The company also engages in importing exporting and maintenance service of electrical and home appliances; offers marketing services; financial and insurance activities; constructions; and transportation and storage activities as well as offers agency services. It provides its products under the LG Indesit Ariston Maytag and Bompani and Midea brands. The company offers its products through a network of sales outlets service centers warehousing facilities and training academies as well as a network of distributors such as specialty retailers. Al Hassan Ghazi Ibrahim Shaker Company was founded in 1950 and is based in Riyadh Saudi Arabia.

Name: Consorcio Aristos S.A.B. de C.V.
Description: Consorcio Aristos S.A.B. de C.V. through its subsidiaries operates in the industrial and construction sectors in Mexico. It develops and executes project works of urban and hydroelectric infrastructure areas as well as electrical engineering area; and manufactures transports and assembles concrete structures. The company offers steel products for transformation and distribution of electric power in telecommunications construction metal and mechanical sectors. In addition it provides various solutions for the management of solid waste and biogas flaring. Consorcio Aristos S.A.B. de C.V. was incorporated in 1955 and is based in Mexico City Mexico.

Name: GCB Bank Plc
Description: GCB Bank Plc engages in the retail and corporate banking consumer and commercial banking and treasury activities in Ghana. The company offers current savings salary student deposit call and foreign currency and exchange accounts; personal employee scheme and short- and medium-term loans; and overdrafts. It also provides bulk cash collection and payroll solutions; import and export finance; letters of credit; bills for collection; money transfer and remittance; business development and advisory services; insurance; bonds and guarantees; and electronic mobile and Internet banking services as well as bancassurance services. In addition the company offers debit cards; fee collection advance payment and investment banking services; and capital raising financial advisory and alternative/long-term assets services. Further it provides swift and telegraphic transfer travellers cheques finware networking cash management small business finance scheme money market foreign drafts trade and documentary collection services. GCB Bank Plc was founded in 1953 and is headquartered in Accra Ghana.

Name: Northern Region Cement Company
Description: Northern Region Cement Company together with its subsidiaries engages in the production and sale of portland cement in Saudi Arabia the Hashemite Kingdom of Jordan and the Iraq Republic. The company offers white portland and white portland limestone cement for prefabricated products building construction purposes architectural construction fountains and swimming pools work concrete support and other applications. It also provides ordinary portland cement and portland cement sulfate resistant grey for pavements floors concrete buildings bridges railway structures warehouses tanks and water pipes and construction units as well as concrete exposed to high sulfur reactions applications; and oil well cement for internal isolation processes of oil wells. In addition the company is involved in wholesale and retail of cement building materials and rock pieces and white cement; and import and export business. The company was incorporated in 2006 and is based in Riyadh Saudi Arabia.

Name: Cleopatra Hospitals Group S.A.E.
Description: Cleopatra Hospitals Group S.A.E. operates hospitals in Egypt. It provides various medical services including surgeries medical supervision analysis examinations and xrays as well as inpatient day patient and outpatient medical services. The company also operates polyclinics; and inpatient and outpatient pharmacies. Cleopatra Hospitals Group S.A.E. was incorporated in 1979 and is headquartered in Cairo Egypt.

Name: Thob Al Aseel Company
Description: Thob Al Aseel Company develops imports exports wholesales and retails fabrics and readymade clothes. The company operates through Thobs and Fabrics segments. It sells men’s clothing and fabric such as thobes underwear pajamas and sleeping robes as well as other products including t-shirt socks and ehram. It operates through a chain of retail outlets under the Al-Jedaie brand. Thob Al Aseel Company was founded in 1987 and is based in Riyadh Saudi Arabia.

Name: Organización Cultiba S.A.B. de C.V.
Description: Organización Cultiba S.A.B. de C.V. together with its subsidiaries produces distributes and sells beverages in Mexico and internationally. It offers carbonated and non-carbonated soft drinks and jug water. It provides its products under the Pepsi Cola Seven Up Mirinda Manzanita Sol Gatorade Garci Crespo brands. The company was formerly known as Grupo Embotelladoras Unidas S.A. de C.V. and changed its name to Organización Cultiba S.A.B. de C.V. in December 2012. Organización Cultiba S.A.B. de C.V. was incorporated in 1978 and is headquartered in Mexico City Mexico.

Name: Wesure Global Tech Ltd
Description: Wesure Global Tech Ltd together with its subsidiaries engages in developing characterizing initiating licensing and marketing or technologies for digital platforms in the insurance and finance industry worldwide. It offers various insurance products such as motor property motor liability property contractors' and other general insurance. The company also provides fire engineering contractor work engineering mechanical equipment mechanical breakdown electronic equipment and agricultural insurance; comprehensive insurance for apartments; mortgage-related building insurance; cargo insurance in transport; vessel insurance; and insurance to cover cyber damage as well as comprehensive insurance for businesses and offices and apartments. The company was incorporated in 2016 and is based in Ramat Gan Israel.

Name: Light S.A.
Description: Light S.A. together with its subsidiaries engages in the generation transmission distribution and sale of electric power in Brazil. The company distributes electricity in the state of Rio de Janeiro. It also engages in the research planning building operation and exploration of generation and transmission systems; purchase sale import and export of electric and thermal power and gas and industrial utilities; provision of consulting services in the energy sector; lease of real estate and personal properties; acquisition and sale of goods related to the studies and projects; implementation operation and maintenance of construction works and facilities; and hydropower generation activities. In addition the company provides services to low voltage clients including the assembly renovation and maintenance of facilities. Further it offers technology solutions and systems for the operating management of public service concessionaires including electricity gas water sewage and other utility companies; and builds installs operates and explores electric power plants. The company primarily serves residential commercial and industrial customers. Light S.A. was founded in 1899 and is headquartered in Rio De Janeiro Brazil.

Name: Tharisa plc
Description: Tharisa plc an investment holding company engages in the mining processing beneficiation marketing sale and logistics of platinum group metals (PGMs) and chrome concentrates in South Africa China Singapore Hong Kong the United Arab Emirates an internationally. It operates through four segments: PGM Chrome Agency and Trading and Manufacturing. The company sells PGM concentrates including platinum palladium rhodium gold ruthenium iridium nickel and copper. It also produces metallurgical chrome concentrate and specialty chrome concentrates; operates a third party chrome plant as well as markets and sells the chrome concentrate produced at this plant; and manufactures and sells mining and mineral processing equipment. In addition the company holds 100% interest in the Tharisa mine an open pit PGM and chrome mine located on the south-western limb of the Bushveld Complex South Africa. Tharisa plc was incorporated in 2008 and is based in Paphos Cyprus.

Name: Angostura Holdings Limited
Description: Angostura Holdings Limited together with its subsidiaries engages in the manufacture and sale of rum aromatic bitters and other spirits worldwide. The company operates through Rum Chill Bulk and Other segments. The company offers consumer alcohol products; concentrate products such as Current Distillate blends and bulk bitters; and wines liquors and other branded spirits. The company also provides Angostura aromatic bitters; Angostura orange bitters; and Angostura cocoa bitters. In addition it offers premium rums; hard rum; coconut flavored rum; real hard puncheon; standard rums; and flavored rums. Further the company provides limited edition rums and carbonated drinks. Additionally it is involved in the bottling of alcohol and other beverages on a contract basis. The company was founded in 1824 and is based in Laventille the Republic of Trinidad and Tobago.

Name: Özata Denizcilik Sanayi ve Ticaret Anonim Sirketi
Description: Özata Denizcilik Sanayi ve Ticaret Anonim Sirketi provides ship repair services in Turkey. The company was founded in 1985 and is based in Yalova Turkey.

Name: TAQA Arabia S.A.E.
Description: TAQA Arabia S.A.E. and its subsidiaries operates as an energy and utility provider in Egypt. The company operates through Gas Power Fuel and lubricants Water and other segments. It constructs manages operates and maintains natural gas transmission and distribution lines; power plants electricity transformers and distribution networks; and water desalination stations refineries water purification transmission lines pumping stations and sewage and industrial drainage grids. The company also distributes electricity natural gas and water; provides consulting services; and is involved in conventional and renewable power generation and distribution. In addition it undertakes engineering procurement and construction works; manages and operates natural gas filling stations under the Master Gas name; and provides compressed natural gas mobile services. Further the company provides wastewater and chemical treatment filtration smart water metering and a smart water management platform; operates a solar power plant fuel stations under the TAQA brand name and fuel storage terminals; and distributes lubricants. It serves residential commercial and industrial clients; and oil and gas petrochemicals tourism agricultural and real estate development sectors. TAQA Arabia S.A.E. was incorporated in 2006 and is headquartered in Cairo Egypt.

Name: Mobile Telecommunications Limited
Description: Mobile Telecommunications Limited operates as a mobile telecommunications company in Namibia. It provides voice and data services and solutions to postpaid and prepaid individual and business customers through its telecommunications transmission and distribution network which is serviced by mobile homes dealerships comprising airtime sellers and distributors 24-hour customer contact center digital channels and a network management and technical quality center. The company also offers mobile; fixed connectivity; Internet of Things; digitally enabled value-added services; fiber to the office and home; secure cloud and private branch exchange hosted solutions; digital payment gateway services; and credit life insurance services The company was founded in 1994 and is based in Windhoek Namibia. Mobile Telecommunications Limited is a subsidiary of Namibia Post and Telecommunications Holdings Limited.

Name: LOG Commercial Properties e Participações S.A.
Description: LOG Commercial Properties e Participações S.A. develops constructs and rents residential and commercial properties in Brazil. It offers logistics warehouses shopping centers and strip malls as well as industrial warehouses; and engineering and construction services for real estate properties. The company was formerly known as MRV Logística E Participações S.A. LOG Commercial Properties e Participações S.A. was incorporated in 2008 and is based in Belo Horizonte Brazil.

Name: Suez Canal Company for Technology Settling (S.A.E)
Description: Suez Canal Company for Technology Settling (S.A.E) engages in the establishment and management of technological zones scientific incubators and training centers for the preparation of researchers and the transfer of technology and the provision of related services. It is also involved in designing software; entering data into computers; creating data and electronic information systems; and producing electronic content in various forms of audio image and data. In addition the company designs produces and operates computer programs systems and applications as well as provides training; and rents housing units. Further it engages in establishing integrated hospitals and the internal therapeutic or service activities; and establishing and managing universities institutes schools and educational institutions. Additionally the company invests in real estate properties. Suez Canal Company for Technology Settling (S.A.E) was founded in 1989 and is based in Cairo Egypt.

Name: Cruzeiro do Sul Educacional S.A.
Description: Cruzeiro do Sul Educacional S.A. provides education services in Brazil. It offers academic and professional education services including elementary school undergraduate graduate and extension courses in on-site and distance learning modalities; kindergartens; and medical courses. The company was founded in 1965 and is headquartered in São Paulo Brazil.

Name: Blumar S.A.
Description: Blumar S.A. engages in the fishing and aquaculture businesses. The company produces and sells fresh or frozen salmon products in the United States Brazil and the rest of Latin America Europe and Asia. It provides fishmeal and fish oil products used in the production of animal feed; and frozen mackerel. In addition the company produces and sells mussels; and other products such as fillets. It also exports its products. The company was founded in 1948 and is based in Santiago de Chile Chile.

Name: Oyak Yatirim Menkul Degerler A.S.
Description: Oyak Yatirim Menkul Degerler A.S. provides research brokerage portfolio management corporate finance and fund operation services for the capital market instruments in Turkey. The company provides research services including analysis forecasts and recommendations to investors on capital market instruments and other investment opportunities; and brokerage services comprising stock exchange brokerage fixed income securities BIST futures and options market transactions over-the-counter derivative transactions and investment funds transactions. It offers portfolio management and investment advisory services; corporate finance services such as mergers and acquisitions configurating debt/stock initial public offering debt instrument issuing and financial consulting; and fund operation services. It serves its products to finance insurance energy telecommunications food fertilizer mining port real estate retail media iron and steel cement logistics and chemistry sectors. The company was incorporated in 1982 and is headquartered in Istanbul Turkey.

Name: Arabian Cement Company S.A.E.
Description: Arabian Cement Company S.A.E. manufactures and sells cement and other related products in Egypt. The company offers cements under the AL MOSALAH and AL NASR names; clinker under the OPC and SRC names; and ready mix concrete including standard and high strength mixes and high density light weight self-compacting screed and fibers concrete. It also provides construction materials; and constructs and operates factories for recycling. In addition the company offers managerial restructuring and general trading services transportation of goods project management and preparation of feasibility study. Further the company involved in environmental services clean energy production and development and establishes and operates factory for recycling wastes and other services. It also exports its products. Arabian Cement Company S.A.E. was founded in 1997 and is headquartered in New Cairo Egypt. Arabian Cement Company S.A.E. is a subsidiary of Aridos Jativa S.L.U.

Name: Pasifik Gayrimenkul Yatirim Ortakligi A.S.
Description: Pasifik Gayrimenkul Yatirim Ortakliği A.Ş. focuses on operating as a REIT company in Turkey. It has various mixed projects. The company is based in Ankara Turkey.

Name: Sidi Kerir Petrochemicals Co.
Description: Sidi Kerir Petrochemicals Co. engages in the production and sale of polyethylene in Egypt and internationally. Its products are used in applications including film blow moulding injection and roto moulding. The company was incorporated in 1997 and is headquartered in Alexandria Egypt.

Name: SBM Holdings Ltd
Description: SBM Holdings Ltd together with its subsidiaries provides various commercial banking and financial services to retail and corporate customers. The company offers savings and current accounts; term deposits; foreign currency short and long term deposit; debit credit and prepaid card; home boost personal student auto lease eco and zero interest loan; working capital finance and project finance; trade corporate and structured finance as well as treasury products and services fixed income products foreign exchange services derivatives and dual currency deposits. It also provides financial services such as trading and structuring asset management registry and valuation services corporate finance insurance agency and factoring; private wealth management and banking services; custodian services; merchant corner; microfinance; dormant account reactivation; and SME banking services. SBM Holdings Ltd was incorporated in 1973 and is headquartered in Port Louis Mauritius.

Name: Çan2 Termik A.S.
Description: Çan2 Termik A.S. operates a thermal power plant in Turkey. The company’s power plant has an installed capacity of 340 MWm/330 Mwe. The company is involved in renting of coal-based electrical energy production facilities electrical energy production energy and the sale of the produced electrical energy and/or capacity to customers. It also engages in the mining business. The company was incorporated in 2003 and is headquartered in Istanbul Turkey. Çan2 Termik A.S. is a subsidiary of Odas Elektrik Üretim Sanayi Ticaret A.S.

Name: Banco Hipotecario S.A.
Description: Banco Hipotecario S.A. provides wholesale and retail banking services in Argentina. The company offers savings current and investor accounts; mortgage loans; personal loans comprising destination short term and salary plan loans; home life personal accident ATM theft movable goods pets sustainable mobility senior health protected purchase and comprehensive health insurance products. It also provides investment products such as fixed term deposits mutual funds titles and shares mortgage certificates safe deposit box and market data solutions as well as corporate financial advisory and office banking services. In addition the company offers treasury management financing accounts and payment and collection solutions to corporates institutions and small and medium enterprises. Banco Hipotecario S.A. was founded in 1886 and is based in Buenos Aires Argentina.

Name: Saudi Advanced Industries Company
Description: Saudi Advanced Industries Company through its subsidiary operates in investment and financing sector in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. It operates through Petrochemical Glass Industry Industrial Services Financial Services and Investments and Others segments. The company is involved in the manufacturing of glass and multi-layer insulating glas; wholesale and retail trade for glass raw materials for glass and accessories; make and chop glass coloring and install glass; establishment and management of related mining quarries. It also provides mortgage services to individuals and resell some derivatives to banks; geophysical and marine studies services for the exploration and development of hydrocarbons minerals and groundwater sources; seismic survey ocean study geodetic studies and map preparation services; drilling services for oil and gas extraction; and self-propelled platform for oil well services. In addition the company offers pure tricalic acid and polyester ores; and aromatic or ring compounds including paracillin and benzene. Further it engages in financial investment activities; provision of academic programs and scientific specializations for male and female students in various fields; and operates in health sector. The company was incorporated in 1988 and is headquartered in Riyadh the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

Name: Alfa Solar Enerji Sanayi ve Ticaret A.S.
Description: Alfa Solar Enerji Sanayi ve Ticaret A.S. engages in the manufacture and sale of solar panels. The company was incorporated in 2011 and is headquartered in Ankara Turkey. Alfa Solar Enerji Sanayi ve Ticaret A.S. operates as a subsidiary of Alfa Kazan Enerji ve Çevre Yatirimlari A.S.

Name: Kuwait National Cinema Company (K.P.S.C)
Description: Kuwait National Cinema Company (K.P.S.C) together with its subsidiaries establishes and operates cinemas in Kuwait and internationally. It operates through Cinema and Buffets Investment and Investments Properties segments. The company establishes operates and leases shops restaurants ready-made meals coffee shops and fun games halls in cinema and theatre buildings; owns movable assets; and manages and operates visual and audio media as well as retail sales of gifts and accessories. It also engages in the publishing and film production and distribution activities. In addition the company invests in equity and investment funds; and invests in and rents real estate properties. Kuwait National Cinema Company (K.P.S.C) was incorporated in 1954 and is based in Kuwait City Kuwait.

Name: Al Soor Fuel Marketing Company K.S.C.P.
Description: Al Soor Fuel Marketing Company K.S.C.P. engages in the sale of fuel and other related services in the State of Kuwait. It operates through Fuel Marketing and Other Related Services and Investment Operations segments. The company engages in the acquisition establishment leasing operation and maintenance of petrol stations. It also provides gasoline diesel fuel and kerosene as well as oil and lube products. In addition the company offers automobile services related to cars and vehicles such as oil changing car washing maintenance workshop and technical check-up services; ships and trades in petroleum products in bulk or retail; and prepaid and postpaid petro cards for public private and government sectors as well as operates soft drinks vending machines at fuel stations. Further the company purchases leases acquires and sells land and real estate properties; and invests in managed portfolio and short-term money market placements. Al Soor Fuel Marketing Company K.S.C.P. was founded in 2005 and is based in Kuwait City Kuwait. The company operates as a subsidiary of Alfa Energy Company K.S.C.

Name: Group Five Pipe Saudi Company
Description: Group Five Pipe Saudi Company engages in the production and sale of spirally welded pipes in the Middle East and North Africa region. Group Five Pipe Saudi Company was founded in 2000 and is based in Dammam the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

Name: Empresa Siderúrgica del Perú S.A.A.
Description: Empresa Siderúrgica del Perú S.A.A. produces and sells steel products in Peru and internationally. The company offers strength structural steel abrasion resistant steel sewers angles structural square bars structural smooth round bars mining bars mining balls U channels steel nails corrugated iron construction iron enabled iron electro welded mesh plates reservoirs galvanized mechanical pipes LAC pipes and mechanical tubes and LAF mechanical tubes. It serves construction road infrastructure energy mining agriculture and industrial companies. The company was incorporated in 1971 and is based in San Isidro Peru. Empresa Siderúrgica del Perú S.A.A. operates as a subsidiary of Gerdau S.A.

Name: Hiron-Trade Investments & Industrial Buildings Ltd
Description: Hiron-Trade Investments & Industrial Buildings Ltd engages in the real estate business in Israel. The company purchases plots and real estate projects; constructs and rents commercial centers including cold storage bonded warehouses archives logistics warehouses light industry facilities offices sales centers and others. It also imports and markets of timber and wood products such as plywood for the furniture industry as well as MDF beech wood white wood and pine hardwood products. The company was incorporated in 1974 and is based in Tel Aviv Israel.

Name: Irani Papel e Embalagem S.A.
Description: Irani Papel e Embalagem S.A. manufactures and sells corrugated cardboard and packaging papers in Brazil and internationally. It operates through three segments: Sustainable Packaging; Paper Segment for Sustainable Packaging; and Sustainable Resins. The company offers light corrugated and heavy cardboard boxes and sheets; and low and heavy weight kraft papers and recycled papers. It also provides forestry and reforestation services; and sells wood and extracts pine resin used as raw material for production of pitch and turpentine. The company was founded in 1941 and is headquartered in Porto Alegre Brazil.

Name: U Consumer Finance S.A.E.
Description: U Consumer Finance S.A.E. a financial technology company provides various financial solutions for customers and businesses. The company offers investment products an instant cash redemption program savings solutions and a financing solution as well as the U* application which provides buy now pay later solutions. It also provides business solutions comprising payroll system payroll card and employee benefits. The company was incorporated in 2017 and is based in Sheikh Zayed City Egypt.

Name: CarrefourSA Carrefour Sabanci Ticaret Merkezi A.S.
Description: CarrefourSA Carrefour Sabanci Ticaret Merkezi A.S. engages in the retail business in Turkey. It offers fruits vegetables meat fish chicken basic food snacks ready meals and frozen products ice creams oven healthy living products drinks milk breakfast detergents baby products pet products cleaning products paper products cosmetics and electronic products as well as home and life products. The company serves in the hypermarket and supermarket sectors. It also engages in the leasing of real estate properties. The company was incorporated in 1991 and is headquartered in Istanbul Turkey. CarrefourSA Carrefour Sabanci Ticaret Merkezi A.S. operates as a subsidiary of Haci Ömer Sabanci Holding A.S.

Name: Société d'Articles Hygiéniques Société Anonyme
Description: Société d'Articles Hygiéniques Société Anonyme produces and distributes detergents and hygiene products for men women and infants. The company offers baby and adult diapers wipes and paper sanitary pads paper dispensers baby nappies and maternity napkins. It also provides detergents including bleach powder and liquid detergent and insecticides. The company was incorporated in 1994 and is headquartered in Tunis Tunisia.

Name: Societe Africaine de Plantations d'Heveas Société anonyme
Description: Societe Africaine de Plantations d'Heveas Société anonyme produces natural rubber. It manages 24400 hectares of industrial plantations; and supervises approximately 29000 independent rubber out growers. The company was incorporated in 1956 and is headquartered in Abidjan Ivory Coast. Societe Africaine de Plantations d'Heveas Société anonyme is a subsidiary of Société Internationale de Plantations d'Hévéas Société Anonyme.

Name: A.S. Bryden & Sons Holdings Limited
Description: A.S. Bryden & Sons Holdings Limited a consumer products distributor distributes food and grocery beverages pharmaceutical hardware houseware and industrial equipment. The company also engages in investment real estate investment and general insurance agency activities as well as provision of logistics services. The company was founded in 1898 and is based in San Juan Trinidad & Tobago. A.S. Bryden & Sons Holdings Limited is a subsidiary of Seprod Limited.

Name: BrasilAgro - Companhia Brasileira de Propriedades Agrícolas
Description: BrasilAgro - Companhia Brasileira de Propriedades Agrícolas engages in the acquisition development exploration and sale of agricultural activities in Brazil Paraguay and Bolivia. It operates through six segments: Real Estate Grains Sugarcane Cattle Raising Cotton and Other. The company is involved in the cultivation of soybean corn sugarcane sesame sorghum bean and cotton lint and seed as well as pasture; and production and sale of beef calves after weaning. It also engages in exploration import and export of agricultural activities and inputs cattle raising livestock and forestry activities; and purchases sells and rents real estate in rural and/or urban properties. In addition the company provides real estate brokerage services; manages third-party assets; and operates farms through own and leased lands. BrasilAgro - Companhia Brasileira de Propriedades Agrícolas was incorporated in 2005 and is headquartered in São Paulo Brazil.

Name: Al-Jouf Agricultural Development Co.
Description: Al-Jouf Agricultural Development Co. engages in the production sale and marketing of agricultural products in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. The company offers sweet potatoes dates olive oil and honey. It also engages in the palm and olive agriculture winter fodder seeds production as well as beekeeping activities. The company was founded in 1988 and is headquartered in Sakakah the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

Name: Akfen Insaat Turizm ve Ticaret Anonim Sirketi
Description: Akfen Insaat Turizm Ve Ticaret Anonim Sirketi engages in the construction business. It constructs hospitals dormitories schools and residential and commercial properties. The company also undertake contracting works for infrastructure facilities such as roads bridges dams and ports as well as industrial and touristic facilities hotels airport terminals and runways and hydroelectric power plants. The company was incorporated in 1986 and is based in Ankara Turkey. Akfen Insaat Turizm Ve Ticaret Anonim Sirketi operates as a subsidiary of Akfen Holding Anonim Sirketi.

Name: Essbio S.A.
Description: Essbio S.A. primarily engages in the catchment decantation filtration disinfection purification storage and distribution of water. It also provides sewage collection and treatment sludge treatment and liquid industrial waste treatment services; sewers maintenance services; and project management advisory and technical assistance for rural health services. The company serves agro-industrial forestry port and mining sectors as well as commercial and residential customers primarily in the regions of O'Higgins and Biobío in Chile. Essbio S.A. was founded in 1990 and is based in Concepción Chile.

Name: Vitania Ltd.
Description: Vitania Ltd. operates as a real estate company in Israel. The company engages in entrepreneurship land development and improvement and construction of buildings. It constructs offices commercial areas residential buildings and assisted living facilities. The company was incorporated in 1995 and is based in Tel Aviv Israel.

Name: FIBRA Storage
Description: FIBRA Storage is an institutional reference for Self-Storage in Mexico. FIBRA Storage offers through its platform and strategically located facilities a solution to space problems for families and businesses in Mexico. FIBRA Storage has vertically integrated platform that allows to generate value throughout the business chain offering peace of mind to investors.

Name: Gipta Ofis Kirtasiye ve Promosyon Ürünleri Imalat Sanayi A.S.
Description: Gipta Ofis Kirtasiye ve Promosyon Ürünleri Imalat Sanayi A.Ş. manufactures and sells notebooks school stationery products office products and promotional products in Turkey and internationally. The company also offers gift boxes and bags. In addition it exports its products primarily to Europe the Balkans and the Middle East. The company was founded in 1990 and is based in Ankara Turkey.

Name: Mohammed Hadi Al-Rasheed Company
Description: Mohammed Hadi Al-Rasheed Company produces silica sand for various industrial applications. The company also produces granites and marble stone; and asphalt mix products and aggregates and limestone for various applications. In addition it undertakes civil and architecture contracting works; and provides supply and maintenance services for military equipment. The company was founded in 2000 and is based in Riyadh Saudi Arabia.

Name: Visne Madencilik Üretim Sanayi ve Ticaret A.S.
Description: Visne Madencilik Üretim Sanayi ve Ticaret A.S. provides construction materials in Turkey and internationally. The company offers quick and slaked lime aggregates and humidity absorbents. Its products are used in steel industries flue gas treatment drinking water agriculture glass building materials paper and pulp synthetic soda and non-steel metal applications. Visne Madencilik Üretim Sanayi ve Ticaret A.S. was founded in 1952 and is headquartered in Alsancak Turkey.

Name: Halwani Bros. Co. Ltd.
Description: Halwani Bros. Co. Ltd. manufactures packages wholesales and retails food products in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia Arab Republic of Egypt and internationally. It offers halawa maamoul tahina breaded chicken meat dairy cheese ground red peppers in oil sugar and sugarcane syrup products; and jams juices olives tissues and sterile swabs as well as catering services. The company was founded in 1830 and is headquartered in Jeddah the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. Halwani Bros. Co. Ltd. is a subsidiary of Aseer Al Arabiah for Industrial Investment Co.

Name: Halk Gayrimenkul Yatirim Ortakligi A.S
Description: Halk Gayrimenkul Yatirim Ortakligi A.S operates as a subsidiary of Turkiye Halk Bankasi A.S.

Name: Ayyan Investment Company
Description: Ayyan Investment Company together with its subsidiaries engages in construction of nonresidential buildings. The company operates through three sectors: Manufacturing Medical Services and Investment. It also owns manages operates and maintains hotels hospitals schools medical centers health educational recreational and tourism facilities as well as industrial agricultural and tourism activities; and government and private dispensaries. The company involves in the wholesale and retail trade in medical devices and equipment; hospital supplies and perfumes; and cosmetics. It establishes and operates cold storage facilities transport fleets maintenance and repair workshops and gas stations. In addition it owns manages operates and maintains real estate and land; and invests in securities. Further the company produces packages and sells dates and its derivatives. The company was formerly known as Al Ahsa Development Company and changed its name to Ayyan Investment Company in July 2020. Ayyan Investment Company was founded in 1993 and is headquartered in Al Khobar Saudi Arabia.

Name: Logo Yazilim Sanayi ve Ticaret A.S.
Description: Logo Yazilim Sanayi ve Ticaret A.S. develops and markets software solutions in Turkey and internationally. The company offers enterprise resource planning customer relationship management warehouse management system human resources process management e-transformation occupational health and safety management document management payroll management field sales management budget management workflow management data analysis and reporting B2B after sales service management retail merchandising management SME logo treasury wizard elogo financial services retail channel management peoplise and logo ecosystem solutions. The company serves agricultural products and livestock automotive and automotive supply aviation chemistry construction distribution and wholesale trade e-commerce education electrical and electronics finance and insurance food and beverage services food production glass cement and soil products health and sports machine and machine parts production media and communication publishing and broadcasting metal products retail trade telecommunications textile apparel and leather production tourism entertainment and hospitality sectors. Logo Yazilim Sanayi ve Ticaret A.S. was founded in 1984 and is headquartered in Gebze Turkey.

Name: Kalekim Kimyevi Maddeler Sanayi Ve Ticaret Anonim Sirketi
Description: Kalekim Kimyevi Maddeler Sanayi Ve Ticaret Anonim Sirketi operates in the construction chemicals sector in Turkey and internationally. It operates through the Ceramic Applications Waterproofing Paint-Plaster and Concrete Cement Chemicals and Raw Materials segments. The company engages in the production of ceramic adhesives joint fillers water and heat insulation materials interior and exterior paints mastics foams surface preparation materials ceramic cleaning materials maintenance materials and decorative ready-made colored plaster; and operation of factories. Its products portfolio includes waterproofing products such as cement -based acrylic-based bitumen-based polyurethane-based and membrane-based waterproofing products as well as impregnated primers and waterproofing bands; tile adhesives including cement acrylic and resin-based adhesives as well as cement epoxy and resin-based grouts; and surface cleaning and maintenance products sealants and grabs and tile levelling systems. In addition it offers bathroom kitchen pool balcony and terrace basement and foundation floor interior and facade solutions. The company was incorporated in 1973 and is headquartered in Istanbul Turkey. Kalekim Kimyevi Maddeler Sanayi Ve Ticaret Anonim Sirketi operates as a subsidiary of H. Ibrahim Bodur Holding Anonim Sirketi.

Name: Polyram Plastic Industries LTD
Description: Polyram Plastic Industries LTD manufactures and supplies thermoplastic compounds in Israel and internationally. The company offers engineering plastics; functional polymers including coupling agents compatibilizers impact modifiers and adhesive resins for automotive multi-layer film industrial and packaging applications; Polytron materials which are primarily used in automotive sector; tie layers; and purging agents. It offers its products through distributors. Polyram Plastic Industries LTD was founded in 1986 and is headquartered in Gilboa Israel.

Name: Standard Chartered Bank Ghana PLC
Description: Standard Chartered Bank Ghana PLC provides various banking products and services in Ghana. It operates through Corporate and Investment Banking Wealth and Retail Banking and Standard Chartered Wealth Management Limited Company. The company offers transaction services including cash management trade finance and working capital. It also provides financial markets such as macro commodities and credit trading financing and securities services sales and structuring debt capital markets and leveraged finance project and transportation finance. In addition the company offers retail products including deposits and personal loans. Further the company provides wealth management and corporate finance such as investments portfolio management insurance and wealth advice. Additionally the company offers debit cards; credit cards; bancassurance products; and online and mobile banking and ATM services. It provides advisory services. Standard Chartered Bank Ghana PLC was founded in 1896 and is headquartered in Accra Ghana. Standard Chartered Bank Ghana PLC is a subsidiary of Standard Chartered Holdings (Africa) BV.

Name: Sinai Cement Co. (S.A.E)
Description: Sinai Cement Co. (S.A.E) together with its subsidiaries manufactures and sells cement and cement products. The company also produces packing bags. The company was founded in 1997 and is headquartered in Cairo Egypt. Sinai Cement Co. (S.A.E) is a subsidiary of Vicat Cement Egypt.

Name: The National Company for Glass Industries
Description: The National Company for Glass Industries produces and sells returnable and non-returnable glass bottles and float glass. It offers generic glass packaging plain bottle jars and custom products. The company operates sand and gravel mines including crushers. The National Company for Glass Industries was founded in 1990 and is based in Riyadh Saudi Arabia.

Name: Herfy Food Services Company
Description: Herfy Food Services Company establishes operates and franchises restaurants in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia and internationally. The company operates through Restaurants Meat Factory and Bakeries. It operates restaurants under the HERFY name. The company also produces and sells bakery and pastry products through bakeries and bakery shops under the Herfy Bakeries/Doka name; and meat products. In addition it provides catering services; purchases and sells land for constructing buildings; and owns uses maintains and leases stores and food store fridges. The company was incorporated in 1981 and is headquartered in Riyadh the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

Name: Amlak International Finance Company
Description: Amlak International Finance Company operates as a real estate finance company that provides real estate SME and personal financing services in Saudi Arabia. The company operates through Retail and Corporate segments. It provides finance products to small and medium sized businesses individuals corporates and institutional customers. The company also holds titles of real estate properties. The company was formerly known as Amlak International for Real Estate Finance Company and changed its name to Amlak International Finance Company in December 2022. Amlak International Finance Co. was incorporated in 2007 and is headquartered in Riyadh the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

Name: Sarkuysan Elektrolitik Bakir Sanayi ve Ticaret A.S.
Description: Sarkuysan Elektrolitik Bakir Sanayi ve Ticaret A.S. together with its subsidiaries produces and trades in electrolytic copper wires copper pipes coppering and copper alloys in Turkey. It offers electrolytic copper cathode products; oxygen free and ETP wire rods; DHP and ETP copper billets; bare tin plated and nickel plated copper single wires; bare and tin plated and nickel plated multi wires as well as bare and tin plated multi wires on braider bobbins; and bare tin plated and nickel plated bunched conductors. The company also provides flat wires and profiles and PV ribbon wires; copper and copper alloy contact wires and stranded copper and copper alloy conductors; copper tubes and busbars; and copper nuggets. In addition it offers electrolytic copper conductors; packaging materials and machinery; and hermetic compressor parts scroll compressor parts nodular and gray iron parts brake and vented brake discs hub drums flywheels exhaust manifolds rings brake cylinders and brackets and brake security parts. Further the company is involved in marketing and distribution and real estate rental activities. Its products are used in various industries including electro technique electronic motor communication power generation and distribution solar and renewable energy home appliances measurement instruments defense automotive chemical construction heating air-conditioning and sanitary plumbing. The company also exports its products to approximately 80 countries worldwide. The company was incorporated in 1972 and is headquartered in Darica Turkey.

Name: Batic Investments and Logistics Company
Description: Batic Investments and Logistics Company engages in the real estate transportation and security business in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. The company is involved in the general construction of residential and non-residential building; management and leasing of residential and non-residential owned or leased properties; purchase and sale of lands and real estate properties; subdivision and map selling; maintenance and operation of buildings; and property management and marketing activities. It also engages in the transportation of goods and missions on the land roads; car and trailer rental activities; rental of cold stores; operation of fuel stations and maintenance workshops; purchase sale and maintenance of equipment and machinery related to road transport; and rental of parking spaces. In addition the company provides security guards and shift services to banks and companies; feeding and maintenance services for bank’s ATMs; money counting and sorting services and postal correspondence; transportation and insurance services for the transfer of money and valuables; home medical and physiotherapy services; supplies medical equipment; and logistic services. Further it installs maintains and wholesale of electronic security devices fire prevention protection equipment and electronic alarm systems remotely or physically. The company was formerly known as Saudi Transport and Investment Company and changed its name to Batic Investments and Logistics Company in April 2017. Batic Investments and Logistics Company was incorporated in 1984 and is headquartered in Riyadh the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

Name: Jordan Ahli Bank
Description: Jordan Ahli Bank provides various banking and financial services in Jordan and internationally. It offers current salary transfer savings and deposit accounts; personal profession real estate and car loans; debit credit and pre-paid cards; bancassurance covering health fire car transportation risk travel and engineering insurance products as well as life and personal accidents retirement and academic insurance programs. The company also provides overdraft facilities syndicated and commercial loans commercial discounted bills letters of guarantee and credit and documentary bills. In addition it offers small and medium enterprises (SME) current and savings accounts and fixed deposits; SME credit cards; financing solution programs; green business packages; trade financial solutions; Anty women in business program which includes current accounts for businesses owned or managed by women; and support and advisory services. The company was formerly known as Jordan National Bank. Jordan Ahli Bank was incorporated in 1955 and is headquartered in Amman Jordan.

Name: Independent Petroleum Group K.S.C.P.
Description: Independent Petroleum Group K.S.C.P. together with its subsidiaries engages in the trading and marketing of crude oil and petroleum products. The company is involved in logistics activities; and owns and operates petroleum products tankers. It operates in Africa the Middle East Europe Asia and the Far East. Independent Petroleum Group K.S.C.P. was incorporated in 1976 and is based in Kuwait City Kuwait.

Name: FibraHotel
Description: FibraHotel is a Mexican trust created primarily to acquire develop and operate hotels in Mexico. Our objective is to provide attractive returns to our CBFI holders through distributions and the appreciation of our real estate assets. Also we will aim to have a high-quality hotel portfolio through the affiliation to different hotel brands and renowned operators as well as geographic and segment diversification.

Name: Chilanga Cement PLC
Description: Chilanga Cement PLC engages in the manufacture and sale of cement products in Zambia. The company offers Mphamvu 325N a general-purpose bagged cement for building and construction projects; SupaSet 425R a rapid-setting cement for block making and concrete projects; Powerplus 425N an ordinary Portland cement for heavy construction projects including bridges railways stadiums and airports; Powerbuild 425N for mass concrete applications in the foundations of large buildings; Supablock 42.5N used in bricks and blockmaking; and Pawalime quicklime acts as a flux for removing impurities. It also exports its products to Zimbabwe Malawi and Burundi. The company was formerly known as Lafarge Zambia Plc and changed its name to Chilanga Cement PLC. The company was founded in 1949 and is headquartered in Lusaka Zambia. Chilanga Cement PLC is a subsidiary of Huaxin (Hainan) Investment Co. Ltd.

Name: Bank of Africa - Benin SA
Description: Bank of Africa - Benin SA provides various banking products and services for individuals and businesses in Benin. It offers checking accounts; debit and credit cards; savings accounts and investment product including time deposit. The company also provides loans such as real estate school consumer equipment vehicle travel group personal vitamin and advance loans as well as over drafting services. In addition it offers insurance products; and money transfer services as well as provides mobile banking services. The company was founded in 1990 and is based in Cotonou Benin. Bank of Africa - Benin SA is a subsidiary of BOA West Africa.

Name: Oceana Group Limited
Description: Oceana Group Limited operates as a fishing and food processing company in South Africa Namibia rest of Africa North America Europe the Far East and internationally. It engages in catching processing and procuring various marine species including pilchard anchovy redeye herring Gulf menhaden lobster squid horse mackerel and hake as well as processing of meat chicken and vegetable products. The company also markets and sells canned fish fishmeal and fish oil. Oceana Group Limited was incorporated in 1918 and is headquartered in Cape Town South Africa.

Name: Grupo Rotoplas S.A.B. de C.V.
Description: Grupo Rotoplas S.A.B. de C.V. together with its subsidiaries manufactures purchases sells and installs plastic containers and accessories for water storage conduction and improvement solutions in Mexico Argentina the United States and internationally. Further it provides sewage treatment purification desalination processed water and integrated water solutions. Additionally the company engages in real estate services and residual water treatment activities; digital research and development services; and operates electronic trade platform as well as grants financial support. The company was founded in 1978 and is headquartered in Mexico City Mexico.

Name: Kustur Kusadasi Turizm Endüstrisi A.S.
Description: Kustur Kusadasi Turizm Endüstrisi A.S. operates holiday clubs in Turkey. Its clubs include restaurants and bars; activities including animation sports mini clubs pools and beaches; and spa and wellness facilities. Name: SEDCO Capital REIT Fund
Description: SEDCO Capital REIT is a Shariah-compliant real estate investment traded fund externally managed by SEDCO Capital. it invests in single-tenant and multiple-tenant properties across Saudi Arabia. SEDCO Capital REIT was formed on 2018 and is based in Saudi Arabia.

Name: Camil Alimentos S.A.
Description: Camil Alimentos S.A. together with its subsidiaries engages in processing production packaging and marketing of food products. The company offers sugar sweets canned sardines and tuna fish pasta coffee biscuits health products and other products as well as grains such as rice and beans. It provides its products under various brands such as Camil Coqueiro União and Santa Amália in Brazil; Saman and La Abundancia in Uruguay; Tucapel in Chile; Costeño in Peru; and Rico Arroz in Ecuador. The company was founded in 1963 and is headquartered in São Paulo Brazil. Camil Alimentos S.A. operates as a subsidiary of Camil Investimentos S.A.

Name: SBN Holdings Limited
Description: SBN Holdings Limited together with its subsidiaries provides banking and financial services to individual customers and small to medium-sized enterprises in Namibia. It operates through Personal and Private Banking; Business & Commercial Banking; and Corporate & Investment Banking segments. It offers personal transactional call current fixed and notice deposits and savings accounts. The company also provides home revolving student and medium-term loans; mortgage loans; trade property vehicle asset and contract finance; instalment sale and finance leases; overdraft; and letters of credit invoice discounting bank guarantees and business revolving credit plans. In addition it offers credit and debit cards; asset management and unit trust services; insurance broking services; safe custodianship services; property investment and construction; and cellphone and internet banking services. The company was founded in 1915 and is headquartered in Windhoek Namibia. SBN Holdings Limited is a subsidiary of Standard Bank Group Limited.

Name: Qatar Islamic Insurance Group Q.P.S.C.
Description: Qatar Islamic Insurance Group Q.P.S.C. provides a range of insurance products and services in Qatar. It operates through three segments: Underwriting Investments and Real Estate. The company offers personal insurance products comprising motor medical travel maid home life and yacht and boat insurance. It also provides corporate insurance products such as energy engineering general accident corporate liability fire and property marine cargo marine hull motor fleet group medical and group life insurance; and takaful insurance products. In addition the company invests in capital and other resources in related activities. It serves private and public sectors including government offices banking institutions hotels and other organizations as well as infrastructure projects. Qatar Islamic Insurance Group Q.P.S.C. was formerly known as Qatar Islamic Insurance Company Q.P.S.C. The company was incorporated in 1993 and is based in Doha Qatar.

Name: Oragroup SA
Description: Oragroup SA provides various banking products and services for individuals professionals and companies and institutions in West and Central Africa. It offers current accounts savings accounts term deposits accounts and packages credits and facilities savings and investment products bank cards checkbooks remote banking services bancassurance money transfer and cash management services as well as lines of credit and digital banking services. The company also offers overdraft equipment and real estate credit services. The company was founded in 1988 and is headquartered in Lome Togo.

Name: Jantsa Jant Sanayi ve Ticaret A.S.
Description: Jantsa Jant Sanayi ve Ticaret A.S. manufactures and sells steel wheels for commercial industrial and agricultural machinery primarily in Turkey. In addition the company provides light commercial type and agricultural type rims heavy duty rims rim lock ring profile rim ring profile hydraulic press and variety mold production. It also supplies its products to OEM and aftermarket customers. It also exports its products to approximately 85 countries. The company was incorporated in 1977 and is headquartered in Aydin Turkey.

Name: Gulf Insurance Group
Description: Gulf Insurance Group provides insurance and reinsurance products and services for corporates SMEs and individual customers in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. It operates through Motor Property and Casualty Health and Protection segments. The company offers car travel home and motorcycle insurance products for individuals. It also provides group healthcare life business travel group personal accident business secure motor fleet marine liability property and engineering insurance products for businesses. The company was formerly known as AXA Cooperative Insurance Company and changed its name to Gulf Insurance Group in June 2022. Gulf Insurance Group was founded in 2008 and is headquartered in Riyadh the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. Gulf Insurance Group is a subsidiary of Gulf Insurance Group (Gulf) B.S.C.

Name: Gedik Yatirim Menkul Degerler A.S.

The company provides products for the stock certificate futures and options market international market investment funds treasury transactions public offering and fixed income securities. It also offers brokerage services to investors in the equity market repo/reverse repo market debt securities market international depository receipt market international debt securities market futures and options market and leveraged trading transaction; individual services such as portfolio management and investment consultancy services; and corporate services including corporate finance international corporate sales public offering brokerage and corporate treasury transaction services. Name: Namibia Breweries Limited
Description: Namibia Breweries Limited together with its subsidiaries engages in brewing and distribution of alcoholic beverages and manufacture of soft drinks in Namibia and South Africa. It offers alcoholic beers under the Windhoek Lager Windhoek Draught Windhoek Non-Alcoholic Tafel Lager Tafel Lite Tafel Radler Hansa Draught Camelthorn King Lager and Heineken brand names; non-alcoholic beer under Horizon brand name; ciders under the Strongbow Savanna Premium and Hunter’s brand names; sparkling and still bottled water under the Aqua Splash brand name; mixers under the McKane brand name; and nectars and juices with flavors including Mediterranean guava strawberry/banana tropical punch apple red grape orange peach/orange peach/pear mango pine and peach/apricot under the Fruitree brand name.
