Namibia Breweries Limited was incorporated in 1920 and is based in Windhoek Namibia. The company operates as a subsidiary of NBL Investment Holdings (Proprietary) Limited.

Name: Falabella Perú S.A.A.
Description: Falabella Perú S.A.A. engages in real estate activities in Peru. The company leases shopping centers. It also invests in fixed or variable income securities movable and immovable properties and other activities. In addition the company develops purchases and sells real estate properties; and provides shopping center management services for the distribution and sale of goods. The company was formerly known as Inversiones y Servicios Falabella Perú S.A. and changed its name to Falabella Perú S.A.A. in 2009. The company was founded in 1994 and is headquartered in Lima Peru. Falabella Perú S.A.A. is a subsidiary of Desarrollos Perú SpA.

Name: Doha Insurance Group Q.P.S.C.
Description: Doha Insurance Group Q.P.S.C. together with its subsidiaries engages in insurance and reinsurance businesses in Qatar the United Arab Emirates Lebanon Luxembourg and Jordan. It operates through five segments: Motor Marine and Aviation; Fire; General and Accident; Group Life and Health; and investments. The company offers personal insurance products such as car insurance travel insurance yacht insurance products and individual medical insurance products. It also offers corporate insurance products such as motor fleet aviation engineering fire health and marine insurance products. In addition the company provides insurance intermediation and management services; Islamic insurance and reinsurance; information technology solutions; real estate holding and leasing operations; and trades in computer network devices and computer software. The company was formerly known as Doha Insurance Company Q.S.C. and changed its name to Doha Insurance Group Q.P.S.C. in March 2017. Doha Insurance Group Q.P.S.C. was incorporated in 1999 and is headquartered in Doha Qatar.

Name: Kerur Holdings Ltd.
Description: Kerur Holdings Ltd. through its subsidiaries operates in the food sector in Israel. It produces and markets soft drinks and mineral water frozen potato and onion fries and plant products. The company was incorporated in 1929 and is based in Or Yehuda Israel. Kerur Holdings Ltd. is a subsidiary of Israeli Shipping and Supply Company Ltd.

Name: Ulusoy Elektrik Imalat Taahhüt ve Ticaret A.S.
Description: Ulusoy Elektrik Imalat Taahhüt ve Ticaret A.S. manufactures and sells electrical equipment for medium voltage power distribution networks and industrial plants in Turkey. It offers metal enclosed modular metal clad and gas insulated switchgears; and compact transformer substations medium voltage distribution transformers and switchgear components and medium voltage cable accessories as well as relays. The company was incorporated in 1985 and is headquartered in Ankara Turkey. Ulusoy Elektrik Imalat Taahhüt ve Ticaret A.S. (IBSE:ULUSE) operates as a subsidiary of Eaton Corporation plc.

Name: Sinad Holding Company
Description: Sinad Holding Company engages in the manufacture packaging wholesale and retail trade of food products in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia Egypt other Arab countries and internationally. The company operates in two segments Investment and Industrial. It manufactures dairy dairy products juices and drinks; manufactures Saudi thobes and uniforms; invests in stocks and securities; owns real estate and movable properties; provides loans guarantees and financing services; and owns and leases industrial property rights including patents trademarks industrial rights franchises and other moral rights. The company was formerly known as Aseer Trading Tourism and Manufacturing Co. and changed its name to Sinad Holding Company in June 2022. Sinad Holding Company was incorporated in 1975 and is based in Riyadh the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. Sinad Holding Company is a subsidiary of Dallah Albaraka Holding Company.

Name: Clientèle Limited
Description: Clientèle Limited through its subsidiaries engages in the provision of financial services in South Africa. It operates through Clientèle Life Insurance; 1Life Insurance; Emerald Life Insurance; Non-Life Insurance; and CBC Rewards Mobile and Direct Rewards segments. The company markets distributes and underwrites insurance and investment products as well as invests funds; operates a micro-insurance license and markets and distributes specialized funeral products; and offers personal and business lines legal insurance policies. It also provides rewards benefits to its clients from retailers and service providers; and airtime and data products. The company was incorporated in 2007 and is headquartered in Morningside South Africa. Clientèle Limited is a subsidiary of Friedshelf 1577 Proprietary Limited.

Name: Sociedad Minera Corona SA
Description: Sociedad Minera Corona SA engages in the exploration extraction production and sale of copper silver gold lead zinc and oxides concentrates. It holds interest in the Yauricocha mine located in the Yauyos province and the Carolina mine located in Hualgayoc province. The company was incorporated in 1993 and is based in Lima Peru. Sociedad Minera Corona SA operates as a subsidiary of Dia Bras Perú S.A.C.

Name: Bemobi Mobile Tech S.A.
Description: Bemobi Mobile Tech S.A. a technology company provides solutions and mobile platforms for digital payments customer engagement microfinance and digital services in Brazil and internationally. It provides Bemobi Pay which includes smart checkouts which offers white-label and customizable solution payment method orchestration and multiple payment methods; Smart POS that accepts payments; Payment Orchestration which optimizes payments and connects business to multiple providers increase approval rates and reduce fraud; and simplify payment management. The company also offers Grace an AI-first conversational payments platform; digital engagement solutions for telecom ISPs and telco MNOS; and Agenda Edu SuperApp a tool for communication engagement and school finances. In addition it provides microfinance and digital subscriptions solutions for telco MNOS; and Wave a digital native platform for telecommunications; and mobile scoring solutions for telcos and finances. The company serves telecom MNOs and ISPs utilities education health and finance industries. Bemobi Mobile Tech S.A. was incorporated in 2007 and is headquartered in Rio De Janeiro Brazil.

Name: Ege Profil Ticaret ve Sanayi Anonim Sirketi
Description: Ege Profil Ticaret ve Sanayi Anonim Sirketi produces and sells plastic pipes spare parts and various profiles and plastic goods in Turkey an internationally. The company offers windows under the Egepen Deceuninck brand; PVC windows doors and blinds systems under the Winsa brand; PVC pipes and window systems under the Pimapen brand; and recyclable products under the Maestro brand name. It also provides frontal systems opening systems grills sunshades and skylight systems under the IQ Aluminum brand; and glass balcony systems under the Camoda brand name. The company was incorporated in 1981 and is based in Izmir Turkey. Ege Profil Ticaret ve Sanayi Anonim Sirketi is a subsidiary of Deceuninck NV.

Name: 1000 Yatirimlar Holding Anonim Sirketi
Description: 1000 Yatirimlar Holding Anonim Sirketi an investment company focuses on transportation software and energy solutions. It engages in the micro mobility electric charging station renewable energy software toy and moped rental businesses. The company was incorporated in 2022 and is based in Istanbul Turkey.

Name: Chubb Arabia Cooperative Insurance Company
Description: Chubb Arabia Cooperative Insurance Company provides property and casualty insurance products in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia and internationally. The company’s property and casualty insurance products portfolio comprise property all risks fire and allied perils business interruption householders’ comprehensive terrorism and sabotage burglary and housebreaking general liability workmen’s compensation and employer’s liability motor plate glass money crime fidelity guarantee/employee dishonesty and travel insurance products. It also provides engineering insurance products consists of contractors all risk erection all risks machinery breakdown business interruption due to machinery breakdown and computer/electronic data processing as well as machinery plant and equipment all risks insurance products. In addition the company offers marine cargo project cargo and DSU inland transit and marine hull insurance products; group life and group personal accident insurance products; and financial insurance products such as bankers blanket bond financial institutions professional indemnity civil liability for financial institutions electronic and computer crime fraud protector financial services industry insurance policy and directors and officers liability insurance as well as reinsurance services. Further it offers property professional liability cyber risk excess casualty workers’ compensation general liability automobile liability commercial marine surety environmental construction medical risk inland marine and A&H coverages as well as claims and risk management products. It serves multinational corporations mid-size companies and small businesses affluent groups high net worth individuals companies and affinity groups; and insurers managing exposures with reinsurance coverage. The company was founded in 2008 and is based in Al Khobar the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

Name: Bank Of Africa Senegal
Description: Bank Of Africa Senegal provides various banking products and services in Senegal. The company offers current savings investment and currency accounts; term deposits; education marketplace home car consumer equipment and overdraft loans; cards; and money transfer insurance and digital banking services. The company was founded in 2001 and is headquartered in Dakar Senegal. Bank Of Africa Senegal is a subsidiary of BOA West Africa.

Name: British American Tobacco Kenya plc
Description: British American Tobacco Kenya plc engages in the manufacture and sale of tobacco and tobacco free oral nicotine pouches in Kenya and internationally. It is involved in farming and processing manufacturing selling of cigarettes and other tobacco and nicotine products. The company was formerly known as BAT Kenya Limited and changed its name to British American Tobacco Kenya plc in 1998. The company was founded in 1907 and is headquartered in Nairobi Kenya. British American Tobacco Kenya plc operates as a subsidiary of British American Tobacco p.l.c.

Name: Bien Yapi Urunleri Sanayi Turizm ve Ticaret A.S.
Description: Bien Yapi Urunleri Sanayi Turizm ve Ticaret A.S. manufactures and sells ceramics floor tiles and sanitary ware in Turkey. The company exports its products. Bien Yapi Urunleri Sanayi Turizm Ve Ticaret Anonim Sirketi was incorporated in 1997 and is based in Ankara Turkey.

Name: Arkan Al-Kuwait Real Estate Company K.S.C.P.
Description: Arkan Al-Kuwait Real Estate Company K.S.C.P. together with its subsidiary provides real estate services primarily in Kuwait. It operates through three segments: Real Estate Investments and Services. The company offers real estate investment and development management of real estate funds as well as real estate evaluation services. It also owns manages operates invests rents and leases hotels clubs health clubs motels entertainment houses rest houses parks fairs restaurants cafeterias compounds tourist facilities health resorts sports and entertainment projects as well as shops. In addition the company involved in development purchase sale and management of properties and land; execution and maintenance of civil mechanical and electrical contracting activities; and owns commercial markets and residential compounds as well as general trading and contracting and air conditioning and refrigeration business. Further it offers development of infrastructure projects for residential commercial and industrial areas under the BOT system; and imports sells and installs various safety and firefighting equipment; and organizes real estate exhibitions. Arkan Al-Kuwait Real Estate Company K.S.C.P. was incorporated in 2003 and is headquartered in Kuwait City Kuwait.

Name: Atreyu Capital Markets Ltd
Description: Atreyu Capital Markets Ltd through its subsidiaries provides investment management services in Israel. It is involved in managing investment portfolios provident funds education funds and mutual funds. The company was formerly known as Leader Capital Markets Ltd. and changed its name to Atreyu Capital Markets Ltd in January 2017. Atreyu Capital Markets Ltd was incorporated in 2006 and is based in Tel Aviv Israel.

Name: Hitit Bilgisayar Hizmetleri A.S.
Description: Hitit Bilgisayar Hizmetleri A.S. provides airline and travel IT and software solutions under the Crane brand in Turkey and internationally. The company offers passenger service system (PSS) a suite of solutions comprising reservation and passenger services internet booking engine mobile application allotment manager departure control system weight and balance baggage reconciliation itinerary and loyalty layer; operations planning solutions consisting of crew management operations control and schedule planning; and accounting solutions such as revenue accounting cost accounting and business performance index. In addition the company offers consultancy business development technical infrastructure and hosting training and after-sales support and maintenance services. It serves airlines travel companies and airports. The company was incorporated in 1994 and is headquartered in Istanbul Turkey.

Name: Al-Arabiya Real Estate Company K.S.C.P.
Description: Al-Arabiya Real Estate Company K.S.C.P. engages in the real estate investment and development activities in Kuwait the United Arab Emirates and Egypt. The company operates through Real Estate Hotels and Investment segments. It is involved in commercial real estate activities such as purchase and sale of lands and properties. The company also involved in the establishment acquisition and management of hotels; and tourism activities. In addition it invests in shares and share capital of the companies. Al-Arabiya Real Estate Company K.S.C.P. was founded in 1976 and is headquartered in Kuwait City Kuwait.

Name: Société Libanaise des Ciments Blancs S.A.L.
Description: Société Libanaise des Ciments Blancs S.A.L. produces sells and exports white cement and related products. The company was incorporated in 1961 and is headquartered in Chekka Lebanon. Société Libanaise des Ciments Blancs S.A.L. is a subsidiary of Holcim (Liban) S.A.L.

Name: Afaq For Energy Co. P.L.C
Description: Afaq For Energy Co. P.L.C engages in the oil and fuel import and export and food trading businesses. It also provides fuel storage and marketing services. The company was formerly known as Al Ameer for Development and Multiprojects and changed its name to Afaq For Energy Co. P.L.C in March 2009. Afaq For Energy Co. P.L.C was incorporated in 2008 and is based in Amman Jordan.

Name: Eshraq Investments PJSC
Description: Eshraq Investments PJSC is a private equity firm. The firm specializes in growth capital. The firm seeks to invest in real estate. The firm seeks to invest in GCC. The firm takes minority stakes. Eshraq Investments PJSC was incorporated in 2006 and is headquartered in Abu Dhabi the United Arab Emirates.

Name: Transnational Corporation of Nigeria Plc
Description: Transnational Corporation of Nigeria Plc together with the subsidiaries engages in the power oil and gas and hospitality businesses in Nigeria. It operates through five operating segments: Hospitality Agro-allied Power Oil & Gas and Corporate Centre. The company owns and operates Transcorp Hilton Abuja and Transcorp Centre as well as Aura a digital hospitality platform and provides hospitality services. It is also involved in the exploration refining and marketing of petroleum products and oil and gas; general maritime marketing; growing of agricultural products; processing of food and cash crops activities; and generation and sale of electric power. In addition the company provides communication services. Transnational Corporation of Nigeria Plc was incorporated in 2004 and is based in Lagos Nigeria.

Name: Qatar General Insurance & Reinsurance Company Q.P.S.C.
Description: Qatar General Insurance & Reinsurance Company Q.P.S.C. together with its subsidiaries provides general insurance and reinsurance products in Qatar. The company offers individual insurance products including travel medical housemaid private motor personal accident jewelry home and marine hull products; and corporate insurance products such as property marine and aviation engineering energy corporate motors liability and miscellaneous group medical and specialty lines insurance products. It is also involved in the investment development and management of real estate properties; hospitality exhibition and events management; contracting and construction; manufacturing of rebar and insulation materials; automobiles repair; and trading of water bottling and beverages. The company was founded in 1978 and is headquartered in Doha Qatar.

Name: Dof Robotik Sanayi Anonim Sirketi
Description: Dof Robotik Sanayi Anonim Sirketi designs and manufactures simulation platforms for the amusement industry internationally. The company offers high-tech attractions that encompass virtual reality (VR) augmented reality (AR) motion simulation and interactive gaming. It also offers a flying theater digital park immersive tunnel XD theater and nautilus. The company was founded in 2006 and is based in Istanbul Turkey.

Name: Koton Magazacilik Tekstil Sanayi ve Ticaret A.S.
Description: Koton Magazacilik Tekstil Sanayi ve Ticaret A.S. engages in the design manufacture and sale of textile products in Turkey and internationally. It offers dresses sweatshirts t-shirts pants skirts shirts blouses crops knitwear cardigans tank tops shorts vests jackets leggings jeans outerwear joggers trousers sweatshirts swimsuits sweatbottoms sweaters underwear boxers swim trunks jumpsuits salopet and beanie products bikini sets coats and cargo and parachute products; partywear sportswear and lingerie and loungewear products; and accessories including bags perfumes hats shawls jewelry and straw products necklaces earrings bracelets rings belts pet clothes purses socks and pantyhose products and hair accessories for women men kids and infants. Koton Magazacilik Tekstil Sanayi ve Ticaret A.S. is a subsidiary of Nemo Apparel B.V.

Name: Palms Sports PJSC
Description: Palms Sports PJSC provides sports training programs for Jiu-Jitsu and other sports in the United Arab Emirates. The company offers lifecycle training and sports program management; comprehensive athletic program; strategic sports and training plans development; program evaluation; program managers and instructors coaching; sports awareness; community involvement promotion; revenue stream creation; and marketing PR and media services as well as sports management and marketing; sport consultancy; and event management services. It also manages sports and health clubs; psychological treatment centers; and provides education services. In addition the company provides recruitment distribution of sporting goods institution and management security guards and cleaning services. The company was founded in 2011 and is based in Abu Dhabi the United Arab Emirates. Palms Sports PJSC is a subsidiary of International Holding Company PJSC (IHC).

Name: Gad-Dairies (Marketing 1992) Ltd.
Description: Gad-Dairies (Marketing 1992) Ltd. engages in the production of packaged food specializing in dairy products. The company’s products include Balkan and local cheeses Italian cheeses special cheeses New York cream cheeses yogurts pre-made pasta sauces desserts and delicacies. The company was founded in 1980 and is based in Bat Yam Israel.

Description: Ensari Sinai Yatirimlar Anonim Sirketi together with its subsidiaries manufactures and sells leather products in Turkey. The company offers merino merinillo lacoon toscana rassado tigrado French and domestic UK products. It also produces sells imports and exports raw materials products machinery and facilities related to the flour industry; and paper and cardboard PVC cellophane polyethylene polypropylene plastic materials aluminum metal and tinplate etc. as well as offers printing gluing and laminating services. The company exports its products to Asia Europe South Korea Italy India Poland Germany Hong Kong Austria Denmark Greece England Belgium Morocco the United States Canada Spain the United Arab Emirates Esthonia Portugal Russia Pakistan Republic of China and Lithuania. Ensari Sinai Yatirimlar Anonim Sirketi was incorporated in 1993 and is headquartered in Istanbul Turkey.

Name: Najran Cement Company
Description: Najran Cement Company engages in manufacture and sale of cement products in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. The company offers ordinary Portland Portland Pozzolanic cement plastering cement and Portland sulphate resistant cement products. It also engages in the transportation of goods. Najran Cement Company was founded in 2005 and is based in Najran the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

Name: TopGum Industries Ltd.
Description: TopGum Industries Ltd. develops manufactures and markets dietary and nutraceutical gummies. The company offers a range of gummiceutical supplements that include vitamins minerals natural extracts pre and probiotics and food products; and nutraceutical products. It also imports and markets other sweets. The company was incorporated in 2004 and is based in Sderot Israel.

Name: Desktop S.A.
Description: Desktop S.A. provides fixed telephony broadband internet and pay television services in Brazil. The company was founded in 1997 and is headquartered in Sumaré Brazil.

Name: Anadolu Isuzu Otomotiv Sanayi ve Ticaret A.S.
Description: Anadolu Isuzu Otomotiv Sanayi ve Ticaret A.S. manufactures assembles imports and sells motor vehicles and spare parts in Turkey. The company offers trucks van and midbus and bus vehicles. It also offers after sales services. The company also exports its products. Anadolu Isuzu Otomotiv Sanayi ve Ticaret A.S. was founded in 1965 and is headquartered in Istanbul Turkey.

Name: Société des Caoutchoucs de Grand-Béréby Société Anonyme
Description: Société des Caoutchoucs de Grand-Béréby Société Anonyme engages in the plantation and cultivation of rubber trees in Grand-Béréby Ivory Coast. It is also involved in the transformation of latex into industrial rubber; planting and cultivation of oil palm; and production of palm oil and palm kernel oil. The company was founded in 1969 and is headquartered in San Pedro Ivory Coast. Société des Caoutchoucs de Grand-Béréby Société Anonyme is a subsidiary of Bereby-Finances (Befin) SA.

Name: Deva Holding A.S.
Description: Deva Holding A.S. manufactures markets and sells pharmaceutical products in Turkey. The company offers antineoplastic and immunomodulating agents; dermatological products; sysyemic hormanal preparations; anti-infective and antiparasitic products for systemic use; food supplements; and electrolyte solutions. It also exports its products to approximately 60 countries. The company was incorporated in 1958 and is based in Istanbul Turkey. Deva Holding A.S. is a subsidiary of Eastpharma S.à R.L.

Name: Oriental Weavers Carpets Company (S.A.E)
Description: Oriental Weavers Carpets Company (S.A.E) manufactures and sells carpets jet-printed rugs and related raw materials worldwide. It offers machine woven and non-woven carpets; door and kitchen rugs rubber-backed bathroom mats multilevel textured mats for outdoor applications car mats children’s rugs and mats scatter rugs and club rugs; and three-dimensional advertising floor panels and runners and artificial turf for indoor and outdoor applications. The company provides wall-to-wall carpets; indoor/outdoor rugs; patterned printed engraved and embossed mats; underlay rolls and rug pads; car mats; and bathroom mats as well as handmade rugs. It serves retailers home fashion brands luxury hotels resorts and other lifestyle centers. The company was founded in 1979 and is headquartered in 10th of Ramadan City Egypt.

Name: Dhofar International Development & Investment SAOG
Description: Dhofar International Development and Investment Holding Company S.A.O.G is a publicly owned investment manager. The firm also provides portfolio and fund management services to its clients. It also invests in real estate markets. Dhofar International Development and Investment Holding Company S.A.O.G was founded on December 9 1987 and is based in Salalah Oman.

Name: Transjamaican Highway Limited
Description: Transjamaican Highway Limited engages in the development operation and maintenance of TransJam Highways tolled road network in Jamaica. The company was incorporated in 2001 and is headquartered in Kingston Jamaica.

Name: CIEL Limited
Description: CIEL Limited an investment holding company operates in multiple business sectors in Mauritius Madagascar Asia South Africa and internationally. It operates in seven segments: Textile Agro Property Hotels and Resorts Financial Healthcare and CIEL. The Textile segment is involved in the manufacture and sale of knitwear woven and fine knit products. Its Agro segment produces and sells sugar. The Property segment develops land and properties. Its Hotels and Resorts segment engages in the ownership and management of a portfolio of hotels. This segment also owns and manages properties in Mauritius a private island a golf course and tour operators. The Financial Services segment provides banking portfolio management and fiduciary products. Its Healthcare segment operates healthcare facilities comprising hospitals primary and secondary care clinics laboratories c-lab collection centers. The company was formerly known as Deep River Investment Limited and changed its name to CIEL Limited in January 2014. CIEL Limited was founded in 1912 and is headquartered in Ebène Mauritius.

Name: SofWave Medical Ltd.
Description: SofWave Medical Ltd. engages in the development production marketing support and distribution of ultrasound technology for non-invasive skin rejuvenation and firming treatment in Israel and internationally. It offers aesthetic medical devices to plastic surgeons dermatologists and other doctors who perform aesthetic treatments on patient under the Softwave brand name. Isik Plastik Sanayi ve Dis Ticaret Pazarlama Anonim Sirketi was founded in 1988 and is based in Istanbul Turkey.

Description: Alamar Foods Company together with its subsidiaries establishes operates and manages quick service restaurants in the Middle East North Africa and Pakistan. Alamar Foods Company is a subsidiary of Abdul Aziz Ibrahim Al Jammaz and Brothers Company.

Name: The United Bank
Description: The United Bank provides commercial and Islamic banking services in Egypt. The company offers current savings and investment accounts; time and fixed time deposit; EGP and USD certificates; debit prepaid and credit cards. It also provides loans including educational car mortgage personal and Intalaka microfinance as well as syndication loans. In addition the company offers microfinance and pharmacist program finance; trade services and finance; cash management and treasury services; treasury bills and bonds; project finance; export financing program; and financing and lending programs. Further it offers safe deposit boxes; remittances services; electronic payment services; internet online and mobile banking services; small and medium enterprises products; and digital wallet e-payroll foreign currency exchange ATM and international payments services. The United Bank was formerly known as United Bank of Egypt and changed its name to The United Bank in June 2006. The company was founded in 2006 and is based in Cairo Egypt.

Name: Dogu Aras Enerji Yatirimlari AS
Description: Dogu Aras Enerji Yatirimlari AS through its subsidiaries engages in the retail sale and distribution of electricity in Turkey. The company was founded in 2013 and is based in Erzurum Turkey.

Name: Unilever Côte d'Ivoire S.A.
Description: Unilever Côte d'Ivoire S.A. manufactures and sells personal care products. It operates through Personal Care Foods Refreshment and Home Care segments. The Personal Care segment offers skin care and hair care products deodorants and oral care products. The Foods segment sells soups bouillons sauces snacks mayonnaise salad dressings margarines and spreads. The Refreshment segment sells ice creams tea-based beverages weight-management products and nutritionally enhanced staples. The Home Care segment sells home care products such as powders liquids and capsules soap bars and various cleaning products. The company is based in Abidjan Ivory Coast. Unilever Côte d'Ivoire S.A. operates as a subsidiary of Unilever Overseas Holdings Limited.

Description: RFG Holdings Limited manufactures and markets convenience meal solutions in South Africa the Kingdom of Eswatini and internationally. It offers canned fruit and jam fruit purees and fruit concentrates canned vegetables canned meat bottled salads and pickles fresh pasta and sauces baked and unbaked pies pasties sausage rolls and pie-slices tomato products fruit juice dry packaged foods and infant meals ready meals dairy and bakery products. Description: Red Sea International Company offers modular building solutions in Saudi Arabia the United Arab Emirates and internationally. The company develops builds sells and leases residential and commercial buildings. It offers various types of industrial modular buildings for temporary or semi-permanent structures workforce accommodation units offices kitchen and dining units recreation facilities laundry areas labor quarters drilling and rig camps dormitories guardhouses hospitals and clinics hotels relief housing facilities schools and religious facilities. The company also provides a range of housing solutions and services to the private and public sectors in the form of integrated communities or standalone housing neighborhoods as well as offers its housing units to communities of single homes apartment buildings or a combination of both. Further it provides building materials to industrial and residential sectors. In addition the company is involved in the general contracting maintenance and construction of utilities; civil works; provision of food services; trade and supply of food products; and rental of properties. It also offers non-concrete residential and commercial buildings and engages in the electrical works telecommunications and other related services as well as provides paints and related services. The company serves oil and gas infrastructure government building and construction mining defense offshore and manufacturing sectors. Red Sea International Company was founded in 1967 and is headquartered in Riyadh the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. Red Sea International Company is a subsidiary of Al Dabbagh Group Holding Company Limited.

Name: Companhia Brasileira De Distribuicao
Description: Companhia Brasileira De Distribuicao operates supermarkets specialized stores and department stores in Brazil. The company sells food products including non-perishables beverages fruits vegetables meat bread cold cuts and dairy products; and non-food products such as cleaning supplies disposable products personal care products and pet supplies under its private label and third-party brands. It is also involved in providing ready-to-eat meals; rental of commercial spaces; and e-commerce sales. The company operates its supermarkets under Pão de Açúcar Mercado Extra and Compre Bem banners; proximity and specialized stores through Mini Extra Minuto Pão de Açúcar Pão de Açúcar Adega and Aliados Minimercado banners; and gas stations through the Pão de Açúcar Mercado Extra and Compre Bem banners as well as sells its products through its websites. The company was founded in 1948 and is headquartered in São Paulo Brazil.

Name: Vestel Beyaz Esya Sanayi ve Ticaret A.S.
Description: Vestel Beyaz Esya Sanayi ve Ticaret A.S. engages in the production and sale of white goods in Turkey. The company produces refrigerators freezers washing machines dryers cooking appliances dishwashers air-conditioners and water heaters. It also exports its products. Vestel Beyaz Esya Sanayi ve Ticaret A.S. was incorporated in 1997 and is headquartered in Istanbul Turkey. Vestel Beyaz Esya Sanayi ve Ticaret A.S. is a subsidiary of Vestel Elektronik Sanayi ve Ticaret A.S.

Name: Michpal Technologies Ltd
Description: Michpal Technologies Ltd designs and develops payroll software that offers attendance system and pension operations. It was formerly known as Michpal Micro Computers (1983) Ltd. The company was incorporated in 1983 and is based in Tel Aviv Israel. Michpal Technologies Ltd is a subsidiary of Formula Systems (1985) Ltd.

Name: Cox Energy S.A.B. de C.V.
Description: Cox Energy S.A.B. de C.V. engages in the management development and operation of portfolio of renewable energy projects in Europe and Latin America. It develops and operates photovoltaic solar assets. The company operates a portfolio of projects with a capacity of 1808 MWh located in Mexico Colombia Latin America Chile Central America and the Caribbean. It is also involved in the provision of project development financing asset management energy supply and operation and maintenance services. The company was founded in 2014 and is based in Mexico City Mexico. Cox Energy S.A.B. de C.V. is a subsidiary of Cox ABG Group S.A.
Industry: Independent Power and Renewable Electricity Producers

Name: Galata Wind Enerji A.S.
Description: Galata Wind Enerji A.Ş. together with its subsidiaries engages in generation and sale of electricity from renewable energy in Turkey. The company operates three wind power plants and three solar power plants with a total capacity of approximately 297.2 MW. It also installs systems for the generation of energy from solar radiation; constructs commissions and leases facilities for the generation of electrical energy; and develops projects in Europe. The company was formerly known as GY Enerji Danışmanlık Poje Mühendislik Üretim Ticaret ve Sanayi Limited Şirketi and changed its name to Galata Wind Enerji A.S. in January 2012. The company was incorporated in 2006 and is headquartered in Istanbul Turkey. Galata Wind Enerji A.Ş. is a subsidiary of Dogan Sirketler Grubu Holding A.S.
Industry: Independent Power and Renewable Electricity Producers

Name: Sonda S.A.
Description: Sonda S.A. together with its subsidiaries provides information technology (IT) solutions in the United States Chile Brazil Mexico Argentina Colombia Costa Rica Ecuador Panama Peru Guatemala and Uruguay. The company offers consulting services that support digitization; APP modernization services; big data & analytics which combined with artificial intelligence solutions enhance decision-making in clients' organizations; digital automation solutions such as RPA Hyperautomation and RaaS; digital quality; turnkey development services; and digital management services. It also provides infrastructure solutions to the outsourcing of all the technological platforms of the client's business; support maintenance and administration services; cloud & data center services including hosting monitoring managing exploiting operating and maintaining basic services servers connectivity data and software both in the public cloud; cybersecurity solutions such as cybersecurity asset management detection of threats and vulnerabilities advanced cybersecurity services as well as consulting and testing services; workplace and help desk services; and technical assistance to users such as notebooks PCs printers and operating systems. In addition the company engages in the sale of computing infrastructure including servers workstations tablets PCs printers storage and backup equipment communications equipment databases operating systems and others. Further it provides implementation maintenance and guarantee management of the assets. The company was incorporated in 1974 and is headquartered in Santiago Chile.

Name: Kuwait Insurance Company S.A.K.P.
Description: Kuwait Insurance Company S.A.K.P. provides various insurance products and services in Kuwait. It operates through Marine and Aviation Fire General Accident Motors and Life Insurance segments. The Marine and Aviation segment provides insurance against risks related to goods transportation and marine and aviation vessels. The Fire segment offers insurance against fire for various types of buildings and stores; industrial risks; and oil and gas industry. The General Accident segment offers insurance against risks of contractors machinery and computer damages and cessation of work; and cash bonds fidelity professional risks work accidents and civil responsibility. The Motors segment provides insurance against motor vehicles. The Life Insurance segment provides life insurance cover for individuals and groups as well as medical insurance products. In addition the company provides takaful insurance. Further it offers travel home boat and yacht and jet ski insurance. The company was founded in 1960 and is headquartered in Kuwait City Kuwait.

Name: Bait Bakfar Ltd
Description: Bait Bakfar Ltd manages and operates sheltered housing complexes in Israel. It offers health welfare and leisure services for the elderly population. The company was founded in 1988 is based in Kfar Saba Israel.

Name: Arabian Company for Agricultural and Industrial Investment
Description: Arabian Company for Agricultural and Industrial Investment engages in manufacturing and distributing fresh and processed poultry and poultry related products under the Entaj brand. The company offers poultry table eggs live birds red meat and cold store products. It is also involved in the egg and broiler chicken production; support activities for animal production; production of chilled and frozen meat; preservation and preparation of meat and meat products in various ways such as drying and canning; production of egg products and eggshells; preparation and processing of egg products; and wholesale of dairy egg frozen meat and poultry products. The company was founded in 2004 and is based in Riyadh Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. Arabian Company for Agricultural and Industrial Investment operates as a subsidiary of Arabian Agricultural Services Co. Ltd.

Name: United Carton Industries Company
Description: United Carton Industries Company provides various paper-based packaging solutions in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia and internationally. The company’s corrugated carton products include regular slotted containers half slotted containers die cut containers wrap around cases high graphic flexographic printing stitched boxes and digitally printed corrugated stands and boxes; folding carton products comprise crush lock bottom cases flat supply products and round cheese boxes; pulp products; and containerboard products comprising test liner and fluting. Its products are used in various industries including food beverages pharmaceuticals hardware shipping and storage and retail packaging. The company was incorporated in 1988 and is headquartered in Jeddah the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

Name: United Projects Company For Aviation Services K.S.C.P.
Description: United Projects Company For Aviation Services K.S.C.P. operates as a commercial real estate development and facilities management company in Kuwait. It operates in two segments Investments and Service Operations. The company provides airplane ground and cleaning services. It offers real estate management and project management and consultancy services; and real estate development services such as property management sales and leasing site development and renovation and space design and planning. In addition the company provides property and facilities management services including parking lot management automated facilities platform security and cleaning check-in counters management and engineering and custodial services; facility and equipment maintenance service comprising air conditioning plumbing electric and conveyor belt services; utilities and communications infrastructure; and exterior landscaping services. The company was founded in 2000 and is based in Kuwait City Kuwait. United Projects Company For Aviation Services K.S.C.P. is a subsidiary of Agility Public Warehousing Company K.S.C.P.

Name: Advanced Technology Company K.S.C.P.
Description: Advanced Technology Company K.S.C.P. provides healthcare and environmental solutions in Kuwait. It offers diagnostic imaging and radiotherapy products; medical technologies and dialysis and health facility infrastructure; laboratory and environmental solutions; automated pharmacy systems and modular furniture for inpatient outpatient and emergency pharmacies; and OR integrated solutions consumable supplies and disposable solutions. The company also provides disinfection and sterilization equipment; patient care and rehabilitation and medical furniture; and specialized equipment instruments materials and consumables for dental clinics and labs. In addition it offers pharmaceuticals aesthetic products medical devices hospital consumables and disinfectants; animal health veterinary agriculture crop protection and irrigation products; and wellness and healthcare apparel products. Further the company provides information solutions such as hospital management systems electronic medical records clinical decision support systems IT strategic consulting process mapping clinical workflows education training and other related services; and structured cabling converged and wireless networking IP telephony video conferencing enterprise datacenters enterprise storage disaster recovery and business continuity security and cloud and virtualization environment building solutions. Additionally it offers kitchen and laundry equipment including cooking equipment dishwashers meal delivery and ventilation systems laundry equipment and insulated trays for hospitals hotels catering services and restaurants; and security surveillance and access control solutions as well as home care nursing and physiotherapy services. It serves government and private hospitals dental practitioners laboratories and physicians. The company was incorporated in 1981 and is based in Salmiya Kuwait.

Name: Arab Palestinian Investment Company
Description: Arab Palestinian Investment Company an investment holding company operates in the manufacture trade distribution and service sectors in Palestine Jordan the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia the United Arab Emirates Iraq and Turkey. The company manufactures cold cuts luncheon canned meat and frozen meats under the Siniora Al-Quds and Unium brands; manufactures aluminum and profiles; distributes fast-moving consumer goods; and distributes human and veterinary pharmaceuticals medical and laboratory equipment and surgical and disposable items to pharmacies private hospitals non-governmental organizations the ministry of health and retail outlets. It also provides after sales services; a range of advertising promotion communication public relations and event management services as well as storage and cooling services; engages in the financial leasing of equipment and machines; distributes passenger cars trucks and vans; and leases vehicles. Arab Palestinian Investment Company was incorporated in 1994 and is headquartered in Amman Jordan.

Name: Dipula Properties Limited
Description: Dipula Properties (formerly Dipula Income Fund) is a prominent diversified South Africa-focused REIT with a long-standing track record of sustainable value creation. As a black-managed property company celebrating two decades of operation this month and nearly 15 of those as a listed entity Dipula exemplifies a rare blend of resilience transformation and consistent delivery that continues to contribute to the real estate sector and South Africa’s broader economic landscape. The Dipula portfolio includes 161 retail office industrial and residential properties across South Africa predominantly in Gauteng. The portfolio is defensively positioned with retail centres in townships rural and urban convenience locations contribute 67% of portfolio income.

Name: ACICO Industries Company - K.S.C. (Public)
Description: ACICO Industries Company - K.S.C. (Public) provides building materials and construction and engineering services in Kuwait the United Arab Emirates the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia Qatar and internationally. It operates through Industrial Operations Real Estate Operations and Contracting Operations segments. The company manufactures autoclaved aerated concrete (AAC) products including AAC slabs construction blocks panels lintels reinforced slabs dry mortar and other AAC reinforced structural components; ground granulated blast furnace slag ordinary Portland resistant micro silica white cement and sulfate resistant cement; and ready-mix concrete products as well as interlock products. It also provides project management construction and management contracting and subcontracting infrastructure project engineering procurement and construction services as well as civil works electrical plumbing heating ventilation and air conditioning services. In addition the company owns develops and manages real estate properties in the Gulf region. Further it engages in the transportation and delivery of various products through a fleet of vehicles and trucks as well as offers integrated construction services with turnkey building solutions for citizens looking to build homes. ACICO Industries Company - K.S.C. (Public) was incorporated in 1990 and is headquartered in Kuwait City Kuwait.

Name: Valid Soluções S.A.
Description: Valid Soluções S.A. provides digital payment solutions in Brazil. It operates through three segments: Payments Method Identification and Mobile. The Payments Method segment offers integrated products and solutions such as chip and magnetic stripe cards gift cards check printing invoices and bank statements as well as solutions in radio frequency identification contactless cards and mobile payments. The Identification segment provides data capture storage and administration security forms recognition and fingerprints. Its solutions are used in the generation of computerized systems for managing databases collection of biometric data printing and customization of official identification documents solutions for smart cities stamps traceable and digital certification services. The Mobile segment offers services of issuing statements and technologies for use in cell phones and digital mobility such as NFC TSM and HCE solutions for mobile service providers. It also develops technologies for use in cell phones such as recharge and payment and production of cards intended for telecommunications. It serves state governments and government agencies large financial institutions telecommunications companies retailers agriculture cooperatives and independent professionals. The company was formerly known as Valid Soluções e Serviços de Segurança em Meios de Pagamento e Identificação S.A. and changed its name to Valid Soluções S.A. in August 2018. Valid Soluções S.A. was founded in 1957 and is headquartered in Sorocaba Brazil.

Name: Arab Jordan Investment Bank
Description: Arab Jordan Investment Bank provides commercial banking services to individuals SMEs or corporations in Jordan and internationally. It operates through Individual Accounts Institutions and Corporate Treasury and Institutional Financing segments. The company offers current demand savings and time deposit accounts. It also provides personal trade and housing loans; and overdrafts revolving commercial loans term loans asset-backed facilities syndicated loans forwards options futures trade finance facilities/transactional banking and online banking services. In addition the company provides safe deposit box postdated cheque cheque book certified cheque sweeping and cash pooling wealth management transfer and trade finance services; treasury VIP banking and financial planning services; letters of credit letters of guarantee and bills for collection; bancassurance services; and debit and credit cards. Further the company offers investment banking services such as mergers acquisitions and leverage buyouts; insurance; financial advisory private banking IPOs and fundraising escrow accounts and project and specialized finance. The company operates through a network of multiple branches and offices in Jordan and Cyprus. Arab Jordan Investment Bank was incorporated in 1978 and is headquartered in Amman Jordan.

Name: Invest Bank
Description: Invest Bank provides various banking and related financial services in Jordan. It provides personal banking services comprising current and saving accounts and time deposits; personal mortgage/housing under construction land financing equity release auto and cash-to-cash loans; and credit cards. The company also offers corporate banking services such as overdraft accounts decreasing loans accounts discounted promissory notes bonded services bridging and amortized loans syndicated loans and other services; treasury services; letters of credit; guarantees; and revolving loans discounted promissory notes structured trade finance solutions and liquidity and cash management products and solutions. In addition it provides factoring brokerage supply chain finance and financial leasing services; and mobile and internet banking services as well as engages in the management and operation of bonded warehouses. The company was formerly known as Jordan Investment & Finance Bank and changed its name to Invest Bank in April 2009. Invest Bank was incorporated in 1982 and is headquartered in Amman Jordan.

Name: Al Suwadi Power Company SAOG
Description: Al Suwadi Power Company SAOG develops finances designs constructs operates maintains insures and owns power-generating facilities in Oman. The company owns and operates the Barka 3 power plant with a power capacity of approximately 750 MW; gas interconnection facilities; and other related infrastructure to produce power. It sells electrical energy to Nama Power and Water Procurement Company SAOC under power purchase agreement. Al Suwadi Power Company SAOG was incorporated in 2010 and is based in Al Khuwayrah Oman.
Industry: Independent Power and Renewable Electricity Producers

Name: FCMB Group Plc
Description: FCMB Group Plc provides various banking and financial services to the wholesale and retail customers in Nigeria and Europe. The company’s Investment Banking segment offers banking services to structured large corporate organizations. This segment is also involved in capital-raising activities for organizations in money and capital markets as well as offers financial advisory services to organizations in raising funds. Its Investment Management segment administers and manages the pension fund assets and other investment portfolios for structured retiree savings account holders and other equity fund account holders. The company’s SME Banking segment provides banking services to small and medium enterprises (SME) and commercial registered businesses. Its Commercial Banking segment offers banking services to SME and commercial registered businesses. The company’s Corporate Banking segment provides direct debit facilities current accounts deposits overdrafts loan and other credit facilities foreign currency and derivative products for companies and financial institutions. Its Personal Banking segment offers private banking services and private customer current accounts; savings deposits and investment savings products; and custody services credit and debit cards consumer loans and mortgages to individuals. The company’s Institutional Banking segment provides government financing as well as services to financial institutions and multilateral agencies. Its Treasury and Financial Markets segment offers funding support to various business segments. This segment is also involved in currency trading including financial instruments trading and structured financing. The company also offers stockbroking trusteeship micro-lending cash management trade loans and advances corporate finance investment banking securities brokerage money market and foreign exchange services. FCMB Group Plc was founded in 1977 and is based in Lagos Nigeria.

Name: Ladun Investment Company
Description: Ladun Investment Company is a real estate investment firm. The firm was founded in 1968 and is based in Riyadh Saudi Arabia.

Name: Arindo Holdings (Mauritius) Limited
Description: Arindo Holdings (Mauritius) Limited was incorporated in 2005 and is based in Port Louis Mauritius.

Name: BrainsWay Ltd.
Description: BrainsWay Ltd. develops and sells noninvasive neurostimulation treatments for mental health disorders in the United States East Asia and internationally. It offers Deep Transcranial Magnetic Stimulation platform technology for the treatment of major depressive disorders anxious depression obsessive-compulsive disorders smoking addiction bipolar disorders post traumatic stress disorders schizophrenia Alzheimer’s disease autism chronic pain multiple sclerosis post stroke rehabilitation and Parkinson’s diseases. The company serves doctors hospitals and medical centers in the field of psychiatry. The company was founded in 2003 and is headquartered in Jerusalem Israel.

Name: Qatar Industrial Manufacturing Company Q.P.S.C.
Description: Qatar Industrial Manufacturing Company Q.P.S.C. together with its subsidiaries engages in industrial manufacturing in Qatar and internationally. The company produces treated sand for construction and agricultural uses; paving stones and kerb stones; sulphuric acid for local and export markets; and non-colored and colored aluminum profiles as well as converts facial tissues toilet rolls kitchen rolls and M Tork rolls. It is also involved in various types of industrial investments. The company was founded in 1990 and is headquartered in Doha Qatar.

Name: Middle East Specialized Cables Company
Description: Middle East Specialized Cables Company together with its subsidiaries manufactures and sells fiber optic cables steel insulated wires and cables copper insulated wires and cables and aluminum insulated wires and cables in Saudi Arabia and the United Arab Emirates. The company offers instrumentation and process cables for use in oil gas and petrochemical automation and process control and marine and offshore industries; building wires that are used in new constructions; power and control cables that are used in construction and industrial applications; and data and communication cables such as co-axial LAN computer telephone and system cables. It also manufactures PVC compounds for wire and cable insulation and sheathing applications; and flexible cables used in various applications including machine tool manufacture power stations heating and air conditioning installations etc. In addition the company produces and sells fire cables used as a fixed wiring within buildings for fire alarms systems; irrigation cables used in commercial sprinkler and irrigation systems golf courses public parks plantations and commercial produce farms; and bare copper used in earthling electrical systems and overhead electrical transmission and distribution system. Middle East Specialized Cables Company was incorporated in 1992 and is based in Riyadh the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

Name: Oxiquim S.A.
Description: Oxiquim S.A. produces and sells resins for the wood board industry in Chile. It offers liquid petroleum gas clean fuels wood board animal feed and nutrition human food food flexible packaging films thermoplastic and compostable resins paints coating and adhesives; industrial water desalination purification and treatment; pharmaceutical mining detergents and cleaning cellulose and paper HPLC solvents and ACS reagents and others. The company also provides reception storage and dispatch services for liquid bulk serving mining companies LPG and fuel distributors pulp mills paint and coating manufacturers and resins and adhesive producers. In addition it is involved in the distribution and marketing of a range of chemicals raw materials and specialties for the productive industry; and marketing sales and technical support product development supply chain and logistics sourcing and procurement mixing and formulation packaging and drumming and private labeling services. The company was founded in 1955 and is based in Santiago Chile.

Name: Saudi Company for Hardware SACO
Description: Saudi Company for Hardware SACO engages in the retail and wholesale of household and office supplies and appliances construction tools and equipment and electrical tools and hardware in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. The company operates in two segments Sales and Services and Logistic Services. It offers freight forwarding transportation and contract logistics as well as delivery installation and maintenance services. The company also provides port handling trans-shipment warehouse management and maintenance and custom clearance services. It sells its products online. Saudi Company for Hardware SACO was incorporated in 1984 and is based in Riyadh the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

Name: Invercap S.A.
Description: Invercap S.A. is involved in the mining and steel businesses in Chile Argentina and Peru. The company produces processes and sells steel products as well as iron mining. Invercap S.A. was founded in 1994 and is based in Santiago Chile.

Name: Mehadrin Ltd
Description: Mehadrin Ltd. grows and markets citrus fruits and vegetables primarily under the JAFFA brand name in Israel and internationally. It offers oranges exotic citrus lemons easy peelers kumquats and grapefruits; avocados; dates; and potatoes carrots litchis Sharon fruits sweet potatoes pomegranates and mangoes. The company also provides cold storage services for fruits vegetables dairy products and frozen products such as juice concentrators frozen vegetables meat and fish; rents areas and buildings; supplies drinking water; and offers sources of drinking water pumping services. The company was incorporated in 1951 and is based in Be'erot Yitzhak Israel.

Name: Pet Center Comércio e Participações S.A.
Description: Pet Center Comércio e Participações S.A. operates physical and digital stores that sells products and services for pets in Brazil. The company offers pet food products such as prescription pet food super premium premium and standard pet food wet food snacks and others; and accessories hygiene cleaning products drugs and others under the Petz brand. It also operates veterinary centers under the Seres brand. The company was incorporated in 2013 and is based in São Paulo Brazil.

Name: Aydem Yenilenebilir Enerji A.S.
Description: Aydem Yenilenebilir Enerji A.S. engages in renewable energy generation in Turkey. The company operates 20 hydroelectric 3 wind and 1 geothermal power plants with a total installed capacity of 1180 megawatts. It also produces electricity using solar resources. The company was incorporated in 1995 and is based in Merkezefendi Turkey. Aydem Yenilenebilir Enerji A.S. operates as a subsidiary of Aydem Enerji Yatirimlari Anonim Sirketi.
Industry: Independent Power and Renewable Electricity Producers

Name: Unifique Telecomunicações S.A.
Description: Unifique Telecomunicações S.A. provides telecommunications services in Brazil. The company offers data storage data hosting and internet services. It also provides SCM multimedia communications services; access to communication networks portals content providers and information services; satellite cable and microwave pay-TV; and internet hosting and switched fixed-line telephone services. In addition the company retail trades computer and mobile phone equipment and supplies; monitors electronic security systems; provides supplementary pension and health plans; and publishes books and retail trades books. Unifique Telecomunicações S.A. was incorporated in 1997 and is headquartered in Timbó Brazil.

Name: Union Internationale de Banques Société anonyme
Description: Union Internationale de Banques Société anonyme provides banking products and services to individuals professionals companies institutions and SMEs in Tunisia. The company offers accounts; bancassurance products; credit products; savings and investments products; and products for juniors teens and students as well as other products and services. It also offers platinum cards and accounts; infinite cards; and day-today banking bancassurance funding and investments. In addition the company provides venture capital stock market intermediation portfolio management consulting asset management and debt collection services. Union Internationale de Banques Société anonyme was founded in 1964 and is headquartered in Tunis Tunisia. Union Internationale de Banques Société anonyme is a subsidiary of Société Générale Société anonyme.

Name: Sechaba Brewery Holdings Limited
Description: Sechaba Brewery Holdings Limited an investment holding company manufactures imports markets and distributes alcoholic and non-alcoholic beverages in Botswana. The company offers beer alcoholic fruit beverages soft drinks purified water and other non-alcoholic beverages. Sechaba Brewery Holdings Limited was incorporated in 1984 and is based in Gaborone Botswana.

Name: Super Group Limited
Description: Super Group Limited engages in the supply chain management mobility dealership and fleet management activities in South Africa sub-Saharan Africa Europe and the United Kingdom. It operates through seven segments: Supply Chain Africa Supply Chain Europe Fleet Africa SG Fleet Dealerships SA Dealerships UK and Services. The company provides supply chain services comprising primary and secondary distribution multi-temperature-controlled product distribution integrated distribution to the national convenience market bonded cross-border transport warehousing supply chain optimisation and consulting brand management sales and merchandising courier services and procurement. It also offers fleet management solutions for specific transport and vehicle management needs of various customers; and various value-added services such as driver fuel and tyre management; accident and insurance administration; fleet optimization and route planning; vehicle tracking and recovery; call center; and repair services. In addition it provides end-to-end logistics warehousing and customs clearance; and transportation and logistics solutions. Further the company offers passenger and commercial vehicles. Super Group Limited was incorporated in 1943 and is headquartered in Sandton South Africa.

Name: Scientific and Medical Equipment House Company
Description: Scientific and Medical Equipment House Company provides technological solutions and services for healthcare and catering projects in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. It operates through Operation and Maintenance Medical Equipment Sales and Post-Sale Maintenance Services Revenue Construction Meat and Food and Medicine and Medical Supplies segments. The company engages in the supply of medical and non-medical staff; general contracting of buildings roads bridges dams electrical electronic and mechanical works; operation of restaurants and hospitals; maintenance and operation of industrial water and sewage works; maintenance of scientific and medical equipment; sale of safety equipment; installation and maintenance of firefighting and fire alarm equipment lighting systems and equipment cooling air conditioning electric gas and oil heating systems; filling and maintenance of fire extinguishers; sale installation and maintenance of security surveillance cameras security detectors inspection and burglar alarm devices; and manufacture of radiological equipment tubes and devices. It is also involved in the repair and maintenance of radiological electronic medical and therapeutic equipment; export wholesale and retail trade in medical electronical electrical and mechanical equipment and devices laundries incinerator equipment and pumps; manufacture of pacemakers and ECG devices; installation and extension of television satellite computer telecommunications networks and electrical and communication wires; and wholesale of food and drinks. In addition the company provides catering and private civil security guard services cleaning services for governmental buildings building maintenance and land freight services for goods and refrigerated food warehouse services as well as meat frozen vegetables and dry food. Scientific and Medical Equipment House Company was incorporated in 1979 and is based in Riyadh the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

Name: Limak Dogu Anadolu Cimento Sanayi ve Ticaret Anonim Sirketi
Description: Limak Dogu Anadolu Cimento Sanayi ve Ticaret Anonim Sirketi produces and sells cement and clinker products in Turkey. The company was founded in 1976 and is headquartered in Siirt Turkey.

Name: Médica Sur S.A.B. de C.V.
Description: Médica Sur S.A.B. de C.V. operates as a healthcare hospital in Mexico. The company offers angiology vascular and endovascular surgery; bariatric surgery; cancer; cardiology; checkup and preventive medicine; children; dental; emergency; endocrinology; gastroenterology hepatology and endoscopy; general surgery; geriatric; and gynecology and obstetrics services. It also provides specialized surgery; neonatology; neurology neurosurgery and gamma knife radiosurgery; neurophysiology; nuclear medicine; orthopedic and traumatology; outpatient surgery; plastic surgery; robotic surgery; spine microsurgery; transplant; urology; vascular disease; and imagine and MRI unit services. In addition the company offers accommodation; concierge; digital hospital and telemedicine; gourmet; assistance in paperwork and filing procedures with insurer; and tour and transportation services. Further it provides medical services and diagnosis. The company was incorporated in 1966 and is based in Mexico City Mexico. Médica Sur S.A.B. de C.V. is a subsidiary of Neuco SAPI de CV.

Name: Future Care Trading Co.
Description: Future Care Trading Co. provides a range of home medical and laboratory services in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. The company is involved in the operation of hospitals specialized medical clinics and complexes plasma collection centers home medical services centers and medical laboratories. It also engages in the operation of tele-care and telemedicine centers physiotherapy centers and radiology centers; design and programming of special software/mobile medical clinics/public medical complexes and application development activities; medical rehabilitation centers; alternative and complementary medicine clinics; publishing of ready-made programs; audio-visual studio; and offers nursing aids doctor visits and support medical services. Future Care Trading Co. was founded in 2015 and is headquartered in Jeddah the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

Name: ICBC Turkey Bank A.S.
Description: ICBC Turkey Bank A.S. together with its subsidiaries provides various banking products and services in Turkey. The company’s corporate and commercial banking products include spot rotating discount-purchase foreign currency indexed and equal installment loans; Eximbank loans; foreign credits such as working capital export credit agencies and pre-export financing loans; and non-cash loans comprising letters of guarantee import loans letters of credit acceptance/aval loans export loans and letters of reference as well as risk management trade finance and RMB cash management and insurance services. It also offers retail banking products and services consisting of demand deposit time-deposit overdraft fund deposit E-deposit and automatic fund saving accounts; consumer loans such as cash car and housing loans; credit cards; money transfer and payment services; safe deposit boxes; insurance services; online banking services; and individual pension systems and life insurances. In addition the company’s retail banking products and services comprise investment products that consist of mutual funds treasury bills and government bonds Eurobonds repurchase agreements stock trading services and derivative products. Further it provides investment banking and other services including treasury transactions. The company was formerly known as Tekstil Bankasi Anonim Sirketi and changed its name to ICBC Turkey Bank A.S. in November 2015. The company was founded in 1985 and is headquartered in Istanbul Turkey. ICBC Turkey Bank A.S. is a subsidiary of Industrial and Commercial Bank of China Limited.

Name: Ari Real Estate (Arena) Investment Ltd
Description: Ari Real Estate (Arena) Investment Ltd engages in real estate business in Israel and internationally. It is involved in the rental management and maintenance of shopping malls and commercial centers. The company was formerly known as Arena Star Group Ltd. and changed its name to Ari Real Estate (Arena) Investment Ltd in March 2022. Ari Real Estate (Arena) Investment Ltd was incorporated in 1992 and is based in Ashdod Israel. As of February 8 2021 Ari Real Estate (Arena) Investment Ltd is a subsidiary of Abu Yechiel Ltd.

Name: Marketing Home Group Company for Trading Company
Description: Marketing Home Group Company for Trading Company operates as a trading company in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia the United Arab Emirates the People’s Republic of China Kingdom of Spain and Arab Republic of Egypt. It engages in the construction of prefabricated buildings on-site; renovation of residential and non-residential buildings; wholesale of agarwood incense perfumes bricks blocks tiles stone marble ceramics porcelain sanitary ware and their extensions water heaters and tanks; retail sale of sanitary ware and extensions such as sinks chairs bathtubs sauna equipment electrical appliances and extensions marble natural and artificial stone ceramics porcelain chandeliers lighting goods and accessories; operation of storage facilities for all types of goods; marble cutting and sawing; manufacture of marble products such as kitchens sinks antiques basins statues sculptures and paintings; and manufacture of air conditioning ducts and duct accessories. The company was incorporated in 2005 and is headquartered in Riyadh Saudi Arabia.

Name: Weaver Fintech Ltd
Description: Weaver Fintech Ltd operates as a fintech company provides financial services. It offers digital lending products such as personal loans and a mobile credit backed wallet; digital payments which includes buy-now-pay-later and paystretch; and funeral and personal accident insurance products. The company also provides merchant services; and sells printed bedding comforters blankets through showrooms sales agents and its e-commerce site. It offers its products under the FinChoice PayJustNow and homechoice brand name. The company was formerly known as HomeChoice International plc and changed its name to Weaver Fintech Ltd in July 2025. The company was founded in 1985 and is based in Riche Terre Mauritius. Weaver Fintech Ltd operates as a subsidiary of GFM Holdings Ltd.

Name: Famous Brands Limited
Description: Famous Brands Limited through its subsidiaries operates as a quick service and casual dining restaurant franchisor in the United Kingdom South Africa South African Development Community the Middle East and Rest of Africa. It operates through Brands and Supply Chain segments. The company operates franchised and company-owned restaurants under the Leading and Signature brands. It is also involved in the manufacture of meat serviette sauces and spices ice cream potato products coffee grounds and beans cheese and juices; and operation of retail outlets. In addition it provides logistics services; and retail products such as dressings and spice condiments frozen meat products frozen chips and other value-added products. The company was formerly known as Steers Holdings Limited and changed its name to Famous Brands Limited in 2004. Famous Brands Limited was incorporated in 1969 and is headquartered in Midrand South Africa.

Name: BK Group PLC
Description: BK Group PLC provides retail and corporate banking insurance brokerage internet and digital services in Rwanda. The company operates a commercial bank that offers a range of financial products including loans mortgages and vehicle financing as well as operates branches ATMS and POS terminals. It serves individuals SMEs corporations non-profits and other financial entities. The company also provides asset management and investment banking; investment and advisory services comprising wealth management and corporate finance; a range of non-life insurance products such as motor transport engineering and personal accident insurance; and smart solutions consisting of home security cashless payments and enterprise security. In addition it invests in education innovation and climate. The company was formerly known as Bank of Kigali Limited and changed its name to BK Group PLC in December 2017. BK Group PLC was incorporated in 1966 and is based in Kigali Rwanda.

Name: Tupy S.A.
Description: Tupy S.A. together with its subsidiaries engages in the development manufacture and sale of cast and compacted graphite iron structural components in North America South and Central Americas Europe Asia Africa Oceania and internationally. The company operates through two segments Freight Transportation Infrastructure Agriculture and Power Generation; and Distribution segments. It offers engine blocks cylinder heads and cast and machined products for the manufacturers of engines used in passenger vehicles commercial vehicles construction machines tractors agricultural machinery power generators capital goods in general and engine assembly for third parties. The company also provides spare parts; malleable iron connections for the construction industry; and cast iron profiles for various use. Tupy S.A. was founded in 1938 and is headquartered in Joinville Brazil.

Name: Fibra Shop
Description: FibraShop (BMV: FSHOP 13) is a unique real estate investment option in Mexico distinguished by its specialization highly experienced human capital in the commercial real estate sector solid operational structure and corporate governance. Together these elements ensure transparency efficiency and secure profitable growth. FibraShop is a real estate and infrastructure trust primarily established to acquire own manage and develop real estate properties in the shopping center sector in Mexico. It is managed by industry specialists with extensive experience and externally advised by FibraShop Portafolios Inmobiliarios S.C. Our goal is to provide attractive returns to our investors holding CBFIs through stable distributions and capital appreciation.

Name: Iochpe-Maxion S.A.
Description: Iochpe-Maxion S.A. produces and sells automotive wheels and structural components for commercial and light vehicles in North America South America Europe Asia and internationally. The company operates in two divisions Maxion Wheels and Maxion Structural Components. It offers steel and aluminum wheels; wheels side rails and chassis for commercial vehicles; and railway freight cars wheels and castings as well as industrial castings. It also provides structural components such as frames sidebars crossbars metal stampings hand brake levers pedal and welded assemblies structural pieces and other automotive components. The company was founded in 1918 and is headquartered in Cruzeiro Brazil.

Name: Saga Falabella S.A.
Description: Saga Falabella S.A. operates chain of department stores in Peru. The company’s stores sell products in various categories including electrohome technology furniture and organization shoes bedroom sports accessories footwear gifts kitchen and kitchenware decoration and lighting pets automotive tool and machinery construction hardware products and beauty and health as well as woman men and children fashion. The company also sells its products through Falabella.com platform. It is also involved in insurance businesses; and rental of spaces to third parties. The company was incorporated in 1953 and is based in San Isidro Peru. Saga Falabella S.A. operates as a subsidiary of Inverfal Perú S.A.A.

Name: ONATEL-SA
Description: ONATEL-SA provides telecommunications services for mobile landline and internet activities. It also sells terminals and other telecommunication equipment. ONATEL-SA is based in Ouagadougou Burkina Faso. ONATEL-SA operates as a subsidiary of Itissalat Al-Maghrib (IAM) S.A.

Name: Arabian Pipes Company
Description: Arabian Pipes Company engages in the production and marketing of steel tubes in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. It is also involved in bending shaping and threading pipes outside and inside pipes and accessories. In addition the company engages in trading of pipes and fittings; and extension of pipeline activity. Further it manufactures pipes hoses and plastic pipes as well as shapes hollow iron and steel. The company exports its products to the North Africa Middle East and Gulf countries. Arabian Pipes Company was founded in 1991 and is based in Riyadh the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

Name: Kayseri Seker Fabrikasi Anonim Sirketi
Description: Kayseri Seker Fabrikasi Anonim Sirketi manufactures and sells sugar in Turkey and internationally. It operates through Sugar Production and Other Activities Segments. The company offers crystal sugar from beet. It serves its customers under the Kayseri Sugar brand name. Kayseri Seker Fabrikasi Anonim Sirketi was incorporated in 1955 and is based in Kayseri Turkey. Kayseri Seker Fabrikasi Anonim Sirketi operates as a subsidiary of S.S Kayseri Pancar Ekiciler Kooperatifi.

Name: Rani Zim Shopping Centers Ltd
Description: Rani Zim Shopping Centers Ltd together with its subsidiaries engages in the development management and lease or sale of commercial projects in Israel. The company primarily operates manages and leases malls and shopping centers. It also initiates constructs and operates or sells housing units. The company was incorporated in 2009 and is based in Petah Tel Aviv-Yafo Israel.

Name: Tera Light Ltd
Description: Tera Light Ltd engages in the construction operation and maintenance of photovoltaic systems. It undertakes range of projects including ground-mounted and rooftop solar facilities energy storage solutions agri-voltaics electric vehicle charging stations and investments in innovative technologies. The company was founded in 2016 and is based in Ramat Gan Israel.

Name: Empresas Tricot S.A.
Description: Empresas Tricot S.A. engages in the sale of clothing and fashion accessories in Chile. The company offers women’s men’s and children’s t-shirts blouses sweaters and vests sweatshirts pants jeans jackets skirts shorts rompers sports and maternal products pajamas nightshirts slippers robes swimwear jackets formal suits divers and underwear products. It also provides accessories such as hair beauty and personal care caps and hats scarves and handkerchiefs pareos glasses belts wallets backpacks and bags jewelry ties and footwear products. The company was founded in 1952 and is headquartered in Macul Chile. Empresas Tricot S.A. is a subsidiary of Inversiones Retail Chile S.A.

Name: Al Batinah Power Company SAOG
Description: Al Batinah Power Company SAOG designs develops finances constructs operates maintains insures and owns a power generating associated gas interconnection and other infrastructure facilities in the Sultanate of Oman.
