It owns the Sohar 2 power plant with a power capacity of approximately 750 MW located in the Al Batinah region of the Sultanate of Oman. The company also sells the generated electrical energy to Nama Power and Water Procurement Company SAOC. Al Batinah Power Company SAOG was incorporated in 2010 and is based in Al Khuwayrah Oman.
Industry: Independent Power and Renewable Electricity Producers

Name: Fenerbahçe Futbol A.S.
Description: Fenerbahçe Futbol A.S. operates football club in Turkey. The company operates in Football Activity and Retailing segments. It distributes markets and sells Fenerbahce licensed products through stores corners and website. The company was founded in 1907 and is based in Istanbul Turkey. Fenerbahçe Futbol A.S. is a subsidiary of Fenerbahçe Spor Kulübü.

Name: Is Finansal Kiralama Anonim Sirketi
Description: Is Finansal Kiralama Anonim Sirketi engages in financial leasing services in Turkey and internationally. The company’s leasing products include sale and lease back software leasing and operational leasing. It also provides secondhand market services insurance transactions and after sales services. The company was incorporated in 1988 and is headquartered in Istanbul Turkey.

Name: Emirates Insurance Company P.J.S.C.
Description: Emirates Insurance Company P.J.S.C. engages in writing general insurance and reinsurance in the United Arab Emirates the United States and Europe. The company operates through Underwriting of General Insurance Business and Investments segments. It offers property insurance products such as fire and allied perils property all risk business interruption householders comprehensive political violence and terrorism and sabotage insurance products; and engineering insurance products such as contractors’ all risks/erection all risks contractors’ plant and equipment machinery breakdown and electronic equipment insurance products as well as insurance for deterioration of stock. The company also provides employee benefit insurance products comprising group life medical and personal accident insurance products as well as workmen’s compensation/employers liability insurance products; motor insurance products; and financial insurance products consisting of fidelity guarantee money and bankers blanket bond insurance products. In addition it offers liability insurance products such as general third-party/public/comprehensive general and products and professional liability insurance products; and package insurance products including hotel comprehensive/block jewelers’ block and office comprehensive insurance products; marine cargo and hull and aviation insurance products; and insurance for energy-related oil and gas risks as well as home healthcare and yacht and pleasure craft insurance products. Further the company provides energy property and engineering facultative and non-marine treaty reinsurance products. Additionally it invests in marketable equity securities and investment funds bonds term deposits and other securities. The company was incorporated in 1982 and is based in Abu Dhabi the United Arab Emirates.

Name: Heriot REIT Limited
Description: Heriot REIT Limited (“Heriot” or “the Company”) is a property holding and investment company that is listed in the “Diversified REITs” sector on the Alternative Exchange of the JSE Limited (“JSE”). Heriot and its subsidiaries (“the Group”) are primarily invested in retail and industrial properties situated in areas with high growth potential. Heriot’s primary objective is to grow and streamline its asset base through the acquisition of high-quality properties the redevelopment of existing properties and the disposal of assets identified as non-core. Pursuant to its investment strategy Heriot acquired 100% of Thibault REIT Limited (“Thibault”) on 28 June 2024 (“Thibault acquisition”). Heriot holds strategic stakes of 592% in Safari Investments RSA Limited (“Safari”) and 217% (excluding treasury shares) in Texton Property Fund Limited (“Texton”).

Name: Vivo Energy Mauritius Limited
Description: Vivo Energy Mauritius Limited markets supplies and distributes fuels and lubricants to retail and commercial customers in Mauritius. It operates through Regulated and Non-regulated segments. The company offers fuelsave unleaded and fuelsave diesel; lubricants including advanced motorcycle motor oil longlife coolant helix passenger car motor oil rimula heavy-duty motor oil and gadus; lubes such as rimalax spirax and tellus; and liquefied petroleum gases (LPG) and solar/hybrid solutions. It also provides car wash services; shell and bank cards; retail food; and retail shops. It serves the aviation marine retail and commercial business and business sectors under the Shell brand. The company was formerly known as Shell Mauritius Limited and changed its name to Vivo Energy Mauritius Limited in December 2011. Vivo Energy Mauritius Limited was incorporated in 1989 and is based in Port Louis Mauritius. Vivo Energy Mauritius Limited is a subsidiary of Vivo Energy Mauritius Holdings B.V.

Name: Tümosan Motor ve Traktör Sanayi A.S.
Description: Tümosan Motor ve Traktör Sanayi A.S. engages in the production marketing and sale of diesel engines and tractors in Turkey and internationally. The company offers garden and field tractors; agricultural machinery engines industrial engines marine engines and generator engines; and electric forklifts. Its diesel engines are used in tractors automotive and cleaning equipment generators and marine vehicles. The company also provides spare parts and after-sales services as well as marine and military subsystems and military platforms. Tümosan Motor ve Traktör Sanayi A.S. was founded in 1975 and is headquartered in Istanbul Turkey. Tümosan Motor ve Traktör Sanayi A.S. is a subsidiary of Ereğli Tekstil Turizm SAN. ve TİC. A.Ş.

Name: Bera Holding A.S.
Description: Bera Holding A.S. operates in the paper and cardboard machinery oil construction and building materials marble textiles tourism and food sectors worldwide. The company engages in the paper production facilities; cardboard and packaging services; production and marketing of bearings under the URB brand; operation of the storage filling and distribution of liquid petroleum gas (LPG) as cylinder gas bulk gas and autogas; and provides flour semolina pulses pasta biscuits marshmallows and wafers. It also offers construction services to housing complexes shopping centers hotels hospitals administrative buildings factory buildings industrial facility buildings social and cultural facility buildings schools and concept projects; marble and minerals; and knitted fabrics as well as operates hotels. The company was formerly known as Kombassan Holding A.S. and changed its name to Bera Holding A.S. in July 2017. The company was founded in 1988 and is based in Konya Turkey.

Name: Hudaco Industries Limited
Description: Hudaco Industries Limited imports and distributes automotive industrial and electrical consumable products in South Africa and internationally. The company operates in two segments Consumer-Related Products and Engineering Consumables. The Consumer-Related Products segment distributes clutch kits automotive ignition leads oil and hydraulic seals wheels brake and clutch hydraulics mountings bushes hydraulic repair kits cylinders hoses CV joints wheel hubs suspension components and vehicle components to the automotive and industrial after-market; batteries chargers and related battery management equipment as well as battery bays; power tools marine engines survey instruments and fasteners; and wireless networking VoIP and physical security solutions. It also distributes intrusion detection surveillance access control and fire detection equipment; two-way radios and satellite communications wireless networking mobile and VoIP services; end to end security and ICT solutions; and cooking heating and outdoor products. The Engineering Consumables segment distributes diesel engines and spares and support services; bearings chains belting industrial hose seals electric motors geared motors and transmission products; filtration solutions kits and accessories to mining process and manufacturing markets; thermoplastic pipes and fittings and equipment; and variable speed drives electric motors electrical cabling plugs sockets and related products. This segment also manufactures and distributes hydraulic and pneumatic products; drivetrains; dragline hoses; conveyor drive pulleys and idlers; and ferrous and non-ferrous castings as well as designs services and repairs systems. It serves the wholesale and retail automotive manufacturing mining exports security alternative energy construction and agriculture markets. Hudaco Industries Limited was founded in 1891 and is headquartered in Edenvale South Africa.

Name: Supreme Ventures Limited
Description: Supreme Ventures Limited engages in betting gaming and lottery operations in Jamaica. The company operates through Lottery Sports Betting Pin Codes and Other segments. It provides video lottery terminal games at gaming lounges and food and beverage operations. In addition the company is also involved in numeric lottery games horseracing activities sports betting micro-financing and selling of PIN codes. Further it provides management and technology services; and micro-financing services. The company was incorporated in 1995 and is based in Kingston Jamaica.

Name: Ledesma Sociedad Anónima Agrícola Industrial
Description: Ledesma Sociedad Anónima Agrícola Industrial operates as an agro-industrial company in Argentina. The company offers sugar alcohol and bioethanol fruits and citric juices and meat and grains as well as paper copybooks school spares and stationary from sugarcane fiber waste. It also produces energy from renewable sources. Ledesma Sociedad Anónima Agrícola Industrial was incorporated in 1914 and is based in Buenos Aires Argentina.

Name: Orbit Technologies Ltd
Description: Orbit Technologies Ltd develops manufactures and sells communication products worldwide. The company offers satellite communication systems for mobile platforms; tracking communication and telemetry systems; and audio communication management systems for aircraft. It serves its products to marine and aviation sectors. The company was incorporated in 1950 and is based in Netanya Israel.

Name: Artex Industrial Investment Company
Description: Artex Industrial Investment Company engages in the manufacture and sale of rugs and carpets in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia Asia North America Africa Europe and Australia. It is also involved in the production of yarn polypropylene yarn masterbatch and PVC tubes; and the provision of staff catering and transportation and training services. The company was formerly known as Al Abdullatif Industrial Investment Company and changed its name to Artex Industrial Investment Company in July 2024. Artex Industrial Investment Company was incorporated in 1989 and is headquartered in Riyadh the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

Name: Grupo Financiero Multiva S.A.B. de C.V.
Description: Grupo Financiero Multiva S.A.B. de C.V. provides various banking products and services in Mexico. It offers various people and business accounts SME products credits and investment and insurance products. The company also provides trust services investment funds investment and agricultural banking services corporate financing capital and money market services stock market trustee services and payroll products and accounts. In addition it offers acquiring business solutions; and online banking products and services. The company was founded in 1980 and is based in Mexico City Mexico. Grupo Financiero Multiva S.A.B. de C.V. operates as a subsidiary of Grupo Empresarial Ángeles SA de CV.

Name: Unilever Nigeria Plc
Description:
Unilever Nigeria Plc manufactures and markets food home care and beauty and personal care products primarily in Nigeria and internationally. It operates through 
Food Products; and Home and Personal Care segments. The company offers products under the Close-Up Pepsodent Rexona Knorr Annarpurna and Royco brand names. The company was formerly known as Lever Brothers (West Africa) Ltd and changed its name to Unilever Nigeria Plc in 2001. Unilever Nigeria Plc was incorporated in 1923 and is based in Lagos Nigeria. Unilever Nigeria Plc is a subsidiary of Unilever Overseas Holdings BV.

Name: Nofoth Food Products Company
Description: Nofoth Food Products Company produces and sells bakery products in Saudi Arabia. It offers maamoul under the Mamola brand; sweets with creamy fillings under the Qashtia brand; stuffing kibbeh and musakhan products under the Anaba brand; fried and baked dates stuffed with various flavors and fillings under the Golden Balah brand; and pies and stuffings under the Pinkish Bite brand. The company also provides biscuits folk and oriental sweets and sugary sweets including candied caramel toffee and nougat; retail sale of used oil nuts coffee spices and perfumes; food services; and operates restaurant and dry fruit stores. Nofoth Food Products Company was founded in 2015 and is headquartered in Riyadh Saudi Arabia.

Name: MM Group for Industry and International Trade S.A.E.
Description: MM Group for Industry and International Trade S.A.E. engages in the distribution business in Egypt. It operates through four segments: Consumer Electronics Activity Telecommunication Activity Automotive Activity and Tractors activity. The company distributes consumer electronics such as mobile phones tablets air-conditioners refrigerators and household appliances; and luxury vehicles. It also engages in the franchises and distribution of mobile services and accessories including pre-paid and post-paid and e-top-up terminals/credit recharge as well as mobile and broadband devices and accessories. In addition the company assembles and distributes agricultural tractors and farm equipment. The company was founded in 1895 and is headquartered in Cairo Egypt.

Name: ATP Yazilim ve Teknoloji Anonim Sirketi
Description: ATP Yazilim ve Teknoloji Anonim Sirketi develops software and infrastructure solutions for finance hospitality and other industries in Turkey and internationally. It offers restaurant POS customer experience online channels and delivery restaurant management and mobile device management and support center services under the Zenia brand; brokerage software fund and portfolio management RPA and automation mobile and virtual branch finance applications and market connectivity solutions under the Tradesoft brand name; customer relationship management (CRM) ERP and e-accounting cloud platform and custom business solutions under the Digital brand; and green and carbon certificates trading platform under the GreenX brand name. The company also provides for enterprise resource planning CRM human resource e-transformation business intelligence and reporting business processes and low-code corporate productivity capital markets energy markets and business solutions; and infrastructure and security cloud software-defined wide area network (SD-WAN) infrastructure monitoring and management cyber security firewall and data security solutions. In addition it offers database and in-memory switchboard and help desk loss leak prevention payment barcode and printer uninterruptible power supply (ups) systems and system solutions; and IT licensing design and integration managed professional research and development consultancy and field services. The company was formerly known as ATP Ticari Bilgisayar Agi ve Elektrik Guc Kaynaklari Uretim Pazarlama ve Ticaret A.S. and changed its name to ATP Yazilim ve Teknoloji Anonim Sirketi in April 2023. ATP Yazilim ve Teknoloji Anonim Sirketi was incorporated in 1997 and is based in Istanbul Turkey.

Name: Bank of Africa - Burkina Faso
Description: Bank of Africa - Burkina Faso provides commercial bank services for retail corporate and financial markets in Burkina Faso. The company offers savings checking current and currency accounts; term deposits; cards; and digital and online banking services as well as various loans such as house equipment collective car and motorcycle personal consumer vitamin holiday and payday advance loans. It also provides cash and overdraft facilities; discounted commercial papers; bridge spot and campaign credits; advances; cash vouchers; insurance advisory and money transfer services; foreign currency endorsements documentary discounts documentary credits and checks or foreign currency items; guarantee letters; and trade express and currency transfer services. The company was founded in 1997 and is headquartered in Ouagadougou Burkina Faso. Bank of Africa - Burkina Faso operates is a subsidiary of BOA West Africa.

Name: Edarat Communication and Information Technology Co.
Description: Edarat Communication and Information Technology Co. operates as a technology services company in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia and internationally. The company operates through two segments Data Center Engineering Services and Cloud Services. It offers smart cities and smart building technology data center engineering ICT consulting and advisory workload migration and cloud services. The company also provides virtual network operator services colocation services system analysis design and programming of software management and monitoring of communications and information networks and web hosting infrastructure and related services as well as offers data center engineering and IT modernization related services. It serves banks telecom operators defense and security and oil and gas businesses. The company was founded in 2004 and is headquartered in Riyadh Saudi Arabia.

Name: Administradora Americana de Inversiones S.A.
Description: Administradora Americana de Inversiones S.A. operates independently of Administradora de Fondos de Pensiones Capital S.A. as of December 1 2021.

Name: Naqi Water Company
Description: Naqi Water Company engages in the production and bottling of pure filtered water in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. It is also involved in the wholesale of bottled water soft drinks and juices; and retail sale of beverages in specialized stores. In addition it is involved in the land transportation of goods; and rearing and producing broiler breeder hens operating hatcheries and producing eggs. The company was incorporated in 2014 and is headquartered in Unaizah Saudi Arabia.

Name: Sygnia Limited
Description: Sygnia Limited a financial services group provides investment management and administration services to institutional and retail clients primarily in South Africa. It offers multi-manager and index-tracking investment funds customized multi-management investment administration and foreign exchange transacting services transition management stockbroking and securities lending and trading services. The company also provides asset management; investment funds such as unitised life funds unit trusts ETFs and management of segregated portfolios; various savings products including retirement annuities tax-free savings accounts investment policies living annuities and preservation funds; and institutional investment administration employee benefits and retirement fund services. Sygnia Limited was founded in 2003 and is headquartered in Cape Town South Africa.

Name: Automatic Bank Services Limited
Description: Automatic Bank Services Limited operates payment systems for international debit cards in Israel. It serves as an infrastructure for credit card clearing; works with various credit companies as clearers and issuers; and works with distributors and manufacturers as well as provides service to businesses; and activates the confirmation switch on the ATM devices. The company was incorporated in 1978 and is based in Holon Israel.

Name: JSL S.A.
Description: JSL S.A. together with its subsidiaries provides logistics services in Brazil. It also offers charge transport internal logistics storage distribution and other charter services. In addition the company provides logistics services comprising intercity interstate and international freight transport services; charter passenger transport; logistical cargo transport; and storage related services. Further it manufactures plants and related equipment. JSL S.A. was founded in 1956 and is headquartered in São Paulo Brazil. The company is a subsidiary of Simpar S.A.

Name: Tiv Taam Holdings 1 Ltd.
Description: Tiv Taam Holdings 1 Ltd. produces markets and imports of food products in Israel. The company offers fruits and vegetables; meat and chicken products; fish and sea fruit; eggs milk and salads; breads and pastries; canned food pasta dressing and spreads; nuts seeds snacks dried fruits; cereal snacks and sweets such granola and muesli oats energy bars halva chocolate and candy snacks and cakes and cookies. It provides frozen vegetable pastry and dough food concentrates fruit and ice cream and ices; beverages comprising juices and nectars soda drinks syrups and concentrates water iced tea hot beverages and tea and infusions; wine beer alcohol cigarette products; and organic and gluten free products products with no sugar herbal drinks soy tofu seitan and cheese alternatives; and vitamins and dietary supplements sports nutrition and medical equipment. In addition the company provides bath and cosmetics including bath oral hygiene baby products hair color and care feminine care protection plaster cotton wool and ear sticks; electrical and lighting accessories; and home care and animal products. Further it sells its products through online. The company was formerly known as World Group Holdings Ltd. and changed its name to Tiv Taam Holdings 1 Ltd. in May 2007. The company was incorporated in 1965 and is based in Hefer Valley Israel.

Name: Dagi Yatirim Holding A.S.
Description: Dagi Yatirim Holding A.S. engages in investment activities in Turkey. The company invests in industrial commercial agricultural food financial real estate construction contracting iron and steel textile petroleum petroleum products telecommunication transportation automotive mining energy production and distribution natural gas distribution and energy and natural gas wholesale sectors. It also invents in companies engaged in banking financial institution brokerage houses insurance investment partnership factoring and leasing and other businesses. The company was formerly known as TAC Yatirim Ortakligi A.S. and changed its name to Dagi Yatirim Holding A.S. in June 2012. Dagi Yatirim Holding A.S. was incorporated in 1994 and is headquartered in Istanbul Turkey.

Name: Meitav Trade Investments Ltd
Description: Meitav Trade Investments Ltd provides financial investment services. The company was incorporated in 2023 is based in Bnei Brak Israel.

Name: Sefalana Holding Company Limited
Description: Sefalana Holding Company Limited through its subsidiaries engages in the wholesale and retail distribution of fast-moving consumer goods in Botswana Zambia Lesotho and Namibia. The company operates through four segments: Trading - Consumer Goods Trading - Others Manufacturing and Property. It operates retail supermarkets under the Sefalana Shopper name; convenience stores under the Sefalana Quick name; cash and carry outlets under the Sefalana Cash & Carry name; hyper stores under the Sefalana Hyper name; liquor stores under the Sefalana Liquor name; retail hybrid store under the The BIG One name; cigarette distribution outlet under the Capital Tobacco name; and fuel station under the Puma and Caltex franchise as well as catering business under the Sefalana Catering name. The company also produces and sells sarona samp; sechaba mabele; soya sorghum weaning food for infants; soya sorghum enriched foods; tholo malt; tsabotlhe a soya sorghum extruded product; maatla an enriched maize meal product; and ultra-high temperature milk under the Delta Fresh and A Star brands. In addition it sells agricultural and construction equipment automotive products and after-sale service; and operates as a franchised local representative for MAN Honda Daewoo and Tata vehicles including light and heavy commercial vehicles passenger vehicles trucks special-purpose vehicles and buses. Further the company leases office blocks workshops factories and warehouses; and manufactures laundry and bath soaps under the Marang Olga and Fusion brand names. Sefalana Holding Company Limited was founded in 1974 and is headquartered in Gaborone Botswana.

Name: Salmones Camanchaca S.A.
Description: Salmones Camanchaca S.A. engages in the salmon farming business in Chile. The company offers Atlantic and Coho salmon products in various formats such as whole fillet portion and other products including bits and pieces harasu and scrape meat. It also exports its products. Salmones Camanchaca S.A. was incorporated in 2009 and is based in Puerto Montt Chile. Salmones Camanchaca S.A. (SNSE:SALMOCAM) operates as a subsidiary of Camanchaca S.A. (SNSE:CAMANCHACA).

Name: Tukas Gida Sanayi ve Ticaret A.S.
Description: Tukas Gida Sanayi ve Ticaret A.S. together with its subsidiaries engages in the manufacture and sale of food products in Turkey and internationally. It offers tomato and pepper pastes dried and grated tomatoes sauces spreads and condiments; roasted and canned products; boiled products; and pickles ready to serve foods jams and olives as well as catering products. The company sells its products under the Tukas brand name. Tukas Gida Sanayi ve Ticaret A.S. was founded in 1962 and is headquartered in Izmir Turkey.

Name: Egyptian International Pharmaceutical Industries Company
Description: Egyptian International Pharmaceutical Industries Company manufactures and sells pharmaceutical ampoules in Egypt and internationally. The company offers analgesics and antipyretic; analgesics and anti-inflammatory; anti-infective; antihistamine; cardiovascular and metabolic; corticosteroids; gastrointestinal tract; nervous system; ophthalmic; respiratory; topical ointment and cream; vitamins; and miscellaneous products. It also exports its products. Egyptian International Pharmaceutical Industries Company was incorporated in 1980 and is based in 10th of Ramadan City Egypt.

Name: OceanPact Serviços Marítimos S.A.
Description: OceanPact Serviços Marítimos S.A. provides services related to the study protection monitoring and sustainable use of the sea coastline and marine resources in Brazil and internationally. It operates through two segments Vessels and Services. The company provides environmental services such as environmental protection oceanographic surveys environmental licensing and studies operational safety and environmental remediation; subsea services including geophysics geotechnics inspection repair and maintenance services as well as support services for construction and decommissioning activities; and logistics and engineering services comprising maritime logistics offshore support base and port and coastal engineering. It primarily serves the oil and gas sector as well as other sectors such as ports shipping mining energy and telecommunications. The company was incorporated in 2007 and is headquartered in Rio De Janeiro Brazil.

Name: Yeo Teknoloji Enerji Ve Endustri Anonim Sirketi
Description: Yeo Teknoloji Enerji Ve Endustri Anonim Sirketi engages in the design engineering procurement integration installation and commissioning of automation electrification and digitization solutions in Turkey and internationally. It offers electrification solutions comprising power distribution and transmission lines mobile substations medium voltage (MV) and low voltage (LV) digital electrification and e-house solutions; automation solutions such as process and factory automation power and energy automation robotics and IoT integrated automation solutions as well as MV and LV drives and motors; and solutions for soft starters and PLC DCS RTU and SCADA applications. It also provides digitalization solutions including IoT cloud connectivity condition monitoring connected smart infrastructure digital electrification manufacturing execution and remote assistance to drives; engineering solutions comprising automation systems high voltage transmission (HV) lines and HV substation design and engineering; and IoT and digital solutions and consultancy instrumentation and motors sizing and selection civil and mechanical engineering services and drives as well as MV and LV systems and auxiliary electrification system design. In addition it offers panel building products such as HV systems protection main distribution MCC compensation frequency convertors/soft starters automation systems type tests and customized and lightning panels; withdrawal switchgears; HV solutions comprising turnkey substations substation protection and automation products; gas air and hybrid gas insulated switchgears; steel and civil works for the substation; HV equipment MV switchgears transformers instruments and auxiliary electrification systems installation; and LV MCC and automation panel installation and other services as well as engages in energy production activities. The company was founded in 2004 and is based in Istanbul Turkey.

Name: Jamjoom Fashion Trading Company
Description: Jamjoom Fashion Trading Company engages in the retail of apparel and fashion products. The company offers lingerie nightwear and ready-to-wear under the Nayomi Mihyar and Dream brand names. It operates through stores and online. The company is based in Jeddah Saudi Arabia. Jamjoom Fashion Trading Company operates as a subsidiary of Kamal Osman Jamjoom Trading LLC (KSA).

Name: Vitru Brasil Empreendimentos Participações e Comércio S.A.
Description: Vitru Brasil Empreendimentos Participações e Comércio S.A. provides educational services in Brazil. It offers distance on-site undergraduate graduate technical and professional courses as well as continuing education and preparatory courses. The company operates campuses or via digital education through learning centers. It also offers bare and insulated copper cables for residential commercial and institutional construction projects; fibre-optic and copper conductor communication cables for government agencies and private and public companies; and high voltage and extra-high voltage power transmission cables including foundation fieldbus thermocouple fire resistant and lead sheathed cables. In addition the company offers copper rods plastics wooden reels and related products; engineering and project management services; aluminum and aluminum alloys rods wires and conductors; contracts trades in distributes and supplies cables electronic products information technology products and related supplies; and undertakes engineering construction and turnkey projects. Further it buys and sells electrical cables and related products; provides electrical power distribution and communications services; and manufactures and supplies electronic tools and goods. The company also exports its products to approximately 40 countries worldwide. Saudi Cable Company was founded in 1975 and is headquartered in Jeddah the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

Name: TSG IT Advanced Systems Ltd
Description: TSG IT Advanced Systems Ltd provides technological products and solutions for the fields of security civil service and the municipal sectors. The company offers control and control systems intelligence and information systems and emergency preparedness and treatment systems as well as telecommunications and IT artificial intelligence cyber security and telecom solutions. It also provides establishment and implementation of customer service centers; management of areas; and assets and infrastructure documentation and recording system and other solutions. The company serves government bodies military units local authorities businesses and industries. The company was founded in 1969 and is based in Or Yehuda Israel.

Name: Banco de Valores S.A.
Description: Banco de Valores S.A. provides various financial products and services in Argentina. The company offers financial and non-financial trusts; shares and debt issuance; mutual funds; and rating services. Banco de Valores S.A. was incorporated in 1977 and is based in Buenos Aires Argentina.

Name: Access Bank (Ghana) Plc
Description: Access Bank (Ghana) Plc provides various banking products and services primarily in Ghana. The company offers current savings and call accounts; fixed deposits; vehicle and personal loans term loan and overdrafts; investment advisory services; mobile and internet banking; money transfer; bancassurance; and dormant account reactivation as well as debit prepaid and credit cards. It also provides financing supply chain finance trade finance project and structured finance global trade cash management treasury and bonds and guarantees; payment and advisory services; and invoice discounting services. The company was incorporated in 2008 and is headquartered in Accra Ghana. Access Bank (Ghana) Plc is a subsidiary of Access Bank Plc.

Name: Dimed S.A. Distribuidora de Medicamentos
Description: Dimed S.A. Distribuidora de Medicamentos sells medicines perfumeries personal hygiene and beauty products cosmetics and dermo-cosmetics in Brazil. It operates through Retail and Wholesale segments. The company its products through distribution centers in the states of Rio Grande do Sul Paraná and Espírito Santo. The company operates through its stores in Rio Grande do Sul Santa Catarina Paraná and São Paulo. It offers its products under Panvel brand. In addition the company involved in purchasing selling brokering subdividing leasing renting managing and administering its owned and third-party properties. Dimed S.A. Distribuidora de Medicamentos was founded in 1920 and is headquartered in Eldorado do Sul Brazil.

Name: Zvi Sarfati & Sons Investments & Constructions Ltd.
Description: Zvi Sarfati & Sons Investments & Constructions Ltd. through its subsidiaries constructs and sells residential projects apartments and commercial spaces and offices in Israel. The company was founded in 1992 and is based in Rishon LeZion Israel.

Name: Hospital Mater Dei S.A.
Description: Hospital Mater Dei S.A. operates hospitals in Brazil. The company provides healthcare services such as hospitalizations surgeries oncology medical consultations exams and other services. It also engages in data and artificial intelligence business. The company was incorporated in 1973 and is headquartered in Belo Horizonte Brazil. Hospital Mater Dei S.A. is a subsidiary of JSS Empreendimentos e Administração LTDA.

Name: Arkaan Real Estate P.L.C
Description: Arkaan Real Estate P.L.C engages in the real estate development and investment activities in Palestine. The company develops and sells real estate properties such as housing tourism commercial and mixed-use lands. It also involved in the financial investment activities. The company was formerly known as Asas Al-Ard Company for Investments and Real Estate Development and changed its name to Arkaan Real Estate P.L.C in May 2022. Arkaan Real Estate P.L.C was incorporated in 2022 and is headquartered in Rawabi Palestinian Authority.

Name: Al Imtiaz Investment Group Company - K.S.C. (Public)
Description: Al Imtiaz Investment Group Company - K.S.C. (Public) an investment holding company manages a portfolio of investments across various sectors in Kuwait and internationally. It operates through Financial Services (Real Estate) Pharma Education Food and Beverage IT Solutions and Oil and Construction segments. The company invests in real estate industrial agriculture and other sectors; buys and sells in shares sukuk and other securities; develops the infrastructure of residential commercial and industrial areas; and manages real estate facilities by built operate and transfer system. It also invests in financial real estate and investment portfolios; and provides lending and guarantee services. In addition the company deals and trades in the foreign exchange and precious metals market. Further it owns property rights patents trademarks or industrial models franchising rights and other intangible rights. Additionally the company engages in real estate media general trading investment and educational catering services; and provision of IT professional audio visual and enterprise software solutions to public and private sectors as well as specialized graduate studies. It also offers grinding and packaging of spices grains and herbs; provides oil and construction services; and branded generic pharmaceuticals. The company was formerly known as Al Imtiaz Investment Company - K.S.C. (Public). Al Imtiaz Investment Group Company - K.S.C. (Public) was incorporated in 2005 and is based in Kuwait City Kuwait.

Name: Spear Reit Limited
Description: Spear REIT Limited (“Spear”) listed as a Real Estate Investment Trust (“REIT”) on the main board of the Johannesburg Stock Exchange (“JSE”) and is the only regionally-focused REIT listed on the JSE that predominantly invests in high-quality income-generating assets in the Western Cape. Spear obtains its diversification through asset type rather than geographical investment. The company conducts its business directly and through a number of subsidiaries collectively referred to as the “group”. The company’s property and asset management functions are internally and directly managed by the Spear executive management team.

Name: Marítima de Inversiones S.A.
Description: Maritima de Inversiones SA is a publicly owned investment manager. The firm manages equity and mutual funds. It invests in term deposits mutual Funds and stocks. The company was founded on March 19 1982 and is based in Santiago Chile.

Name: Rapac Communication & Infrastructure Ltd
Description: Rapac Communication & Infrastructure Ltd engages in trade commerce electrical projects government and electricity production businesses in Israel. It provides consultancy representation and distribution; program management and system integration; business development; engineering/technical support; entrepreneurship; and other support services for the defense community as well as markets communication missile avionics navigation microwave and other defense systems. The company also offers solutions for power generation transmission and distribution as well as for domestic industrial and government sectors; finance for projects to produce electricity. In addition it implements energy electricity and air-conditioning projects for power plants renewable and solar energy various industry telecom high-tech commercial and public buildings military and defense facilities electrical and telecom infrastructure and street lighting; manufactures electrical switchboards; constructs power stations and substations; and operates as an EPC contractor for PV projects. The company was formerly known as RAPAC Electronics Ltd. The company was incorporated in 1964 and is based in Netanya Israel.

Name: National Industries Company - KPSC
Description: National Industries Company - KPSC engages in the manufacturing and marketing of building and constructing materials and infrastructure products in Kuwait the GCC and the Middle East. It operates through four segments: Building Materials and Contracting Services Oil Sector Real Estate and Investments. The company offers interlock yard tiles kerbstone garden benches and flower pots; cement cladding and limestone bricks; cladding bricks and materials; and mansory blocks. It also provides PPR fittings cPVC and uPVC pressure fittings uPVC sewerage and drainage systems uPVC conduit pipes and accessories and uPVC cable ducts. National Industries Company - KPSC was founded in 1960 and is based in Kuwait City Kuwait.

Name: Kingston Wharves Limited
Description: Kingston Wharves Limited provides multi-purpose port terminal and logistics services in Jamaica. It operates through Terminal Operations and Logistics Services segments. The company operates public wharves and stevedoring of vessels as well as warehousing and logistics facilities. It also involved in the provision of port security services; rents of ambient warehouses and cold storage facilities; and rents properties. In addition the company offers verified gross mass services for full container load shipment; logistics services including inventory management order fulfilment product assembling and labelling order picking and packaging customized freight transportation and distribution services warehousing and returns immediate short-term and long-term lease and postponement services; and contract labor services. Kingston Wharves Limited was incorporated in 1945 and is based in Kingston Jamaica.

Name: Vakko Tekstil ve Hazir Giyim Sanayi Isletmeleri A.S.
Description: Vakko Tekstil ve Hazir Giyim Sanayi Isletmeleri A.S. manufactures and sells ready-to-wear clothes for men and women under the Vakko brand in Turkey. The company offers dresses blouses knitwear jackets skirts pants shorts t-shirts and sweatshirts trousers and mont and kaban; jewelry hats belts socks bag accessories beanies and gloves; and scarves and shawls for women as well as beach wear swimwear bikinis sandals and slippers and accessories. It also provides suits jackets knitwear shirts t-shirts pants shorts outwear tuxedos underwear beach wears ties pocket square bow ties handkerchiefs belts socks bracelets cufflinks beanie hats gloves and scarves for men; shoes and bags; home décor and textile products; chocolates; and cosmetics. The company offers products through its stores as well as online. Vakko Tekstil ve Hazir Giyim Sanayi Isletmeleri A.S. was founded in 1934 and is based in Istanbul Turkey.

Name: Electreon Wireless Ltd
Description: Electreon Wireless Ltd engages in the research development and implementation of the wireless electric road system in Israel. The company offers static dynamic and semi-dynamic charging solutions for electric vehicles. Its wireless electric road system is a shared invisible platform that wirelessly charges commercial and passenger electric vehicles while driving. The company offers its solution for governments cities and fleet operators. Electreon Wireless Ltd was incorporated in 1992 and is based in Beit Yanai Israel.

Name: Sociedad Eléctrica del Sur Oeste S.A.
Description: Sociedad Eléctrica del Sur Oeste S.A. engages distribution of electricity in Peru. The company was formerly known as Electroperú S.A. and changed its name to Sociedad Eléctrica del Sur Oeste S.A. Sociedad Eléctrica del Sur Oeste S.A. was incorporated in 1905 and is based in Arequipa Peru.

Name: Kordsa Teknik Tekstil A.S.
Description: Kordsa Teknik Tekstil A.S. manufactures and sells vehicle tires and related products in North America South America Europe the Middle East Africa and Asia. The company offers rubber plastic and industrial fabrics products comprising of transmission rubber hoses and V-belts; and denier fiber and connection fabrics. It also produces and markets fabrics for mechanical rubber goods and other rubber reinforcement materials; converts various types of yarns into cord fabrics; and provides advanced composites to the civil aviation sector; and offers nylon 6 nylon 6.6 and polyethylene-terephthalate high modulus low shrinkage polyester as well as rayon heavy decitex yarns for use in tires and mechanical rubber goods. The company provides its products primarily to the tire construction and composite reinforcement industries. Kordsa Teknik Tekstil A.S. was formerly known as Kordsa Endüstriyel Iplik ve Kord Bezi Sanayi ve Ticaret Anonim Sirketi and changed its name to Kordsa Teknik Tekstil A.S. in March 2017. The company was incorporated in 1973 and is headquartered in Izmit Turkey. Kordsa Teknik Tekstil A.S. is a subsidiary of Haci Ömer Sabanci Holding A.S.

Name: Adgar Investments and Development Ltd
Description: Adgar Investments and Development Ltd engages in the real estate business in Israel Canada Poland and Belgium. The company invests in office space. It also develops income-producing office assets through land purchases and utilization of land reserves associated to various property holdings. Adgar Investments and Development Ltd was incorporated in 1977 and is based in Petah Tikva Israel. Adgar Investments and Development Ltd is a subsidiary of Direct I.D.I. Holdings Ltd.

Name: Terminal X Online Ltd.
Description: Terminal X Online Ltd. offers clothing footwear fashion accessories cosmetics and beauty products for men women and teenager under various brands through online. The company was incorporated in 2017 and is based in Bnei Brak Israel. Terminal X Online Ltd. operates as a subsidiary of Fox-Wizel Ltd.

Name: Balady Poultry Company
Description: Balady Poultry Company together with its subsidiaries produces poultry products in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia other GCC countries and internationally. The company offers whole and marinated chicken; and chicken parts including gizzards hearts breasts thighs whole chicken feet wings mix chicken pieces liver feet and legs as well as chicken fillet. It also engages in the rearing and production of laying boiler breeders and operation of its hatcheries; operation of slaughterhouses for the slaughter and preparation of poultry rabbit and bird meat; land transportation of refrigerated and frozen goods; wholesale of feed and non-pharmaceutical feed additives; and production of chilled and frozen meat poultry rabbits and birds as well as poultry feed. In addition the company is involved in the production of fertilizers from organic materials and potassium fertilizers; construction and renovation of residential and non-residential buildings such as schools hospitals and hotels; pharmaceutical sales agency; and construction of government buildings. The company was formerly known as Balady Poultry Trading Company. Balady Poultry Company was founded in 2006 and is headquartered in Khamis Mushait the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

Name: APM Terminals Bahrain B.S.C.
Description: APM Terminals Bahrain B.S.C. owns and operates Khalifa Bin Salman Port in Bahrain. The company offers container terminal services; general cargo services that handles various vessel types comprising dhows five-star cruise vessels various bulk and break-bulk vessels RORO and livestock; and engages in landside operations including less-than container loads (LCL)/ full container loads (FCL) stations containerization of cargo vehicle storage and long/short term storage solutions. It also provides break bulk and project cargo services; operates roll-on roll-off (RoRo) terminal that handles tractors buses trucks oversized cargo loaded on special flatbed mafi and lowboy trailers as well as new or used vehicle import and export and related services; and provides cruise terminal services. In addition the company offers marine services such as activities relating to pilotage and towage FCL LCL livestock domestic export/import transshipment and mooring. Further it provides container repair reefer documentation gate/yard and data and application programming interface store services. The company was incorporated in 2006 and is based in Muharraq Bahrain. APM Terminals Bahrain B.S.C. operates as a subsidiary of APM Terminals B.V.

Name: The Egyptian Satellite Company Nilesat
Description: The Egyptian Satellite Company Nilesat provides direct-to-home (DTH) broadcasting satellite broadband and other communication services in Egypt the Middle East and North Africa. It operates fleet of satellites including Nilesat 201 and Nilesat 301; and geostationary satellites that delivers a range of television channels radio stations and data and internet connectivity solutions to households businesses and governmental organizations. The company also offers satellite services including KA-BAND broadband services and KU-BAND and EXT. KU-BAND broadcasting services. In addition it provides teleport services such as OTT and video streaming satellite uplink and downlink services DTH playout and backhauling solutions and occasional TV solutions. Further the company offers gateway operations and consultancy services; broadcasting services including free-to-air and encrypted television channels radio stations and interactive services; satellite-based broadband and data services to support internet connectivity in underserved areas; and serves as a primary distribution platform for various Arabic-language broadcasters which includes content in various genres such as news sports entertainment and educational programming. The Egyptian Satellite Company Nilesat was founded in 1996 and is headquartered in 6th of October City Egypt.

Name: Dogus Gayrimenkul Yatirim Ortakligi A.S.
Description: Doğuş Gayrimenkul Yatırım Ortaklığı A.Ş. (“Company”) has been incorporated in accordance with capital market law on 25 July 1997. Doğuş Gayrimenkul Yatırım Ortaklığı A.Ş.’s (the “Company”) which is traded on the Borsa Istanbul main activity is to invest in properties create manage make the necessary changes in the portfolio minimize the risk of variation in real estate; property related capital market instruments invest and monitor continuously the real estate based projects and take the necessary measures to protect also research to increase the value of the portfolio. The headquarter of the Company is registered in Doğuş Center Maslak Maslak Mahallesi Ahi Evran Cad. No: 4/23 Maslak Sarıyer-İstanbul.

Name: SDT Uzay ve Savunma Teknolojileri Anonim Sirketi
Description: Sdt Uzay Ve Savunma Teknolojileri Anonim Sirketi engages in the production and sale of defense electronics and software products. The company offers radar systems communication systems electronic warfare systems platform management systems weapon systems digital data recorders air combat training systems land combat training systems naval combat training systems synthetic aperture radars and RF jammer systems. It also provides precision and wing assisted guidance kit electronics image processing and analysis software aircraft arresting systems satellite ground stations satellite signal/data processing and analysis systems associated electronic and avionics systems of aerial platforms and weapon guidance electronics and simulation/information systems as well as electronic units for land platforms. The company was incorporated in 2005 and is headquartered in Ankara Turkey.

Name: Zamp S.A.
Description: Zamp S.A. engages in the restaurant business in Brazil. It operates and franchises restaurants under the Burger King and Popeyes brands. The company was formerly known as BK Brasil Operação e Assessoria a Restaurantes S.A. The company was incorporated in 2011 and is based in São Paulo Brazil.

Name: Academy of Learning Company
Description: Academy of Learning Company operates education and training institutes in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. The company’s training program includes diploma in accounting and taxation hotel and resort management marketing and e-commerce supply chain management and logistics insurance and risk management business administration graphic design cyber security artificial intelligence occupational safety and health public relations and media event organization and management and human resources. It also engages in the wholesale of computers and accessories including printers and inks; and real estate investment activities. Academy of Learning Company was incorporated in 2004 and is headquartered in Dammam the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

Name: Cartavio S.A.A.
Description: Cartavio S.A.A. engages in the cultivation processing and industrialization of sugarcane in Peru. It produces refined white and brown sugar; rectified and industrial ethyl alcohol; and other products such as molasses and bagasse. The company was incorporated in 1970 and is based in Cartavio Peru. Cartavio S.A.A. operates as a subsidiary of Corporación Azucarera del Perú S.A.

Name: Accel S.A.B. de C.V.
Description: Accel S.A.B. de C.V. provides manufacturing and logistics services in Mexico and the United States. The company’s Manufacturing division manufactures and produces sweets nuts confectionery and various snacks as well as engages in real estate activities. Its Logistics division offers solutions for the handling conservation marketing and distribution of merchandise; merchandise collection delivery and selection; and inventory control packaging and labeling crossing platform and other services. Accel S.A.B. de C.V. was incorporated in 1979 and is headquartered in Mexico City Mexico.

Name: Boa Safra Sementes S.A.
Description: Boa Safra Sementes S.A. produces and sells soybean seeds in Brazil. It also offers corn and bean seeds. The company was founded in 2009 and is based in Formosa Brazil.

Name: Taaleem Management Services Company S.A.E.
Description: Taaleem Management Services Company provides private higher education and skills-based learning services in Egypt. It operates Nahda University Badya University and Memphis University. The company was formerly known as Bisco Investment Company and changed its name to Taaleem Management Services Company S.A.E. in July 2016. The company was founded in 2014 and is headquartered in Giza Egypt.

Name: Les Eaux Minérales d'Oulmès S.A.
Description: Les Eaux Minérales d'Oulmès S.A. captures produces bottles and markets still and carbonated natural mineral waters in Morocco. It is involved in the manufacture and sale of preforms as well as bottling and marketing of table water. The company offers its products under the Sidi Ali Oulmès Aïn Atlas Vitalya Bahia Purifya Glass' Orangina Fifa of Sainte Luce and DIAM brands. Les Eaux Minérales d'Oulmès S.A. was founded in 1933 and is headquartered in Casablanca Morocco.

Name: Navarino S.A.
Description: Navarino S.A. through its subsidiaries manufactures and sells steel parts for mining and grinding balls in Chile and internationally. It is also involved in the glass packaging business. Navarino S.A. was incorporated in 1989 and is based in Santiago Chile.

Name: Banque Nationale Agricole Société anonyme
Description: Banque Nationale Agricole Société anonyme provides various banking products and services in Tunisia. The company offers savings foreign currency and convertible dinar accounts as well as personal business agricultural and professional financing. It also provides investment products remote banking bancassurance TPE affiliation AVA business travel allowance and MoneyGram services as well as international services and credit cards. The company was incorporated in 1959 and is headquartered in Tunis Tunisia.

Name: ASAS Makeen Real Estate Development and Investment Company
Description: ASAS Makeen Real Estate Development and Investment Company engages in the real estate development activities. It develops villas townhouses residential apartments commercial and hotel compounds and apartments. The company also rents villas townhouses residential apartments and apartments. ASAS Makeen Real Estate Development and Investment Company was founded in 2010 and is based in Riyadh Saudi Arabia.

Name: Oncoclínicas do Brasil Serviços Médicos S.A.
Description: Oncoclínicas do Brasil Serviços Médicos S.A. together with its subsidiaries provides oncology hematology radiotherapy and genomics healthcare services in Latin America. The company offers treatment services including radiotherapy hormone therapy immunotherapy port-a-cath palliative care target therapy breast cancer hormone therapy bone marrow transplant non-oncological infusions chemotherapy oral chemotherapy and prostate cancer hormone therapy; and surgery procedures such as breast head and neck lung prostate cancer stomach bladder cancer oncological kidney cancer gynecological and testicular cancer. It also provides diagnostics services comprising pathological analysis genetic testing molecular journey personalized medicine and individualized treatment myelogram-bone marrow biopsy and ONCO test-PDO. In addition the company offers treatment support services which include veinviewer cryotherapy integrative medicine and DeLife as well as hilotherapy laser therapy OC care line OC precision medicine OncoACCESS survivorship and telemedicine services. Oncoclínicas do Brasil Serviços Médicos S.A. was founded in 2010 and is headquartered in São Paulo Brazil.

Name: Sönmez Filament Sentetik Iplik ve Elyaf Sanayi A.S.
Description: Sönmez Filament Sentetik Iplik ve Elyaf Sanayi A.S. manufactures and sells yarns and fibers in Turkey. It offers poy plain textured twisted and dyed yarns for the automotive industry as well as high flap yarns. The company also engages in leasing of real estates. Sönmez Filament Sentetik Iplik ve Elyaf Sanayi A.S. was incorporated in 1972 and is headquartered in Bursa Turkey.

Name: Tourism Enterprise Company (Shams)
Description: Tourism Enterprise Company (Shams) engages in managing of tourism projects in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. The company manages hotels furnished residential units chalets tourist inns resorts wedding halls and events. It also manages camps restaurants coffee shops cafeterias and tourist accommodation facilities. In addition the company operates entertainment centers and facilities amusement parks and other recreational activities as well as rents bicycles. Further it owns and operates the Palm Beach Resort. The company was founded in 1991 and is based in Dammam the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

Name: Trisul S.A.
Description: Trisul S.A. engages in the construction and development of real estate properties in Brazil. It is also involved in the subdivision of plots of land; and purchase and sale of properties. The company develops real estate projects including with ownership interest of third parties. Trisul S.A. was founded in 2007 and is headquartered in São Paulo Brazil.

Name: The Gold Bond Group Ltd.
Description: The Gold Bond Group Ltd. engages in the storage conveyance and logistical solutions for cargoes and containers. It provides terminal services such as container and cargo terminal customs supervision storage and unload containers train transport and storage and transport hazardous cargo; and advanced logistics services including temperature and climate warehouse wash TK and tankers storage RF containers and e-commerce warehouse as well as rents heavy forklifts. It serves importers and exporters delivery companies customs brokers and maritime companies. The company was formerly known as H.M.N Paper Products Factory Ltd. and changed its name to The Gold Bond Group Ltd. in February 1994. The Gold Bond Group Ltd. was incorporated in 1963 and is based in Ashdod Israel.

Name: Palmci S.A.
Description: Palmci S.A. engages in the management of oil palm plantations in Ivory Coast. The company produces and sells crude palm and palm kernel oil. It also engages in the production of natural rubber cane sugar and biomass. The company was founded in 1997 and is headquartered in Abidjan Ivory Coast.

Name: Kepler Weber S.A.
Description: Kepler Weber S.A. provides grain storage equipment and post-harvest grain solutions in Brazil the Americas Africa Europe and Asia. The company operates through five segments: Farms Agroindustry Ports and Terminals Replacement and Services and International Business. The company offers grain storage and preservation systems such as silos dryers cleaning machines and related components; belt semi-enclosed belt enclosed belt and chain conveyors; sweep augers screw conveyors elevators dispatch hoppers heat generators catwalks and structures and metallic structures; industrial equipment; and port terminals. It also provides spare parts and technical assistance services; technical engineering and data processing services; engineering risk insurance services; and grain temperature and moisture monitoring services in the processing and storage process. The company was founded in 1925 and is headquartered in São Paulo Brazil.

Name: Compagnie Ivoirienne d'Électricité (CIE) S.A.
Description: Compagnie Ivoirienne d'Électricité (CIE) S.A. engages in the production transmission and distribution of electricity in West Africa. The company also engages in the production of drinking water. In addition it provides management of public services. The company was founded in 1990 and is headquartered in Abidjan Ivory Coast.

Name: Wiz Co Participações e Corretagem de Seguros S.A.
Description: Wiz Co Participações e Corretagem de Seguros S.A. operates as an insurance broker in Brazil. The company offers financial and insurance products including individual and corporate insurance consortia capitalization and private pension plans. It is involved in prospecting activation support insurance and financial products through car dealership networks and training for the sale of credit and credit-related insurance products. The company was formerly known as Wiz Soluções e Corretagem de Seguros S.A. Wiz Co Participações e Corretagem de Seguros S.A. was founded in 1973 and is headquartered in Brasília Brazil.

Name: Emilia Development (O.F.G) Ltd.
Description: Emilia Development (O.F.G) Ltd. manages a portfolio of investments in field of distribution logistics and industry services in Israel. The company provides hazardous industrial and medical waste treatment as well as environmental protection services; sampling and analysis services to the food agriculture pharma cosmetics and environmental industries; and logistic services as well as distributes chemicals and raw materials to the food and beverage agriculture plastics construction paint detergent cosmetics pharma and energy industries; operates lab for occupational and environmental monitoring; and accompanies consults and monitors the food and agricultural sectors. It is also involved in the production import market and distribution of pipes valves and fittings for the construction plumbing sanitation infrastructure firefighting HVAC and special metals industries; importing processing marketing and distributing of metals and steels; technical and engineering composites for liquid transportation water desalination and the chip processing industries; and sanitary devices faucets tubs shower stalls and wet room complementary products. In addition the company manufactures polyethylene pipes; and provides ground transport services for containers and cargoes. Emilia Development (O.F.G) Ltd. was incorporated in 1945 and is based in Ramat Gan Israel.

Name: Emirates Reem Investments Company P.J.S.C
Description: Emirates Reem Investments Company P.J.S.C together with its subsidiaries engages in the bottling distribution and trading of mineral water carbonated drinks soft drinks juices and evaporated milk in the United Arab Emirates rest of the Middle East and Africa. It operates through Land and Building Leasing Corporate and Operations segments. The company also manufactures plastic bottles cups and containers; and engages in the leasing of investment property warehouses. It markets and sells its products under the Jeema and AL REEM brand names. Emirates Reem Investments Company P.J.S.C was formerly known as Emirates Refreshments (P.S.C.) and changed its name to Emirates Reem Investments Company P.J.S.C in August 2023. The company was incorporated in 1980 and is headquartered in Dubai the United Arab Emirates.

Name: Metalfrio Solutions S.A.
Description: Metalfrio Solutions S.A. together with its subsidiaries manufactures imports and sells domestic and commercial refrigerators and freezers in Brazil Turkey Mexico the United States and internationally. The company offers horizontal and vertical freezers and refrigerators conservators inverters storage units ice cream freezers beverage displays coolers breweries display and glass doors beer max and all black equipment under the Metalfrio Klimasan Derby and Caravell brands. It also provides maintenance and technical assistance; sells spare parts; offers logistic services; leases related goods and services; and refurbishment services. The company exports its products. Metalfrio Solutions S.A. was founded in 1960 and is headquartered in São Paulo Brazil.

Name: Escar Filo Kiralama Hizmetleri A.S.
Description: Escar Filo Kiralama Hizmetleri A.S. provides motor vehicle renting services in Turkey. The company offers various services including roadside assistance car rental insurances consulting service tire management spare vehicle door to door service and online fleet reporting. Escar Filo Kiralama Hizmetleri A.S. was incorporated in 2001 and is based in Istanbul Turkey.

Name: Ofis Yem Gida Sanayi ve Ticaret A.S.
Description: Ofis Yem Gida Sanayi ve Ticaret A.S. produces and sells feeds for the livestock sector in Turkey. It offers ovine calf fattening milk and poultry feeds under the Ofis Yem brand. The company was incorporated in 1997 and is headquartered in Ankara Turkey.

Name: Altin Yunus Çesme Turistik Tesisler A.S.
Description: Altin Yunus Çesme Turistik Tesisler A.S. operates a hotel in Turkey. It provides various facilities that covers wedding and banquet meeting and conference spa and catering as well as events. The company was founded in 1972 and is based in Izmir Turkey. Altin Yunus Çesme Turistik Tesisler A.S. is a subsidiary of Yasar Holding A.S.

Name: Banco Popular S.A.
Description: Banco Popular S.A. provides banking products and services in Colombia. The company offers debit and credit cards; savings and current accounts; CDT term deposits; investment and voluntary pension funds; housing and investment credits; protection and insurance; tax payment; and customer service and payment channels; cash management; working capital; development credits; commercial consumer mortgage and microcredit loans; financial leasing; and money table products and services as well as digital wallet. It also provides overdraft real estate and machinery and equipment leasing; collection with barcode PSE payment to suppliers payment of payroll and tax and national referenced collection; and foreign trade services including import and export credit portfolio guarantees and warranties and import and export financing. Banco Popular S.A. was incorporated in 1950 and is based in Bogotá Colombia. Banco Popular S.A. is a subsidiary of Grupo Aval Acciones y Valores S.A.

Name: Ser Educacional S.A.
Description: Ser Educacional S.A. together with its subsidiaries develops and manages activities for on-campus and distance-learning undergraduate graduate and professional training courses and other education-related areas in Brazil. It offers undergraduate post graduate on-campus and digital learning and vocational courses. Name: Drake and Scull International P.J.S.C.
Description: Drake and Scull International P.J.S.C. together with its subsidiaries engages in construction activities in the United Arab Emirates Saudi Arabia Kuwait Egypt Oman Germany Algeria India Iraq Jordan and internationally. The company operates in Finance and Investments segments. The Finance segment provides consumer credit leasing card acquiring and issuing insurance and factoring services. Name: Akfen Gayrimenkul Yatirim Ortakligi A.S.
Description: Akfen Real Estate Investment Trust Inc. (the Company" or "Akfen GYO") was formed through the rebranding transformation and restructuring of Aksel Tourism Investments and Management Inc. ("Aksel") into a real estate investment trust. Aksel was initially established on June 25 1997 as a partnership between Hamdi Akın and Yüksel Construction Inc. to invest in the domestic tourism sector. Subsequently Yüksel Construction Inc.'s shares were acquired by Akfen Holding Inc. ("Akfen Holding") in 2006 and the Company became a subsidiary of Akfen Holding. August 6 2018 1000 Group A and 1000 Group D preferred shares of Akfen GYO owned by Akfen Holding were transferred to Hamdi Akın who is the indirect ultimate owner of the management control of these shares. The Company's main field of activity is to invest in real estate- based capital market instruments to create and develop a real estate portfolio and to engage in the written objectives and subjects described in Articles 5 23 and 25 of the CMB's Communiqué on Principles Regarding Real Estate Investment Trusts (Series III No: 48.1). In 2005 the Company signed a framework agreement with ACCOR SA one of the world's leading hotel chains to develop hotel projects in Turkey under the Novotel and Ibis Hotel brands. The Company primarily develops hotel projects under the Novotel and Ibis Hotel brands and operates under the auspices of Tamaris Turizm A.Ş. a 100% subsidiary of ACCOR SA in Turkey. (“Tamaris”). The Company was listed on Borsa Istanbul (BIST) on 11 May 2011."
