The company was formerly known as Paz Ashdod Refinery Ltd. and changed its name to Ashdod Refinery Ltd in September 2023. Ashdod Refinery Ltd was founded in 1973 and is based in Ashdod Israel.

Name: Financiera Oh! S.A.
Description: Financiera Oh! S.A. a finance company provides financial products services in Peru. The company offers fixed term deposit CTS and savings accounts; cash credit and other loans; credit cards; and insurance against card protection cancer cell phone and others. The company was formerly known as Financiera Uno S.A. and changed its name to Financiera Oh! S.A. on July 15 2016. Financiera Oh! S.A. was incorporated in 2009 and is based in Lima Peru. Financiera Oh! S.A. is a subsidiary of IFH Retail Corporation.

Name: Socovesa S.A.
Description: Socovesa S.A. engages in the real estate development and construction businesses under the Almagro Socovesa Pilares and Desarrollos Comerciales brands in Chile. The company constructs various projects such as houses buildings bridges roads dams irrigation works tunnels ports airports and earthworks. It also develops high-rise housing projects. Socovesa S.A. was founded in 1965 and is based in Providencia Chile.

Name: Zur Shamir Holdings Ltd
Description: Zur Shamir Holdings Ltd through its subsidiaries operates in the insurance consumer credit and real estate markets in Israel. The company provides insurance products such as compulsory car property car property general medical expenses and hospitalization personal disability critical illness travel abroad life insurance and savings and other health insurance as well as savings products. It is also involved in the direct financing activity; and provision of loans for purchase of vehicles products and services as well as investment in real estate assets. The company was formerly known as Zur and changed to its name to Zur Shamir Holdings Ltd in February 1997. The company was founded in 1957 and is based in Petah Tikva Israel.

Name: C.A. Ron Santa Teresa
Description: C.A. Ron Santa Teresa operates a distillery in Venezuela. It produces rums from sugarcane as well as cocktails. The company was founded in 1796 and is based in El Consejo Venezuela.

Name: Novolog (Pharm-Up 1966) Ltd
Description: Novolog (Pharm-Up 1966) Ltd provides healthcare services in Israel. The company operates through three divisions: Logistics Health Services and Digital. The Logistics division engages in the import and distribution of medicine and medical products; logistics of clinical trials and related services; provision of pharmaceutical services to customers; and sterilization and validation processes of consumable medical equipment. The Health Services division provides customized medicine medical and diagnostic laboratory and other medical services to patients health organizations insurance companies multinational companies and government bodies. The Digital division develops technological tools for health services; deals with making medical information accessible to the public through medical websites; promotes digital presence for clinics doctors therapists and medical bodies; provides services and management tools; and operates and markets digital platforms for doctors and clinics. Novolog (Pharm-Up 1966) Ltd was incorporated in 1966 and is headquartered in Modi'in-Maccabim-Re'ut Israel.

Name: Kardan Israel Ltd
Description: Kardan Israel Ltd. through its subsidiaries engages in the real estate business in Israel and the United States. It locates initiates and develops residential buildings in Israel for sale; demolishes and rebuilds properties for urban renewal; develops sells and rents office buildings and commercial areas; and invests in real estate properties. The company also provides contractor services for the construction of residential buildings commercial buildings public buildings etc. In addition it is involved in the development sale and rental of logistics real estate complexes such as server farm commerce office and cold storage buildings. The company was incorporated in 1982 and is based in Tel Aviv Israel.

Name: Axelerated Solutions for Information and Communication Technology Company
Description: Axelerated Solutions for Information and Communication Technology Company provides IT solutions in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. The company offers infrastructure solutions including data center infrastructure deployment migrations services and disaster recovery and business continuity solutions; cyber security solutions such as identity and access management privileged access management mobile device management encryption and single sign on and multi-factor authentication solutions; managed services; and system integration services including automation implementation. It serves telecom and service providers banks healthcare manufacturing government military and retail business sectors. The company was founded in 2015 and is based in Riyadh the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

Name: Mpact Limited
Description: Mpact Limited engages in the paper and plastic packaging and recycling business in South Africa and internationally. It operates through Paper and Plastics segments. The company offers recycled-based packaging and industrial paper such as containerboard and carton board and other materials; corrugated packaging products; bags; and sacks as well as plastic packaging solutions. It serves packaging converters fruit producers FMCG companies and quick restaurant sectors as well as food beverage personal care home care pharmaceutical agricultural and retail markets. The company is based in Johannesburg South Africa.

Name: Al Jouf Cement Company
Description: Al Jouf Cement Company engages in production and sale of cement in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. It provides sulfate-resistant cement ordinary Portland cement Super 20 cement and finishing cement. The company also engages in the provision of marketing services; land transport of goods; and import export wholesale and retail trade of cement products. Its products are used in various application such as various types of concrete structures and foundations civil and construction projects reinforced concrete works pipes and cement brick factories as well as finishing works. The company was founded in 2006 and is based in Riyadh the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

Name: Bank of Baroda (Uganda) Limited
Description: Bank of Baroda (Uganda) Limited provides commercial banking services in Uganda. It offers various deposit products including savings accounts current accounts festival flexible recurring deposits monthly and quarterly income plan for fixed deposit and fixed/short-term deposit accounts. The company also provides loans/advances such as salary multi-purpose housing loans against bank's deposits education traders business and short-term loans; financing against warehouse/storage receipts sales invoice financing suppliers bill discounting and asset finance products as well as loans against future rent receivables and bank deposits. In addition it offers non-fund based services/products comprising letter of credit and bank guarantee services; funds transfer services; foreign exchange services; and lockers Internet banking ATM cards and tax collection services as well as invests in government securities such as treasury bills and treasury bonds. Further the company provides equity brokering services; and investment advisory securities trading securities exchanges listing sponsoring services and remittance services as well as other digital channels comprising mobile banking cash recyclers agent banking SMS alerts automated account statement website and call center services. The company was founded in 1953 and is headquartered in Kampala Uganda. Bank of Baroda (Uganda) Limited operates as a subsidiary of Bank of Baroda Limited.

Name: Societe Generale Ghana PLC
Description: Societe Generale Ghana PLC engages in the provision of retail corporate and investment banking services in Ghana. It operates through three segments: Retail Banking Corporate Banking and Treasury. The company offers current and savings accounts; consumer appliance institutional auto home chat CAGD and cash covered loans as well as relief credit; treasury services overdrafts revolving advance factoring trade finance and working capital loans; term loans comprising asset financing finance leasing and project financing; safe deposit boxes; and insurance products comprising drive cash home eduflex and funeral insurance. It also provides cash management services including merchant/point-of-sale terminal acquiring bill/fees payment reporting account flow and liquidity management cash and electronic banking services as well as business cards; working capital finance that include project and infrastructure industrial project acquisition and structured corporate finance as well as syndicated loans and leverage buy outs; and trade finance services comprising letters of credit guarantees documentary collection standby letters of credit and avalised bills and bills discounting; and treasury services. In addition the company offers investment banking services as well as invests in liquid assets such as short-term placements and government debt securities. It serves individuals clients institutional clients and businesses. The company was formerly known as Societe Generale Ghana Limited and changed its name to Societe Generale Ghana PLC. Societe Generale Ghana PLC was incorporated in 1975 and is headquartered in Accra Ghana. Societe Generale Ghana PLC operates as a subsidiary of SG Financial Services Holding SA.

Name: Americanas S.A.
Description: Americanas S.A. operates in the e-commerce business in Brazil. It offers e-commerce digital platform for various digital solutions. The company operates Americanas.com an online store with various products; Submarino a digital brand in books games technology and entertainment; Shoptime an online brand in books games technology and entertainment; Ame a platform for financial and non-financial products and services; and Puket an online clothing platform; MinD an online design and home decoration platform. In addition it provides imaginarium a multi-brand e-commerce channels; Lovebrands an online platform that offers various products and services; Skoob a virtual library platform as well as operates a retail chain of fruits and vegetables under Hortifruti Natural da Terra brand. Americanas S.A. was founded in 1999 and is headquartered in Rio de Janeiro Brazil.

Name: Peña Verde S.A.B.
Description: Peña Verde S.A.B. offers insurance and reinsurance services in Mexico Latin America the Caribbean and internationally. It offers life personal accident health civil liability and professional risks maritime and transportation fire automobiles credit agricultural and animal earthquake and other catastrophic risks insurance products. The company was formerly known as Minera Peña Verde SA and changed its name to Peña Verde S.A.B. in 1978. The company was incorporated in 1971 and is based in Mexico City Mexico.

Name: A'ayan Real Estate Company K.S.C.P.
Description: A'ayan Real Estate Company K.S.C.P. together with its subsidiaries engages in the real estate development and investment activities in Kuwait and rest of GCC countries. The company operates through Project Management Investments Property Management and Others segments. It owns trades in leases and rents real estate properties; buys develops owns and sells land; and develops establishes and manages commercial residential tourist infrastructure and industrial projects. The company also engages in contracting business related to real estate; trading of construction materials and building supplies; and the provision of building maintenance services. In addition it invests in owns operates manages rents and leases hotels health clubs tourist facilities restaurants and cafeterias residential complexes shops and sports projects. Further the company is involved in the exploitation of investing surplus funds in portfolios. Additionally it invests in and establishes engineering laboratories associated with real estate investment; and provides real estate consultancy services. The company was founded in 1976 and is headquartered in Kuwait City Kuwait.

Name: Hareket Proje Tasimaciligi Ve Yuk Muhendisligi Anonim Sirketi
Description: Hareket Proje Tasimaciligi Ve Yuk Muhendisligi Anonim Sirketi provides heavy lifting and transportation services with engineering solutions in Turkey Europe Asia the Middle East and Africa. It offers load out services equipment rental and renewable energy solutions as well as rigging engineering and transport survey consultancy. The company also provides project planning route surveys lift engineering project management and installation services. It serves petrochemical renewable energy and power industries as well as offshore projects. The company was founded in 1957 and is headquartered in Istanbul Turkey.

Name: Saudi Marketing Company
Description: Saudi Marketing Company engages in the retail trading and importing business in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. It operates through three segments: Retail Household and Entertainment Service. The company is involved in wholesale and retail of foodstuffs household consumables toys textiles and stationery products. It also provides marketing services; fast food items and cold and hot beverages; operates and manages bakeries restaurants and coffee shops; and establishes operates and maintains amusement centers. The company operates under the Farm Superstores name. Saudi Marketing Company was founded in 1978 and is based in Dammam Saudi Arabia.

Name: Beta Glass Plc
Description: Beta Glass Plc manufactures distributes and sells glass bottles and containers in Nigeria and internationally. The company also offers crowns and crates. Its products are used by soft drinks breweries wine and spirits pharmaceutical food and cosmetics companies. The company also exports its products to Ghana Burkina Faso Benin Republic Cameroon Gabon Republic of Congo Angola Mauritius South Africa Côte d’Ivoire Sierra Leone Guinea and Liberia. The company was incorporated in 1974 and is headquartered in Lagos Nigeria. Beta Glass Plc is a subsidiary of Frigoglass Industries Nigeria Limited.

Name: The Kenya Power and Lighting Company Plc
Description: The Kenya Power and Lighting Company Plc engages in the transmission distribution and retail of electricity in Kenya. It purchases electricity generated from geothermal hydro thermal solar cogeneration and wind sources. The company was formerly known as East Africa Power & Lighting Limited and changed its name to The Kenya Power and Lighting Company Plc in October 1983. The Kenya Power and Lighting Company Plc was incorporated in 1922 and is headquartered in Nairobi Kenya.

Name: Collins Property Group Limited
Description: Collins Property Group Limited an investment holding company owns develops manages and leases real estate properties. Its portfolio includes retail office industrial residential and leisure properties. The company is also involved in the ownership and development of commercial properties as well as provision of rental and treasury services. It operates in South Africa Mozambique Namibia Zambia Austria Switzerland Luxembourg Malta and Mauritius. The company was formerly known as Tradehold Limited and changed its name to Collins Property Group Limited in June 2023. Collins Property Group Limited was incorporated in 1970 and is based in Umhlanga South Africa.

Name: Globrands Ltd.
Description: Globrands Ltd. distributes consumer goods in Israel. The company operates through Smoking Products Sector; Sweet and Snacks Sector; and Other Sector segments. It is involved in the importation sale and distribution of tobacco products and smoking products including cigarettes rolling tobacco lighters and papers to roll; distribution sale and marketing of sweets and snacks; and distribution of non-prescription pharmaceutical products. In addition the company imports and distributes cigarettes under the Natural American Spirit Camel Winston Kent Pall Mall Vogue Rothmans and Golden Virginia brands. It serves its products to retail customers and multinational corporations. The company was incorporated in 2000 and is based in Tel Aviv Israel.

Name: Vakif Gayrimenkul Yatirim Ortakligi AS
Description: Vakif Gayrimenkul Yatirim Ortakligi AS is a real estate investment trust. Vakif Gayrimenkul Yatirim Ortakligi AS is based in Turkey. Vakif Gayrimenkul Yatirim Ortakligi AS operates as a subsidiary of Türkiye Vakiflar Bankasi Türk Anonim Ortakligi.

Name: Besiktas Futbol Yatirimlari Sanayi ve Ticaret A.S.
Description: Besiktas Futbol Yatirimlari Sanayi ve Ticaret A.S. engages in professional football activities in Turkey. The company invests in professional football teams; and establishes and operates football facilities. Besiktas Futbol Yatirimlari Sanayi ve Ticaret A.S. was founded in 1995 and is based in Istanbul Turkey.

Name: KAMCO Investment Company K.S.C.P.
Description: KAMCO Investment Company K.S.C.P. is a publicly owned investment manager. The firm also provides wealth management forward trading access to IPOs and advisory services to its clients. It provides its services to individual institutional clients ultra-high net worth individuals high net worth clients family offices sovereigns endowments foundations and corporate. The firm manages customized portfolios and mutual funds for its clients. It invests in the public equity fixed income and alternative investments markets across the globe with a focus on the MENA region. The firm employs quantitative analysis to make its investments. It makes its investments in the securities of companies operating across diversified sectors. The firm conducts in-house research to make its investments. KAMCO Investment Company K.S.C.P. was formerly known as Kipco Asset Management Company K.S.C.C. till December 07 2014. KAMCO Investment Company K.S.C.P. was founded in September 28 1998 and is based in Sharq Kuwait. KAMCO Investment Company K.S.C.P. operates as a subsidiary of United Gulf Bank B.S.C. (E.C.).

Name: Hod Assaf Industries Ltd.
Description: Hod Assaf Industries Ltd. engages in the production processing and sale of steel products in Israel and Romania. The company offers welded mesh profile fences gates and screens light mesh fences and other fencing products. Its products are used in construction infrastructure security and agricultural sectors and industries. Hod Assaf Industries Ltd. was incorporated in 1947 and is based in Acre Israel.

Name: Akmerkez Gayrimenkul Yatirim Ortakligi A.S.
Description: Akmerkez Gayrimenkul Yatirim Ortakligi A.S. operates as a real estate investment association in Turkey. It engages in the investment ownership development and rental of real estate properties primarily shopping centers. The company was formerly known as Akmerkez Gayrimenkul Yatirimi A.S. and changed its name to Akmerkez Gayrimenkul Yatirim Ortakligi A.S. in February 2005. Akmerkez Gayrimenkul Yatirim Ortakligi A.S. is based in Istanbul Turkey.

Name: Mondi Tire Kutsan Kagit ve Ambalaj Sanayi A.S.
Description: Mondi Tire Kutsan Kagit ve Ambalaj Sanayi A.S. together with its subsidiaries engages in the production and sale of corrugated containerboards. It offers tray and hood perforated boxes; bottle carrier boxes; corrugated packaging solutions for fresh fruits and vegetables; corrugated wrap around boxes; deppo boxes; octabin boxes; tanker boxes; kit modules; solar panel boxes; and automotive logistic packaging solutions. The company also provides e-commerce packaging solutions such as envelop mailers delight boxes e-grocery boxes sizeme boxes and floral boxes. It offers a range of packaging solution for industrial applications as well as food beverage and retail sectors. The company operates in approximately 30 countries including Turkey Europe Asia North America and Africa. The company was incorporated in 1974 and is headquartered in Istanbul Turkey. The company operates as a subsidiary of Mondi Corrugated B.V.

Name: Bikurey Hasade Group Ltd
Description: Bikurey Hasade (Holdings) Ltd. engages in growing marketing and distributing fresh vegetables and fruits in Israel and internationally. The company also provides various shipping and collection solutions for agricultural produce from the growers at a controlled temperature; multi-purpose plastic packaging and pallet services; and accounting services for the agricultural field personal treatment and close accompaniment. Bikurey Hasade (Holdings) Ltd. was incorporated in 1996 and is based in Kiryat Malakhi Israel.

Name: Central Costanera S.A.
Description: Central Costanera S.A. generates transports trades and distributes electrical energy in Argentina. It owns and operates four conventional turbo steam units with an installed capacity of 661 MW; two cycles energy plant with an installed capacity of 851 MW; a gas turbine; and a BTH steam turbine with an installed capacity of 277 MW. The company provides engineering consultancy and management services for operation of electrical power plants. The company was formerly known as Enel Generación Costanera S.A. and changed its name to Central Costanera S.A. in March 2023. The company was incorporated in 1992 and is based in Buenos Aires Argentina. The company operates as a subsidiary of Enel Argentina S.A.
Industry: Independent Power and Renewable Electricity Producers

Name: Misr Beni Suef Cement Co. S.A.E
Description: Misr Beni Suef Cement Co. S.A.E produces and sells cement products in Egypt and internationally. The company offers clinker and Portland pozzolana cement products. It also exports its products as bulk or bagged cement. The company was founded in 1997 and is headquartered in Cairo Egypt.

Name: Gozde Girisim Sermayesi Yatirim Ortakligi A.S.
Description: Gozde Girisim Sermayesi Yatirim Ortakligi A.S. is a private equity and venture capital firm specializing in investments in early venture mid venture late venture pre-IPO opportunities and in equity private placements consolidations and buildups and growth capital financings. The firm targets to invest in non-food companies having financial and operational restructuring needs. It focuses its investment in finance information and communication technology retail renewable energy real estate logistics and agriculture. The firm typically holds controlling or significant minority interests in companies in Turkey. It seeks to act as lead equity investor in strategic minority equity investments. The firm seeks to hold its investment for five to seven years. Gozde Girisim Sermayesi Yatirim Ortakligi A.S. was founded in January 2010 and is headquartered in Istanbul Turkey with an additional office in Istanbul Turkey.

Name: Oman Flour Mills Company SAOG
Description: Oman Flour Mills Company SAOG together with its subsidiaries engages in milling wheat and other cereals in the Sultanate of Oman. It operates in four segments: Flour Mill Feed Mill Bakery and Others. The company offers bread baking health special grain and premix products under the Dahabi and Atyab brands; and cattle and poultry feed products including general ruminant calf rearer sheep cubes camel and horse feed and breeder and pigeon feed under the Barakat brand. It also manufactures sells and distributes fresh and frozen bakery products; sells and distributes confectionery items and other flour related products; and manufactures imports and exports wheat and flour. In addition the company provides laboratory services for testing of materials and chemicals; and consultancy services. Further it engages in investment activities. Oman Flour Mills Company SAOG was founded in 1976 and is based in Ruwi the Sultanate of Oman.

Name: Electro Cable Egypt
Description: Electro Cable Egypt manufactures and sells power and telecommunication cables in Egypt. It offers enameled copper wires; low medium and high voltage wires and cables; overhead transmission conductors; building wires; and telephone cables. The company also exports its products to Africa Europe and the Arab countries. Electro Cable Egypt was founded in 1954 and is based in Cairo Egypt.

Name: Unimer SA
Description: Unimer SA operates in the seafood industry in Morocco. It offers canned sardines and mackerel and semi canned anchovies; and provides fish meal and oil. The company is also involved in deep sea fishing fish farming and freezing businesses. It offers its products primarily under the Princesse Madrigal Walima Conserveries Provençales Belmonte Gourmet La Monegasque Vanelli and Titus brands. The company was founded in 1973 and is headquartered in Casablanca Morocco. Unimer SA is a subsidiary of Sanam Agro.

Name: Egyptian Resorts Company (S.A.E)
Description: Egyptian Resorts Company (S.A.E) develops communities in Egypt. Its flagship project is Sahl Hasheesh a resort located in Red Sea coast. The company acquires land holdings; sells pre-designated land plots to sub-developers for various purposes such as residential communities hotels and entertainment venues office parks schools hospitals and others; and offers infrastructure development and community and property management services. It also provides electricity water and irrigation communication network services and roads and lighting; and develops and operates its own projects including Old Town Jamaran Tawaya and Sawari marina. The company was founded in 1995 and is headquartered in Cairo Egypt.

Name: Tarkim Bitki Koruma Sanayi ve Ticaret A.S.
Description: Tarkim Bitki Koruma Sanayi ve Ticaret A.S. produces sells and markets plant protection products. The company was incorporated in 2009 and is based in Manisa Turkey.

Name: Standard Chartered Bank Zambia Plc
Description: Standard Chartered Bank Zambia Plc provides various banking products and services in Zambia. It operates through Corporate & Investment Banking and Wealth & Retail Banking segments. The company offers current and savings accounts foreign currency and fixed deposit accounts and time and term deposits; personal instalment loans mortgages loans corporate and trade finance personal loans overdrafts credit and debit cards working capital solutions and business loans; investment services including mutual funds fixed income securities wealth lending foreign exchange and international banking; cash management and other transaction services; and bancassurance services. It also sells third-party insurance products such as group life assurance and motor and houseowner/householder insurance; operates client contact centers; and provides mobile online and agent banking. The company serves corporate personal priority and business clients. Standard Chartered Bank Zambia Plc was founded in 1906 and is headquartered in Lusaka Zambia. Standard Chartered Bank Zambia Plc operates as a subsidiary of Standard Chartered Holdings (Africa) BV.

Name: Madinet Masr For Housing and Development
Description: Madinet Masr For Housing and Development engages in development of real estate properties in Egypt. The company develops large scale urban communities. It also provides civil construction and brokerage services. Madinet Masr For Housing and Development was founded in 1959 and is headquartered in Cairo Egypt. Madinet Masr For Housing and Development operates as a subsidiary of BIG Investment Group Limited.

Name: Emirates Investment Bank P.J.S.C.
Description: Emirates Investment Bank P.J.S.C. engages in the investment advisory and wealth management businesses in the United Arab Emirates. It operates in two segments Investments and Banking Services. The company manages investment portfolio; provides treasury services; credit facilities; and accepts deposits from corporate and individual customers. It also provides wealth and estate planning asset management lending and banking services as well as trading and execution services. The company was formerly known as Arab Emirates Investment Bank P.J.S.C. and changed its name to Emirates Investment Bank P.J.S.C. in 2010. The company was incorporated in 1976 and is based in Dubai the United Arab Emirates. Emirates Investment Bank P.J.S.C. operates as a subsidiary of Al-Futtaim Private Company LLC.

Name: Grupo Minsa S.A.B. de C.V.
Description: Grupo Minsa S.A.B. de C.V. produces distributes and sells nixtamalized cornmeal under the MINSAA brand name in Mexico. The company sells packaged corn and corn flour to mills small producers and industrialists. Its products are used to produce tortillas and other food products. The company was incorporated in 1993 and is based in Tlalnepantla de Baz Mexico. Grupo Minsa S.A.B. de C.V. is a subsidiary of Promotora Empresarial de Occidente SA de CV.

Name: Kirac Galvaniz Telekominikasyon Metal Makine Insaat Elektrik Sanayi ve Ticaret Anonim Sirketi
Description: Kirac Galvaniz Telekominikasyon Metal Makine Insaat Elektrik Sanayi ve Ticaret Anonim Sirketi operates as a guardrail supplier company in Turkey. The company provides steel guardrail systems noise barrier systems solar energy systems and motorcyclist protection systems as well as hot dip galvanizing services. It also offers other products such as traffic sign and boards steel constructions and informative signs omega profiles traffic sign trailers pedestrian guardrails crash cushions and pedestrian overpass construction systems. The company was founded in 2006 and is based in Bursa Turkey.

Name: Morabaha Marina Financing Company
Description: Morabaha Marina Financing Company provides financing to individual and small and medium enterprises in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. The company operates through Retail SMEs and Digital Payments segments. It offers finance leasing; and consumer financing as well as electronic commerce payments and wallet services. Morabaha Marina Financing Company was incorporated in 2012 and is headquartered in Riyadh the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

Name: Standard Chartered Bank Botswana Limited
Description: Standard Chartered Bank Botswana Limited provides banking products and services in Botswana. It operates in two segments Corporate Commercial and Institutional Banking; and Consumer Private & Business Banking. The company offers personal banking products and services such as current call and savings accounts; fixed deposits; personal auto and home loans; credit cards; foreign exchange mutual funds and fixed income securities; and insurance products. It provides business banking products and services including business current savings and call accounts; loans and working capital solutions such as loan against property business mortgages term loans business overdraft and trade solutions; foreign exchange forwards; yield enhancement solutions including fixed and term and fixed income deposit accounts; and cross border services. In addition the company offers corporate and institutional banking products and services comprising cash management trade services syndications and lending treasury services foreign exchange currency options government bonds high yield deposits and other liquidity management products. Further it provides corporate finance advisory hedging and transactional services online and mobile banking as well as ATM services. It serves individuals corporations governments banks and investors. The company was founded in 1897 and is based in Gaborone Botswana. Standard Chartered Bank Botswana Limited operates as a subsidiary of Standard Chartered Holdings (Africa) BV.

Name: Solidarity Bahrain B.S.C.
Description: Solidarity Bahrain B.S.C. provides insurance products in Bahrain. It operates through Non-motor Motor Medical Group Life and Family Takaful segments. The company develops and provides protection coverages for property engineering general accident liability marine cargo marine hull aviation medical group life motor level term assurance and decreasing term assurance. It also manages general takaful and family takaful funds. In addition the company offers travel expat medical visa smart device domestic helper and personal cyber insurance products; life planning services; and savings and protection plans. It offers its services through its online platform. The company was formerly known as Al Ahlia Insurance Company B.S.C. and changed its name to Solidarity Bahrain B.S.C. in January 2018. The company was incorporated in 1976 and is headquartered in Manama Bahrain. Solidarity Bahrain B.S.C. is a subsidiary of Solidarity Group Holding B.S.C (c).

Name: Oman Refreshment Company SAOG
Description: Oman Refreshment Company SAOG engages in the filling and distribution of soft drinks water and juices in the Sultanate of Oman. The company holds the franchise rights to produce fill and distribute PepsiCo range of soft drinks and Aquafina Water. It also trades in consumer-packaged goods such as new edge beverages; Lays range of snacks; Quaker range of oat products; Eurocake and EDITA bakery products; Froneri range of ice cream products consisting of Nestle and Mondelez brand name; Dairy and Chilled products including Balade and Barada names; and frozen food products. In addition the company sells vending machines; provides related vending products; and produces and distributes juices under its Topfruit brand name. Further it engages in the buying selling and sub-dividing of real estate into plots; renting and operating of self-owned or leased residential and non-residential real estate; real estate appraisal; export and import business; business agencies activities; and renting of commercial equipment and professional machinery. Oman Refreshment Company SAOG was founded in 1974 and is headquartered in Muscat the Sultanate of Oman.

Name: Kuzey Boru Anonim Sirketi
Description: Kuzey Boru Anonim Sirketi produces and sells plastic pipes and fittings in Turkey and internationally. Its clean water pipes include high-density polyethylene (HDPE) PVC low-density polyethylene (LDPE) polypropylene random copolymer (PPRC) and glass reinforced thermosetting pipes; and drainage pipes comprise corrugated drainage steel reinforced corrugated perforated drainage and geotextile covered drainage pipes. The company offers pre-insulated geothermal pipes; fish farming aquaculture polyethylene and PVC pipes and cages; HDPE cable PVC cable casing and corrugated cable casing ducts as well as telecommunication pipes; dredging and marine pipes and sea dredger pipes and floaters; and hydropower spiral corrugated HDPE cooling water and gas pipes. It also provides HDPE electro fusion and spigot fittings corrugated and PP-R fittings HDPE coupling fittings valves fire hydrants and pipe welding machines. The company was founded in 2001 and is based in Aksaray Turkey.

Name: Octodec Investments Limited
Description: Octodec Investments Limited (Octodec or the company) its subsidiaries and associated company (the group) is a real estate investment trust (REIT) listed on the JSE Ltd (JSE) and A2X with a diversified portfolio of 226 residential retail office and industrial properties situated in the major metropolitan areas of Tshwane and Johannesburg. The portfolio including an equity-accounted joint venture has a lettable area of 1 504 601m2 and is valued at R11.3 billion.

Name: Kimteks Poliüretan Sanayi ve Ticaret A.S.
Description: Kimteks Poliüretan Sanayi ve Ticaret A.S. engages in the production and sale of polyurethane system. It offers polyurethane unit sole polyurethane slipper system polyurethane safety shoe sole polyurethane boot polyurethane insole polyester polyol and polymeric polyester polyol systems; release agents; and liquid color master batch systems. The company provides sandwich panel polyurethane pipe insulation polyurethane spray foam polyurethane polyurea systems polyurethane rubber binder system and shutter and sectional doors polyurethane systems; elastomers; polyester polyols; integral foam filter foam and sound insulation systems; and office furniture foam wood imitation viscoelastic integral foam polyester polyol systems. In addition it offers commercial and domestic refrigerator polyurethane cold storage room refrigerator container polyurethane and boiler and solar panel systems; EVA compounds thermoplastic polyurethane polyurethane gels and stress ball systems; and polyols for rigid polyurethane and foam and CASE Applications. It serves footwear building and insulation automotive furniture and foam and heating and cooling industries. Kimteks Poliüretan Sanayi ve Ticaret A.S. was founded in 1983 and is headquartered in Istanbul Turkey.

Name: Diviso Grupo Financiero S.A.
Description: Diviso Grupo Financiero S.A. provides products and services related to the financial markets in Peru and internationally. It offers mutual funds investment funds local and foreign stock exchanges and team deposits. It also provides divicambio and private fixed income related services. The company was formerly known as NCF Inversiones SA and changed its name to Diviso Grupo Financiero S.A. in November 2013. Diviso Grupo Financiero S.A. was incorporated in 2004 and is based in Lima Peru.

Name: Karel Elektronik Sanayi Ve Ticaret A.S.
Description: Karel Elektronik Sanayi Ve Ticaret A.S. designs develops produces and sells communication systems in Turkey. It offers communication products such as PBX phone systems for small medium and large-scale businesses; IP based call center systems for public and private institutions; and IP analog wall hotel and feature phones as well as direct station select modules and operator phone headsets. The company also provides convergence and integration products including conference products GSM terminals wireless (DECT) systems auto-attendant and voicemail modules call traffic control systems VoIP and network products call recording systems nurse call systems and other products as well as vehicle tracking systems. In addition it offers visual communication and security systems comprising security cameras intruder alarm and intercoms; cloud solutions with Internet applications that facilitate the business processes and provide economy and productivity for corporate users; and electronics manufacturing services as well as undertakes telecommunication projects for fixed and mobile operators and state institutions and organizations. Further the company offers defense industry solutions such as military tactical switches; alarm and announcement system for small boats and navy ships phone and intercom PABX system military gateway and communications switching systems; electronic mirror; military computers; and inertial navigation systems. It provides its communication solutions for hotels public institutions medical institutions educational institutions production facilities retail business finance institutions and transportation institutions. The company also exports its products and technologies to approximately 30 countries. Karel Elektronik Sanayi Ve Ticaret A.S. was founded in 1986 and is headquartered in Istanbul Turkey.

Name: Biomm S.A.
Description: Biomm S.A. operates as a biotechnology company in Brazil. The company offers AFREZZA a human insulin inhalation powder; GHEMAXAN an enoxaparina sodica; GLARGILIN a glargine insulin; WOSULIN R a human insulin; WOSULIN N an isophane insulin; HERZUMA a trastuzumab; and CANETA LIFEPEN G PARA APLICACAO DE INSULINA. Biomm S.A. was founded in 2001 and is headquartered in Nova Lima Brazil.

Name: Parsan Makina Parçalari Sanayii A.S.
Description: Parsan Makina Parçalari Sanayii A.S. produces and sells forging parts and components for light medium and heavy vehicle manufacturers in Turkey. The company offers body parts including rear axle shafts shafts front axle beams and front axle assemblies; and engine parts such as crankshafts camshafts forged pistons steering knuckles rods pinion forgings various gear forgings spider gears slip shafts and other products and assemblies as well as arms and various parts for different sectors. It serves automotive agricultural and construction equipment aerospace railway and other industries. The company also exports its products to Germany Belgium Italy France Spain the United Kingdom Hungary Czech Republic Austria the Netherlands Egypt and South Africa. Parsan Makina Parçalari Sanayii A.S. was founded in 1968 and is based in Istanbul Turkey. Parsan Makina Parçalari Sanayii A.S. is a subsidiary of Celik Holding A.S.

Name: Al Wathba National Insurance Company PJSC
Description: Al Wathba National Insurance Company PJSC together with its subsidiaries engages in general insurance and reinsurance business in the United Arab Emirates and internationally. The company operates through Marine; Fire and General Accident; Motor; and Investments segments. It offers fire and general accident insurance products that cover fire and allied perils property risks business interruption hotel comprehensive money fidelity guarantee bankers blanket jewelers block shop keepers home comprehensive workmen’s compensation employer’s liability third party and public liability and medical malpractices as well as individual and group personal accident insurance. The company also provides engineering insurance products including contractors and erection risks contractor’s plant machinery breakdown machinery loss of profits electronic equipment deterioration of stock and boiler insurance. In addition it offers marine insurance products such as marine liabilities hull and machinery and aviation insurance; oil and energy insurance products comprising offshore and onshore construction risks as well as operational risks; comprehensive fire and theft and third-party liability motor vehicle insurance; and home travel pet visa motor yacht and jet ski insurance products for individuals. The company was founded in 1996 and is headquartered in Abu Dhabi the United Arab Emirates.

Name: Victory Supermarket Chain Ltd
Description: Victory Supermarket Chain Ltd operates supermarkets in Israel. The company sells kosher products. Victory Supermarket Chain Ltd also sells its products through online. The company was founded in 1986 and is based in Yavne Israel.

Name: L'azurde Company for Jewelry
Description: L'azurde Company for Jewelry together with its subsidiaries engages in manufacturing forming and forging golden wares jewelry precious stones and golden alloys. It operates in Wholesale and Retail segments. The company also distributes glasses watches men and women accessories pens perfumes and leather products; and exports gold wares alloys and silver. In addition it engages in manufacturing and trading of gold jewellery as well as trading of gold and silver products pearls and precious stones. It primarily operates in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia Egypt the United Arab Emirates Kuwait the Sultanate of Oman and Qatar. The company sells its products under the L’azurde Instyle Miss L’ and Waves brands. The company was founded in 1980 and is based in Riyadh Saudi Arabia.

Name: Alexandria Mineral Oils Company
Description: Alexandria Mineral Oils Company engages in the production and sale of oil products in Egypt and internationally. The company offers fuel and transformer oils paraffin wax and derivatives gasoline and diesel neutral and special mineral oils liquefied petroleum gas naphtha and wax distillates as well as engages in the maximization of gas oil with low sulphur and pour point oil loading and blending and crude oil refining activities. It is also involved in importing exporting marketing selling and trading its products other petroleum products and supplies as well as engages in the warehouse leasing business. The company was founded in 1997 and is based in Alexandria Egypt.

Name: Bolsa de Valores de Colombia S.A.
Description: Bolsa de Valores de Colombia S.A. provides stock over the counter markets services for equity fixed income derivative and foreign exchange services in Colombia. The company offers listing services to issuer and issues; trading services through electronic trading and recording platforms; post trading services which consist of settlement clearing collateral management custody and securities management services; market information and price procurement services; and core banking and securities market system implementation services as well as digital solutions. The company was formerly known as Servicios Integrados Bursátiles S.A. and changed its name to Bolsa de Valores de Colombia S.A. in June 2001. Bolsa de Valores de Colombia S.A. was founded in 2001 and is headquartered in Bogota Colombia. Bolsa de Valores de Colombia S.A. is a subsidiary of Holding Bursátil Regional S.A.

Name: Panora Gayrimenkul Yatirim Ortakligi A.S.
Description: Panora Gayrimenkul Yatirim Ortakligi A.S. is a real estate investment trust. It invests in the real estate markets of Turkey. Panora Gayrimenkul Yatirim Ortakligi A.S. is based in Turkey.

Name: Odas Elektrik Üretim Sanayi Ticaret A.S.
Description: Odas Elektrik Üretim Sanayi Ticaret A.S. together with its subsidiaries produces and sells electricity by natural gas combined cycles in Turkey and internationally. The company operates a natural gas combined cycle power plant with an installed capacity of 140 MW; a solar energy power plant with an installed capacity of 0.25 MW; a hydroelectric power plant with an installed capacity of 8.2 MW; and a thermal power plant with an installed capacity of 340 MW. It also produces imports and wholesales natural gas liquefied natural gas (LNG) and compressed natural gas (CNG) to exporters LNG and CNG clients wholesale companies and eligible consumers. In addition the company extracts purchases manufactures imports exports sells and installs various natural stone and mineral ores that primarily include gold silver antimony and coal. Odas Elektrik Üretim Sanayi Ticaret A.S. was founded in 2010 and is headquartered in Istanbul Turkey.

Name: Rasiyat Holding Company K.P.S.C.
Description: Rasiyat Holding Company K.P.S.C. together with its subsidiaries develops promotes acquires and invests in education real estate financial and industrial projects in Kuwait and internationally. It operates through Academic and Investments segments. The company owns Kuwait Technical College as well as engages in a range of activities including curriculum development course delivery and academic research comprising creating organizing and delivering educational programs to students. It also develops residential commercial and mixed-use properties. In addition the company owns and holds shares of institutions; invests in income generating assets and service sector as well as Islamic bonds and bank notes; and owns stocks of local and foreign companies. The company was formerly known as Gulf North Africa Holding Company – KPSC. The company was founded in 2005 and is based in Kuwait City Kuwait.

Name: Misr Cement (Qena) Company (S.A.E)
Description: Misr Cement (Qena) Company (S.A.E) produces and sells cement products in Egypt and internationally. The company offers Portland sulphate resistant and blended pozzolanic cement. It also exports its products to Sudan. Misr Cement (Qena) Company (S.A.E) was incorporated in 1997 and is headquartered in Cairo Egypt.

Name: Disway S.A.
Description: Disway S.A. distributes IT and telecom equipment products in Morocco Tunisia the Middle East and Africa. The company offers desktop PC and laptops; printer scanner point of sale terminal tracer copier fax and consumables; tablet smartphone connected object and headphones and earphones; PC screen TV game console video projector projection screen videoconferencing interactive screen and photo and video; and accessories including cable drive hard drive flash memory luggage storage keyboard and mouse memory stick gaming audio webcam power bank and strip inverter and others and miscellaneous. It also provides solutions for server network data center storage backup software and video surveillance; and solar panels on and off grid solution solar pumping protections and solar accessories. In addition the company offers logistics services; manages stocks; processes orders; and engages in packing and co-packing drop shipping assembly inventory and reporting services. Disway S.A. was founded in 1982 and is headquartered in Casablanca Morocco.

Name: Al Jazeera Steel Products Company SAOG
Description: Al Jazeera Steel Products Company SAOG together with its subsidiaries manufactures and sells steel products in the Sultanate of Oman the United Arab Emirates Saudi Arabia and internationally. It offers black and galvanized pipes hollow sections merchant bar mill products and rebars. The company also operates tube mill and merchant bar mill facilities. Its products are used in construction scaffolding irrigation agriculture engineering public health fencing steam and gas facilities firefighting and water and sanitation pipes. The company was formerly known as Al Jazeera Tube Mills Company S.A.O.G. Al Jazeera Steel Products Company SAOG was founded in 1996 and is headquartered in Sohar the Sultanate of Oman.

Name: Fideicomiso Irrevocable db/1616
Description: Fibra Inn is a Mexican trust formed primarily to acquire develop and rent a broad range of hotel properties for lodging in Mexico aimed at the business traveler. Fibra Inn is internally managed through a subsidiary which does not charge any fee for the asset management services. The Company has signed franchise license and brand usage agreements with international hotel brands for the operation of global brands as well as the operation of national brands. Additionally the Company has development agreements. These hotels enjoy some of the industry’s top loyalty programs. Fibra Inn trades its Real Estate Certificates (“CBFIs”) on the Mexican Stock Exchange under the ticker symbol “FINN13”.

Name: Mobiltel Iletisim Hizmetleri Sanayi ve Ticaret A.S.
Description: Mobiltel Iletisim Hizmetleri Sanayi ve Ticaret A.S. distributes mobile phones in Turkey. It offers smart phones tablets desktop phones laptops ecosystems and wearable technology and accessories as well as telecommunication operator products such as modems line top up (virtual TL) and speech cards. Mobiltel Iletisim Hizmetleri Sanayi ve Ticaret A.S. was founded in 2001 and is based in Bahcelievler Turkey.

Name: Ekos Teknoloji ve Elektrik Anonim Sirketi
Description: Ekos Teknoloji Ve Elektrik Anonim Sirketi operates as a technology and service provider company for electrical infrastructure in Turkey and internationally. The company offers metal enclosed gas insulated metal clad and metal enclosed air insulated modular switchgears as well as other switching products; prefabricated substations; automation and control panels; NTP/PTP time servers; and GE distribution products. It also undertakes turnkey projects; and primary and secondary site tests. The company serves power producers network operators and industrial and commercial consumers. Ekos Teknoloji Ve Elektrik Anonim Sirketi was founded in 2000 and is headquartered in Kocaeli Turkey.

Name: Guinness Ghana Breweries PLC
Description: Guinness Ghana Breweries PLC manufactures distributes and sells spirits alcoholic and non-alcoholic beverages and other ancillary products. It offers its products under the Guinness Malta Guinness Johnnie Walker Star and Smirnoff Ice brands. Guinness Ghana Breweries PLC was incorporated in 1960 and is based in Kumasi Ghana.

Name: Mendelson Infrastructures & Industries Ltd.
Description: Mendelson Infrastructures & Industries Ltd. engages in the supply of conduction and flow products in Israel. The company offers plumbing products such as domestic water supply systems tanks sewage products air release\strainer\check valve\Ppressure reducing products steel fittings brass fittings and ball valves; HDPE’s; fire extinguishing products including grooved and threaded fittings fire protection valves hydrants fire accessories water flow switches fire sprinklers pipe hangers fire monitors and red pipes; steel piping and steel press fittings; and stainless steel steel concrete PE PVC and copper pipes. It serves industry infrastructure contractors local government businesses institutions and private customers through its distribution centers. Mendelson Infrastructures & Industries Ltd. was founded in 1947 and is based in Kiryat Ata Israel. Mendelson Infrastructures & Industries Ltd. is a subsidiary of Emilia Development (M.O.P.) Ltd.

Name: Michlol Finance Ltd
Description: Michlol Finance Ltd through its subsidiaries engages in financing and management of construction projects in Israel and internationally. It offers finance to entrepreneurs in the field of residential real estate sector as well as commercial and hotel projects; and credit to medium and small business corporations. Michlol Finance Ltd was incorporated in 2017 and is based in Bnei Brak Israel.

Name: Obour Land for Food Industries S.A.E.
Description: Obour Land for Food Industries S.A.E. manufactures and distributes dairy products in Egypt. The company engages in the packing and pasteurization of liquid dairies cream and natural butter as well as white dry and cooked cheese; and yogurt ice creams biscuits and natural fruit juices. The company was incorporated in 1997 and is based in El Obour City Egypt.

Name: National Enterprises Limited
Description: National Enterprises Limited an investment holding company engages in natural gas and energy-based manufacturing telecommunications power generation and basic foods manufacturing and marketing businesses in the Republic of Trinidad and Tobago. It offers dry mixes pet food livestock feed packaged rice bottled cooking oil coconut milk instant yeast and ginger tea as well as flour such as all purpose flour baker’s flour whole wheat flour cake flour self-rising flour breading flour wheat germ wheat bran wheat cereal and cracked wheat flour. The company also provides mobile fixed-line broadband pay TV security and other related services; and generates and distributes power for supply in bulk form to industrial commercial and residential customers. National Enterprises Limited was incorporated in 1999 and is based in Port of Spain Trinidad & Tobago.

Name: Arab Insurance Group (B.S.C.)
Description: Arab Insurance Group (B.S.C.) together with its subsidiaries provides life and non-life reinsurance products and related services in the Afro Asia region. The company offers property marine engineering accident whole account and other non-life policies as well as short term group life policies and long term life policies. Arab Insurance Group (B.S.C.) was founded in 1980 and is headquartered in Manama the Kingdom of Bahrain.

Name: El-Mor Electric Installation & Services (1986) Ltd.
Description: El-Mor Electric Installation & Services (1986) Ltd. operates in the energy infrastructure and communications business in Israel. The company undertakes the construction and implementation of energy electricity and air-conditioning projects in various fields such as power plants renewable and solar energy industry telecom high-tech commercial and public buildings military and defense facilities electrical and telecom infrastructure and street lighting. It also constructs substations; contracts photovoltaic solar plants; manufactures and assembles power electrical boards distribution switchboards and automation and MCC boards; and operates energy electrical and electro-mechanical projects. In addition the company engages in transforming organic waste into energy using pyrolysis and gasification solutions. El-Mor Electric Installation & Services (1986) Ltd. was incorporated in 1967 and is based in Ashkelon Israel.

Name: Reit Azorim - H.F Living Ltd
Description: Reit Azorim - H.F Living Ltd leases and invests in housing rental properties. The company was incorporated in 2019 and is headquartered in Tel Aviv-Yafo Israel.

Name: United Wire Factories Company
Description: United Wire Factories Company engages in the production and marketing of steel wire products for the industrial construction and civil sectors in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. It offers steel rebars wire mesh block ladder mesh nails fences barbed and concertina wires and tying wires. The company also provides bailing wires cloth hangers welded wires mesh staples clips and black annealed wires as well as welded wire mesh rolls; and black drawn galvanized PVC coated and deformed wires. Name: Göknur Gida Maddeleri Enerji Imalat Ithalat Ihracat Ticaret ve Sanayi Anonim Sirketi
Description: Göknur Gida Maddeleri Enerji Imalat Ithalat Ihracat Ticaret ve Sanayi Anonim Sirketi operates as a fruit and vegetable concentrate company in Turkey. The company offers concentrate products puree concentrate products puree products deionized concentrate products frozen IQF natural peel oils natural fruit FTNF direct pressed fruit juices dried seeds consumer products and fresh fruits. Göknur Gida Maddeleri Enerji Imalat Ithalat Ihracat Ticaret ve Sanayi Anonim Sirketi was founded in 1993 and is headquartered in Ankara Turkey.

Name: Döktas Dökümcülük Ticaret ve Sanayi A.S.
Description: Döktas Dökümcülük Ticaret ve Sanayi A.S. produces and trades gray and spheroidal cast iron and aluminum castings for the automotive industry in Turkey. The company operates through Pig & Ductile Iron Casting; Aluminum Casting; and Wheels segments. It offers pig and ductile iron; high and low pressure aluminum cast parts; and aluminum wheels. The company also exports its products. It serves heavy commercial vehicles agricultural machinery construction and mining machinery manufacturing e-mobility and railway and other sectors. The company was formerly known as Componenta Dökümcülük Ticaret ve Sanayi A.S. and changed its name to Döktas Dökümcülük Ticaret ve Sanayi A.S. in April 2018. The company was incorporated in 1973 and is based in Bursa Turkey. Döktas Dökümcülük Ticaret ve Sanayi A.S. is a subsidiary of Çelik Holding A.S.

Name: KAL Group Limited
Description: KAL Group Limited operates as a diversified trader and retailer in the agricultural manufacturing retail and fuel and convenience markets in South Africa and Namibia. It operates through Agrimark The Fuel Company Agrimark Grain and Manufacturing segments. The company engages in the grain handling and storage; marketing of agricultural commodities; seed and animal feed sales; provision of agricultural management advisory services; marketing of small grains and oilseeds; trading of potatoes; marketing of mechanical equipment; and sale of farming machinery and equipment as well as offers after-sales services. It also distributes packaging materials such as cartons carton inner packaging plastic bags labels pallet strapping and pallets for fruits and vegetables; and offers local wines and beers pet products and financing products. In addition the company manufactures and sells plastic products such as bulk bins; and irrigation equipment such as micro sprinklers inline valves and automation products. It also provides retail fuel including convenience stores under the Expressmark brand as well as quick service restaurant outlets. The company was formerly known as Kaap Agri Limited and changed its name to KAL Group Limited in March 2023. KAL Group Limited was founded in 1912 and is based in Paarl South Africa.

Name: Mayagüez S.A.
Description: Mayagüez S.A. engages as an agro-industrial business in Colombia. The company offers white and raw sugar and Bio-fertilizer; generates energy through fossil fuels; and bioethanol products. Mayagüez S.A. was founded in 1937 and is headquartered in Candelaria Colombia.

Name: Societe Tunisienne de Verreries
Description: Societe Tunisienne de Verreries engages in the manufacture and marketing of glass and ancillary products in Tunisia and internationally. The company was founded in 1963 and is based in Zaghouan Tunisia. Societe Tunisienne de Verreries is a subsidiary of Compagnie Financiere d'Investissement CFI.

Name: Baazeem Trading Company
Description: Baazeem Trading Company operates as a FMCG distribution company. The company was founded in 1978 and is headquartered in Riyadh Saudi Arabia.

Name: Adel Kalemcilik Ticaret ve Sanayi A.S.

It offers wood-walled pencils crayons and copy pens ballpoint liquid ink pens markers felt-tip pens pastels watercolors erasers sharpeners finger paints play dough and gouache paints; and toys. The company offers its products under the Faber-Castell Graf von Faber-Castell Adel and Panfix and Citizen brands. It exports its products to approximately 40 countries. The company also provides training courses under the Netcraft Academy name; and maintenance and support outsourcing and professional services.
