The company was incorporated in 1982 and is headquartered in Tel Aviv-Yafo Israel.

Name: Tunisie Profilés Aluminium Société Anonyme
Description: Tunisie Profilés Aluminium Société Anonyme engages in the design manufacture and sale of aluminum alloy profiles for building and industrial needs in Tunisia. It also exports its products. The company was founded in 1978 and is based in Mégrine Tunisia.

Name: Methanol Chemicals Company
Description: Methanol Chemicals Company engages in the production and sale of formaldehyde liquid and urea formaldehyde liquid in the Saudi Arabia and internationally. It offers aqueous formaldehyde solution urea formaldehyde concentrate hexamethylene tetramine paraformaldehyde urea formaldehyde powder resin melamine formaldehyde powder resin melamine urea formaldehyde resin sulphonated naphthalene formaldehyde hexane methylene tetramine phenol formaldehyde resins and liquid and powder formaldehyde resins. The company also provides dimethylamine trimethylamine methanol monomethylamine dimethyl formamide pentaerythritol sodium formate carbon monoxide di-methylamine concrete improvers acetaldehyde and penta aritheretol; and formaldehyde liquid and urea formaldehyde liquid and their mixtures trimon-methylamine and di-methyl Formamide. The company was formerly known as Saudi Formaldehyde Chemical Company Limited. Methanol Chemicals Company was incorporated in 1989 and is based in Jubail the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

Name: Zanlakol Ltd
Description: Zanlakol Ltd engages in the development production marketing and sale vegetable products in Israel. It provides corn peas chickpeas beans and other legumes. The company also offers hummus and dips; cooking sauces including pasta pizza lasagna Bolognese and omelet sauces; tomato products such as crushed tomatoes tomato pastes and concentrates diced tomatoes tomato omelet sauce and spicy pepper salsa; and canned vegetable products comprising apple purees beans potatoes mixed vegetables corn kernels carrots chickpeas and lupines. In addition it provides vinegar preserved lemon sauce and syrups; and customized products. It sells its products to food chains independent retailers hospitals catering services companies restaurants the ministry of defense and various manufacturing companies. The company also exports its products to the United States Europe and internationally. Zanlakol Ltd was incorporated in 1940 and is based in Afula Israel.

Name: BAAN Holding Group Company
Description: BAAN Holding Group Company for Tourism and Development Company provides hospitality and entertainment services in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia the United Arab Emirates and Egypt. It operates through Hotel Entertainment and Other segments. The company operates hotels tourism health resort cafes and restaurants as well as furnished apartments entertainment and recreation centers tourist resorts commercial malls fun cities parks and gardens and related facilities. It also operates and manages electrical games hall children amusement games hall and electronic games as well as establishes and operates sports facilities projects. The company was formerly known as Abdulmohsen Al-Hokair Group and changed its name to BAAN Holding Group Company in November 2024. BAAN Holding Group Company was incorporated in 1978 and is headquartered in Riyadh Saudi Arabia.

Name: Shell Oman Marketing Company SAOG
Description: Shell Oman Marketing Company SAOG engages in marketing and distributing of petroleum products in the Sultanate of Oman. The company is also involved in blending of lubricants. In addition it operates Shell service stations; Shell Select shops which offers beverages fresh food and localized offers; Shell Café; and Shell GO+ for digital promotions. Further the company offers shell fuel cards engine oils and lubricants for motorists; and industrial lubricants for industries including auto and truck dealers aviation construction fleet manufacturing marine metals mining and power. The company was formerly known as Shell Marketing (Oman) Ltd. and changed its name to Shell Oman Marketing Company SAOG in June 1997. Shell Oman Marketing Company SAOG was founded in 1958 and is based in Muscat the Sultanate of Oman.

Name: Inversora Juramento S.A.
Description: Inversora Juramento S.A. operates as an agricultural and livestock company in the northwestern region of Argentina. The company engages in the production industrialization marketing and sale of meat and agricultural products. Its agricultural products include soybeans sorghum alfalfa pastures and corn. The company has approximately 89504 hectares of land located in the province of Salta. It also exports its products. The company was founded in 1990 and is based in Salta Argentina.

Name: Bogazici Beton Sanayi Ve Ticaret Anonim Sirketi
Description: Bogazici Beton Sanayi Ve Ticaret Anonim Sirketi produces manufactures and sells ready-made concrete and aggregates under the Bosphorus Concrete brand in Turkey. It offers standard concretes; special and technical concretes such as fiber reinforced colored pressed concrete ready plaster screed concrete with visible aggregate surface white and impermeable concretes; and boutique concretes for industrial field marine structure and construction and precast production sites. The company was founded in 1997 and is headquartered in Istanbul Turkey.

Name: Ayen Enerji A.S.
Description: Ayen Enerji A.S. together with its subsidiaries engages in the production distribution and trading of electricity in Turkey and internationally. It generates electricity through hydroelectric and wind sources. Ayen Enerji A.S. was incorporated in 1990 and is based in Ankara Turkey. Ayen Enerji A.S. operates as a subsidiary of Aydiner Insaat AS.

Name: Grupo Clarín S.A.
Description: Grupo Clarín S.A. together with its subsidiaries operates in the media industry in Argentina an Internationally. It operates through Digital and Printed Publications; and Production and Distribution of Content segments. The Digital and Printed Publications segment includes newspapers with national and regional circulation sports newspapers the edition and publication and distribution of magazines as well as commercial printing; publishes newspapers a sports daily; magazine publishing and editing and distribution. This segment also offers Diario Clarín a national newspaper for the Spanish-speaking world; Olé a sports newspaper for the Argentine market; and Genios a children’s magazine. The Production and Distribution of Content segment offers Canal 13 channels amplitude modulation/frequency modulation radio broadcast stations and Radio Mitre and La 100 as well as produces content for television films and radio and cable television signals; and organizes and broadcasts sporting events. The company was founded in 1945 and is based in Buenos Aires Argentina. Grupo Clarín S.A. is a subsidiary of GC Dominio S.A.

Name: Allied Tecnologia S.A.
Description: Allied Tecnologia S.A. a technology company operates in the consumer electronics market in Brazil. The company engages in the retail sale of digital products through its stores as well as online. It also manufactures and distributes electronic products as well as owns and operates e-commerce solutions for refurbished products. In addition the company operates financial platform for credit payment solutions. Allied Tecnologia S.A. was founded in 2001 and is based in São Paulo Brazil.

Name: Purple Group Limited
Description: Purple Group Limited a financial services and technology company engages in trading platforms fractional property and crypto asset investing retirement fund administration and asset management businesses in South Africa. The company operates through EasyTrader and EasyAssetManagement (EAM); and Easy Group segments. The EasyTrader and EasyAssetManagement (EAM) segment is involved in the derivatives trading and asset management operations. The Easy Group segment includes EasyEquities EasyProperties EasyCrypto and RISE EasyRetire. It also offers EasyBonds EasyTrader EasyPartnerships EasyCredit and EasyProtect solutions. The company was formerly known as Purple Capital Limited and changed its name to Purple Group Limited in December 2013. Purple Group Limited was incorporated in 1998 and is based in Johannesburg South Africa.

Name: Yigit Aku Malzemeleri Nakliyat Turizm Insaat Sanayi ve Ticaret A.S.
Description: Yigit Aku Malzemeleri Nakliyat Turizm Insaat Sanayi ve Ticaret A.S. manufactures and distributes batteries. Its starter batteries comprising car EFB start-stop taxi agricultural marine defense industry heavy duty and AGM start-stop batteries; industrial batteries which includes AGM motive power gel FFP front terminal motorcycle traction OPZS stationary and OPZV stationary batteries; and lithium batteries. The company markets its products under Platin Helden Akü Tunç Akü Turkuaz Akü Macpower Gentry Vesline Distalong Fierte Probat and Yiğit Akü brand names. Yigit Aku Malzemeleri A.S. was founded in 1976 and is based in Ankara Turkey.

Name: Jubilee Holdings Limited
Description: Jubilee Holdings Limited an investment holding company underwrites life and non-life insurance risks associated with death disability health property and liability. It operates through two segments: Health Business and Life Business. The company offers life insurance; health insurance; property and casualty insurance; retirement products; medical insurance; and individual life group life and investments products. It also provides life and investment products which includes retail life products personal pension individual annuity income drawdown last expense corporate life group pension and credit life; and health products comprising individual health plans SME plan corporate health third party administration critical illness and international health. In addition the company offers financial investment products including money market fund and fixed income fund; and leases commercial space. Further it issues a portfolio of investment contracts liabilities to provide asset management solutions for savings and retirement needs. Additionally the company provides financial advisory services; invests in properties; generates electricity; sells fresh and processed meat products; and other financial related services. It operates in Kenya Uganda Tanzania Burundi and Mauritius. Jubilee Holdings Limited was founded in 1937 and is headquartered in Nairobi Kenya.

Name: Société Tunisienne d'Assurances et de Réassurances
Description: Société Tunisienne d'Assurances et de Réassurances provides insurance and reinsurance products for individuals professionals and businesses in Tunisia. It offers automobile home travel life and accident and retirement savings insurance for individuals; and professional multi-risk collective health and retirement construction transportation agricultural multi-risk and automotive insurance for businesses. The company was incorporated in 1958 and is headquartered in Tunis Tunisia.

Name: BLC BANK S.A.L.
Description: BLC BANK S.A.L. provides investment corporate and retail banking services in Lebanon. The company offers current savings and term deposit accounts; life accidental term life education retirement home and investment insurance; credit debit internet fresh and prepaid cards; banker’s draft and transfer services; ATM BLC pass ATM cardless withdrawal internet point of sale and mobile banking services; and mother and child account and safe deposit boxes. It also provides letter of credit documentary collection and bank guarantees; and advisory asset management and brokerage products and services. The company was founded in 1949 and is headquartered in Beirut Lebanon. BLC BANK S.A.L. operates as a subsidiary of Fransabank S.A.L.

Name: La Positiva Seguros y Reaseguros S.A.
Description: La Positiva Seguros y Reaseguros S.A. provides insurance and reinsurance products and services to individuals and business customers in Peru. The company offers vehicle home card and credit health oncology accident family life life funeral life and savings and travel insurance products. It also provides property equipment and machinery and agricultural insurance products as well as insurance products for negotiations and guarantees. La Positiva Seguros y Reaseguros S.A. was incorporated in 1937 and is headquartered in San Isidro Peru. La Positiva Seguros y Reaseguros S.A. is a subsidiary of Fidelidade - Companhia de Seguros S.A.

Name: Atakey Patates Gida Sanayi ve Ticaret A.S.
Description: Atakey Patates Gida Sanayi ve Ticaret A.S. produces and supplies French fries in Turkey. The company offers potato wedges spicy coated potato wedges crinkle potato spicy coated crinkle potato coated cage fries and spicy coated cage fries. It supplies its products to quick service restaurants. The company was incorporated in 2012 and is headquartered in Istanbul Turkey.

Name: Al Maha Petroleum Products Marketing Company SAOG
Description: Al Maha Petroleum Products Marketing Company SAOG engages in the marketing and distribution of petroleum products in the Sultanate of Oman. It operates through Retail Commercial Aviation Lubricants and Non-Fuel Services segments. The company offers gasoline diesel jet fuel and kerosene; retail commercial aviation and marine fuels; lubricants comprising engine gear and hydraulic oils as well as specialty lubricants brake fluids engine coolants and greases; fuel cards; autofill RFID; Fuely a fuel delivery service; bunkering services for vessels; and non-fuel related services. It also provides smart tags; Al Maha PLUS app; car wash services; and oil and lube change services for cars as well as operates fuel stations convenience stores and service centers. Al Maha Petroleum Products Marketing Company SAOG was founded in 1993 and is headquartered in Muscat the Sultanate of Oman.

Name: Puerto Ventanas S.A.
Description: Puerto Ventanas S.A. operates a port in Chile. The company offers warehousing services; and services to the ships including docking and undocking tug and berthing and unberthing. It also provides land transportation services by road or rail; and loading and unloading services. Puerto Ventanas S.A. was incorporated in 1991 and is based in Santiago Chile.

Name: Asce Gayrimenkul Yatirim Ortakligi A.S.
Description: Asce Gayrimenkul Yatirim Ortakligi Anonim Sirketi engages in the construction business in Turkey. It develops and constructs housing projects. The company was founded in 2010 and is headquartered in Gaziantep Turkey.

Name: Autopistas Del Sol SA
Description: Autopistas Del Sol SA is involved in the construction expansion remodeling preservation improvement operation and administration of highways. It operates the North Access a 95-kilometer highway that connects the Autonomous City of Buenos Aires with the suburbs in the north and nearby coastal areas; and the General Paz Beltway highway a 24-kilometer toll-free section of the primary ring road that surrounds the Autonomous City of Buenos Aires. The company was incorporated in 1994 and is based in Buenos Aires Argentina.

Name: Hamat Group Ltd.
Description: Hamat Group Ltd. engages in the production development import marketing distribution and sale of home design and construction finishing products for bathrooms toilets and kitchens in Israel and internationally. The company offers ceramic and porcelain granite tiles terrazzo floors marble and stone products parquet wood floors and related products; kitchen and bathroom faucets; shower sets and accessories; sanitary ware such as toilets and clay sinks; and plastic plumbing and sanitation products comprising pipes pipe fittings visible flushing tanks toilet seats etc. It also provides plastic consumer products for the bathroom and kitchen including bins baskets laundry baskets etc.; faucets and related accessories irrigation and landscaping accessories and sanitary ware and related accessories for bathrooms; and complementary fitting products such as mirrors racks soaps hygiene tools etc. Hamat Group Ltd. was founded in 1944 and is based in Ashdod Israel. Hamat Group Ltd. is a subsidiary of Nior Holdings (1994) Ltd.

Name: Desa Deri Sanayi ve Ticaret A.S.
Description: Desa Deri Sanayi ve Ticaret A.S. manufactures and sells leather and leather products in Turkey. The company offers leather jackets clothing shoes bags and accessories backpacks suitcases and other leather accessories for men and women. It markets and sells its products through wholesale and retail sales channels as well as through online sales store. The company was founded in 1972 and is headquartered in Istanbul Turkey. Desa Deri Sanayi ve Ticaret A.S. is a subsidiary of Çelet Holding A.S.

Name: Akenerji Elektrik Üretim A.S.
Description: Akenerji Elektrik Üretim A.S. together with its subsidiaries engages in the generation transmission and trading of electricity in Turkey. The company operates hydroelectric wind and natural gas combined cycle power plants with a total installed capacity of 1224 megawatts. It is also involved in the natural gas trading business. Akenerji Elektrik Üretim A.S. was incorporated in 1989 and is headquartered in Istanbul Turkey.
Industry: Independent Power and Renewable Electricity Producers

Name: Büyük Sefler Gida Turizm Tekstil Danismanlik Organizasyon Egitim Sanayi Ve Ticaret A.S.
Description: Büyük Sefler Gida Turizm Tekstil Danismanlik Organizasyon Egitim Sanayi Ve Ticaret A.S. together with its subsidiaries operates a chain of restaurants under the BigChefs NumNum and Buselik brands in Turkey and internationally. It also franchises its restaurants. Büyük Sefler Gida Turizm Tekstil Danismanlik Organizasyon Egitim Sanayi Ve Ticaret A.S. was founded in 2007 and is headquartered in Istanbul Turkey.

Name: Burgan Company for Well Drilling Trading and Maintenance K.S.C. (Public)
Description: Burgan Company for Well Drilling Trading and Maintenance K.S.C. (Public) provides drilling and workover services for oil companies in Kuwait and internationally. The company provides integrated maintenance services; transportation support through a fleet of heavy-duty trucks low beds Kenworth forklifts and cranes; workshop; supply chain; and catering services. The company was formerly known as Hamad Al-Hamad and Partners for well drilling trading and maintenance Company and changed its name to Burgan Company for Well Drilling Trading and Maintenance K.S.C. (Public) in February 2005. The Company was incorporated in 1970 and is headquartered in Fahaheel Kuwait.

Name: Cristalerías de Chile S.A.
Description: Cristalerías de Chile S.A. manufactures and sells glass containers for wine beer non-alcoholic beverages liquors and food markets in Chile and internationally. The company operates through Glass Packaging Wine Communications Electric Generation and Investment segments. It is involved in the production import export and sale of alcoholic and non-alcoholic beverages such as wines and spirits; generation of electricity; and written digital and editorial press activities. The company was founded in 1904 and is based in Padre Hurtado Chile. Cristalerías de Chile S.A. operates as a subsidiary of Compañía Electro Metalúrgica S.A.

Name: CVC Brasil Operadora e Agência de Viagens S.A.
Description: CVC Brasil Operadora e Agência de Viagens S.A. together with its subsidiaries provides tourism services in Brazil and internationally. It offers intermediation airfare ground transportation hotel reservations tickets and chartered sea cruises cultural and professional exchange and other services. The company operates under the Trend Travel and VHC brands in the United States of America; Almundo.com Avantrip Biblos Quiero Viajes CVC and Ola brands in Argentina. It provides its tourism services directly to customers through independent service providers. CVC Brasil Operadora e Agência de Viagens S.A. was incorporated in 2009 and is headquartered in Santo André Brazil.

Name: Fibra Plus
Description: Fibra Plus is a real estate investment Trust. The firm is based in Mexico.

Name: Alarko Gayrimenkul Yatirim Ortakligi A.S.
Description: Alarko Real Estate Investment Company ALGYO" was founded in 1996. It is the first Real Estate Investment Company that went public in Turkey. Alarko REIC an affiliate of Alarko Holding operating in the field of real estate development sector provides its investors with a fixed income with the rental income it derives from the real properties in its portfolio and also possesses valuable lands for the purpose of development. The company's goodwill constantly increased starting from the date of its foundation with its real properties gaining value and its successful cash management effort."

Name: Norstar Holdings Inc
Description: Norstar Holdings Inc together with its subsidiaries develops rents and manages real estate properties in Northern Europe Central and Eastern Europe Israel Brazil and the United States. It develops commerce residential and office properties. The company was formerly known as Gazit Inc. and changed its name to Norstar Holdings Inc in May 2011. The company was incorporated in 1962 and is based in Panama City Panama.

Name: Naseej International Trading Company
Description: Naseej International Trading Company together with subsidiaries engages in the manufacture import export wholesale and retailing of carpets and rugs in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. The company’s products also include flooring furniture and furnishings antiques office furniture blankets kitchens bed sheets curtain fabrics and accessories tuft and yarns. In addition it provides maintenance services for factories governmental and private institutions. The company was formerly known as Al Sorayai Trading And Industrial Group Company. Naseej International Trading Company was founded in 1953 and is based in Jeddah the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

Name: Proagro C.A.
Description: Proagro C.A. produces and markets animal feed products. The company provides chickens and whole chickens; sausages cooked breasts hams bolognese and mortadella; and frozen nuggets milanese tenders chicken wings and burger products. It offers animal feed products for ruminants equine pigs broilers fish and rabbit; and breeding and production of poultry. It offers its products under Corral and Protinal brand names. The company was founded in 1977 and is based in Valencia Venezuela.

Name: Custodian Investment Plc
Description: Custodian Investment Plc through its subsidiaries provides insurance products and services in Nigeria. It operates through Non-Life Business Life Business Pension Administration Property Development and Management and Trustees and Others segments. The Non-Life Business segment offers engineering aviation marine and motor liability oil and energy fire and property insurance for individual and corporate customers. The Life Business segment provides a range of life insurance products for individual and group including annuity endowment and investment-oriented products and insurance products with discretionary participatory features (DPF). The Pension Administration segment is involved in the administration and management of the retirement benefits of members. The Property Development and Management segment engages in the acquisition development sale and management of various commercial residential hospitality and retail property assets. The Trustees and Others segment includes trustee management corporate services investment and property management. The company offers general insurance products such as auto travel home event personal accident and other insurance products; and life insurance products including savings and investment endowment protection annuity and other products as well as group life and group credit life insurance products. The company was formerly known as Custodian and Allied Insurance Limited. Custodian Investment Plc was incorporated in 1991 and is headquartered in Lagos Nigeria.

Name: Maridive and Oil Services S.A.E.
Description: Maridive and Oil Services S.A.E. together with its subsidiaries provides offshore marine and oil support services in Egypt. The company manages and operates AHTS PSV multi purpose vessel diving support vessel mooring boats and offshore support vessels as well as utility vessels; and under water activities and diving scope of services. It also provides marine work services including oil spill recovery; firefighting capabilities; dynamic positioning; 4-point mooring; and supply installation and maintenance of marine navigation aids such as buoys and navigation light services. In addition the company offers track record EPCI contracts installation engineering laying of sub sea pipelines sub sea coiled tubing submarine power cables mooring systems protective coating and construction work services; and survey services comprising rig positioning ROV inspection pre-engineering survey and construction support services. Maridive and Oil Services S.A.E. was founded in 1977 and is based in Port Said Egypt.

Name: Naturel Yenilenebilir Enerji Ticaret Anonim Sirketi
Description: Naturel Yenilenebilir Enerji Ticaret Anonim Sirketi engages in the production of electricity from renewable energy sources in Turkey. The company installs operates and trades in solar power plants as well as manages ground-mounted and hybrid solar projects. It operates 88 unlicensed and 1 licensed solar power plant and 1 geothermal plant. In addition the company is involved in rooftop solar installations for industrial customers. Further it provides EPC maintenance and repair project development and investment services. Naturel Yenilenebilir Enerji Ticaret Anonim Sirketi was founded in 2009 and is headquartered in Ankara Turkey.
Industry: Independent Power and Renewable Electricity Producers

Name: Rav-Bariach (08) Industries Ltd.
Description: Rav-Bariach (08) Industries Ltd. primarily engages in the development manufacture and marketing of security doors and solutions in Israel and internationally. The company offers entrance interior wooden entrance fire and fire rated high security and steel doors as well as handles and accessories for commercial and residential properties. It also provides dock shelters and levelers roller shutters overhead sectional doors and sliding gates; and reinforced security room doors and windows as well as security room systems under the Lavi+System name. The company was founded in 1973 and is based in Ashkelon Israel.

Name: Koç Metalürji Anonim Sirketi
Description: Koç Metalürji Anonim Sirketi operates in the iron and steel industry in Turkey. It produces construction iron. The company was founded in 1993 and is headquartered in Istanbul Turkey.

Name: Adeer Real Estate Company
Description: Adeer Real Estate Company provides real estate marketing services individuals companies and institutions. It also engages in the management and sale of real estate properties; and provision of real estate consulting and studies services. The company was founded in 2014 and is based in Al Khobar Saudi Arabia. Adeer Real Estate Company operates as a subsidiary of Sumou International Investment Company.

Name: Gersan Elektrik Ticaret ve Sanayi Anonim Sirketi
Description: Gersan Elektrik Ticaret ve Sanayi Anonim Sirketi together with its subsidiaries engages in the electrical materials and electrochemical contracting activities in Turkey and Russia. The company offers Power and Lighting busbar systems that are used for buildings and industrial facitlities; hot-dip galvanized pregalvanized stainless steel aluminum normal type and heavy duty cable trays for use buildings airports ships and refineries; and cable carriers cable carrier systems and cable ladder elements. It provides earth crossing resistance value current carrying capacity and equipotential bond earthing systems that are used for electrical operating vehicles; and distribution panels including solar panels surface mounted distribution panels and rack cabinets for use in factories hospitals buildings and skyscrapers; and underfloor trunking consisting of underfloor cable tray and raised underfloor cable trays for electricity connection. In addition the company offers electric vehicle charging stations; led-bus lightning systems; and G-Bus automation systems. The company was formerly known as Gersan Ticaret. The company was incorporated in 1985 and is headquartered in Istanbul Turkey.

Name: Al Ramz Corporation Investment and Development P.J.S.C.
Description: Al Ramz Corporation Investment and Development P.J.S.C. a financial institution engages in the provision of asset management corporate finance brokerage lending security margins market making liquidity providing public offering management and financial research services in the United Arab Emirates. It also invests and manages commercial industrial and agricultural enterprises. In addition the company trades in real estate. Al Ramz Corporation Investment and Development P.J.S.C. was founded in 1975 and is based in Dubai the United Arab Emirates.

Name: Emirates REIT (CEIC) PLC
Description: Emirates REIT is the UAE largest listed Sharia compliant Real Estate Investment Trust (REIT). It was the first REIT incorporated in the UAE in 2010 and has approximately USD 1057.6 million of assets under management. Emirates REIT is incorporated in the DIFC and licensed by the DFSA.

Name: Union Bancaire pour le Commerce et L'Industrie Société anonyme
Description: Union Bancaire pour le Commerce et L'Industrie Société anonyme provides various banking products and services to individuals professionals and corporate and institutional clients in Tunisia. The company accepts various accounts and packages; and offers credit savings and investments fundings and collections services. It also provides growth financing operating cycle and flow management international trade and hedging of exchange rate risk services. In addition the company offers remote banking; cash management market activities investment banking international trade financial engineering and leasing and factoring; project financing bancassurance and wealth management; and electronic and mobile payment services. Union Bancaire pour le Commerce et L'Industrie Société anonyme was incorporated in 1961 and is headquartered in Tunis Tunisia.

Name: Riopaila Castilla S.A.
Description: Riopaila Castilla S.A. operates as an agro-industrial company in Colombia. The company offers sugars honeys inverted syrup mixtures and palm oil as well as fertilizers under the FertiRio Conditioner name. It also engages in cattle raising activities; cogeneration of energy from sugarcane bagasse; and production of renewable energy including alcohol and palm oil. In addition the company provides agricultural services and consulting services such as adaptation preparation and planting; crop lifting; fertilizer application; variable-rate fertilization; and precision agriculture. Riopaila Castilla S.A. was founded in 1918 and is headquartered in Santiago de Cali Colombia.

Name: Mazaya Real Estate Development Q.P.S.C.
Description: Mazaya Real Estate Development Q.P.S.C. buys builds operates and sells residential and commercial real estate projects. The company develops and manages residential compounds; invests in real estate projects; develops land for resale; engages in the construction project management and real estate marketing activities; and provides property management maintenance and brokerage services. Mazaya Real Estate Development Q.P.S.C. was incorporated in 2008 and is based in Doha Qatar.

Name: Engen Botswana Limited
Description: Engen Botswana Limited engages in the petrochemical investments and property operations businesses in Botswana. It operates through two segments Petrochemical Activities and Property Letting. The company is involved in the selling and distributing fuel; and letting of properties. It also markets petroleum products. The company was incorporated in 1966 and is headquartered in Gaborone Botswana. Engen Botswana Limited is a subsidiary of Petroleum Investment Holdings Limited.

Name: Monteiro Aranha S.A.
Description: Monteiro Aranha S.A. through its subsidiaries operates in the paper petrochemical and real estate sectors in Brazil. The company produces exports and recycles paper comprising packaging corrugated packaging and industrial bags; and produces and trades wood in logs. It also distributes fuel and LPG; produces ethylene oxide and its derivatives specialty chemicals fatty alcohols and co-products. In addition the company offers storage services for liquid bulk; and operates drugstores. Further it develops and invests in residential and commercial real estate projects. Monteiro Aranha S.A. was founded in 1921 and is based in Rio de Janeiro Brazil.

Name: Marmaris Altinyunus Turistik Tesisler A.S.
Description: Marmaris Altinyunus Turistik Tesisler A.S. engages in the operation of tourist hotels in Antalya and Marmaris Turkey. It also provides tourism services; and leases the tourist facilities. The company was incorporated in 1986 and is based in Antalya Turkey.

Name: Canadian General Medical Center Complex Company
Description: Canadian General Medical Center Complex Company manages hospitals and health centers in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. It trades in hospital tools and equipment and ambulances. The company was incorporated in 2008 and is based in Dammam the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

Name: Merit Turizm Yatirim ve Isletme Anonim Sirketi
Description: Merit Turizm Yatirim ve Isletme Anonim Sirketi together with its subsidiaries engages in the hotel management business in Turkey. The company was founded in 1988 and is based in Istanbul Turkey. Merit Turizm Yatirim ve Isletme Anonim Sirketi operates as a subsidiary of Net Holding A.S. Merit Turizm Yatirim ve Isletme Anonim Sirketi opearates as a subsidiary of Net Holding A.S.

Name: Zambian Breweries Plc
Description: Zambian Breweries Plc engages in the manufacture and distribution of alcoholic beverages in Zambia. The company offers beers under the Mosi Premium Lager Mosi Light Castle Castle Lite Carling Black Label Eagle Lagers Budweiser Stella Artois Corona Flying Fish and Brutal Fruit. It distributes its products through retailers bar owners and wholesalers. The company was founded in 1968 and is based in Lusaka Zambia. Zambian Breweries Plc operates as a subsidiary of AB InBev Africa BV.

Name: Palestine Electric Company P.L.C
Description: Palestine Electric Company P.L.C through its subsidiary Gaza Power Generating Company engages in the generation and sale of electricity in the Gaza Strip Palestine. It operates a power plants to produce natural gas. The company was founded in 1999 and is based in Gaza Palestine. Palestine Electric Company P.L.C is a subsidiary of Palestine Power Company.
Industry: Independent Power and Renewable Electricity Producers

Name: Almogim Holdings Ltd
Description: Almogim Holdings Ltd together with its subsidiaries develops and sells real estate properties in Israel and internationally. It engages in the initiation development construction marketing and sale of residential real estate projects; lease of properties for residential office service and commercial use; and operation of residential complexes for young people as well as provision of ancillary services such as maintenance management fees sale of electricity services etc. to the complexes. The company was founded in 1986 and is based in Tirat Carmel Israel.

Name: Letshego Africa Holdings Limited
Description: Letshego Africa Holdings Limited together with its subsidiaries provides retail financial services in Botswana Namibia Mozambique Lesotho Eswatini Kenya Rwanda Uganda Tanzania Nigeria and Ghana. The company is also involved in banking and microfinance activities; unsecured consumer lending; deposit licensed; group and MSE lending; property; and support services. In addition it accepts demand accounts savings accounts and call and term deposits; and provides insurance arrangements. The company was formerly known as Letshego Holdings Limited and changed its name to Letshego Africa Holdings Limited in December 2023. Letshego Africa Holdings Limited was founded in 1998 and is headquartered in Gaborone Botswana.

Name: Aenza S.A.A.
Description: Aenza S.A.A. together with its subsidiaries provides specialized management consulting services and leasing of corporation in Peru Chile and Colombia. It operates through Infrastructure Energy Engineering and Construction and Real Estate segments. The company’s Infrastructure segment offers long-term concessions or similar contractual arrangements in Peru for toll roads transportation and water treatment as well as operation and maintenance services for infrastructure assets. Its Engineering and Construction segment provides traditional engineering services such as architectural planning structural civil and design engineering for advanced specialties comprising process design simulation and environmental services. This segment also provides services related to civil works which include construction of hydroelectric power stations and other large infrastructure facilities; electromechanic construction such as power plant concentrator plants oil and natural gas pipelines and transmission lines; and office and residential buildings hotels accessible housing projects shopping centers and industrial facilities. Its Energy segment engages in exploration production treatment marketing services of natural gas and its derivatives in the gas processing plant and gas processing as well as the construction and assembly of oil facilities and the storage and dispatch of fuel and oil by products. Its Real Estate segment develops and sells house  offices and commercial spaces. The company was formerly known as Graña y Montero S.A.A. and changed its name to Aenza S.A.A. in November 2020. Aenza S.A.A. was founded in 1933 and is based in Lima Peru.

Name: Viña San Pedro Tarapacá S.A.
Description: Viña San Pedro Tarapacá S.A. produces and exports wines in Chile Argentina and internationally. It sells its products under the Altair Cabo de Hornos Sideral Tierras Moradas Kankana del Elqui 1865 Tayu 1865 GatoNegro 9 Lives Epica Castillo de Molina Gran Reserva Tarapaca Leyda Misiones de Rango Santa Helena Alpaca Viñamar La Celia Graffigna and B-LIV brands. The company was founded in 1865 and is based in Santiago Chile. Viña San Pedro Tarapacá S.A. operates as a subsidiary of CCU Inversiones S.A.

Name: The National Bank
Description: The National Bank provides various banking and financial services to retail corporate institutional and public sector customers in the Palestinian Authority. It operates through Retail Accounts; Corporate and Institution Accounts; Public Sector Accounts; and Treasury segments. The company offers current demand savings and time deposits; consumer loans; overdrafts; credit cards and other services. It also provides trading and treasury services. The company was incorporated in 2005 and is headquartered in Ramallah the Palestinian Authority.

Name: Spur Corporation Ltd
Description: Spur Corporation Ltd together with its subsidiaries operates as a restaurant franchisor in South Africa and internationally. It operates and franchises restaurants under the Spur Steak Ranches Panarottis Pizza Pasta John Dory’s Fish Grill Sushi The Hussar Grill RocoMamas Casa Bella Nikos Doppio Zero Modern Tailor and Piza e Vino brands fast casual brand RocoMamas and three bespoke speciality dining brands The Hussar Grill Casa Bella Nikos Coalgrill Greek Doppio Zero Modern Tailors; Virtual Kitchen brands includes Just Wingz (Spur Steak Ranches) Pizza Pug Bento Reel Sushi Rib Shack RocoFellas and CharGrill Chicken. It is also involved in sauce manufacturing warehousing product distribution training export décor manufacturing and call center businesses. In addition it operates retail company stores as well as provides marketing services. The company was founded in 1967 and is based in Cape Town South Africa.

Name: Sokouk Holding Company K.S.C.P.
Description: Sokouk Holding Company K.S.C.P. engages in managing real estate projects in Kuwait. It operates in Hotel Operations Real Estate and Investment segments. The company invest develop and trades real estate properties as well as manages real estate investment commercial projects investment funds and portfolios. Sokouk Holding Company K.S.C.P. was incorporated in 1998 and is headquartered in Kuwait City Kuwait.

Name: Türk Prysmian Kablo ve Sistemleri Anonim Sirketi
Description: Türk Prysmian Kablo ve Sistemleri Anonim Sirketi produces imports exports and trades in cables conductors machinery apparatuses tools and equipment and spare parts and accessories worldwide. It offers energy cables communication cables with copper conductors and fiber optic cables; cable for utilities and power grids; telecom; transportation and mobility; and asset monitoring systems and electronics. The company provides medium and low voltage fire performance and building wire cables for trade and installers; cables for industries including renewables water treatment oil and gas oems nuclear mining military and defence marine and crane. It offers its products under the Prysmian General Cable and Draka brands. The company exports its products to approximately 50 countries. The company was formerly known as Turk Pirelli Kablo ve Sistemleri A.S. and changed its name to Türk Prysmian Kablo ve Sistemleri Anonim Sirketi in September 2005. The company was founded in 1964 and is headquartered in Mudanya Turkey. Türk Prysmian Kablo ve Sistemleri Anonim Sirketi is a subsidiary of Draka Holding B.V.

Name: Privatization Holding Company - K.P.S.C.
Description: Privatization Holding Company - K.P.S.C. invests in utilities and infrastructure sectors in Kuwait and internationally. It operates in two segments Investment and Other. The company engages in investment; electric power generation; manufacturing; and real estate businesses as well as the provision of IT general trading and contracting educational and medical services. The company was incorporated in 1994 and is based in Kuwait City Kuwait.

Name: Gentas Dekoratif Yuzeyler Sanayi ve Ticaret A.S.
Description: Gentas Dekoratif Yuzeyler Sanayi ve Ticaret A.S. engages in the production and sale of impregnated and laminate paper table tops school desks chair backrests and building profiles in Turkey and internationally. The company was formerly known as Gentas Genel Metal Sanayi ve Ticaret A.S. and changed its name to Gentas Dekoratif Yuzeyler Sanayi ve Ticaret A.S. in April 2020. The company was incorporated in 1972 and is headquartered in Ankara Turkey.

Name: Michman Finance Ltd
Description: Michman Finance Ltd provides credit to small and medium-sized businesses. It offers credit to business through short-term commercial credit to the middle market companies through solo deferred relays and third parties transfers directly or through other authorized credit providers and such credit is secured by various collateral including property liens and guarantees; credit backed by real estate; and through debt financing. The company was formerly known as Michman Basad Ltd and changed its name to Michman Finance Ltd in December 2023. Michman Finance Ltd was incorporated in 2015 and is based in Bnei Brak Israel.

Name: Naturelgaz Sanayi ve Ticaret A.S.
Description: Naturelgaz Sanayi ve Ticaret A.S. engages in the purchase compression transportation and delivery of natural gas in Turkey. The company supplies compressed natural gas (CNG) and liquefied natural gas (LNG) products. It offers CNG through 13 industrial CNG filling plants consisting of approximately 60.000 CNG cylinders fleet of 35 towing vehicles and 71 industrial CNG compressors; and LNG through 6 LNG road tankers 31 LNG storage tanks and 94 evaporators. The company also supplies CNG through dispensers to heavy duty vehicles such as logistics trucks garbage trucks and city buses from its auto CNG stations. It serves industrial establishments factories asphalt plants hotels greenhouses social facilities chemical industry construction material producers metal industry food industry mining operations and other industrial facilities. The company was incorporated in 2004 and is headquartered in Istanbul Turkey. Naturelgaz Sanayi ve Ticaret A.S. is a subsidiary of Global Yatirim Holding A.S.

Name: Rotem Shani Entrepreneurship and Investment Ltd.
Description: Rotem Shani Entrepreneurship and Investment Ltd. together with its subsidiaries engages in the real estate business in Israel. The company initiates develops establishes manages markets and sells as well as constructs of entrepreneurial projects for residential commercial employment storage and others. The company was formerly known as Delta Eshbol Entrepreneurship Ltd. and changed its name to Rotem Shani Entrepreneurship and Investment Ltd. in May 1996. The company was incorporated in 1996 and is based in Tel Aviv Israel.

Name: Dexxos Participações S.A.
Description: Dexxos Participações S.A. engages in the production and sale of thermosetting resins to the reconstituted wood panels industry in Brazil. The company also engages in the production of formaldehyde and hexamine; and resale of methanol and other chemical products. In addition it manufactures tubes for construction infrastructure and automobile markets; and produces steel tubes for petroleum and gas segment. The company was formerly known as GPC Participações S.A. and changed its name to Dexxos Participações S.A. in June 2021. Dexxos Participações S.A. was founded in 1929 and is headquartered in Rio de Janeiro Brazil.

Name: Shoval Engineering and Construction Ltd
Description: Shoval Engineering and Construction Ltd a construction company engages in the planning and execution of logistics centers public buildings commercial centers industrial buildings and offices in Israel. The company is based in Nesher Israel.

Name: Nigerian Aviation Handling Company Plc
Description: Nigerian Aviation Handling Company Plc provides aircraft and cargo handling passenger handling passenger profiling and crew transportation services in Nigeria. It operates through Ground Handling Cargo Handling and Other segments. The company engages in ramp services and baggage handling. It also provides cargo documentation services for airlines import and export facilitation through customs bonded warehouses across the network. In addition the company involved in energy and power distribution and leasing of ground handling equipment. Further the company offers aircraft handling disinfection cleaning and aircraft movement control load control baggage/cargo off and onloading GSE supply and utilization unit load device management and baggage reconciliation services. Additionally it provides cargo handling services including warehousing import cargo bulk breaking cargo delivery and customs control-services; and crew transportation as well as aviation training services. Nigerian Aviation Handling Company Plc was incorporated in 1979 and is headquartered in Lagos Nigeria.

Name: Havanna Holding S.A.
Description: Havanna Holding S.A. through its subsidiaries engages in the operation and franchise of coffee shops in Brazil Peru Paraguay Chile Spain and Bolivia. The company offers caramel cookies havannets cookies mini line chocolates caramel sauce haired lattes and frappes. It also operates bars and cafés. The company is involved in the distribution activities in the United States Colombia Costa Rica El Nicaragua Europe Israel and Australia. Havanna Holding S.A. was founded in 1947 and is based in Buenos Aires Argentina.

Name: Emek Elektrik Endustrisi Anonim Sirketi
Description: Emek Elektrik Endustrisi Anonim Sirketi engages in the production testing marketing and sale of transformers capacitors separators and electromechanical equipment in Turkey. It offers oil type and epoxy resin current and voltage transformers disconnectors with earth knife and without earth blade insulators components grading and coupling capacitors and 1 and 3 phase earth knifes. The company also exports its products. Emek Elektrik Endustrisi Anonim Sirketi was incorporated in 1969 and is based in Ankara Turkey. Emek Elektrik Endustrisi Anonim Sirketi operates as a subsidiary of Emek Elektrik USA Inc.

Name: Profarma Distribuidora de Produtos Farmacêuticos S.A.
Description: Profarma Distribuidora de Produtos Farmacêuticos S.A. together with its subsidiaries engages in the distribution of pharmaceutical products in Brazil. It provides pharmaceutical personal hygiene and beauty products. The company operates retail stores under the Drogasmil Farmalife Drogarias Tamoio and Drogaria Rosário brands. Profarma Distribuidora de Produtos Farmacêuticos S.A. was incorporated in 1961 and is headquartered in Rio De Janeiro Brazil.

Name: MOBI Industry Co.
Description: MOBI Industry Co. manufactures and sells fertilizers and nitrogen compounds in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. It also offers phosphate and potash fertilizers; plastics; household insect and rodenticides; floor glass and furniture polishes and scouring powders; and preparations for perfuming rooms and removing odors. The company also provides soaps and shampoos; industrial detergents and washing and cleaning materials as well as preparations under the Mobi and Shot brand names. In addition it is involved in plastic bottles manufacturing. The company was formerly known as National Fertilizer Company Ltd. and changed its name to MOBI Industry Co. in November 2022. MOBI Industry Co. was founded in 1981 and is based in Riyadh the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

Name: Link Bilgisayar Sistemleri Yazilimi ve Donanimi Sanayi ve Ticaret A.S.
Description: Link Bilgisayar Sistemleri Yazilimi ve Donanimi Sanayi ve Ticaret A.S. operates as a software development company in Turkey. The company offers e-document e-ledger; bank integration software; marketplace integration software; enterprise resource planning software; new generation software for tracking and managing accounting stock current account invoice bill check personnel fixed assets and other processes; techno human resources use for managing and monitoring of human resources and personnel payroll management needs; food production software; and campus software. It also provides organized industry invoicing e-reconciliation e-purchase invoice transfer payment recording device e-export passenger together invoice mandatory bes transactions management güneş warehouse management contractual invoicing e-prescription solution link-POS and link new generation payroll. The company was founded in 1984 and is headquartered in Istanbul Turkey.

Name: Darb Saudi Investment Company
Description: Darb Saudi Investment Company together with its subsidiaries manages and leases residential and non-residential real estates in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. It is also involved in the management and leasing of warehouses; brokerage of real estate; management of properties; and real estate investment and development. In addition the company engages in the construction of buildings; financial service activities; wholesale and retail trade; support functions; residence food and beverage service activities; creative activities arts and entertainment; and usage activities. The company was formerly known as Al-Baha Investment and Development Company and changed its name to Darb Saudi Investment Company in June 2025. Darb Saudi Investment Company was founded in 1992 and is headquartered in Riyadh the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

Name: CI Capital Holding For Financial Investments (S.A.E)
Description: CI Capital Holding For Financial Investments (S.A.E) provides diversified financial services in Egypt and internationally. It offers leasing solutions including finance and operating leases and sale and leaseback for a range of corporate clients and SMEs; microfinance lending; and investment banking platform to provide market leading capital raising mergers and acquisitions (M&A) advisory asset management securities brokerage custody fixed income brokerage and research services. The company also provides ECM advisory services such as advisory on capital structuring and capital market activity through public offerings private placements rights issues and pre-IPO transactions; debt raising debt structuring and restructuring services; asset management products comprising fixed income money market equity balanced indexed and Sharia-compliant funds as well as range of mutual funds and saving plans; institutional and individual clients bookkeeping services; and mortgage finance. It offers its services to a client base that include global and regional institutions and family offices large corporates SMEs and high net worth and individual investors. CI Capital Holding For Financial Investments (S.A.E) was incorporated in 2005 and is headquartered in Sheikh Zayed City Egypt. CI Capital Holding For Financial Investments (S.A.E) operates as a subsidiary of Banque Misr S.A.E.

Name: Britam Holdings Plc
Description: Britam Holdings Plc an investment holding company provides financial solutions in Kenya Uganda Tanzania Rwanda South Sudan Mozambique and Malawi. The company operates in five segments: Life Insurance Business; Non-Life Insurance Business; Asset Management; Property; and Corporate and Other segments. The Life Insurance Business segment provides unit linked products education plans whole life plans and other conventional products; and group life and critical illness products disability products individual pension plans umbrella pension plans and corporate pension plans. Its Non-Life Insurance Business segment offers protection to customers’ assets particularly for personal and commercial business; and aviation engineering fire-domestic risks fire-industrial and commercial risks liability marine motor personal accident theft workmen’s compensation and employer’s liability and miscellaneous insurance. The Asset Management segment offers discretionary/segregated portfolio management and wealth management services as well as unit trust funds. Its Property segment is involved in the purchase and sale of properties as well as buying developing selling and leasing land to third parties. The Corporate and Other segment offers debt-financed investment portfolios. It serves individual and corporate customers through financial advisors partners and digital channels. Britam Holdings Plc was founded in 1965 and is headquartered in Nairobi Kenya.
